analyzed: pratyakṣa kṛtaḥ hi vastu vyavahāraḥ ukta krameṇa tad a tad lakṣaṇa sādhāraṇaḥ na kṣaṇikatva sādhanāya niyamena prabhavati arthakriyā sāmarthyam tu vastu lakṣaṇam abhavat api yatra svayam vartate tatra avaśyam tat an upanīya na svarūpa sattām āviśati tatas sādhana tvena asya prastāvaḥ atra na vastu lakṣaṇa tvena iti sthitam

original: evaṃ jñāne .api svarūpasaṃvedanaṃ sattvāvyabhicārīti sarvaṃ pūrvavat| tadanenāpi viṣayasya sāmarthyasiddhir avyāhateti veditavyam| pareṇa hi paravedane bhrāntiśaṅkāvakāśaḥ| svarūpavedane punaḥ sarvathā tadabhāva eva|

original: atha svavedane vipratipadyeta, tadaikārthasamavāyināpi jñānena vedanasvīkāre .aṅkurādivad eva pareṇāpi svarūpopadhānān na kaścid doṣaḥ| anyathā dṛṣṭārthavyavahārahāniḥ sarvathā prasajyeta|
analyzed: atha sva vedane vipratipadyeta tadā ekārtha samavāyinā api jñānena vedana svīkāre aṅkura ādi vat eva pareṇa api sva rūpa upadhānāt na kaścid doṣaḥ anyathā dṛṣṭārtha vyavahāra hāniḥ sarvathā prasajyeta

original: nanu viṣayajñānayor hetuphalabhāva eva katham avagantavyaḥ, upalambhāt pūrvaṃ viṣayasyānupalambhāt? vyatirekaphalād iti brūmaḥ| sati ca bāhye .arthe sthiretaratvanirṇayārambhaḥ| tasmād arthakriyākārikadambakapakṣīkaraṇavat pramāṇagocaracakrapakṣīkarraṇe .api nāśrayasvarūpadvārā dvividhāpy asiddhir asthirasādhanasya||

original: atha bhāvasāṃvṛtaśaktisamanvayinī kṣaṇikatāpi sāṃvṛtī syān na pāramārthikīti matiḥ, tatrāpy ucyate| iha tattvābhyāso .abhyudayaniḥśreyasaphalahetur iti nityānityādivicāram ārabhante santaḥ, tad aniścaye .abhyāsānupapatteḥ|

original: sa cābhyāso nityeśvarādidattasāhāyakas tannirapekṣo vā tatphalahetuḥ syād itīdṛśi prakaraṇe pramāṇaparīkṣād akṣāṇāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgāvatāraḥ| atra yadi paramapuruṣārthasādhanam aniṣṭaparihāreṇa śaktisthitinānantarīyakatayā saṃvṛtir eveyam, kṣaṇikatāpi saṃvritir evāstu paramapuruṣārthopayogenaiva kṣaṇikatyāyām ādarāt|
analyzed: sa ca abhyāsaḥ nitya īśvara ādi datta sāhāyakaḥ tad nirapekṣaḥ vā tad phala hetuḥ syāt iti īdṛśi prakaraṇe pramāṇa parīkṣāt akṣāṇām kṣaṇabhaṅga avatāraḥ atra yadi parama puruṣa artha sādhanam aniṣṭa parihāreṇa śakti sthitinā ānantarīyaka tayā saṃvṛtiḥ evā iyam kṣaṇikatā api saṃvritiḥ evā astu parama puruṣa artha upayogena eva kṣaṇika tyāyām ādarāt

original: kimātmakaṃ paramārthacintayā yatra na pramāṇaprameyavibhāgaḥ sādhyasādhanavyavahāro vā kaścit? atha paramārthe .apy evaṃ saṃbhavati, tadā tadākṛṣṭaḥ śaktisambhavaḥ, tadanvayī vā ksaṇabhaṅgo na pāramārthikatvam āpatati|
analyzed: kimātmakam paramārtha cintayā yatra na pramāṇa prameya vibhāgaḥ sādhya sādhana vyavahāraḥ vā kaścid atha paramārthe api evam saṃbhavati tadā tad ākṛṣṭaḥ śakti sambhavaḥ tad anvayī vā ksaṇabhaṅgaḥ na pāramārthika tvam āpatati

original: pramāṇaprameyavibhāgādyabhāve tu sarvathā caitanyavāvṛttau svacinmātravyavasthitau vā pakṣadharmatvādyabhāvaniścayakālavat kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir abhavanty api na pīḍayati| tatra kṣaṇikāsiddhir atāttivkīti yas trāsayati, sa svargāpavargaphalaprāptir apārmārthikīti kiṃ na trasyati?
analyzed: pramāṇa prameya vibhāga ādi abhāve tu sarvathā sva cit mātra vyavasthitau vā pakṣa dharma tva ādi abhāva niścaya kāla vat kṣaṇa bhaṅga siddhiḥ abhavantī api na pīḍayati tatra kṣaṇikā siddhiḥ a tāttivkī iti yaḥ trāsayati sa svarga apavarga phala prāptiḥ a pārmārthikī iti kim na trasyati

original: tasmād yāvat sādhyasādhanabhāvavyavahāraḥ tāvat parīkṣākṣam amityeva pāramārthikatvam, mūladūṣaṇaṃ pratisūkṣmavicārāntarasyāsatkalpatvād iti| alam ativistareṇa||
analyzed: tasmāt yāvat sādhya sādhana bhāva vyavahāraḥ tāvat parīkṣā akṣam am iti eva pāramārthika tvam mūla dūṣaṇam prati sūkṣma vicāra antarasya asat kalpa tvāt iti alam ati vistareṇa

original: etena yad asthānābhiniveśinā nyāyabhūṣaṇakāreṇa bhāṣyakārīyaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvadūṣaṇaprabandham utthāpy varṇitam, tat sarvaṃ nirupayogam iti pratipāditam| tathā hi yady etāvataḥ śramasyāsiddhatodbhāvanāyām evopayogaḥ, kim anena kartavyam? asiddhiś ca parihṛtā, puruṣārthasamīhayā vastutattvanirūpaṇapravṛttasya śaktisiddhināntarīyakavyāpāratvāt|
analyzed: etena yat asthāna abhiniveśinā nyāyabhūṣaṇa kāreṇa bhāṣya kārīyam kārya kāraṇa bhāva dūṣaṇa prabandham utthāpi varṇitam tat sarvam nirupayogam iti pratipāditam tathā hi yadi etāvataḥ śramasya asiddha tā udbhāvanāyām eva upayogaḥ kim anena kartavyam asiddhiḥ ca parihṛtā puruṣa artha samīhayā vastu tattva nirūpaṇa pravṛttasya śakti siddhi nāntarīyaka vyāpāra tvāt

original: tata eva tathā kramākramābhyāṃ kāryotpattir vāptety etad apy asiddham iti yad uktaṃ tad api niravakāśam| yad apy anena tat tadāśaṅkyottarābhimānāt paryante sāṃvṛtatvārthakriyāpātāt---
analyzed: tatas eva tathā krama akramābhyām kārya utpattiḥ vāptā iti etat api asiddham iti yat uktam tat api niravakāśam yat api anena tat tad āśaṅkya uttara abhimānāt paryante sāṃvṛta tva artha kriyā pātāt

original: arthakriyāsamarthaṃ yat tad atra paramārthasat| (pra Vā 1.3=pratyakṣa 3)
analyzed: artha kriyā samartham yat tat atra paramārtha sat

original: ityuktivaiyartham udbhāvya likhitam| yathā saṃvṛtyarthakriyāsamartham, tathā tat paramārthasad iti cet---sāmānyāvayavisaṃyogādeḥ kiṃ na tathā sattvam iṣṭam? tasya saṃvṛtyāpy asāmarthyam iti cet---na, anvayavyatirekapratibhāsasyobhayathā tulyatvāt|
analyzed: iti ukti vaiyartham udbhāvya likhitam yathā saṃvṛti arthakriyā samartham tathā tat paramārtha sat iti ced sāmānya avayavi saṃyoga ādeḥ kim na tathā sattvam iṣṭam tasya saṃvṛtya api asāmarthyam iti ced na anvaya vyatireka pratibhāsasya ubhayathā tulya tvāt

original: tathā hi yatra yathra cakṣuḥ pravartate tatra tatra taimirikakeśādivan na stambhādipratibhāso bhavatīti stambhādeḥ sāmarthyagatiḥ| tathā mahipādiṣu gavyādyanvayabuddhir na bhavati| paramāṇumātreṣu saṃyogādirahiteṣu cāvayavisaṃyogabuddhir na bhavatīti sāmānyāder api sāmarthyagatir iti| tad apy asāram|
analyzed: tathā hi cakṣuḥ pravartate tatra tatra taimirika keśa ādi vat na stambha ādi pratibhāsaḥ bhavati iti stambha ādeḥ sāmarthya gatiḥ tathā mahipa ādiṣu gavya ādi anvaya buddhiḥ na bhavati paramāṇu mātreṣu saṃyoga ādi rahiteṣu ca avayavi saṃyoga buddhiḥ na bhavati iti sāmānya ādeḥ api sāmarthya gatiḥ iti tat api asāram

original: na hi saṃvṛtir ity eva parigrahas tyāgo vā, bālasaṃvṛter api grahaṇaprasaṅgāt| paṇḍitasaṃvṛter api paramapuruṣārthasādhanaprabaṇāyās tyāgaprasaṅgāt| avicāritaramyā hi pratītiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ| asti ca bālakasya darpaṇatarlābalīnasatyavad anagraho vicāravidhuraḥ|
analyzed: na hi saṃvṛtiḥ iti eva parigrahaḥ tyāgaḥ vā bāla saṃvṛteḥ api grahaṇa prasaṅgāt paṇḍita saṃvṛteḥ api parama puruṣa artha sādhana prabaṇāyāḥ tyāga prasaṅgāt avicārita ramyā hi pratītiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ asti ca bālakasya anagrahaḥ vicāra vidhuraḥ

original: puruṣārthasādhanagraho vā paṇḍitānāṃ tvadvicāreṇa vidhurito na ca tyājyaḥ, tatparityāge kṣaṇabhaṅgaparīkṣānapekṣāyā iṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: puruṣa artha sādhana grahaḥ vā paṇḍitānām tvad vicāreṇa vidhuritaḥ na ca tyājyaḥ tad parityāge kṣaṇabhaṅga parīkṣā anapekṣāyāḥ iṣṭa tvāt

original: atha bauddhasyāyaṃ vicāro mama tv atrāniṣṭir eva| tato bauddhasyaiva siddhāntavirodhaḥ, sādhanasya ca vādyasiddhitā doṣa iti cet---sa tāvad ayaṃ vicāraḥ pramāṇam apramāṇaṃ vā? pramāṇatve tavaivāyaṃ na mameti vibhāgānupapattiḥ| pratyuta pramāṇād bahirbhāvasvīkāre nādhikāraḥ prativāde .api tavety āyātam|
analyzed: atha bauddhasya ayam vicāraḥ mama tu atra aniṣṭiḥ eva tatas bauddhasya eva siddhānta virodhaḥ sādhanasya ca vādi asiddhitā doṣaḥ iti ced sa tāvat ayam vicāraḥ pramāṇam apramāṇam vā pramāṇa tve tava eva ayam na mama iti vibhāga anupapattiḥ pratyuta pramāṇāt bahirbhāva svīkāre na adhikāraḥ prativāde api tava iti āyātam

original: athāpramāṇam, tadā yadi nāmāgamapradeśapratipādito .arthaḥ kaścin na samarthaḥ prakṛtasya tu na kṣatiḥ tad etad āyātam---

original: ity anena kiṃ navābhidhānam? naiyāyikasya copamānaṃ pramāṇam icchato vaiśeṣikāpekṣayā kathaṃ na siddhāntavirodhaḥ? bhinnaprathānatvaṃ tu samānam| śaktisaṃśrayaś ca na sautrāntikanītim atikramya| yadi tu tatrāpi na syāt śaktisthitiḥ, tadā svapratibhāsamātram ācaṣṭe na bauddhasiddh¯natasthita iti syāt|
analyzed: iti anena kim nava abhidhānam naiyāyikasya ca upamānam pramāṇam icchataḥ vaiśeṣika apekṣayā katham na siddhānta virodhaḥ bhinna prathāna tvam tu samānam śakti saṃśrayaḥ ca na sautrāntika nītim atikramya yadi tu tatra api na syāt śakti sthitiḥ tadā sva pratibhāsa mātram ācaṣṭe na bauddha siddhnata sthitaḥ iti syāt

original: tasmān nayāntaravirodhe .api na siddhāntavirodhayogaḥ| nāpi vādyasiddhiḥ| na ca vastubalapravṛttānumāne śāstrānurodhaḥ kaścit| tadvicāraprāmāṇye tu sāṃvṛtatve .apy arthaśakter avaśyābhyupagantavyatayā tadupanītakṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhibādhitanityābhimatasāmānyasamavāyādikalpanam adharasaṃvṛtitvād bālasaṃvṛtivan nopādeyam arthakriyāśaktau|
analyzed: tasmāt naya antara virodhe api na siddhānta virodha yogaḥ nā api vādi asiddhiḥ na ca vastu bala pravṛtta anumāne śāstra anurodhaḥ kaścid tad vicāra prāmāṇye tu sāṃvṛta tve api arthaśakteḥ avaśya abhyupagantavya tayā tad upanīta kṣaṇa bhaṅga siddhi bādhita nitya abhimata sāmānya samavāya ādi kalpanam adhara saṃvṛti tvāt bāla saṃvṛti vat nā upādeyam arthakriyāśaktau

original: aśaktau svaviṣayajñānajanane .apy ayogyasya sattvābhyupagamaḥ saṃvṛtir astu kiṃ tv adharato .apy adhareti niścayaḥ| ata evādharādharasaṃvṛtyapekṣayottarottrāsu parmārthatvena vyavasthāpyamānāvaśyaābhyupagantavyā, niruttarārthakriyaiva saṃvṛtiḥ parmārtha iti tayā sat paramārthasad ucyate|
analyzed: aśaktau sva viṣaya jñāna janane api ayogyasya sattva abhyupagamaḥ saṃvṛtiḥ astu kim tu adharatas api adharā iti niścayaḥ atas eva adhara adhara saṃvṛti apekṣayā uttarottrāsu parma artha tvena vyavasthāpyamānā avaśyā abhyupagantavyā niruttara artha kriyā eva saṃvṛtiḥ parma arthaḥ iti tayā sat paramārtha sat ucyate

original: tathā hi bālasya darpaṇatale vadanagraham apekṣayāsad eva vadanam atra khyātīti paramārtha iti ucyate| tadapekṣayā ca darpaṇapratihativyāvṛttyā netrāṃśavaḥ svamukham eva gṛhṇātīti paramārthaḥ| evam uttarottaraparikalpeṣu balavatsu pūrvapūrvaḥ saṃvṛtir uttarotttaraḥ paramārtho yāvad arthakriyāsthitiḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi bālasya darpaṇa tale vadana graham apekṣayā asat eva vadanam atra khyāti iti paramārthaḥ iti ucyate tad apekṣayā ca darpaṇa pratihati vyāvṛttyā netra aṃśavaḥ sva mukham eva gṛhṇāti iti paramārthaḥ evam uttara uttara parikalpeṣu balavatsu pūrva pūrvaḥ saṃvṛtiḥ uttara uttaraḥ paramārthaḥ yāvat arthakriyā sthitiḥ

original: tadatikrame hi grāhyagrāhakabhaṅgād āyātaṃ pratibhāsamātravyavasthānam iti kva saṃvṛter vārtā? tasmāt saṃvṛtīnām antimārthakriyāśaktir eva paramārthaśabdavācyeti na saṃvṛtimātratvena sāmānyādisaṃvṛtis tatkalām adhirohati|
analyzed: tad atikrame hi grāhya grāhaka bhaṅgāt āyātam pratibhāsa mātra vyavasthānam iti kva saṃvṛteḥ vārtā tasmāt saṃvṛtīnām antima artha kriyā śaktiḥ eva paramārtha śabda vācyā iti na saṃvṛti mātra tvena sāmānya ādi saṃvṛtiḥ tad kalām adhirohati

original: tadvicāraprāmāṇyaṃ tu gajanimīlitakayāvadhīrya tattvata eva śaktiḥ paramārthas tatra tatrocyate, sāmānyādayaś ca saṃvṛitsanta iti| evam avayavisaṃyogādayo .api saṃvṛtisantas tadvad ubhayathā veditavyāḥ śakteḥ paramārthatayā nityatābhyupagamatvāt kṣaṇashitidharmatāyāḥ|
analyzed: tad vicāra prāmāṇyam tu gaja nimīlitakayā avadhīrya tattvataḥ eva śaktiḥ paramārthaḥ tatra tatra ucyate sāmānya ādayaḥ ca saṃvṛitsante iti evam avayavi saṃyoga ādayaḥ api saṃvṛti santaḥ tadvat ubhayathā veditavyāḥ śakteḥ paramārtha tayā nitya tā abhyupagama tvāt kṣaṇa shiti dharma tāyāḥ

original: aṇava eva hi viśiṣṭotpannā dravyadvayaṃ vā saṃyogaśūnyaṃ tattadbuddhisādhanam iti kim avayavyādinā? tat kathaṃ sāmānyādiparigrahaḥ saṃvṛtimātratvenārthakriyā samīkriyate| yadi ca tāvataiva sāmyaṃ kim upapatighoṣaṇena? mā bhūd adharasaṃvṛtitvam iti [niyamo]panyāsaḥ| tac ca śaktisamanvayinaḥ tadādhārasya vā kṣaṇabhaṅgasaṅgamena durnivāram|
analyzed: aṇavaḥ eva hi viśiṣṭa utpannāḥ dravya dvayam vā saṃyoga śūnyam tat tat buddhi sādhanam iti kim avayavi ādinā tat katham sāmānya ādi parigrahaḥ saṃvṛti mātra tvena arthakriyā samīkriyate yadi ca tāvatā eva sāmyam kim upapati ghoṣaṇena mā bhūt adhara saṃvṛti tvam iti niyama upanyāsaḥ tat ca śakti samanvayinaḥ tad ādhārasya vā kṣaṇabhaṅga saṅgamena durnivāram

original: yathoktaṃ prāk śaktisamanvayābhāve tadādhārasyāpi saṃvṛtisattve kutas taddharmasya sāmānyāder adharasaṃvṛtitvaparihāraḥ? tasmāt saṃvṛtimātratvam eva sāmyam| tatra cokto doṣaḥ| yā ceyam upapattir buddhivyatireko nāma sāpy apohe cintayiṣyate|
analyzed: yathā uktam prāk śakti samanvaya abhāve tad ādhārasya api saṃvṛti sattve kutas tad dharmasya sāmānya ādeḥ adhara saṃvṛti tva parihāraḥ tasmāt saṃvṛti mātra tvam eva sāmyam tatra ca uktaḥ doṣaḥ yā ca iyam upapattiḥ buddhi vyatirekaḥ nāma sā api apohe cintayiṣyate

original: [p. 8] yac cedam amūce---kiṃ ca yady anirūpitatattvā pratītiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ, tata eva kāryakāraṇavyavasthitir iṣṭā, tathā saty akṣaṇikānām eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sarvavyavahāriprasiddho .anvartho jñeyaḥ, kiṃ tatra sūkṣmavicāreṇeti---tad apy ayuktam|
analyzed: ca idam ca yadi anirūpita tattvā pratītiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ tatas eva kārya kāraṇa vyavasthitiḥ iṣṭā tathā sati akṣaṇikānām eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sarva vyavahāri prasiddhaḥ anvarthaḥ jñeyaḥ kim tatra sūkṣma vicāreṇa iti tat api ayuktam

original: tathā hi yas tāvat tattvata eva kṣaṇabhaṅgurabhāvagrāmsasādhanāya sādhanam āha sautrāntikaḥ, svacinmātrāsthitau sādhanadūṣaṇāvadhānābhāvāt tasya tāttvikam eva sāmarthyaṃ trividhaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhopalabhyam|
analyzed: tathā hi yaḥ tāvat tattvataḥ eva sādhanam āha sautrāntikaḥ sva cit mātra sthitau sādhana dūṣaṇa avadhāna abhāvāt tasya tāttvikam eva sāmarthyam trividham pratyakṣa anupalambha upalabhyam

original: kathaṃ tasyāyam upalāmbhaḥ? paraviṣayapramāṇopasthāpitam anyaṃ vā parihṛtya katham āsitum asau samarthaḥ? tāvatā ca tāttvikī kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir akṣaṇikānām eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ sāṃvṛtam upapādayati iti kim asyāṅgīkaraṇaprayāsena? na ca vicāraḥ parisphurann eva parihartuṃ śakyaḥ, chāyādravyatādiniṣedheśvarasiddhyādiṣv apy anādaraprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: katham tasya ayam upalāmbhaḥ para viṣaya pramāṇa upasthāpitam anyam vā parihṛtya katham āsitum asau samarthaḥ tāvatā ca tāttvikī kṣaṇa bhaṅga siddhiḥ akṣaṇikānām eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvam sāṃvṛtam upapādayati iti kim asya aṅgīkaraṇa prayāsena na ca vicāraḥ parisphuran eva parihartum śakyaḥ chāyā dravya tā ādi niṣedha īśvara siddhi ādiṣu api anādara prasaṅgāt

original: tadaniṣṭavādinaḥ pratītasyāpi vicārasya sūkṣmatvād iti kṛtam idānīṃ śāstraparamparāpariśrameṇa| tataś ca kiṃ tatra sūkṣmavicāreṇeti vimucya vicāraś cārurasau na bhavati, yenākṣaṇikakṣepa iti vaktum ucitam| tac ca na pratijñāmātreṇa sidhyati| asmābhis tu nityam atyetuṃ sādhanam upanyastam| na ca tatra doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tad aniṣṭa vādinaḥ pratītasya api vicārasya sūkṣma tvāt iti kṛtam idānīm śāstra paramparā pariśrameṇa tatas ca kim tatra sūkṣma vicāreṇa iti vimucya vicāraḥ cāruḥ asau na bhavati yena akṣaṇika kṣepaḥ iti vaktum ucitam tat ca na pratijñā mātreṇa sidhyati asmābhiḥ tu nityam atyetum sādhanam upanyastam na ca tatra doṣaḥ

original: atha prastutasūkṣmavicārādare sūkṣmavicārāntarasyāpy avakāśaprasaṅgo doṣa eva| yad āha---sūkṣmekṣikayā hi kāryakāraṇabhāvād bheda eva syāt, tvaduktāt nyāyād iti| idam api śraddhājaḍasyaiva śobhate| yāvad dhi bhāvānām arthakriyāśaktiparityāgaṃ na sahāmahe tāvad avyāhataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgāṅgīkāro nityanigrahaś ca|
analyzed: atha prastuta sūkṣma vicāra ādare sūkṣma vicāra antarasya api avakāśa prasaṅgaḥ doṣaḥ eva yat āha sūkṣma īkṣikayā hi kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt bhedaḥ eva syāt tvad uktāt nyāyāt iti idam api śraddhā jaḍasya eva śobhate yāvat hi bhāvānām artha kriyā śakti parityāgam na sahāmahe tāvat avyāhataḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga aṅgīkāraḥ nitya nigrahaḥ ca

original: yadā tu śaktivivecanavicārāntare ca balavati cetaḥ kramiṣyate tadā kṣaṇikatāvimokṣam apīty akṣamaḥ, samānatvād daṇḍasya| na caiva.śakter upagamo nityatām anityatāṃ ca pratyujjīvayitu.śaknoti, asādhāraṇatvāt| tathā hi na khalu śaktir iti pramāṇaśūnyam eva kiñcit kvacit kadācid astīty avimokṣaḥ|
analyzed: yadā tu śakti vivecana vicāra antare ca balavati cetaḥ kramiṣyate tadā kṣaṇikatā vimokṣam api iti akṣamaḥ samāna tvāt daṇḍasya na ca eva śakteḥ upagamaḥ nitya tām anitya tām ca asādhāraṇa tvāt tathā hi na khalu śaktiḥ iti pramāṇa śūnyam eva kiñcid kvacid kadācid asti iti avimokṣaḥ

original: kiṃtarhi etadbījādikam aṅkurādisamartham ity anenākāreṇa pratyakṣaprativedyatayaiva| tac ca pratyakṣaṃ yathānvayavyatireke pramāṇam iṣṭaṃ tathā kāryāṇāṃ krmītaratve .apīty evaṃ prakāreṇa nyāyena śaktiḥ kṣaṇikatāyāṃ viśrāmyantī na nityasādhāraṇīti [p.9] katham ubhayor api pratyujjīvanam? tad eva.balavati hetuphalatābhraṃśaśaṃsini vicāre śaktisiddhā
analyzed: kim tarhi etat bīja ādikam aṅkura ādi samartham iti anena ākāreṇa pratyakṣa prativedya tayā eva tat ca pratyakṣam yathā anvaya vyatireke pramāṇam iṣṭam tathā kāryāṇām krmī itaratve api iti evam prakāreṇa nyāyena śaktiḥ kṣaṇikatāyām viśrāmyantī na nitya sādhāraṇī iti katham ubhayoḥ api pratyujjīvanam tat eva balavati hetu phala tā bhraṃśa śaṃsini vicāre śakti siddhā

original: kṣaṇikataivāsti| sā saṃvṛtiḥ| nityatā tv adharasaṃvṛtir eveti sāmānyavad bhāvyam| tadvicārabalane tu na kiñcid āśaṃkāsthānam iti siddhaiva śaktiḥ|
analyzed: kṣaṇikatā evā asti sā saṃvṛtiḥ nityatā tu adhara saṃvṛtiḥ evā iti sāmānya vat bhāvyam tad vicāra balane tu na kiñcid āśaṃkā sthānam iti siddhā eva śaktiḥ

original: tat katham ucyate---tathāpy asiddhatvān na sattvena kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| nāpy arthakriyāyāḥ kramākramābhyāṃ vyāptisiddhir iti, sāṃvṛtaśaktipakṣe .api nirvāhasya darśitatvāt?
analyzed: tat katham ucyate tathā api asiddha tvāt na sattvena kṣaṇika tva siddhiḥ nā api arthakriyāyāḥ kramākramābhyām vyāpti siddhiḥ iti sāṃvṛta śakti pakṣe api nirvāhasya darśita tvāt

original: nanu yathā saṃvṛtau paramapuruṣārthaṃ prārthayamānasyopāyānveṣaṇapraṛttasya nārthaśaktim anāśritya sthātuṃ śaktiḥ, tathā mayā tatphalalābhinā bhāvyam ity upāyanveṣaṇān nityatāgraho .apy avaśyam āyāta iti nityo .api tatsaṃvṛtisan na bhavatu katham adharasaṃvṛtiviṣayaḥ? nityātmā tu cintāntaram arhati|
analyzed: nanu yathā saṃvṛtau parama puruṣa artham prārthayamānasya upāya anveṣaṇa praṛttasya na artha śaktim an āśritya sthātum śaktiḥ tathā mayā tad phala lābhinā bhāvyam iti upāya nveṣaṇāt nityatā grahaḥ api avaśyam āyātaḥ iti nityaḥ api tad saṃvṛti san na bhavatu katham adhara saṃvṛti viṣayaḥ nitya ātmā tu cintā antaram arhati

original: na ca tanmātreṇopagamārhaḥ, yataḥ saṃvṛtiviśeṣaviṣayaḥ syāt| evaṃ śaktigraho .anveṣaṇe prayojako .astu| śaktyā kiṃ kartavyam iti abhidadhīta nāma| na tu śaktivyatikramo .anena vacasā dalitaḥ, śaktigrahasyopāyānveṣaṇahetutvasvīkārāt| na tv evam ātmani śakyam| śaktigraho .api saṃvṛttyaiva prayojaka iti cet astu saṃvṛttyā tattvena vā|
analyzed: na ca tanmātreṇa upagama arhaḥ yatas saṃvṛti viśeṣa viṣayaḥ syāt evam śakti grahaḥ anveṣaṇe prayojakaḥ astu śaktyā kim kartavyam iti abhidadhīta nāma na tu śakti vyatikramaḥ anena vacasā dalitaḥ śakti grahasya upāya anveṣaṇa hetu tva svīkārāt na tu evam ātmani śakyam śakti grahaḥ api saṃvṛttyā eva prayojakaḥ iti ced astu saṃvṛttyā tattvena vā anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra anyatra

original: śaktisiddhau ca punar ātmagrahasyāpi prayojakatvasiddher nāvaśyam ātmasiddher ākṣepa iti| nirṇayāpekṣaṇe kṣaṇikatvasiddhis tadbādhanīty uktaprāyam| hetuphalagrahaṇe vyavasthitapratisandhātṛsiddhivādas tu prastopyate .anekāntacintāyām|
analyzed: śakti siddhau ca punar ātma grahasya api prayojaka tva siddheḥ na avaśyam ātma siddheḥ ākṣepaḥ iti nirṇaya apekṣaṇe kṣaṇika tva siddhiḥ tad bādhanī iti ukta prāyam hetu phala grahaṇe vyavasthita pratisandhātṛ siddhi vādaḥ tu prastopyate anekāntacintāyām

original: tad apīdam uktam, sūkṣmekṣikayāpi tvanmatat eva kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavati, anyenānyasyāpratibaddhasya grahaṇānabhyupagamāt| pratibandhaś ca dviṣṭhaḥ pratyakṣeṇādvayagrāhiṇā na gṛhyata ity anumānasya tatrāpravṛtteḥ| asmanmate tu kāryakāraṇabhāvasyāpi na grahaṇānupapattiḥ, pratyakṣasyaikakṣaṇaviṣayatvaniyamānabhyupagamāt|
analyzed: tat api idam uktam sūkṣmekṣikayā api tvad matat eva kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇam naṣṭam bhavati anyena anyasya apratibaddhasya grahaṇa anabhyupagamāt pratibandhaḥ ca dviṣṭhaḥ pratyakṣeṇa advaya grāhiṇā na gṛhyate iti anumānasya tatra apravṛtteḥ asmad mate tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya api na grahaṇa anupapattiḥ pratyakṣasya eka kṣaṇa viṣaya tva niyama anabhyupagamāt

original: tatha ca vyāptigrahaṇasamarthanaprastāve .asmadādipratyakṣam apy atītānāgatādiviṣayaṃ kadācid adṛṣṭādihetuvaśāt pravartata iti samarthitam| na hy anyathā kāraṇatāvādapratītiḥ saṃbhavatīti| [p.10] tad api sakalaṃ viphalam| tathā hi pareṇa parasya vedanaṃ tāvad ubhayor api kṣaṇiketaravādinor iṣṭam|
analyzed: ca vyāpti grahaṇa samarthana prastāve asmat ādi pratyakṣam api atīta anāgata ādi viṣayam kadācid adṛṣṭa ādi hetu vaśāt pravartate iti samarthitam na hi anyathā kāraṇatā vāda pratītiḥ saṃbhavati iti tat api sakalam viphalam tathā hi pareṇa parasya vedanam tāvat ubhayoḥ api kṣaṇika itara vādinoḥ iṣṭam

original: tatra ca yadi pratyakṣeṇādvayagrahaṇaṃ nāma, nyāyaviruddham etat| dvayagrahaṇam eva nyāyyam| tathā ca sati kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇasya na vyāghātaḥ| kṣaṇabhaṅgavādy api tathopagacchan kiyatīṃ kṣatim āsādayet| na hy adṛṣṭam aniṣṭam evāsya|
analyzed: tatra ca yadi pratyakṣeṇa advaya grahaṇam nāma nyāya viruddham etat dvaya grahaṇam eva nyāyyam tathā ca sati kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇasya na vyāghātaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅga vādī api tathā upagacchan kiyatīm kṣatim āsādayet na hi adṛṣṭam aniṣṭam eva asya

analyzed: pūrvam api eṣa siddhāntam sva icchayā eva gṛhītavān

analyzed: kathñcid anyam SAM sa SNM punar  grahītum In labhate SPr3In na  kim SANe

original: atha kathañcid advyagrahaṇam eva nyāyam, tadā tadviparītaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇapravaṇam api tvadiṣṭimātraṃ kutropayogi?
analyzed: atha kathañcid a dvi a grahaṇam eva nyāyam tadā tad viparītam kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇa pravaṇam api tvad iṣṭi mātram kutra upayogi

original: atha kṣaṇabhaṅgavāde kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇam api na prāpnotīty ākūtam, tarhy asti kāryakāraṇabhāva iti virodha udbhāvyatām, nāsiddhiḥ| tatra ca vakṣyāmaḥ|
analyzed: atha kṣaṇabhaṅga vāde kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇam api na prāpnoti iti ākūtam tarhi asti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti virodhaḥ udbhāvyatām na asiddhiḥ tatra ca vakṣyāmaḥ

original: yad apīdam uktam anādivāsanāta eveyaṃ pratītir iti cet---na, atrāpi pramāṇābhāvād iti, tatrāpi kāyacittavyatiriktātmadravyasamavāye vastvantaradharmādharmalakṣaṇaguṇaprasādhakam ayaṃ pramāṇam upanyasituṃ śakto nāparaś cetaḥśaktiviśeṣaḥ karmety asya prasādhakam iti mahatī śraddhā| cittaśaktir eva hi vāsanety abhidhīyate|
analyzed: yat api idam uktam anādi vāsanātaḥ evā iyam pratītiḥ iti ced na atra api pramāṇa abhāvāt iti tatra api kāya citta vyatirikta ātma dravya samavāye vastu antara dharma adharma lakṣaṇa guṇa prasādhakam ayam pramāṇam upanyasitum śaktaḥ na aparaḥ cetaḥ śakti viśeṣaḥ karma iti asya prasādhakam iti mahatī śraddhā citta śaktiḥ eva hi vāsanā iti abhidhīyate

original: tasmād asaṃsṛṣṭakṣaṇamātravedanavādino hi vyavahārasyānādir abhyāsaḥ| tato vāsanā| tato mithyā pratītir iti| etat sarvam andhaparamparāvad apramāṇakam ity api dhandhāndhavilasitam iti mantavyam| asaṃsṛṣṭakṣaṇamātravedanavādī hi prastutaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgavādī sautrāntika ity arthaḥ| tasya kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītiḥ mithyā pratītir iti mahatī bhrāntiḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt asaṃsṛṣṭa kṣaṇa mātra vedana vādinaḥ hi vyavahārasya anādiḥ abhyāsaḥ tatas vāsanā tatas mithyā pratītiḥ iti etat sarvam andha paramparā vat apramāṇakam iti api dhandhāndhavilasitam iti mantavyam asaṃsṛṣṭa kṣaṇa mātra vedana vādī hi prastutaḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga vādī sautrāntikaḥ iti arthaḥ tasya kārya kāraṇa bhāva pratītiḥ mithyā pratītiḥ iti mahatī bhrāntiḥ

original: kāryakāraṇabhāvāpalāpī tu yogācāraḥ svasaṃvinmātravedanavādīti vaditum ucitam| na ca tasya dūṣaṇena kṣaṇabhaṅgavādinaḥ kiñcit| hetuphahāpalāpino .api yadi tadapalāpāya nyāyasaṃbhavaḥ, tadā tad api na dūram iti kim atra nirbandhaneneti| sthitam etat yadi kāryakriyāśaktis tāttvikī, taditarā vā| ubhayathāpi nāsiddhidūṣaṇāvatāra iti||
analyzed: kārya kāraṇa bhāva apalāpī tu yoga ācāraḥ sva saṃvid mātra vedana vādī iti vaditum ucitam na ca tasya dūṣaṇena kṣaṇabhaṅga vādinaḥ kiñcid api yadi tad apalāpāya nyāya saṃbhavaḥ tadā tat api na dūram iti kim atra nirbandhanena iti sthitam etat yadi kārya kriyāśaktiḥ tāttvikī tad itarā vā ubhayathā api nā asiddhi dūṣaṇa avatāraḥ iti

original: pakṣadharmatādhikāro nāma prathamaḥ pādaḥ||
analyzed: pakṣadharmatādhikāraḥ nāma prathamaḥ pādaḥ

original: [11,1] [kṣaṇabhaṅgādhyāye]

original: [11,3] nāpy ayaṃ viruddho hetuḥ, sapakṣīkṛto jalabhṛti darśanāt, sādhyaviparyasya vyāptilakṣaṇasya viruddhasya sādhyavati darśanānupapatteḥ | nanu sāhasam etat, kvacid api dhiyaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgagocarīkaraṇasāmarthyānupalabdheḥ, tathāvasāyābhāvāt | na ca pramāṇabalāvalambanād ambude kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: na api ayam viruddhaḥ hetuḥ sapakṣīkṛtaḥ jalabhṛti darśanāt sādhya viparyasya vyāpti lakṣaṇasya viruddhasya sādhyavati darśana anupapatteḥ nanu sāhasam etat kvacid api dhiyaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅga gocarīkaraṇa sāmarthya anupalabdheḥ tathā avasāya abhāvāt na ca pramāṇa bala avalambanāt ambude kṣaṇabhaṅga siddhiḥ

original: pratyakṣato hi sa eva ayaṃ toyada iti pratyabhijñānam asya kālāntarasthāyitām evopasthāpayati | tadbādhitatvāc cānumānam anavakāśam | na cānumānam anyad asti | sattvānumāne ca punar nirdarśanāntara samīkṣāyām anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ | tasmāt sapakṣe 'darśanāt na virodhaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: pratyakṣataḥ hi saḥ eva ayam toyadaḥ iti pratyabhijñānam asya kāla antara sthāyi tām eva upasthāpayati tad bādhita tvāt ca anumānam anavakāśam na ca anumānam anyat asti sattva anumāne ca punar nirdarśana antara samīkṣāyām anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt sapakṣe darśanāt na virodha parihāraḥ

original: ataś ca bādhakābhāve 'pi nāmāprāmāṇyavyavahāro 'śakyasādhanaḥ | tad-vad eva saṃvādena prāmāṇyam anuaśāsataḥ tad-abhāvāt prāmāṇyavyavahāro 'pi kutaḥ pratyabhijñāyāḥ? ubayaniścayābhāve ca tad-ubhayāvalambī saṃśayaḥ siddhaḥ | tal-lakṣaṇe kadalakāṇṭādau vyabhicāradarśanāt paripṛṣṭāniṣṭāṅgaś ca | tat-kutaḥ prāmāṇyam?
analyzed: atas ca bādhaka abhāve pi nāma aprāmāṇya vyavahāraḥ śakya sādhanaḥ tadvat eva saṃvādena prāmāṇyam tad abhāvāt prāmāṇya vyavahāraḥ pi kutas pratyabhijñāyāḥ ubaya niścaya abhāve ca tad ubhaya avalambī saṃśayaḥ siddhaḥ tad lakṣaṇe kadala kāṇṭa ādau vyabhicāra darśanāt paripṛṣṭa aniṣṭa aṅgaḥ ca tat kutas prāmāṇyam

original: atha pramāṇaviṣayatvamātraṃ prameyatvam, tac ca vyabhicāriṇo 'py akṣīṇam | evaṃ tarhi pūrvāpraikīkaraṇamātraṃ pratyabhijñārthaḥ | tac ca vyabhicāriṇyā apy asti | pratyabhijñā nāma kriyātāṃ mā vā, kevalaṃ sā pramāṇam eva na bhavatīti vaktavyam | prameyatvam api yad-vyabhicāri, tat liṅgam eva na bhavatīty api brūhi |

original: ekalakṣaṇatayā yathaikatra vyabhicāras tathānyatrāpi saṃbhavan na nivāryata iti pratyabhijñāne 'pi nāśakyam || nanv agnir atrety anumānam ananumānaṃ ca hetvābhāsakāle samānākāram | tat-kathamekatrāśvaso nānyatra? hetu-dvāreṇa viśeṣāt |
analyzed: eka lakṣaṇa tayā yathā ekatra vyabhicāraḥ tathā anyatra api saṃbhavan na nivāryate iti pratyabhijñāne na aśakyam nanu agniḥ atrā iti anumānam ananumānam ca hetvābhāsa kāle samāna ākāram tat katham ekatra āśvasaḥ na anyatra hetu dvāreṇa viśeṣāt

original: yathā hi ekaṃ tri-rūpaliṅganiścayajanitam anyad anyathā, yathā kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītir eva kācit pariśuddhā yā adhyakṣānupalabdhi-sādhanā, kācid anyatheti darśitam | tathā ca sati bhinnalakṣaṇatvāt nāśvāsānāśvāsasaṅkaraḥ | tathā na pratyabhijñāyāṃ śakyam, anupahatendriyasyeva tajjñānasya vā vyabhicāriṇyām api vyāpārāt |
analyzed: yathā hi ekam trirūpa liṅga niścaya janitam anyat anyathā yathā kārya kāraṇa bhāva pratītiḥ eva kācid pariśuddhā yā adhyakṣa anupalabdhi sādhanā kācid anyathā iti darśitam tathā ca sati bhinna lakṣaṇa tvāt na āśvāsa anāśvāsa saṅkaraḥ tathā na pratyabhijñāyām śakyam anupahata indriyasya iva tad jñānasya vā vyabhicāriṇyām api vyāpārāt

original: [16] vyāmohād adṛṣṭādi-hetuprabhāvād viparyayasāmagrī-samavadhānaparilambe 'py upapattimat,yathoktaṃ prāk | yad vā yataḥ kutaścit parokṣārthapratipattim anumānam anumatya yatra vyabhicāraḥ, tal-liṅgam eva na bhavati, anumānaṃ veti nirvṛttim ālambamānaḥ pakṣadharmatvādikaṃ liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ tat-prabhavam anumānaṃ kiṃ artham abhidadhyāt?
analyzed: vyāmohāt adṛṣṭa ādi hetu prabhāvāt viparyaya sāmagrī samavadhāna parilambe pi upapattimati atha uktam prāk yat vā yatas kutaścid parokṣa artha pratipattim anumānam anumatya yatra vyabhicāraḥ tad liṅgam eva na bhavati anumānam vā iti nirvṛttim ālambamānaḥ pakṣa dharma tva ādikam liṅga lakṣaṇam tad prabhavam anumānam kim artham abhidadhyāt

original: atha vyabhicāriṇo 'pi vyabhicāradarśanam asamartham, sāmagrī-lābhavilambe vyabhicārādadarśanamātreṇa liṅgatvaprasaṅgād vaktavyam eva lakṣaṇam, yad-īkṣaṇān nirvṛttir anīkṣaṇād anāśvāsaś ca jāyate? tato na prekṣas tad-anurūpānuṣṭhāna prārambham āsādayet |
analyzed: atha vyabhicāriṇaḥ vyabhicāra darśanam asamartham sāmagrī lābha vilambe vyabhicārāt adarśana mātreṇa liṅga tva prasaṅgāt vaktavyam eva lakṣaṇam yat īkṣaṇāt nirvṛttiḥ an īkṣaṇāt anāśvāsaḥ ca jāyate tatas na prekṣaḥ prārambham āsādayet

original: santi hi pratyanīkadarśanasthānāṃ sādhanāni cirakākābhyāsabhavitā samasamādhi-balonmīlad adhyakṣagocaravyabhicārāṇi kṣaṇikatādi-sādhanavat | tat-kim idānīṃ vyabhicārād adarśanamātreṇa bhāvinyāḥ pramāṇānupapatteḥ sādhanāny eva bhavantu tad-anurūpānuṣṭhānena (7b) vā viphalamāyā-samāviśatu prekṣaḥ |
analyzed: santi hi pratyanīka darśana sthānām sādhanāni cira kāka abhyāsa bhavitā sama samādhi bala unmīlat adhyakṣa gocara vyabhicārāṇi kṣaṇikatā ādi sādhana vat tat kim idānīm vyabhicārāt adarśana mātreṇa bhāvinyāḥ pramāṇa anupapatteḥ sādhanāni eva bhavantu tad anurūpa anuṣṭhānena vā viphalam āyāsam āviśatu prekṣaḥ

original: pakṣadharmatvādilakṣaṇe tu tal-lakṣaṇanirūpaṇāyāṃ tad-aprāptau tadaiva hastakatyāgān nāyā-samāviśati | tal-lakṣaṇaprāptau vā tad eva upādadīta | tan na vyabhicārāvalambanaṃ sādhu, vyatirekanirākaraṇāyaiva vivekārambhāt ||
analyzed: pakṣa dharma tva ādi lakṣaṇe tu tad lakṣaṇa nirūpaṇāyām tad aprāptau tadā eva hastaka tyāgāt na āyāsam āviśati tad lakṣaṇa prāptau vā tat eva upādadīta tat na vyabhicāra avalambanam sādhu vyatireka nirākaraṇāya eva viveka ārambhāt

original: tat-kathaṃ lakṣaṇam avācyam iti cet, etat sarvaṃ pratyabhijñāyām api ālocayan yāvan na lakṣaṇabhedaṃ paśyasi, tāvannaikasyāṃ vyabhicārādarśī vyabhicārād adarśanamātreṇāparasyām āśvāsam ekāntena kartum arhasi | tasmāl lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsaṃbhave tal-lakṣaṇam eva dūṣitaṃ syād iti sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ |
analyzed: tat katham lakṣaṇam avācyam iti ced etat sarvam pratyabhijñāyām api ālocayan yāvat na lakṣaṇa bhedam paśyasi tāvat na ekasyām vyabhicāra adarśī vyabhicārāt adarśana mātreṇa aparasyām āśvāsam ekāntena kartum arhasi tasmāt lakṣaṇa yukte bādhā asaṃbhave tad lakṣaṇam eva dūṣitam syāt iti sarvatra anāśvāsaḥ

original: tad iyaṃ pratyabhijñā vyapanayatu vyabhicāraśaṅkāṃ, kalaṅkitā tayā na kālāntarasthitim arthasya sthāpayituṃ prabhavati, nāpy anumānam anavakāśayitum | tat-kathaṃ tad-apekṣayā pratyakṣabādhitaḥ pakṣa ucyate? sapakṣe vā jaladhare katham anvayābhāvaḥ?
analyzed: tat iyam pratyabhijñā vyapanayatu vyabhicāra śaṅkām kalaṅki tā tayā na kāla antara sthitim arthasya sthāpayitum prabhavati na api anumānam an avakāśayitum tat katham tad apekṣayā pratyakṣa bādhitaḥ pakṣaḥ ucyate sapakṣe vā jaladhare katham anvaya abhāvaḥ

original: atha mā bhūt pratyabhijñāyāḥ prāmāṇyam, tad-anusārī sthiratāniścayo vā | kṣaṇikatvāvadhāraṇaṃ tu sapakṣīkṛte kathaṃ yataḥ sapakṣe sattvaṃ hetor upapadyate? ucyate, iha jaladharasya jaladhāraṇakriyā-samarthas tāvad ekārthasvabhāvo 'śakyaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: atha mā bhūt pratyabhijñāyāḥ prāmāṇyam tad anusārī sthira tā niścayaḥ vā kṣaṇika tva avadhāraṇam tu sapakṣīkṛte katham yatas sapakṣe sattvam hetoḥ upapadyate ucyate iha jaladharasya jala dhāraṇa kriyā samarthaḥ tāvat śakya parihāraḥ

original: kṣaṇāntare ca dvitīyādau tat-kriyāyāḥ kṛtatvāt punaḥ kartum aśakyatvāt taj-jātīyām anyajātīyāṃ vā kuryāt | na kuryād vā kām api kriyām iti pakṣaḥ | evaṃ tat kriyā-karaṇakṣaṇāt prāg api
analyzed: kṣaṇa antare ca dvitīya ādau tad kriyāyāḥ kṛta tvāt punar kartum aśakya tvāt tad jātīyām anya jātīyām vā kuryāt na kuryāt vā kām api kriyām iti pakṣaḥ evam tat kriyā karaṇa kṣaṇāt prāk api

original: [17] vaktavyam | tatra yadi tat-karaṇasamarthasvabhāvo 'mbhodharaḥ, tat-kṣaṇavat kṣaṇāntare 'pi kathaṃ kadācit kriyā-vicchedaḥ? kṣaṇāntaranivartanīyakriyā-samarthasvabhāvatve vā kṣaṇāntaravat tatrāpi kṣaṇe sajātīyetarakriyā-prasavaprasaṅgaḥ | kṣaṇāntare 'pi hi tac chāmarthyasya saṃbhavāj jananaṃ tac cānyadāpy akṣīṇam |
analyzed: vaktavyam tatra yadi tad karaṇa samartha svabhāvaḥ mbhodharaḥ tad kṣaṇa vat kṣaṇa antare pi katham kadācid kriyā vicchedaḥ kṣaṇa antara nivartanīya kriyā samartha svabhāva tve vā kṣaṇa antara vat tatra api kṣaṇe sajātīya itara kriyā prasava prasaṅgaḥ kṣaṇa antare pi hi tat śāmarthyasya saṃbhavāt jananam tat ca anyadā api akṣīṇam

original: kāryāṇi hi vilambante kāraṇāsannidhānataḥ |
analyzed: kāryāṇi hi vilambante kāraṇa asannidhānataḥ

original: samarthahetu-sadbhāve kṣepas teṣāṃ tu kiṃ kṛtaḥ || (TS 395)
analyzed: samartha hetu sadbhāve kṣepaḥ teṣām tu kim  kṛtaḥ SNPaM

original: etenākaraṇapakṣo 'pi pratikṣiptaḥ | yadā vilambo 'py asahyaḥ, tadā dūrotsāritam akaraṇam | asāmarthye vā samīhitasamaye 'py akaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, sadaikasvabhāvatvāt | svabhāvabhraṃśe ca prati-kṣaṇaṃ kṣayaḥ siddho jaladharasya | tatra prayogaḥ, yad yadā yaj jananasamarthaṃ tat tadā taj janayaty eva |
analyzed: etena akaraṇa pakṣaḥ pi pratikṣiptaḥ yadā vilambaḥ pi asahyaḥ tadā dūra utsāritam akaraṇam asāmarthye vā samīhita samaye pi akaraṇa prasaṅgaḥ sadā eka svabhāva tvāt svabhāva bhraṃśe ca pratikṣaṇam kṣayaḥ siddhaḥ jaladharasya tatra prayogaḥ yat yadā yat janana samartham tat tadā tat janayati eva

original: yathā 'ntyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryam, sa eva vā jaladharas tad avasthāyāṃ vāri dhārayan kṛṣī-balavilocanotsavādi-kāryam, vārivitaraṇakāle vā tat-kriyām, śaktaś cāyam ubhayadaśāyām ubhayakāryam arjitum iti svabhāvahetuprasaṅga | jananam antareṇa sāmarthyavyavasthāyāṃ sarvasya sarvatra śaktivyavahāraprasaṅgaḥ | niyataś cāyaṃ pratipanno vyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: yathā ntyā kāraṇa sāmagrī sva kāryam saḥ eva vā jaladharaḥ tat avasthāyām vāri dhārayan kṛṣī bala vilocana utsava ādi kāryam vāri vitaraṇa kāle vā tad kriyām śaktaḥ ca ayam ubhaya daśāyām ubhaya kāryam arjitum iti svabhāva hetu prasaṅga jananam antareṇa sāmarthya vyavasthāyām sarvasya sarvatra śakti vyavahāra prasaṅgaḥ niyataḥ ca ayam pratipannaḥ vyavahāraḥ

original: na cāsya jananād anyan nimittam upapadyate | tato jananavinābhāve vipakṣe niyamavattve (8a) lakṣaṇavyāpakaviyogenātmasattayā viyujyamāno janana eva viśrāmyatīti samarthavyavahāragocaratvamātrānubandhi janakatvaṃ siddham iti vyāpti-siddhiḥ ||
analyzed: na ca asya jananāt anyat nimittam upapadyate tatas janana vinābhāve vipakṣe niyamavat tve lakṣaṇa vyāpaka viyogena ātma sattayā viyujyamānaḥ janane eva viśrāmyati iti samartha vyavahāra gocara tva mātra anubandhi janaka tvam siddham iti vyāpti siddhiḥ

original: na karoti ca prathamakṣaṇasādhyāṃ kriyāṃ dvitīyādikṣaṇe, dvitīyādi-kṣaṇasādhyaṃ
analyzed: na karoti ca prathama kṣaṇa sādhyām kriyām dvitīya ādi kṣaṇe dvitīya ādi kṣaṇa sādhyam

original: [18,1] vā prathamakṣaṇa, iti vyāpakānupalabdhir jaladharasya tat-tat-kriyāsu samarthāsamarthasvabhāvatayā prati-kṣaṇaṃ bhedam utpādayatīti || evaṃ sarvathā 'karaṇāpekṣayā yad yatra karoti na tat tatra samarthaṃ yathā śālyaṅkuram akurvan kodravaḥ | na karoticākaraṇakāle karaṇakālakāryaṃ kriyām iti | sāmarthyāpekṣayā,
analyzed: vā prathama kṣaṇe iti vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ jaladharasya tat tat kriyāsu samartha asamartha svabhāva tayā pratikṣaṇam bhedam utpādayati iti evam sarvathā karaṇa apekṣayā yat yatra karoti na tat tatra samartham yathā śāli aṅkuram akurvan kodravaḥ na karoti ca a karaṇa kāle karaṇa kāla kāryam kriyām iti sāmarthya apekṣayā

original: yad yat karoti na tat tatrāśaktam, antyasāmagrīvat | karoti cāyaṃ toyadharas toyadhāraṇam iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhir asamarthakṣaṇād bhinatti karaṇasamartham |
analyzed: yat yat karoti na tat tatra aśaktam antya sāmagrī vat karoti ca ayam toyadharaḥ toya dhāraṇam iti viruddha vyāpta upalabdhiḥ asamartha kṣaṇāt bhinatti karaṇa samartham

original: yathā hi jananena vyāpyate samarthasthiti-yogyatā, tathā jananaṃ tayāpi (|) tad asāmarthyaviruddhaṃ yat sāmarthyaṃ tena vyāptaṃ karaṇam upalabhyamānasāmarthyaṃ kadarthayatīti samarthāsamarthasvabhāvatayā svabhāvabhedaḥ siddhas toyadasya | tat-kathaṃ sattvād anyad anumānaṃ nāstīty ucyate?
analyzed: yathā hi jananena vyāpyate samartha sthiti yogyatā tathā jananam tayā api tat asāmarthya viruddham yat sāmarthyam tena vyāptam karaṇam upalabhyamāna sāmarthyam kadarthayati iti samartha asamartha svabhāva tayā svabhāva bhedaḥ siddhaḥ toyadasya tat katham sattvāt anyat anumānam na asti iti ucyate

original: atra ca samarthavyavahārayogyatā-jananayor bhinnavyāvṛttikatayā sādhyāviśiṣṭatā hetor ity avāntaraiḥ kīrtitaṃ dūṣaṇam anavakāśaṃ veditavyam | tasmād ekārthakāriṇiḥ kṣaṇāntarāpekṣayā samarthetarasvabhāvatayā bheda eveti kṣaṇabhaṅgitayā sapakṣatām āvahati | balāhake sattvasiddhir aviruddhā |
analyzed: atra ca samartha vyavahāra yogya tā jananayoḥ bhinna vyāvṛttika tayā sādhya aviśiṣṭa tā hetoḥ iti avāntaraiḥ kīrtitam dūṣaṇam anavakāśam veditavyam tasmāt kṣaṇa antara apekṣayā samartha itara svabhāva tayā bhedaḥ eva iti kṣaṇabhaṅgi tayā sapakṣa tām āvahati balāhake sattva siddhiḥ aviruddhā

original: nanu kṣaṇabhedeṣv avatiṣṭhamānasyāpi bhāvasya sahakāri-saṃgamāpekṣayā karaṇākaraṇam upapadyamānaṃ kathaṃ svabhāvabhedam āpādayituṃ prabhavati? tato yathoktaprasaṅgamaulahetuṣv anekāntaḥ | kiṃ punar asya samarthasvabhāvasya sahakāribhiḥ kartavyam, yad ayam anapekṣya sahakāriṇo na svakāryakarmaṇi pravṛttim ālambate? anupakāriṇy apekṣāyā ayogāt |
analyzed: nanu kṣaṇa bhedeṣu avatiṣṭhamānasya api bhāvasya sahakāri saṃgama apekṣayā karaṇa akaraṇam upapadyamānam katham svabhāva bhedam āpādayitum prabhavati tatas yathā ukta prasaṅga maula hetuṣu anekāntaḥ kim punar asya samartha svabhāvasya sahakāribhiḥ kartavyam yat ayam an apekṣya sahakāriṇaḥ na sva kārya karmaṇi pravṛttim ālambate anupakāriṇi apekṣāyāḥ ayogāt

original: svayam asamarthas tu sāmarthyam arthayamānaḥ sahakāriṇo 'pekṣata iti yuktam etat | tato 'kiñcit karāḥ ca sahakāriṇo 'pekṣāgocarāś ceti vyāhatam |
analyzed: svayam asamarthaḥ tu sāmarthyam arthayamānaḥ sahakāriṇaḥ pekṣate iti yuktam etat tatas kiñcid karāḥ ca sahakāriṇaḥ pekṣā gocarāḥ ca iti vyāhatam

original: atra śaṃkaraḥ, sahakāriviraho hi tasyāsāmarthyam ucyate | tac cāsya sahakāri-sākalyahetubhir apanīyate, tayor ekatra (8b) sahasthitivirodhāt | sākalyahetubhyaś ca vaikalyasyaiva vyāvṛttiḥ, na tadvataḥ sākalyasya sahakārivirahavyāvṛtti-rūpatvāt |
analyzed: atra śaṃkaraḥ sahakāri virahaḥ hi tasya asāmarthyam ucyate tat ca asya sahakāri sākalya hetubhiḥ apanīyate tayoḥ ekatra saha sthiti virodhāt sākalya hetubhyaḥ ca vaikalyasya eva vyāvṛttiḥ na tadvataḥ sākalyasya sahakāri viraha vyāvṛtti rūpa tvāt

original: na ca sahakāri-sākalyavaikalyayor āvirbhāvatirobhāvābhyāṃ tad-vatas tadbhāvasiddhiḥ, tasya tābhyām anyatvāt | ata eva sahakārivirahavyāvṛtti-hetor na tad-vatas tirobhāvasiddhir iti ||
analyzed: na ca sahakāri sākalya vaikalyayoḥ āvirbhāva tirobhāvābhyām tadvataḥ tad bhāva siddhiḥ tasya tābhyām anya tvāt atas eva sahakāri viraha vyāvṛtti hetoḥ na tadvataḥ tirobhāva siddhiḥ iti

original: [19,1] etad eva nyāyabhūṣaṇakāro 'py āha, sahakāriṇas tasya kam upakāraṃ kurvanti yena tair vinā na karotīti cet, kāryam eva kurvanti | anyopakārakaraṇe hi sahakāritvam eva na syāt | tathā hi yadi tam eva kurvanti tadā tat-kāriṇa eva syuḥ na tatsahakāriṇaḥ | tena sahaikaṃ kāryaṃ kurvanto hi tatsahakāriṇo 'bhidhīyanta iti |
analyzed: etat eva nyāyabhūṣaṇa kāraḥ u pi āha sahakāriṇaḥ tasya kam upakāram kurvanti yena taiḥ vinā na karoti iti ced kāryam eva kurvanti anya upakāra karaṇe hi sahakāri tvam eva na syāt tathā hi yadi tam eva kurvanti tadā tad kāriṇaḥ eva syuḥ na tad sahakāriṇaḥ tena saha ekam kāryam kurvantaḥ hi tad sahakāriṇaḥ bhidhīyante iti

original: tathā bhavatu nāmānupakārako 'pi sahakārī, tathā yadi tasya prāg eva śaktir asti kiṃ na karoti? nāsti cet, paścād aśaktaḥ kathaṃ karoti? paścāc chaktaś cet, śaktāśaktayoḥ kathaṃ na nānātvam? viruddhadharmādhyāsasya bhedakatvād ity āśaṅkya sahakāri-sākalyaṃ hi tasya śaktiḥ | tad-vaikalyaṃ cāśaktiḥ | tena sahakārivaikalye prāg aśakta ucyate |
analyzed: tathā bhavatu nāma anupakārakaḥ sahakārī tathā yadi tasya prāk eva śaktiḥ asti kim na karoti na asti ced paścāt aśaktaḥ katham karoti paścāt śaktaḥ ced śakta aśaktayoḥ katham na nānātvam viruddha dharma adhyāsasya bhedaka tvāt iti āśaṅkya sahakāri sākalyam hi tasya śaktiḥ tad vaikalyam ca aśaktiḥ tena sahakāri vaikalye prāk aśaktaḥ ucyate

original: paścāt sākalye ca śaktaḥ | dharmadharmiṇoś ca bhedaḥ prasādhitaḥ | tena śakty utpāde 'pi nāvaśyaṃ tad utpādaḥ | aśakti-nivṛttāv api nāvaśyaṃ tadvato nivṛttiḥ, pratibandhābhāvād iti |
analyzed: paścāt sākalye ca śaktaḥ dharma dharmiṇoḥ ca bhedaḥ prasādhitaḥ tena śaktī utpāde na avaśyam tat utpādaḥ aśakti nivṛttau api na avaśyam tadvataḥ nivṛttiḥ pratibandha abhāvāt iti

original: tad etat sarvam apohaprastāve dharm-dharmiṇor abhedapratipādanenaiva nirastaṃ veditavyam, sākalyavaikalyayor āvirbhāvatirobhāvābhyāṃ dharmiṇa eva tathāvasthānāt | astu vā dharmadharmiṇor bheda eva (|) nāpi sahakāriṇām akiñcit-paratve vipratipādyāmahe | kevalaṃ na tāvanta eva sahakāriṇaḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ |
analyzed: tat etat sarvam apoha prastāve dharm dharmiṇoḥ abheda pratipādanena eva nirastam veditavyam sākalya vaikalyayoḥ āvirbhāva tirobhāvābhyām dharmiṇaḥ eva tathā avasthānāt astu vā dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhedaḥ eva nā api sahakāriṇām akiñcitparatve vipratipādyāmahe kevalam na tāvantaḥ eva sahakāriṇaḥ kārya kāriṇaḥ

original: nāpi sākalyam eva kāryam arjati, kiṃ tu so 'pi bhāvaḥ | tad-arthaṃ tair eva prayattam iti na vistareṇopayogaḥ | tasya ca bhāvasya yādṛśaś caramakṣaṇe 'kṣepakriyā-dharmā svabhāvaṛ(,) tādṛśa eva cet, prathamakṣaṇe 'pi, tadaiva prasahya kurvāṇo gīrvāṇaśāpenāpi nāpahastayituṃ śaktaḥ |
analyzed: na api sākalyam eva kāryam arjati kim tu saḥ pi bhāvaḥ tad artham taiḥ eva prayattam iti na vistareṇa upayogaḥ tasya ca bhāvasya yādṛśaḥ carama kṣaṇe kṣepa kriyā dharmā tādṛśaḥ eva ced prathama kṣaṇe tadā eva prasahya kurvāṇaḥ gīrvāṇa śāpena api nā apahastayitum śaktaḥ

original: kiṃ punas tavāmunā marmapīṭā-janitaviklavavikrośamātreṇa? yathā hi śaktāśaktayā bhaṅgaprasaṅgaparihārāya sākalyavaikalyalakṣaṇadharmāntarasvabhāve śakty-aśaktī bhinnasvabhāve kalpite, tathā na so 'py akṣepakriyā-dharmā svabhāvo bhāvād bhinna evābhidhātuṃ śakyaḥ, bhāvasyākartṛtvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: kim punar tava amunā marma pīṭā janita viklava vikrośa mātreṇa yathā hi śakta aśaktayā bhaṅga prasaṅga parihārāya sākalya vaikalya lakṣaṇa dharma antara svabhāve śakti aśaktī bhinna svabhāve kalpite tathā na saḥ u pi akṣepa kriyā dharmā svabhāvaḥ bhāvāt bhinnaḥ eva abhidhātum śakyaḥ bhāvasya akartṛ tva prasaṅgāt

original: atha yathā śakty-aśaktī bhinnau dharmau pratijānīmahe, na ca tayor udayavyayābhyāṃ bhāvasya kiñcit, tathā 'kṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ kṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ ca dharmāntaram eva | tac ca sahakāri-sannidhānapratyayabhāvākṣepam udety vyeti ceti | tathaiva bhāvasya na kiñcid ity ucyate |
analyzed: atha yathā śakti aśaktī bhinnau dharmau pratijānīmahe na ca tayoḥ udaya vyayābhyām bhāvasya kiñcid tathā kṣepa kriyā dharma tvam kṣepa kriyā dharma tvam ca dharma antaram eva tat ca sahakāri sannidhāna pratyaya bhāva ākṣepam udeti vyeti ca iti tathā eva bhāvasya na kiñcid iti ucyate

original: ucyatām | kevalam astu nedānīṃ kāryajanma, kāraṇābhimatasya tādavasthyāt | tathā hi na sahakāriṇa eva, nāpi sākalyam eva janakaṃ tathā sākalye (9a) sati
analyzed: ucyatām kevalam astu nā idānīm kārya janma kāraṇa abhimatasya tādavasthyāt tathā hi na sahakāriṇaḥ eva nā api sākalyam eva janakam tathā sākalye sati

original: [20,1] jātam akṣepakriyā-dharmatvam api na prakṛtaṃ bhāvam anapekṣya janakam, janakatve 'pi svayam eva bhāvasya janakatvasvīkārāt | kiṃ tu prakṛto pi bhāvaḥ kartā svīkartavyaḥ | sa ca pracīnadaśāto 'natiricyamānamūrtiḥ kurvan pūrvam api kuryāt, akurvan vā paścād api na kuryād iti tad avasthaḥ paribhavaḥ |
analyzed: jātam akṣepa kriyā dharma tvam api na prakṛtam bhāvam an apekṣya janakam janaka tve pi svayam eva bhāvasya janaka tva svīkārāt kim tu prakṛtaḥ api bhāvaḥ kartā svīkartavyaḥ sa ca pracīna daśātaḥ na atiricyamāna mūrtiḥ kurvan pūrvam api kuryāt akurvān vā paścāt api na kuryāt iti tat avasthaḥ paribhavaḥ

original: yadi tu kādācitkaṃ sākalyādivastv-antaram eva hetuḥ, tadā kāryam api tad apekṣyaṃ kādācitkam iti nyāyyam etat | evaṃ yāvad yāvad dharmāntaraparikalpaḥ, tāvat tāvad udāsīno bhāvaḥ | atha akṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ jātaṃ, kāryaṃ tu tato notpādyata iti ko 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ? tad avaśyaṃ kāryeṇa janitavyam |
analyzed: yadi tu kādācitkam sākalya ādi vastu antaram eva hetuḥ tadā kāryam api tat apekṣyam kādācitkam iti nyāyyam etat evam yāvat yāvat dharma antara parikalpaḥ tāvat tāvat udāsīnaḥ bhāvaḥ atha akṣepa kriyā dharma tvam jātam kāryam tu tatas na utpādyate iti kaḥ yam nyāyaḥ tat avaśyam kāryeṇa janitavyam

original: tac cākṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ prāṇ-nāsīd iti kāryodayasyāpi nāvakāśaḥ | evaṃ tarhi kāryotpādanāntarīyakam akṣepakāritvam, akṣepakāritvanāntarīyakaś ca kāryotpāda iti vyaktam itaretarāśrayatvam | anyathā na yadi kāryotpādanāntarīyakam akṣepakāritvam, nākṣepakāritvena kāryodayākṣepaḥ |
analyzed: tat ca ākṣepa kriyā dharma tvam prāṇ nā āsīt iti kārya udayasya api nā avakāśaḥ evam tarhi kārya utpāda nāntarīyakam akṣepa kāri tvam akṣepa kāri tva nāntarīyakaḥ ca kārya utpādaḥ iti vyaktam itaretara āśraya tvam anyathā na yadi kārya utpāda nāntarīyakam akṣepa kāri tvam na ākṣepa kāri tvena kārya udaya ākṣepaḥ

original: yadi ca nākṣepakāritvanāntarīyakaḥ kāryotpādo 'kṣepakāritvāt prāg api syāt | ekārthatve tu sākalye jāte saty akṣepakāritvaṃ dharmāntaraṃ jātam iti kim anayā bhāṣayābhihitaṃ kāryam utpannam iti? tathā ca sati na prakṛtadoṣaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca na ākṣepa kāri tva nāntarīyakaḥ kārya utpādaḥ kṣepa kāri tvāt prāk api syāt ekārtha tve tu sākalye jāte sati akṣepa kāri tvam dharma antaram jātam iti kim anayā bhāṣayā abhihitam kāryam utpannam iti tathā ca sati na prakṛta doṣa parihāraḥ

original: na hi kāryajanmani vivādaḥ, yat svarūpāpekṣas tu kāryodayaḥ tasya sarvadā tādavasthyāt kathaṃ kadācitkateti cintyate |
analyzed: na hi kārya janmani vivādaḥ yat svarūpa apekṣaḥ tu kārya udayaḥ tasya sarvadā tādavasthyāt katham kadācitkatā iti cintyate

original: tasmād akṣepakriyā-dharmeti janayaīti vā yat svarūpapuraskāreṇeyam abhikhyā tasya prāg api sattve katham ajani kadācit? akṣepakriyā-dharmakapratyanīkasvabhāvasya vā prācyasya paścād anuvṛttau kathaṃ kadācid api kāryasaṃbhavaḥ? atha yadi sa evaikaḥ kartā syāt? yuktam etat kiṃ tu sāmagrī janikā tatsahakāry-antaravirahavelāyāṃ balīyaso 'pi na
analyzed: tasmāt akṣepa kriyā dharmā iti vā yat sva rūpa puraskāreṇa iyam abhikhyā tasya prāk api sattve katham ajani kadācid akṣepa kriyā dharmaka pratyanīka svabhāvasya vā prācyasya paścāt anuvṛttau katham kadācid api kārya saṃbhavaḥ atha yadi saḥ eva ekaḥ kartā syāt yuktam etat kim tu sāmagrī janikā tad sahakāri antara viraha velāyām na asti

original: kāryaprasava iti kim atra viruddham? ekārthakaraṇāc ca sahakāritvam uktam, nopakāreṇeti |
analyzed: kārya prasavaḥ iti kim atra viruddham eka artha karaṇāt ca sahakāri tvam uktam na upakāreṇa iti

original: atrocyate | yadi militāḥ santaḥ kāryaṃ kurvate, tadaikārthakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ sahakāritvam eṣām astu, ko niṣeddhā? militair eva tu tat kāryaṃ kartavyam iti kuto labhyate? pūrvāparakāryayor ekatve tāvad bhāvasya sarvadā jananājananayor anyataraniyamaprasaṅgasya durnirvāratvāt |
analyzed: atrā ucyate yadi militāḥ santaḥ kāryam kurvate tadā ekārtha karaṇa lakṣaṇam sahakāri tvam eṣām astu kaḥ niṣeddhā militaiḥ eva tu tat kāryam kartavyam iti kutas labhyate pūrva apara kāryayoḥ ekatve tāvat bhāvasya sarvadā janana ajananayoḥ anyatara niyama prasaṅgasya durnirvāra tvāt

original: tasmāt sāmagrī janikā, naikaṃ janakam iti sthiravādināṃ manorathasyānyaviṣayaḥ | dṛśyate tāvad evam iti cetata eva na sthairyapakṣaḥ kṣama iti
analyzed: tasmāt sāmagrī janikā na ekam janakam iti sthira vādinām manorathasya anya viṣayaḥ dṛśyate tāvat evam iti cetataḥ eva na sthairya pakṣaḥ kṣamaḥ iti

original: [21,1] brumaḥ | sarvo hi prasaṅgo viparyayaparyavasānaḥ | tato yadi nityatā syāt janayituḥ, janyaṃ sarvadā syān na vā kadācid apīti |
analyzed: brumaḥ sarvaḥ hi prasaṅgaḥ viparyaya paryavasānaḥ tatas yadi nitya tā syāt janayituḥ janyam sarvadā syāt na vā kadācid api iti

original: na caivam, sākalya eva kadācit-kāryotpattir iti niyamena svabhāvabhaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam sākalye eva kadācid kārya utpattiḥ iti niyamena svabhāva bhaṅgaḥ

original: nanu yadi kvacin nityaṃ sarvadā kāraṇam upalabdhaṃ syāt, tadā kvacin nityatvābhyupagame sadā kartṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ saṃgacchate | yāvatā sarvadā tasyābhāvāt katham etādṛśaṃ prasañjayituṃ śakyate?
analyzed: nanu yadi kvacid nityam sarvadā kāraṇam upalabdham syāt tadā kvacid nitya tva abhyupagame sadā kartṛ tva prasaṅgaḥ saṃgacchate yāvatā sarvadā tasya abhāvāt katham etādṛśam prasañjayitum śakyate

original: (9b) tad etad api grāmyam | tathā hi nityatve satīti | asyāyam arthaḥ | parakālabhāvī janako yaḥ svabhāvo bhāvasya, sa eva yadi pūrvakālabhāvī, pūrvakālabhāvī vā yo 'janakaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa eva yadi parakālabhāvī, tadā tad upalabdham eva jananam ajananaṃ vā syād iti | tathā ca sati siddhayor ekatvārope siddham eva jananam ajananaṃ vā prasajyeta |
analyzed: tat etat api grāmyam tathā hi nitya tve sati iti asya ayam arthaḥ para kāla bhāvī janakaḥ yaḥ svabhāvaḥ bhāvasya saḥ eva yadi pūrva kāla bhāvī pūrva kāla bhāvī vā yaḥ janakaḥ svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva yadi para kāla bhāvī pūrva kāla bhāvī vā yaḥ janakaḥ svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva yadi para kāla bhāvī tadā tat upalabdham eva jananam ajananam vā syāt iti tathā ca sati siddhayoḥ ekatva ārope siddham eva jananam ajananam vā prasajyeta

original: [36,3] yathā tarhi Trilocanaś caryayati tathānayor api nīyatām abhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca Nyāyamañjarī, asādhāraṇam api sattvaṃ mādhyamikanyāyena śakyam udbhāvayitum | tathā hi, kṣaṇavāde 'pi pūrvarūpakṣaṇe yena [sva] bhāvenānantarakṣaṇam utpādayati, kiṃ tenaiva rasakṣaṇam apy āhosvit svabhāvāntareṇa | yadi tenaiva, rasasyāpi rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ |

original: bhāvābhāvau ca sākṣād viruddhau pūrvakaṃ rūpalakṣaṇaṃ bhintaḥ | na ca bhinno dṛśyate saḥ |

original: tasmād asādhāraṇam upādadānasya svabhāvabhedāpatteḥ kṣaṇikebhyo nivartamānaṃ sattvam | yena ca prakāreṇa svabhāvabhedo nirākriyate, tasyākṣaṇikatve 'pi samānatvāt sattvam akṣaṇikān na nivartate | ato vyatirekāsiddheḥ pratibandhāsiddhir iti |

original: [36,18] tatra tāvad Yogācāraniṣṭhām anālocayann ayaṃ saugatasamayajñānābhimānī Mādhyamikanyāyenety āha, ubhayor api hetuphalāpavādasya tattvato 'bhimatatvād ity adharasiddhim uddhūya Sākārasiddhau darśitam eva | sthite ca heuphalabhāve 'smākam iyaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgacintety uktam | sā ca sthitir grāhyagrāhakabhāvasya tāttvikatve gṛhīte |

original: ekasvabhāvāt tu kāraṇān na kāryabheda iti smānasāmagryā na kāryavaijātyam ity arthaḥ | ata eva na viśvasyāhetukatvam | tasmād ekasmād anekotpattir avirodhinī | kāryadvāreṇa tu rūpaṃ rūpakāraṇaṃ rasakāraṇaṃ ceti samuccayena svabhāvadvayavyavahāraḥ | ata eva na virodhavārtā | na hi samuccaye pramāṇasiddhe virodhagandhaḥ |
analyzed: eka svabhāvāt tu kāraṇāt na kārya bhedaḥ iti smāna sāmagryāḥ na kārya vaijātyam iti arthaḥ atas eva na viśvasya ahetuka tvam tasmāt ekasmāt aneka utpattiḥ avirodhinī kārya dvāreṇa tu rūpam rūpa kāraṇam rasa kāraṇam ca iti samuccayena svabhāva dvaya vyavahāraḥ atas eva na virodha vārtā na hi samuccaye pramāṇa siddhe virodha gandhaḥ

original: virodhas tu yady apy ekasmin dharmiṇi dvayor asaṃbhavayor niyamaḥ, sa ca kadācid vastunor ekasya bhāve 'nyaparyādānād dahanatuhinavat | kadācid dharmayoḥ svabhāvenaiva ekādhiṣṭhite 'nyāsaṃbhavāt bhāvābhāvavat, nīlatvānīlatvavad vā | tatra yadi nīlapītadravyayor apy ekabhāve 'nyaparyādānam āpādayet, syād eva (16a) sahānavasthānanāmā virodhaḥ |

original: kevalaṃ kalpanā-buddhau yathārthāntaram iva rūpajanakatvaṃ pratibhāti, tathā tad-abhāvāvyabhicāri ca pṛthag eva rasajanakatvam avasīyate | yataḥ pṛthak śabdapramāṇavṛttiḥ apekṣyate, tāvataiva virodham adhyavasyati | sāvagatiḥ kṛtakatvānityatvayor api na vyavasīyate kenāpi | nāpi tatra virodhābhidhānena kaścid upayogaḥ |
analyzed: kevalam kalpanā buddhau yathā artha antaram iva rūpa janaka tvam pratibhāti tathā tad abhāva avyabhicāri ca pṛthak eva rasa janaka tvam avasīyate yatas pṛthak śabda pramāṇa vṛttiḥ apekṣyate tāvatā eva virodham adhyavasyati sa avagatiḥ kṛtaka tva anitya tvayoḥ api na vyavasīyate kena api nā api tatra virodha abhidhānena kaścid upayogaḥ

original: ekatra dharmiṇy aparaparihārārtham eva hi virodhaḥ sādhyate | tad yadi virodhe 'py ekadharmi-samparkaḥ, kṛtaṃ virodhacintayā | nīlatvānīlatvādiṣu tu prayujyate parasparaparihārātmā virodhaḥ |
analyzed: ekatra dharmiṇi apara parihāra artham eva hi virodhaḥ sādhyate tat yadi virodhe pi eka dharmi samparkaḥ kṛtam virodha cintayā nīla tva anīla tva ādiṣu tu prayujyate paraspara parihāra ātmā virodhaḥ

original: [38,14] nanu parasparābhāvāvyabhicārāviśeṣe 'pi kathaṃ keṣāñcid dharmāṇām ekadharmiṇy anavasthānātmā virodhaḥ, keṣāñcit punar bhedamātrṃ na virodhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu paraspara abhāva avyabhicāra aviśeṣe katham keṣāṃcid dharmāṇām eka dharmiṇi anavasthāna ātmā virodhaḥ keṣāñcid punar bheda mātram na virodhaḥ

original: uktam atra, yad vyavacchedena yasya vidhānaṃ yad vidhānena vā yasya vyavacchedo niyamena, tat tena pratiyoginā viruddham | yatra neyaṃ gatiḥ, tad-aviruddham ity alaṃ punaḥ pariśrameṇa | tad evaṃ rūpajananarasajananayoḥ parasparābhāvāvyabhicāre 'pi kṛtakatvānityatvavad bhedamātraṃ śabdapramāṇāntarākarṣi, na tu virodha iti sthitam |
analyzed: uktam atra yat vyavacchedena yasya vidhānam yat vidhānena vā yasya vyavacchedaḥ niyamena tat tena pratiyoginā viruddham yatra na iyam gatiḥ tat aviruddham iti alam punar pariśrameṇa tat evam rūpa janana rasa jananayoḥ paraspara abhāva avyabhicāre pi kṛtaka tva anitya tva vat bheda mātram śabda pramāṇa antara ākarṣi na tu virodhaḥ iti sthitam

original: [38,20] yat tūktam, tatra yadi svabhāvāntaraṃ bhaved ity-ādi | sa tarhi nyāyaḥ kiṃ kṛtak[tv] ānityatvābhyāṃ bibheti | prasaṅga eva tatrāpi bhavatv iti cet |
analyzed: yat tu uktam tatra yadi svabhāva antaram bhavet ityādi sa tarhi nyāyaḥ kim kṛtaktu ā nitya tvābhyām bibheti prasaṅgaḥ eva tatra api bhavatu iti ced

original: nanu parābhyupagamena prasaṅgaḥ, na ca mayedam aṅgīkṛtaṃ parasparābhāvāvyabhicāramātreṇa virodha ekatrānavasthānahetur iti | kiṃ tavaiṣo 'bhyupagamaḥ pramāṇavṛttir vā | ubhayathā 'pi na mamāparādhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu para abhyupagamena prasaṅgaḥ na ca mayā idam aṅgīkṛtam paraspara abhāva avyabhicāra mātreṇa virodhaḥ ekatra anavasthāna hetuḥ iti kim tava eṣaḥ bhyupagamaḥ pramāṇa vṛttiḥ vā ubhayathā na mama aparādhaḥ

original: (16b) sudhyatutarāṃ ca kṛtakatvānity[tv] ādīnāṃ virodho, na caivaṃ tasmāt parasparāvyabhicārasya tādātmyaniṣedhe vyāpārāt na kṛtakatvam evānityatvam | aniṣedhe tv ekasyaiva kṛtakatvasya bhāve 'bhāvaś ca syāt | yathā vastuno nīlād anīlasyāvyavacchede tasyaiva bhāvo 'bhāvaś ca svīkṛtaḥ syād ity ucyate | nīlam iti hi tasya bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ca kṛtaka tva anitya tu ādīnām virodhaḥ na ca evam tasmāt paraspara avyabhicārasya tādātmya niṣedhe vyāpārāt na kṛtaka tvam eva anitya tvam aniṣedhe tu ekasya eva kṛtaka tvasya bhāve bhāvaḥ ca syāt yathā vastunaḥ nīlāt anīlasya avyavacchede tasya eva bhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca svīkṛtaḥ syāt iti ucyate nīlam iti hi tasya bhāvaḥ

original: anīlam iti cābhāvaḥ tad-abhāvavyāptasyānīlasya bhāvo na vyāpakaṃ tad-abhāvam anākṛṣya sthātuṃ śaktaḥ, bhāvābhāvayoś ca virodhaḥ prasādhita evety ekadharmiṇy anavasthānam iti yan nīlaṃ tan nānīlaṃ pītādivastu, tathā dharmo 'pi yad kṛtakatvaṃ tan nākṛtakatvam anityatvādi | yad rūpajananaṃ tan nārūpajananaṃ rasajananādi |
analyzed: anīlam iti ca abhāvaḥ tad abhāva vyāptasya anīlasya bhāvaḥ na vyāpakam tad abhāvam an ākṛṣya sthātum śaktaḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ ca virodhaḥ prasādhitaḥ eva iti eka dharmiṇi anavasthānam iti yat nīlam tat na anīlam pīta ādi vastu tathā yat kṛtaka tvam tat na akṛtaka tvam anitya tva ādi yat rūpa jananam tat na arūpa jananam rasa janana ādi

original: anyathaikatra kṛtakatvarūpajananādau śabdapramāṇapravṛttāv anyatrānityatvarasajananādau pramāṇāntarānapekṣāprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā ekatra kṛtaka tva rūpa janana ādau śabda pramāṇa pravṛttau anyatra anitya tva rasa janana ādau pramāṇa antara anapekṣā prasaṅgaḥ

original: [39,9] tasmāt tādātmye bhāvo 'bhāvaś caikatra syād iti doṣaḥ | na tad-ādhāratve | tau hi parasparaṃ bhinnau dharmau yady ekatra syātāṃ, kīdṛśo doṣaḥ | bhāvābhāvadoṣasya bhedasādhanenaiva caritārthatvāt | śāstre 'pi hi viruddhadharmādhyāso bheda ukto, na virodhaḥ | virodhalakṣaṇaṃ tv anyat prasiddham eva |
analyzed: tasmāt tādātmye bhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca ekatra syāt iti doṣaḥ na tad ādhāra tve tau hi parasparam bhinnau dharmau yadi ekatra syātām kīdṛśaḥ doṣaḥ bhāva abhāva doṣasya bheda sādhanena eva caritārtha tvāt śāstre hi viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ bhedaḥ uktaḥ na virodhaḥ virodha lakṣaṇam tu anyat prasiddham eva

original: tādātmyaniṣedho 'pi viśeṣaṇānapekṣasvabhāvānupalambhād ukto na viruddhopalambhāt | tad evaṃ bhāvābhāvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmasaṣargāt tad-dharmitvena bhāsamānau dharmāv eva bhinnau bhavata iti na tayor api dharmivastunor nānā-dharmayogamātreṇa bhedavārtā |
analyzed: tādātmya niṣedhaḥ pi viśeṣaṇa anapekṣa svabhāva anupalambhāt uktaḥ na viruddha upalambhāt tat evam bhāva abhāva lakṣaṇa viruddha dharma saṣargāt tad dharmi tvena bhāsamānau dharmau eva bhinnau bhavataḥ iti na tayoḥ api dharmi vastunoḥ nānā dharma yoga mātreṇa bheda vārtā

original: yadā punas tathā bhidyamānāv eva dharmau yathoktaparasparapratidvandvinau bhavatas tadā tad-dharmiṇo 'pi bhedaḥ, nīlatvānīlatvabhāvābhāvadharmivat, ekakāryaṃ prati jananājananavac ca | tasmād bhāvābhāvau sākṣād viruddhau rūpajanakatvadharmāv eva svadharmitvenābhāsamānau bhintaḥ | na tayor apy ādhāraṃ pracīnavirūpalakṣaṇam, svayaṃ virodhābhāvāt |
analyzed: yadā punar tathā bhidyamānau eva dharmau yathā ukta paraspara pratidvandvinau bhavataḥ tadā tad dharmiṇaḥ pi bhedaḥ nīla tva a nīla tva bhāva abhāva dharmi vat eka kāryam prati janana ajanana vat ca tasmāt bhāva abhāvau sākṣāt viruddhau rūpa janaka tva dharmau eva sva dharmi tvena ābhāsamānau bhintaḥ na tayoḥ api ādhāram pracīna virūpa lakṣaṇam svayam virodha abhāvāt

original: [39, 22] ayaṃ tu svayam eva na hy ekasvabhāvāt kāryabheda paśyāma iti na ca bhinno dṛśyate sa iti ca brūvann asvastha eva na nirbandhayogyaḥ | tamān naikasvabhāvāyāḥ sāmāgryāḥ kāryavaijātyam ity avirodhaḥ | na tu svabhāvaparamparā-rahitād iti |
analyzed: ayam tu svayam eva na hi eka svabhāvāt kārya bheda paśyāmaḥ iti na ca bhinnaḥ dṛśyate saḥ iti ca brūvan asvasthaḥ eva na nirbandha yogyaḥ na eka svabhāvāyāḥ sāmāgryāḥ kārya vaijātyam iti avirodhaḥ na tu svabhāva paramparā rahitāt iti

original: tad evaṃ svabhāvasandehāpohād yad uktam, kṣaṇikebhyo nivartāmānaṃ sattvam asādhāraṇam upādānasya svabhāvabhedāpattir iti tan nirastam |

original: [40,3] kālpanika iva bhedapratibhāso na tāttviko bhedaḥ | kiṃ ca tāttvikasvabhāvabhedāpattāv api sattvam asādhāraṇam iti śraddhāvadheyam eva | na hi vastūnāṃ parimāṇātirekeṇa nityād iva kṣaṇikād api vyāvṛttaṃ bhavati sattvam, yato 'sādhāraṇam avadhāryeta | svabhāvabhūmani kaścin nityo 'pi syād iti cet |
analyzed: kālpanikaḥ iva bheda pratibhāsaḥ na tāttvikaḥ bhedaḥ kim ca tāttvika svabhāva bheda āpattau api sattvam asādhāraṇam iti śraddhā avadheyam eva na hi vastūnām parimāṇa atirekeṇa nityāt iva kṣaṇikāt api vyāvṛttam bhavati sattvam yatas sādhāraṇam avadhāryeta svabhāva bhūmani kaścid syāt iti ced

original: tam anupatat tarhi sattvaṃ (17a) sādhāraṇam anaikāntikam āśaṅkyatām | tac ca cintyam | bādhakānāṃ vyāttavadanānāṃ saṃbhavāt |
analyzed: tam anupatat tarhi sattvam sādhāraṇam anaikāntikam āśaṅkyatām tat ca cintyam bādhakānām vyātta vadanānām saṃbhavāt

original: atha svabhāvaparamparā-saṃbhāve bhāvasyeva kasya kṣaṇikatvam iti kṣaṇikād api vyāvṛttam ucyate, tad api nāsti | svayam eva svabhāvebhyo bhinnasya svabhāvinaḥ kriyā-samarthanena rakṣāvidhānāt | na ca svabhāvabheda-[a] saṃbhave mūlasya kṣayo 'pi yuktaḥ, aparimititopādhi-saṃbhave 'pi tad-vato vyayāniṣṭaḥ |

original: asmad darśane 'pi yadi nāma vastv-antararāśer udayaḥ, tathāpi prakṛtabhāvasya kīdṛśī kṣayopapattir iti vyaktam etat | sa tu rāśiḥ pramāṇam anviyān na veti cintyam | bhavatu vā mūlāpalāpaḥ | ye tu svabhāvā bhāvikā dṛṣṭaḥ tad-ātmani magnatvān mūlasyaikaṃ pṛthak sat kṣaṇikaṃ mā bhūt |

original: bhūyāṃsas tu kṣaṇikāḥ santa ity upacaya eva kṣaṇikāyāḥ, kathaṃ kṣaṇikatāyāḥ sattvavyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: bhūyāṃsaḥ tu kṣaṇikāḥ santaḥ iti upacayaḥ eva kṣaṇikāyāḥ katham kṣaṇikatāyāḥ sattva vyāvṛttiḥ

original: tad evam evaṃ vidhāḥ pralāpā grāmyajanajanitam ahimānas teṣv eva śobhante, na tarkakarkaśakuśāgrīyabuddhiṣu bauddheṣu | yā tu śikṣā svabhāvabhedasādhanāya syād etad ity-ādiḥ saiṣām evāstuḥ, anyo 'nyasya svabhāva iti svasthasya vaktum 'śakteḥ | svabhāvabhedas tu sādhanāsaṃbhavād adhyakṣabādhanāc ca parihṛta eva |
analyzed: tat evam evaṃvidhāḥ pralāpāḥ grāmya jana janitam ahimānaḥ teṣu eva śobhante na tarka karkaśa kuśāgrīya buddhiṣu bauddheṣu yā tu śikṣā svabhāva bheda sādhanāya syāt etat ityādiḥ sā eṣām eva astuḥ anyaḥ nyasya svabhāvaḥ iti svasthasya vaktum śakteḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ tu sādhana asaṃbhavāt adhyakṣa bādhanāt ca parihṛtaḥ eva

original: na ca bhavann api prakṛtadoṣasaṃsparśī | nāpi sahakāry-antaram eva svabhāvāntaram iti dantaniṣkoṣikayā svabhāvabhedasādhanā hetavo viparyāsayituṃ śakyante | kṣaṇikavādī hi sahakāriṇaḥ paśyann eva prasiddhasvabhāvabhedasādhanāya sādhanam upanyasya na katham apy anena vacasā pratārayituṃ śakyaḥ |
analyzed: na ca bhavan api prakṛta doṣa saṃsparśī na api sahakāri antaram eva svabhāva antaram iti danta niṣkoṣikayā svabhāva bheda sādhanāḥ hetavaḥ viparyāsayitum śakyante kṣaṇika vādī hi sahakāriṇaḥ paśyan eva prasiddha svabhāva bheda sādhanāya sādhanam upanyasya na katham api anena vacasā pratārayitum śakyaḥ

original: tad varaṃ tatsādhanam asādhanam eveti mukham ākhyātāniṣṭasiddhavyāghātād iti | tatra coktam asmābhiḥ | na ca sahakāri-sādhanāyaiva pratyavasthātur ayaṃ prayatnaḥ | kāryeṇānubhūtānvayavyatirekā hi sahakāriṇaḥ pratyakṣādi-pramāṇasiddhā eva kim atra sādhyam |
analyzed: tat varam tad sādhanam asādhanam eva iti mukham ākhyāta aniṣṭa siddha vyāghātāt iti tatra ca uktam asmābhiḥ na ca sahakāri sādhanāya eva pratyavasthātuḥ ayam prayatnaḥ kāryeṇa anubhūta anvaya vyatirekāḥ hi sahakāriṇaḥ pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa siddhāḥ eva kim atra sādhyam

original: tato 'kṣaṇikābhimatasya kramavatīṣu kāryavyaktiṣu svalakṣaṇabhedasādhana upanyaste dūṣaṇam anuktvā sahakāry-antaram eva svabhāvabheda iti lapanaṃ yadi svahṛdayasantoṣam ālambeta, ālambatām | na tu parasādhyaṃ bādhitam anena | tasmāt siddham arthakriyā-kāritvam asthairyeṇa vyāptam iti ||
analyzed: kṣaṇika abhimatasya kramavatīṣu kārya vyaktiṣu sva lakṣaṇa bheda sādhane upanyaste dūṣaṇam an uktvā sahakāri antaram eva svabhāva bhedaḥ iti lapanam yadi sva hṛdaya santoṣam ālambeta ālambatām na tu para sādhyam bādhitam anena tasmāt siddham arthakriyā kāri tvam asthairyeṇa vyāptam iti

original: [41,7] yad apy anenaoktam, kiṃ cedaṃ tāvad ayaṃ kṣaṇikavādī praṣṭavyaḥ | pūrvasya kṣaṇasyottarasminn ekasantānavartini kṣaṇe kartavye nānyat kiñcid apekṣaṇīyam asti | tataś ca parotpatti praty anapekṣatvāt tan-mātrānubaddhenottareṇāpi saty eva tasmin bhavitavyam | abhvan vā tan-mātrānubaddho na syāt, api tu nimittāntarāpekṣo vijñāyeta |
analyzed: yat api anena uktam kim ca idam tāvat ayam kṣaṇika vādī praṣṭavyaḥ pūrvasya kṣaṇasya uttarasmin eka santāna vartini kṣaṇe kartavye na anyat kiñcid apekṣaṇīyam asti tatas ca para utpatti prati anapekṣa tvāt tanmātra anubaddhena uttareṇa api sati eva tasmin bhavitavyam abhvan vā tanmātra anubaddhaḥ na syāt api tu nimitta antara apekṣaḥ vijñāyeta

original: asabhāgotpattau tu pūrve samānasantānavartina ekasantānāntarbhūtatvāviśeṣāt samarthā asamarthā vā bhaveyuḥ | na tu sabhāgakṣaṇapratibandhotpattau | tathā ca sati pūrvakṣaṇasattā-mātrānubandhitvāviśeṣād uttarottaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ paurvāparyaṃ tyaktvā yugapadutpadyeta | tataś ca prabandhāpekṣakārya(17b)-kṣaṇakālabhāvināṃ kṣaṇānāṃ prabandha ucchidyeta |
analyzed: a sa bhāga utpattau tu pūrve samāna santāna vartinaḥ eka santāna antarbhūta tva aviśeṣāt samarthāḥ asamarthāḥ vā bhaveyuḥ na tu sa bhāga kṣaṇa pratibandha utpattau tathā ca sati pūrva kṣaṇa sattā mātra anubandhi tva aviśeṣāt uttara uttaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ paurvāparyam tyaktvā yugapad utpadyeta tatas ca prabandha apekṣa kārya kṣaṇa kāla bhāvinām kṣaṇānām prabandhaḥ ucchidyeta

original: tataś ca trailokyavarti-sakalavastu-santānabhāvinām anenaiva paryāyeṇa prabandhocchedād anyonyasaṃpī[ṭi] tā kṛtsnā trilokī prasajyeta |
analyzed: tatas ca trailokya varti sakala vastu santāna bhāvinām anena eva paryāyeṇa prabandha ucchedāt anyonya saṃpīṭi tā kṛtsnā trilokī prasajyeta

original: [41,17] athāpi samayasamayabhāvitvāt savyetarago-viṣāṇayor iva kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāstīty ucyate, yady evam atīte kṣaṇe pūrvasmin vastv-antara utpadyeta, sati ca notpadyeta ity apūrvo 'yam anvayavyatirekānugamaprakāraḥ | etayāpi dvārā kṣaṇikānām arthakriyā-kāritvam evānupapannam iti ||

original: [41,21] tad api sarvam asaṃbaddham | tathā hi yat tāvat pūrvasyottare kartavye nānyatra kvacid apekṣeti, tatra uttare sarva eva kṣaṇā abhipretā bhavataḥ | anyathā sarveṣāṃ yaugapadyaprasañjanam anupapannaṃ syāt | tatra yadi svābhiprāye dūṣaṇaṃ tadā na kaścid vipakṣaḥ |
analyzed: tat api sarvam asaṃbaddham tathā hi yat tāvat pūrvasya uttare kartavye na anyatra kvacid apekṣā iti tatra uttare sarve eva kṣaṇāḥ abhipretāḥ bhavataḥ anyathā sarveṣām yaugapadya prasañjanam anupapannam syāt tatra yadi sva abhiprāye dūṣaṇam tadā na kaścid vipakṣaḥ

original: atha saugata eva praṣṭavyaḥ, tadā pūrvasya uttarasminn-anantara eva kṣaṇe kartavye nirapekṣatvaṃ, nottare kṣaṇe | sa eva tarhi tasya svabhāvo nāsti yas tad utpādakaḥ | tataḥ svabhāvasāpekṣatvāt katham anapekṣaḥ | sa tarhi svabhāvaḥ kadācid asya bhāvī, na bhāvī tarhi tad-apekṣa iti vāco yukteḥ ko 'rthaḥ |
analyzed: atha saugataḥ eva praṣṭavyaḥ tadā pūrvasya uttarasmin anantare eva kṣaṇe kartavye nirapekṣa tvam na uttare kṣaṇe saḥ eva tarhi tasya svabhāvaḥ na asti yaḥ tat utpādakaḥ tatas svabhāva sāpekṣa tvāt katham anapekṣaḥ sa tarhi svabhāvaḥ kadācid asya bhāvī na bhāvī tarhi tad apekṣaḥ iti vācaḥ yukteḥ kaḥ rthaḥ

original: [42,3] ayam arthaḥ | yad ucyate devadatto 'tra kārye yajñadattāpekṣaḥ samartha iti | tatra dvayaṃ pratīyate, svayam asamartha iti, yajñadattena saha samartha iti ca | na ca sarvo vyavahāras tattvānurodhī | kiṃ tu kvacit kiñcit satyam | tad atrāpi svayam asamartha ity ayam aṃśa ubhayasaṃmatatvād durapahnavaḥ |
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ yat ucyate devadattaḥ utra kārye yajñadatta apekṣaḥ samarthaḥ iti tatra dvayam pratīyate svayam asamarthaḥ iti yajñadattena saha samarthaḥ iti ca na ca sarvaḥ vyavahāraḥ tattva anurodhī kim tu kvacid kiñcid satyam tat atra api svayam asamarthaḥ iti ayam aṃśaḥ ubhaya saṃmata tvāt durapahnavaḥ

original: sa eva paścād anyena saha samartha ity atra tu vivādaḥ | ata eva sādhane bādhanāvatāraḥ | atas tad aṃśāsiddheḥ tad-apekṣaṃ svayaṃ śabdam apy apanīya kvacit sāpekṣa ity asamartha ity evārthaḥ | tata uttarottare kartavye asaṃbhavini tad utpādanasvabhāve sāpekṣa iti ko 'rthaḥ | uttarottarakartavye samarthaḥ | tad atra yad dūṣaṇaṃ tad ucyatām |
analyzed: saḥ eva paścāt anyena saha samarthaḥ iti atra tu vivādaḥ atas eva sādhane bādhana avatāraḥ atas tat aṃśa asiddheḥ tad apekṣam svayam śabdam api apanīya kvacid sāpekṣaḥ iti asamarthaḥ iti eva arthaḥ tatas uttara uttare kartavye asaṃbhavini tat utpādana svabhāve sāpekṣaḥ iti kaḥ rthaḥ uttara uttara kartavye samarthaḥ tat atra yat dūṣaṇam tat ucyatām

original: [42,11] syād etat | uttarasvarūpāviśiṣṭam uttarottaram, tataḥ pūrvaṃ yathottare śaktaṃ tathottarottare 'pi | uttarottare aśaktaḥ tad uttare 'pi kathaṃ śaktaḥ syāt, ekasvabhāvatvād dvayor iti |
analyzed: syāt etat uttara svarūpa aviśiṣṭam uttarottaram tatas pūrvam yathā uttare śaktam tathā uttarottare pi uttarottare aśaktaḥ tat uttare pi katham śaktaḥ syāt eka svabhāva tvāt dvayoḥ iti

original: [42,14] tad apy asaṃgatam,ekasvabhāvatvāsiddheḥ | sabhāgakṣaṇaparamparāpekṣayā siddham ekasvabhāvatvam iti cet, na, sarvathā sabhāgatvāsiddheḥ | sajātīyārtho hi sabhāgārthaḥ | sajātīyatvaṃ ca vividham | rūpataḥ śaktitata ubhayataś ceti | tatra yady api rūpamātrakṛtaṃ sajātīyatvam uttarasyottareṇa, tathāpi sāmarthyakṛtaṃ nāsti |
analyzed: tat api asaṃgatam eka svabhāva tva asiddheḥ sabhāga kṣaṇa paramparā apekṣayā siddham eka svabhāva tvam iti ced na sarvathā sabhāga tva asiddheḥ sajātīya arthaḥ hi sabhāga arthaḥ sajātīya tvam ca vividham rūpataḥ śakti tatas ubhayatas ca iti tatra yadi api rūpa mātra kṛtam sajātīya tvam uttarasya uttareṇa tathā api sāmarthya kṛtam na asti

original: tataḥ kṛtaṃ vijātīyatvam eva | ata eva bījādīnāṃ svabhāvapariṇāmaparamparayā kiyatyāpy aṅkurakāryaniṣpattiḥ | tatra hi antimasya bījakṣaṇasyāṅkure śaktiḥ | antime punar upāntyasyopāntye ca tat-pūrvasyety evaṃ yāvat prathamabījasaṃbhavaḥ | evaṃ sahakāri-sāmagry api tatrāparāparāviśiṣṭaiveti veditavyam |
analyzed: tatas kṛtam vijātīya tvam eva atas eva bīja ādīnām svabhāva pariṇāma paramparayā kiyatyā api aṅkura kārya niṣpattiḥ tatra hi antimasya bīja kṣaṇasya aṅkure śaktiḥ antime punar upāntyasya upāntye ca tad pūrvasya iti evam yāvat prathama bīja saṃbhavaḥ evam sahakāri sāmagrī api tatra apara aparā viśiṣṭā eva iti veditavyam

original: ata evāparāparapratyayayogena prati-kṣaṇabhinnaśaktayaḥ saṃtanvantaḥ saṃskārā yady api kutaścit sāmyāt sarūpāḥ pratīyante, athāpi bhinna evaiṣāṃ svabhāvas tena kiñcid eva kasyacit kāraṇam kāryaṃ veti nyāyaḥ | (18a) tataḥ sarvathā sabhāgatvavirahāt pūrvasyottarakṣaṇajananasāmarthye 'pi nottarottarajananam asya, tataḥ śaktiviśeṣeṇa viśeṣāt |
analyzed: atas eva apara apara pratyaya yogena prati kṣaṇa bhinna śaktayaḥ saṃtanvantaḥ saṃskārāḥ yadi api kutaścid sāmyāt sarūpāḥ pratīyante atha api bhinnaḥ eva eṣām svabhāvaḥ tena kiñcid eva kasyacid kāraṇam kāryam vā iti nyāyaḥ tatas sarvathā sa bhāga tva virahāt pūrvasya uttara kṣaṇa janana sāmarthye na uttara uttara jananam asya tatas śakti viśeṣeṇa viśeṣāt

original: tathā tasyāpy anyasmāt śakter upacayo 'pacayo vā | ubayor api viśeṣa evocyate | viśiṣyate 'nyasmād iti | tat katham ekakṣaṇa eva sarveṣāṃ sabhāgābhimatakṣaṇānām upanipātacodyāvakāśaḥ | anvayavyatirekotprāso 'pi paścimo duścaritam eva | kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanasāmarthyākad-arthane hi yad ekānantaram anyajanma, sa evānvayaḥ |
analyzed: tathā tasya api anyasmāt śakteḥ upacayaḥ upacayaḥ vā ubayoḥ api viśeṣaḥ eva ucyate viśiṣyate iti tat katham eka kṣaṇaḥ eva sarveṣām sa bhāga abhimata kṣaṇānām upanipāta codya avakāśaḥ anvaya vyatireka utprāsaḥ duścaritam eva kṣaṇa bhaṅga sādhana sāmarthya a kadarthane hi yat eka anantaram anya janma saḥ eva anvayaḥ

original: yac ca tat-kāraṇasya prāgasaṃbhave 'saṃbhava eva deśakālāntare kāryasya, sa eva vyatireka iti kiṃ atra kriyatām anicchatāpi | nityavādino 'pi hi na sahaiva hetuphalayor janma | kiṃtu hetu-janmānantaraṃ phalasya janma | yat kṣaṇāc ca kāraṇasya kāryam udayavat tataḥ prāk paścād vā saṃbhave kāraṇasya kārya ka upakāraḥ |
analyzed: yat ca tad kāraṇasya prāk asaṃbhave saṃbhavaḥ eva deśa kāla antare kāryasya saḥ eva vyatirekaḥ iti kim atra kriyatām an icchatā api nityavādinā hi na saha eva hetu phalayoḥ janma kiṃtu hetu janma anantaram phalasya janma yat kṣaṇāt ca kāraṇasya kāryam udaya vat tatas prāk paścāt vā saṃbhave kāraṇasya kārya kaḥ upakāraḥ

original: tat-kṣaṇānantaram asya janmeti tāvataiva kṛtāthatvāt kāryasya tāvataivānvayaḥ, tad-abhāve 'bhāvaś ceti vyatirekaś ca | kevalaṃ tat-kṣaṇāt pāk paścād api kāraṇābhimatasya bhāvaḥ pramāṇopanītena kāryānupayogamātreṇa arihartuṃ śakya iti tāvan nityavādino viśeṣaḥ | saca vicāritaḥ | anvayavyatirekau tu yathoktamātreṇeti sthitam ||
analyzed: tad kṣaṇa anantaram asya janma iti tāvatā eva kṛta atha tvāt kāryasya tāvatā eva anvayaḥ tad abhāve bhāvaḥ ca iti vyatirekaḥ ca kevalam tad kṣaṇāt pāk paścāt api kāraṇa abhimatasya bhāvaḥ pramāṇa upanītena kārya anupayoga mātreṇa arihartum śakyaḥ iti tāvat nitya vādinaḥ viśeṣaḥ sa ca vicāritaḥ anvaya vyatirekau tu yathā ukta mātreṇa iti sthitam

original: [43,11] yad api sattvasyāsādhāraṇatāṃ pratijñāya ekasmād anekasmād ekaṃ anekaṃ votpadyata iti vimṛśyānekasmād anekotpatti-pakṣaṃ sthitam ādāyovāca Vācaspatiḥ, kiṃ pūrve kṣaṇā uttareṣāṃ kṣaṇāṃ parasparaṃ nirapekṣā eva janakā āhosvit sāpekṣā iti |
analyzed: yat api sattvasya asādhāraṇa tām pratijñāya ekasmāt anekasmāt ekam anekam vā utpadyate iti vimṛśya anekasmāt aneka utpatti pakṣam sthitam ādāya uvāca Vācaspatiḥ kim pūrve kṣaṇāḥ uttareṣām kṣaṇām parasparam nirapekṣāḥ eva janakāḥ āhosvit sa apekṣāḥ iti

original: nanūktam antyakṣaṇaprāptāḥ parasparam anapekṣāḥ kāryāṇi janayantīti | tat kim anabhyupetāropaprapañcena | tat kim idānīṃ samarthabījakṣaṇajanako 'pi taj-janane bījakṣaṇo 'napekṣa eva | om iti brūmaḥ | hantānena prakāreṇa sarva eva bījakṣaṇā nirapekṣāḥ kāryajanana iti kṛtaṃ sahakāribhiḥ |
analyzed: nanu uktam antya kṣaṇa prāptāḥ parasparam anapekṣāḥ kāryāṇi janayanti iti tat kim anabhyupeta āropa prapañcena tat kim idānīm samartha bīja kṣaṇa janakaḥ api tad janane bīja kṣaṇaḥ eva om iti brūmaḥ hanta anena prakāreṇa sarve eva bīja kṣaṇāḥ nirapekṣāḥ kārya janane iti kṛtam sahakāribhiḥ

original: nanūktaṃ naite prekṣāvantaḥ kiṃ tu svapratyayādhīnaniyatasannidhayo na kṣaṇam api vyavadher-īśata iti | tat kiṃ ayaṃ kṛṣī-balo 'pi na prekṣāvān, yaḥ kuśūlād apanīya bījam āvapati bhūmau parikarṣitāyāṃ kṣityādi-sahabhāvena evātiśayotpādaparamparayā aṅkurajananasāmarthyād bījasya | kuśūlasthād vatsara[śa] tenāpi tad adarśanāt tatrāvapatīti cet |
analyzed: nanu uktam na ete prekṣāvantaḥ kim tu sva pratyaya adhīna niyata sannidhayaḥ na kṣaṇam api vyavadheḥ īśate iti tat kim ayam na prekṣāvān yaḥ kuśūlāt apanīya bījam āvapati bhūmau parikarṣitāyām kṣiti ādi sahabhāvena eva atiśaya utpāda paramparayā aṅkura janana sāmarthyāt bījasya kuśūla sthāt vatsaraśas tena api tat adarśanāt tatra āvapati iti ced

original: atha kim ayaṃ na svasantānamātraprabhavaḥ samartho bījakṣaṇa | tathā cet, kathaṃ santānāntaraṃ sahakāri nāpekṣeta kāryakaraṇe |
analyzed: atha kim ayam na sva santāna mātra prabhavaḥ samarthaḥ bīja kṣaṇa tathā ced katham santāna antaram sahakāri na apekṣeta kārya karaṇe

original: [44,1] nanv apekṣata eva svotpāde, na punaḥ svakārye | tatratasyānapekṣatvam ucyate, na tu svotpattau | nanu svotpattāv apy asya svasantānavartī jāgarti pūrva eva nirapekṣaḥ kṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ tasya tasya pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ svasantānapatita evānapekṣo jāgarti janana iti kuśūlanihitabīja eva syāt kṛtī kṛṣī-balaḥ |
analyzed: nanu apekṣate eva sva utpāde na punar sva kārye tatra tasya anapekṣa tvam ucyate na tu sva utpattau nanu sva utpattau api asya sva santāna vartī jāgarti pūrvaḥ eva nirapekṣaḥ kṣaṇaḥ evam tasya tasya pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ sva santāna patitaḥ eva anapekṣaḥ jāgarti janane iti kuśūla nihita bījaḥ eva syāt kṛtī kṛṣī balaḥ

original: kṛtam asya prekṣāvataḥ kṛṣi-karmaṇā duṛkhākareṇeti |
analyzed: kṛtam asya prekṣāvataḥ kṛṣi karmaṇā duṛkhā kareṇa iti

original: [44,11] yadi manyeta dvividham iha kāryaṃ, ekaṃ [18b) sahakāribhir āhitātiśayaviśeṣaparamparā-prasavadharmakam, dvitīyaṃ sahakāry-atiśayanirapekṣajanakam | yatrāṅkuro 'tiśayaviśeṣaparamparāpekṣajanmā | ādyātiśayas tu sahakāri-kṛtātiśayaparamparā-nirapekṣotpādaḥ | na caitad ubhayavidham api kāryaṃ bījasya svasantānamātrād utpattim arhati |
analyzed: yadi manyeta dvividham iha kāryam ekam sahakāribhiḥ āhita atiśaya viśeṣa paramparā prasava dharmakam dvitīyam sahakāri atiśaya nirapekṣa janakam yatra aṅkura utiśaya viśeṣa paramparā apekṣa janmā ādya atiśayaḥ tu sahakāri kṛta atiśaya paramparā nirapekṣa utpādaḥ na ca etat ubhayavidham api kāryam bījasya sva santāna mātrāt utpattim arhati

original: kṣity-ādi-santānāntarāpekṣam eva bījaṃ svasantānavarti, bhinnasantānavarti vā kādācitkaṃ kāryaṃ karotīti kalpate kṛṣi-karmaṃ, santānāntarāṇi tu kādācitkakāryotpattau ye sahakāri-pratyayāḥ, ta eva yathāṅkurotpattau sahakāriṇo bījasya sāmarthyaprabodhe hetavaḥ kadācit teṣāṃ kṣity-ādīnāṃ yo 'pi jananahetavaḥ ta eva sāmarthyahetavo bhavanti, yathā
analyzed: kṣiti ādi santāna antara apekṣam eva bījam sva santāna varti bhinna santāna varti vā kādācitkam kāryam karoti iti kalpate kṛṣi karmam santāna antarāṇi tu kādācitka kārya utpattau ye sahakāri pratyayāḥ te eva yathā aṅkura utpattau sahakāriṇaḥ bījasya sāmarthya prabodhe hetavaḥ kadācid teṣām kṣiti ādīnām janana hetavaḥ te eva sāmarthya hetavaḥ bhavanti yathā

original: bījādinām ādyātiśayotpādane sāmarthyaprabodhahetava upasarpaṇapratyayāḥ | sarvathā santānāntarair anāhitātiśayaṃ na bījaṃ kāryaviśeṣaṃ kādācitkaṃ karoti | sāmarthyaprabodhahetavaś ca sahakāri-pratyayā upasarpaṇapratyayāś ca |
analyzed: bīja ādinām ādya atiśaya utpādane sāmarthya prabodha hetavaḥ upasarpaṇa pratyayāḥ sarvathā santāna antaraiḥ an āhita atiśayam na bījam kārya viśeṣam kādācitkam karoti sāmarthya prabodha hetavaḥ ca sahakāri pratyayāḥ upasarpaṇa pratyayāḥ ca

original: tad anupapannam | tathā hi bhavatu tathā dvividhaṃ kāryam | astu ca tat-kādācitkatvāt santānāntarāpekṣam | apekṣārthaś ca vaktavyaḥ | kāraṇasya svasāmarthyaprabodha iti cet |
analyzed: tat anupapannam tathā hi bhavatu tathā dvividham kāryam astu ca tad kādācitkatvāt santāna antara apekṣam apekṣā arthaḥ ca vaktavyaḥ kāraṇasya sva sāmarthya prabodhaḥ iti ced

original: nanu sāmarthyatat-prabodhayoḥ samarthabhāvatattvāvyatirekāt samarthapratyayotpāda ity uktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca svotpādāpekṣitakāraṇaṃ sahakāri-pratyayāt satyam abhyupagama eva doṣatvena codyate |

original: athāyam aṅkurajananasamartho vā kṣaṇaḥ, ādyātiśayo vā kiṃ nirapekṣeṇa svasantānamātrajanmanā pūrvakṣaṇena janyate, na punaḥ svasantānamātrajanmanā, asyāpi pūrvasmād eva puñjād utpatteḥ |
analyzed: atha ayam aṅkura janana samarthaḥ vā kṣaṇaḥ ādya atiśayaḥ vā kim nirapekṣeṇa sva santāna mātra janmanā pūrva kṣaṇena janyate na punar sva santāna mātra janmanā asya api pūrvasmāt eva puñjāt utpatteḥ

original: [45,1] nanu samāna śaktyā kuśūlajanmasu bījasantāneṣu kasmāt kiñcid eva bījaṃ paramparayā 'ṅkuropajananānuguṇam upajanyati bījakṣaṇam, nānye bījakṣaṇā bhinnasantānāntaḥ pātinaḥ | na khalūpasarpaṇapratyayāt prāg eteṣāṃ samānāsamānasantānavartināṃ kaścit paramparātiśayo bījakṣaṇānām |
analyzed: nanu śaktyā kuśūla janmasu bīja santāneṣu kasmāt kiñcid eva bījam paramparayā ṅkura upajanana anuguṇam upajanyati bīja kṣaṇam na anye bīja kṣaṇāḥ bhinna santāna antar pātinaḥ na khalu upasarpaṇa pratyayāt prāk eteṣām samāna asamāna santāna vartinām kaścid paramparā atiśayaḥ bīja kṣaṇānām

original: artopasarpaṇapratyayāt prāṇ na tatsantānavartino janayanti paramparayāpy aṅkuropajananānuguṇaṃ bījakṣaṇam, bījamātrajananāt teṣām | kasyacid bījakṣaṇasyopasarpaṇapratyayasahabhuva ādyātiśayotpādaḥ | hanta tarhi tad abhāve saty utpanno 'pi janayed eva |

original: kiṃ ca, prakṛtavyāpakānupalambhasya kṣaṇikavat akṣaṇike 'pi sāmarthyānapāyāt kathaṃ bādhakasiddhir ity asiddhir eva sarvathāyātā | śakyaṃ hi nitye 'pi vaktuṃ na sahakāriṇi sāpekṣasya karaṇam upakārābhāvāt | na nirapekṣasya, tena vinā karaṇāt |

original: sthiraṃ ca bījam aṅkurajanakenaiva rūpeṇa kṣitim utpādayati bhinnena vety-ādi yadā visadṛśakṣity-ādi-janmopālambhaḥ pradīpo 'pi cākṣaṇika eva bhavatām | tatra vartivikāratailakṣayāv ekena bhinnena vā rūpeṇa kriyetām iti samānam |

original: yas tu samādhiḥ sahakāriṇa eva bhinnāḥ tasya svarūpabheda iti, evaṃ ca bruvatā paro 'py ātmā ātmāpi para iti nivṛttedānīm ātmaparādi-śabdebhyaḥ pratiniyatārthapratyāyanapratyāśā | na ca devadattasya svarūpaṃ yajñadattaḥ śuklasya vā nīlam ity ucitaṃ kvacid ekakarmaṇi vyāpāre 'pi |
