original: [55,9] sahakāriṇo 'vadhīrya ca svarūpaśabdavācyam arthaṃ sahakāriṇottaram iti vyaktaṃ na tena nānyena vātmanā janayati sthiro 'pi bhāva iti niyatam anujñātaiva vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | anyasyāpi hi sa evātmā janako na svayam iti na kaścij janakaḥ | tad ayaṃ sthirāsthirayoḥ sādhārṇo nyāyaḥ kriyā-niṣedhasādhana iti |
analyzed: sahakāriṇaḥ ca svarūpa śabda vācyam artham sahakāriṇā uttaram iti vyaktam na tena na anyena vā ātmanā janayati sthiraḥ api bhāvaḥ iti niyatam anujñātā eva vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ anyasya api hi saḥ eva ātmā janakaḥ na svayam iti na kaścid janakaḥ tat ayam sthira asthirayoḥ sādhārṇaḥ nyāyaḥ kriyā niṣedha sādhanaḥ iti

original: tasya dṛṭhatve sarvathā kriyaiva nāstīty asiddhir eva, antataḥ kramayaugapadyavirahalakṣaṇasyāpi doṣasyāparihārāt | sthire 'pi kriyā-nivṛttir avaśyābhyupeyā | katham anyathā kṣaṇike kriyā-niṣedhābhidhānena kevalenāsādhāraṇatā-pratijñā nivṛttim ālambeta | na hi sādhyād vyāvṛttir ity evāsādhāraṇatā |
analyzed: tasya dṛṭha tve sarvathā kriyā eva nā asti iti asiddhiḥ eva antatas krama yaugapadya viraha lakṣaṇasya api doṣasya aparihārāt sthire pi kriyā nivṛttiḥ avaśya abhyupeyā katham anyathā kṣaṇike kriyā niṣedha abhidhānena kevalena asādhāraṇa tā pratijñā nivṛttim ālambeta na hi sādhyāt vyāvṛttiḥ iti eva asādhāraṇa tā

original: anyathā vipakṣād vyāvṛttir eva kiṃ nāsādhāraṇatvam ucyate, kim iyatā prayāsena |
analyzed: anyathā vipakṣāt vyāvṛttiḥ eva kim nā asādhāraṇa tvam ucyate kim iyatā prayāsena

original: [55,17] nanu vipakṣād vyāvṛttyā sādhye niyamād dhetur eva syād iti cet | sādhyād vyāvṛttyā vipakṣe niyamād viruddha eva (23a) syād iti smānam | tasmād arthakriyāyā[ḥ] pratijñā-mātre 'py asiddhir eva | athānyena prakāreṇa ubhayor aniścayamātraṃ sattāyāḥ khyāpyate, tathā ca saty asādhāraṇatā yuktaiva |
analyzed: nanu vipakṣāt vyāvṛttyā sādhye niyamāt hetuḥ eva syāt iti ced sādhyāt vyāvṛttyā vipakṣe niyamāt viruddhaḥ eva syāt iti smānam tasmāt arthakriyāyāḥ pratijñā mātre pi asiddhiḥ eva atha anyena prakāreṇa ubhayoḥ aniścaya mātram sattāyāḥ khyāpyate tathā ca satī asādhāraṇa tā yuktā eva

original: tad ayuktam | vyāpakānupalambho hy ekāntato 'bhāvaniścayakara eva katham aniścayaḥ | tatra yadi nāma kramādy-anupalambhasya nityāt sattā-nivartakasya dārṭhyamasaṃgatam, tathāpi prakṛtasya kṣaṇe nityatā-bādhanasya dṛṭhatvam abhipretam eva, anyathopanyāsāyogāt | tataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgurāt kriyāyā ekāntikī vyāvṛttir eva vyāvṛttir asādhāraṇatāyāḥ |
analyzed: tat ayuktam vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ hi ekāntataḥ bhāva niścaya karaḥ eva katham aniścayaḥ tatra yadi nāma krama ādi anupalambhasya nityāt sattā nivartakasya dārṭhyam asaṃgatam tathā api prakṛtasya kṣaṇe nitya tā bādhanasya dṛṭha tvam abhipretam eva anyathā upanyāsa ayogāt tatas kṣaṇa bhaṅgurāt kriyāyāḥ ekāntikī vyāvṛttiḥ eva vyāvṛttiḥ asādhāraṇa tāyāḥ

original: na hi gandhavattvaṃkutaścid ekāntena vyāvṛttam avasātuṃ śakyam | tad ayaṃ vyāpakānupalambhaḥ
analyzed: na hi gandhavat tvam kutaścid ekāntena vyāvṛttam avasātum śakyam tat ayam vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ

original: [56,1] sthire 'pi vyāpakānupalambham apekṣamāṇo na sādhur asādhāraṇatāsādhane | sarvathā kriyām evonmūlayatīty asiddhir eva na sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sthire pi vyāpaka anupalambham apekṣamāṇaḥ na sādhuḥ asādhāraṇa tā sādhane sarvathā kriyām eva unmūlayati iti asiddhiḥ eva na sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ

original: tasmād bāhyavedanaṃ bāhyavedakapramāṇasiddhaṃ cārthakriyāṃ vastu-satīm āśritya vādaprakrame tasyāsādharaṇatā-vādinā na sādhyetarayor ekatra vṛttir ekatā vyāvṛttir vopadarśayitavyā, kiṃ tūbhayatra saṃśayamātraṃ | na ca vyāpakānupalambhe saṃbhavas tasya | tasmān na sādhur asādhāraṇatopanyāsa iti sthitam |
analyzed: tasmāt bāhya vedanam bāhya vedaka pramāṇa siddham ca arthakriyām vastu satīm āśritya vāda prakrame tasya asādharaṇa tā vādinā na sādhya itarayoḥ ekatra vṛttiḥ ekatā vyāvṛttiḥ vā upadarśayitavyā kim tu ubhayatra saṃśaya mātram na ca vyāpaka anupalambhe saṃbhavaḥ tasya tasmāt na sādhuḥ asādhāraṇa tā upanyāsaḥ iti sthitam

original: [56,7] syād etat | yadi bhinnakālakāryajanmani janakasya svabhāvabhedaḥ, tadā bhinnadeśakāryotpāde 'py eṣa prasaṅgaḥ | tad avaśyaṃ sahakāryāpekṣayaiva deśabhedaḥ kāryāṇām | na ca kiñcit-karaḥ sahakārīti kālabhedo 'py eṣām akiñcit-karaḥ sahakāry-apekṣayaivāstu | athopādānabhedād deśabhedaḥ kālabhede tu naivaṃ śakyam abhidhātum |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi bhinna kāla kārya janmani janakasya svabhāva bhedaḥ tadā bhinna deśa kārya utpāde pi eṣa prasaṅgaḥ tat avaśyam sahakārya apekṣayā eva deśa bhedaḥ kāryāṇām na ca kiñcitkaraḥ sahakārī iti kāla bhedaḥ u pi eṣām akiñcitkaraḥ sahakāri apekṣayā eva astu atha upādāna bhedāt deśa bhedaḥ kāla bhede tu na evam śakyam abhidhātum

original: kālāntarajanyānām apādānasya sthirapakṣe tadānīm api prāpti-saṃbhavāt | tasmāt kāraṇabhedarūpabhedanibandhana eva kāryasya kālabheda iti cet, tad api nāsti, upādānasahakāri-bhedasya tattvato 'tāttvikatvāt | tāttvikatve 'py upādeyasahakāryabhedena dīpāder upādānasahakāri-bhāvabhedād anekasvabhāvatā prasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: kāla antara janyānām apādānasya sthira pakṣe tadānīm api prāpti saṃbhavāt tasmāt kāraṇa bheda rūpa bheda nibandhanaḥ eva kāryasya kāla bhedaḥ iti ced tat api nā asti upādāna sahakāri bhedasya tattvataḥ tāttvika tvāt tāttvika tve pi upādeya sahakārya bhedena dīpa ādeḥ upādāna sahakāri bhāva bhedāt aneka svabhāva tā prasaṅgaḥ

original: tad ayam āropitasvabhāva upāānasahakāri-bhāvabhedena bhedaḥ kāraṇasya kathaṃ kāryasya deśabhedāya prabhavet | yadi cāropito 'pi kāraṇasya bhedaḥ kāryasya deśabhedāya prabhaved evaṃ saty āropita eva kāraṇabhedaḥ kālabhedāya kāraṇāṃ paryāpta ity alaṃ tāttvikabhedapratyāśayā |
analyzed: tat ayam āropita svabhāvaḥ upāāna sahakāri bhāva bhedena bhedaḥ kāraṇasya katham kāryasya deśa bhedāya prabhavet yadi ca āropitaḥ api kāraṇasya bhedaḥ kāryasya deśa bhedāya prabhavet evam sati āropitaḥ eva kāraṇa bhedaḥ kāla bhedāya kāraṇām paryāptaḥ iti alam tāttvika bheda pratyāśayā

original: [56,18] na caitad vaktavyam, yathā kālabhede yad yadā yaj janakam ity-ādi bādhakam asti na tadā deśabheda iti, etādṛśasya bādhakasya deśabhede 'pi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt | yathā yat yat kāryaṃ tat tad deśe yathopādeyābhimataṃ, tat-kāryaṃ ca kāryāntaram apīti || yad apīdam ucyate,
analyzed: na ca etat vaktavyam yathā kāla bhede yat yadā yat janakam ityādi bādhakam asti na tadā deśa bhedaḥ iti etādṛśasya bādhakasya deśa bhede vaktum śakya tvāt yathā yat yat kāryam tat tat deśe yathā upādeya abhimatam tat kāryam ca kārya antaram api iti yat api idam ucyate

original: [57,3] atha kāraṇasya vaibhāvāabhyupagame syād eṣa doṣaḥ | tad-abhāve [23b) tu kiṃ kṛtam asya sarvadeśasamānatvam | evaṃ tarhi deśāntare 'pi kāryaṃ na kuryāt, tatra svayam apravṛtteḥ | yogyatā-mātreṇa tu tad-deśavṛttim anapekṣya tatra kāryakāriṇaḥ samāno 'sya deśaḥ upakārasyaikato 'py alābhāt |
analyzed: atha kāraṇasya vaibhāva aabhyupagame syāt eṣa doṣaḥ tad abhāve tu kim kṛtam asya sarva deśa samāna tvam evam tarhi deśa antare pi kāryam na kuryāt tatra svayam apravṛtteḥ yogyatā mātreṇa tu tad deśa vṛttim an apekṣya tatra kārya kāriṇaḥ samānaḥ sya deśaḥ upakārasya ekatas pi alābhāt

original: tasmāt tad-deśe karotīti na svāpekṣayā deśasyādhārabhāvaḥ kiṃ tu kāryāpekṣyā | ayogavyavacchedena ca tat-karaṇam | anyathā deśāntaravataḥ kāryasya karaṇaprasaṅgāt | evaṃ tarhi kāle karotīti sa kālaḥ kāryasyaivādhāro niyamena | hetos tu sa cāsac ca syāt | ayogavyavacchedena tv ekakālakāryakaraṇam iti kālāntaravato 'pi kāryasya karaṇam avirodhi |
analyzed: tasmāt tad deśe karoti iti na sva apekṣayā deśasya ādhāra bhāvaḥ kim tu kārya apekṣyāḥ ayoga vyavacchedena ca tat karaṇam anyathā deśa antaravataḥ kāryasya karaṇa prasaṅgāt evam tarhi kāle karoti iti sa kālaḥ kāryasya eva ādhāraḥ niyamena hetoḥ tu sa ca asat ca syāt ayoga vyavacchedena tu eka kāla kārya karaṇam iti kāla antaravataḥ pi kāryasya karaṇam avirodhi

original: tasmāt kuśūlādi-sarvāvasthā-samānasvabhāvasyāpi tad-atat-kālakāryajananam upapannam, bhinnadeśānekakāryārjanavat iti |
analyzed: tasmāt kuśūla ādi sarva avasthā samāna svabhāvasya api tad atatkāla kārya jananam upapannam bhinna deśa aneka kārya arjana vat iti

original: [57,12] tad etan na saṅgatam, bādhakabhāvābhāvābhyāṃ viśeṣāt | yat tu tat-kāryatvaṃ tad-deśatā-sādhanāyopanyastaṃ tad-viparyayabādhakapramāṇābhāvād asādhanam eva | anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyaś ca kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | tau ca yathā tad-deśakāryajanmani dṛṣṭau tathā bhinnadeśakāryasaṃbhave 'pi |
analyzed: tat etat na bādhaka bhāva abhāvābhyām viśeṣāt yat tu tad kāryatvam tad deśa tā sādhanāya upanyastam tad viparyaya bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt asādhanam eva anvaya vyatireka samadhigamyaḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tau ca yathā tad deśa kārya janmani dṛṣṭau tathā bhinna deśa kārya saṃbhave pi

original: na caivaṃ sthitenāpi kāraṇena saha tat-kālakāryasyānyakālakāryasya vānvayavyatirekau samānāv iti yuktam | kālāntare 'pi tad eva kāraṇam anuvartata iti na pratyabhijñāto 'nyat pramāṇam, sā ca dūṣiteti kathaṃ sthireṇānvayavyatirekagrahaṇaṃ kāryāṇāṃ kālabhedavatām iti nāyaṃ nyāyaḥ samānaḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam sthitena api kāraṇena saha tad kāla kāryasya anya kāla kāryasya vā anvaya vyatirekau samānau iti yuktam kāla antare pi tat eva kāraṇam anuvartate iti na pratyabhijñātaḥ pramāṇam sā ca dūṣitā iti katham sthireṇa anvaya vyatireka grahaṇam kāryāṇām kāla bhedavatām iti na ayam nyāyaḥ samānaḥ

original: tato viparyayabādhakavikalatayā deśabhede bhedasādhano hetur yadi svasādhyasādhanasamarthaḥ kim āyātaṃ tadbalavataḥ kālabhede bhedasādhanasya | na hi vṛṣbhasyādohayogyatve dhenor api tatheti yuktam |

original: [57,21] astu vā deśabhedena bhedasādhanasyāpi viparyayabādhā balam, kālabhede bhedasādhanasya tu kim etāvatā dūṣaṇam anaikāntikatvam upapādyata iti cet?

original: tad apy ayuktam | tathā hi na parmāṇoḥ kālavyāpti-sadṛśī deśavyāptir iṣyate nityavādibhiḥ | nāpi vidyud(24a)-udyotasya deśavyāpti-sadṛśī kālavyāptir eva ghaṭāder apīti kathaṃ sarvatra samānanyāyatā | na cānyatra samānanyāyatādadarśane 'pi sarvatra tathā-bhāvaḥ, prastute vaiparītyasaṃbhave bādhakābhāvāt ||
analyzed: tat api ayuktam tathā hi na parma aṇoḥ kāla vyāpti sadṛśī deśa vyāptiḥ iṣyate nitya vādibhiḥ nā api vidyut audyotasya deśa vyāpti sadṛśī kāla vyāptiḥ eva ghaṭa ādeḥ api iti katham sarvatra samāna nyāya tā na ca anyatra samāna nyāya tā dadarśane sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ prastute vaiparītya saṃbhave bādhaka abhāvāt

original: [60,20] kriyāvatā ced avaśyaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgureṇa bhāvyam, kṣaṇikatvavyatireke na bhavaty eva niyataṃ satteti | yadi tu tad abhāve 'pi syāt, tadā tasyāṃ satyāṃ niyamena kṣaṇikatvam ity anvayo 'pi katham | tasmāt sādhyābhāve sādhanasyaikāntiko vyatirekaḥ, sādhane sati sādhyasyāvaśyam anvayo veti na kaścid arthato bhedaḥ |

original: pramāṇavyāpāras tu mukhyato 'rthataś ceti dvidhā vyavahāraḥ | ata eva yatra yatra sādhyaviparyaye bādhakapramāṇaparyeṣaṇā, tatra sādhane sati sādhyānvayaḥ, sādhakapramāṇaparyeṣaṇāpi tayopalakṣitā veditavyā | viparyayabādhakaśabdena punar ubhayasaṃgraha eva |

original: vyatirekarūpavyāptau hi sādhyaviparyaye bādhakaṃ sādhanasya, anvayarūpāyāṃ tu sādhyaviparyayasya bādhakaṃ sādhane satīti | tad ubhayābhāve sādhanasya sādhyapratibandhānupapattir ity ayam arthaḥ |

original: anyathā vyatirekaniścāyakapramāṇasya sākṣād alābhe 'pi yadi sādhanasya sādhyenānvayaniyamaprasādhakaṃ pramāṇam upadarśayet, kas tasya sādhyasiddhau pratibandho vyatirekasyānvayasyāpi sāmarthyākṣepāt | anyathā sādharmyaprayogo 'nupādeya eva syāt, sākṣād vyatirekānupadarśanāt |
analyzed: anyathā vyatireka niścāyaka pramāṇasya sākṣāt alābhe yadi sādhanasya sādhyena anvaya niyama prasādhakam pramāṇam upadarśayet kaḥ tasya sādhya siddhau pratibandhaḥ vyatirekasya anvayasya api sāmarthya ākṣepāt anyathā sādharmya prayogaḥ nu upādeyaḥ eva syāt sākṣāt vyatireka anupadarśanāt

original: tad yadi sāmarthyagamyo 'pi na vyatirekātmā, tadā 'pi yatra yatra sādhanaṃ tatra tatra sādhyam itīyataiva sādhane sati sādhyapratyāśā-prayuktaḥ kṛtīkṛtārthaḥ | tad abhāve 'bhāviny api hi sādhane sati yadi tadbhāve 'vaśyaṃbhāvi sādhyaṃ tadā phalitaḥ sādhanasvīkāraḥ |

original: tasmāt sādhanavādinā dvayam api paryeṣaṇīyaṃ vikalpena, vādinā caiko 'pi prakāraḥ pramāṇasiddha upadarśayitavyaḥ, parasādhaneṣu ca vyatirekavad anvayo 'pi niyamavān durlabha eveti veditavyam |

original: yo yaḥ saṃskāraḥ kvacit santāne āhitaḥ sa tatraiva phaladānayoggyo nānyatra | yathā karpāsasantane bījāvasthāyāṃ rāgadravyayogajanitaḥ puṣpāvasthāyāṃ phalāvasthāyāṃ vā rāgaṃ phalam unmīlayituṃ yogyo nānya- santāne |
analyzed: yaḥ yaḥ saṃskāraḥ kvacid santāne āhitaḥ sa tatra eva phala dāna yoggyaḥ na anyatra yathā karpāsa santane bīja avasthāyām rāga dravya yoga janitaḥ puṣpa avasthāyām phala avasthāyām vā rāgam phalam unmīlayitum yogyaḥ na anya santāne

original: saṃskāraś cāyaṃ dānādi-karmajanitaś cittasantāna
analyzed: saṃskāraḥ ca ayam dāna ādi karma janitaḥ citta santāna

original: iti | svabhāvahetur eva samudāyasādhyāpekṣayā | saṃskāramatrānubandhinī hi tatsantāne phaladānayogyatā anyasantāne sarvathā tad-ayogyatā ceti nimittāntarānapekṣaṇāt | ekaikasādhyatve tu prathame svabhāvahetuḥ |
analyzed: iti svabhāva hetuḥ eva samudāya sādhya apekṣayā saṃskāra matra anubandhinī hi tad santāne phala dāna yogyatā anya santāne sarvathā tad ayogya tā ca iti nimitta antara anapekṣaṇāt ekaika sādhya tve tu prathame svabhāva hetuḥ

original: dvitīye tu viruddhavyāptopalabdhiḥ, svādhārād anyasantāne phaladānaviruddhena svādhārasantāna eva phaladānena vyāptasya saṃskāratvasyopalabdheḥ | tatra yadi saṃskāre 'pi sati tatra santāne phaladānayogyatā nimittāntaram apekṣeta, prayatnena saṃskāraghaṭanam anarthakaṃ syāt | anyasantāne 'pi phaladānasāmarthye ca dvitīyaprayatnavaiyarthyam |
analyzed: dvitīye tu viruddha vyāpta upalabdhiḥ sva ādhārāt anya santāne phala dāna viruddhena sva ādhāra santāne eva phala dānena vyāptasya saṃskāra tvasya upalabdheḥ tatra yadi saṃskāre sati tatra santāne phala dāna yogya tā nimitta antaram apekṣeta prayatnena saṃskāra ghaṭanam anarthakam syāt anya santāne pi phala dāna sāmarthye ca dvitīya prayatna vaiyarthyam

original: na caikāmalakyāṃ kṣīrāavaseke sarvāmalakī madhuraphalā | tasmāt svasantāna eva phaladānena vyāptiḥ saṃskārasyeti nānekāntaḥ | saṃskāraś ca karmakṛto viśeṣaś cetasa ity āgamasiddham abhyupagamyaiva codyavat samādhānam apīti nāsiddhiḥ | sapakṣe bhāvān na virodho vyāpty-asiddher vā |
analyzed: na ca eka āmalakyām kṣīra avaseke sarvā āmalakī madhura phalā tasmāt sva santāne eva phala dānena vyāptiḥ saṃskārasya iti na anekāntaḥ saṃskāraḥ ca karma kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ cetasaḥ iti āgama siddham abhyupagamya eva codya vat samādhānam api iti na asiddhiḥ sapakṣe bhāvāt na virodhaḥ vyāpti asiddheḥ vā

original: atha vā, yo yaḥ santānaḥ sa svādikaraṇa eva saṃskāre saṃskāre phaladānayogyo yathā karpāsasantānaḥ, santānaś cāyaṃ cittasantāna iti pūrvavat ||
analyzed: atha vā yaḥ yaḥ santānaḥ sa sva ādi karaṇe eva saṃskāre saṃskāre phala dāna yogyaḥ yathā karpāsa santānaḥ santānaḥ ca ayam citta santānaḥ iti pūrvavat

original: [73,9] smṛtyādi-phalāpekṣayā 'py ayam eva nyāyaḥ | yadi santānadvāreṇāyaṃ vyavasthā, tadā vidyāyoni-saṃbandhaprasidde 'pi santāne prasaṃgaḥ | tato guruṇānubhūtādau śiṣyasya smṛty-ādiḥ syāt, evaṃ pitur-anubhavādau putrasya bhavet | naitādṛśaḥ santāno 'tra vivakṣitaḥ upādānopādeyabhūtahetuphalaparamparā-rūpaḥ | kiṃ punar upādānopādeyalakṣaṇam |
analyzed: smṛti ādi phala apekṣayā api ayam eva nyāyaḥ yadi santāna dvāreṇa ayam vyavasthā tadā santāne prasaṃgaḥ tatas guruṇā anubhūta ādau śiṣyasya smṛti ādiḥ syāt evam pituḥ anubhava ādau putrasya bhavet na etādṛśaḥ santānaḥ vivakṣitaḥ upādāna upādeya bhūta hetu phala paramparā rūpaḥ kim punar upādāna upādeya lakṣaṇam

original: ekādhāratāniyamo 'sati vicārakāraṇe, vicāre 'pi tad-yogyatāniyamaḥ | vicitrā hi kāryakāraṇaparamparopapāditā pūrvam, tatraivaṃ lakṣaṇā paramparā santāna ucyata ity api sūcitam eva | na caivaṃ guru-śiṣyacetasoḥ pitā-putramanasor vā astīti nātiprasaṅgadoṣo Nyāyabhūṣaṇīyaḥ |
analyzed: sati vicāra kāraṇe vicāre tad yogya tā niyamaḥ vicitrā hi kārya kāraṇa paramparā upapāditā pūrvam tatra evam lakṣaṇā paramparā santānaḥ ucyate iti api sūcitam eva na ca evam guru śiṣya cetasoḥ pitā putra manasoḥ vā asti iti na ati prasaṅga doṣaḥ

original: santānopādānavyavasthyor vānyonyāśrayadoṣaḥ, upādānavyavasthāyās tad nāśrayatvapratipādanāt |
analyzed: santāna upādāna vyavasthyoḥ vā anyonya āśraya doṣaḥ upādāna vyavasthāyāḥ tat na āśraya tva pratipādanāt

original: [73,18] atha vā abhrānta-(30a)saṃmataikāvasāyaḥ prakṛtivikriye ubhau hetuphalasyopādānopādeyalakṣaṇam | hetuphalasantatau idam upādānam idam upādeyam iti pratyabhijñā-pratyayena lakṣitaṃ veditavyam | visabhāgotpattau tu prakṛtir-upādānasya vikṛtir upādeyasya lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāva eva |
analyzed: atha vā abhrānta asaṃmata eka avasāyaḥ prakṛti vikriye ubhau hetu phalasya upādāna upādeya lakṣaṇam hetu phala santatau idam upādānam idam upādeyam iti pratyabhijñā pratyayena lakṣitam veditavyam visabhāga utpattau tu prakṛtiḥ upādānasya vikṛtiḥ upādeyasya lakṣaṇam svabhāvaḥ eva

original: prakṛtivikṛtitvaṃ vā lakṣaṇam iti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, kāṣṭhayūpavat kāṣṭhāṅgāravac ca | anekotpattāv api bhinnā eva bhāgā upādānam | yathā dhūme uṣmādīnām aṅgārāṇām, buddhāv apy ekapuruṣaprajñaptir ekāvasāyaḥ | asti ca viṣayoparāgaṃ vivecya caitanyamātram āmṛśata ekapuruṣābhimatāyāṃ santatau saiveyaṃ buddhir ity avasāyaḥ |
analyzed: prakṛti vikṛti tvam vā lakṣaṇam iti bhāva pradhānaḥ nirdeśaḥ kāṣṭha yūpa vat kāṣṭha aṅgāra vat ca aneka utpattau api bhinnāḥ eva bhāgāḥ upādānam yathā dhūme uṣma ādīnām aṅgārāṇām buddhau api eka puruṣa prajñaptiḥ eka avasāyaḥ asti ca viṣaya uparāgam vivecya caitanya mātram āmṛśate eka puruṣa abhimatāyām santatau sā eva iyam buddhiḥ iti avasāyaḥ

original: te punar atrāśeṣasvarūpānanukārāt, anukārasaṃbhave 'pi stabāntaravad ekāvasāyo bhrānta iti na pitā-putrādāv upādānādivyavasthā | tad evaṃ upādānādilakṣaṇam anapekṣya tādṛk-santatau upādānādivyavasthāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ kīdṛśe santāne āhitā karmavāsaneti jijñāsāyāṃ yatropādānādivyavastheti bhaṇitau na doṣaḥ |
analyzed: te punar atra aśeṣa svarūpa an anukārāt anukāra saṃbhave staba antara vat eka avasāyaḥ bhrāntaḥ iti na pitāputra ādau upādāna ādi vyavasthā tat evam upādāna ādi lakṣaṇam an apekṣya tādṛś santatau upādāna ādi vyavasthāyām kṛtāyām kīdṛśe santāne āhitā karma vāsanā iti jijñāsāyām yatra upādāna ādi vyavasthā iti bhaṇitau na doṣaḥ

original: [74,4] yat punar ayam evāha | na, sambandhaviśeṣābhāve kāraṇamātraviśeṣād upādānetaravibhāgānupapatteḥ, yathāsmākaṃ janakatvāviśeṣe 'pi samavāyy-asamavāyi-nimittakāraṇavibhāgaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣāt, na tathā tava kāraṇānām upādānetaravibhāgaṃ paśyāma iti |
analyzed: yat punar ayam eva āha na sambandha viśeṣa abhāve kāraṇa mātra viśeṣāt upādāna itara vibhāga anupapatteḥ yathā asmākam janaka tva aviśeṣe pi samavāyi asamavāyi nimitta kāraṇa vibhāgaḥ saṃbandha viśeṣāt na tathā tava kāraṇānām upādāna itara vibhāgam paśyāmaḥ iti

original: etad api dūṣitam eva, kāraṇatvasāmānye 'pi kāryāpekṣayā vibhāgasya darśitatvāt | kāryakāraṇayor anyonyaviśeṣānapekṣaṇe hi saṃbandhadvāreṇāpi vyavasthādausthyam āpāditam | na ca samavāyaḥ kṣama ity api leśena sūcitam eva | tasmān na saṃskārasantānayor dūṣaṇaṃ kiñcit |
analyzed: etat api dūṣitam eva kāraṇa tva sāmānye pi kārya apekṣayā vibhāgasya darśita tvāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ anyonya viśeṣa anapekṣaṇe hi saṃbandha dvāreṇa api vyavasthā dausthyam āpāditam na ca samavāyaḥ kṣamaḥ iti api leśena sūcitam eva tasmāt na saṃskāra santānayoḥ dūṣaṇam kiñcid

original: [74,11] yady api cātra śloke karmavāsanā-śabdaḥ prayukto na cāsyārthaḥ karpāsam anveti, tathāpi vāsanārtho 'bhisaṃskāras tāvad anvetīti sa eva hetuḥ sūcito grāhyaḥ | atha vā karmaśabdenāpi kriyā | yatra santāne yayā kayācit kriyayā kṛto 'bhisaṃskāra ity arthaḥ | etena vyāpti-pradarśanam, pakṣadharmas tu prastāvād boddhavyaḥ |
analyzed: yadi api ca atra śloke karma vāsanā śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ na ca asya arthaḥ karpāsam anveti tathā api vāsanā arthaḥ bhisaṃskāraḥ tāvat anveti iti saḥ eva hetuḥ sūcitaḥ grāhyaḥ atha vā karma śabdena api kriyā yatra santāne yayā kayācid kriyayā kṛtaḥ bhisaṃskāraḥ iti arthaḥ etena vyāpti pradarśanam pakṣa dharmaḥ tu prastāvāt boddhavyaḥ

original: tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ sākṣāt tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ sākṣāt smṛtau pratipādakam ādāya yad uktaṃ tatsarvaṃ viplutam, kāryakāraṇabhāvāśrayaviśeṣānvayinī tu smṛtir ity anavadyam |
analyzed: tatas kārya kāraṇa bhāvam sākṣāt tatas kārya kāraṇa bhāvam sākṣāt smṛtau pratipādakam ādāya yat uktam tat sarvam viplutam kārya kāraṇa bhāva āśraya viśeṣa anvayinī tu smṛtiḥ iti anavadyam

original: yat punar asya sādhanaṃ na pūrvabuddhyānubhūte 'rthe uttarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtir bhavaty anyatvāt, santānāntarabuddhivad iti, tatrottarabuddhīnāṃ dharmiṇīnāṃ bhinnasmṛti-rūpabuddhi-sambandho niṣidhyata uta smṛti-rūpatvam eva tāsāṃ vāryate, atha smṛtyā phalavaty astā na bhavatīti pratipādyate | prathamapakṣas tāvad ayuktaḥ |
analyzed: yat punar asya sādhanam na pūrva buddhyā anubhūte rthe uttara buddhīnām smṛtiḥ bhavati anya tvāt santāna antara buddhi vat iti tatra uttara buddhīnām dharmiṇīnām bhinna smṛti rūpa buddhi sambandhaḥ niṣidhyate uta smṛti rūpa tvam eva tāsām vāryate atha smṛtyā phalavatī astā na bhavati iti pratipādyate prathama pakṣaḥ tāvat ayuktaḥ

original: na hy smṛtir anyā ca smṛti-matī matir iṣyate asmābhir yan niṣedhaḥ syāt, api tu smṛti-rūpaiva sā matir iti |
analyzed: na hi smṛtiḥ anyā ca smṛtimatī matiḥ iṣyate asmābhiḥ yat niṣedhaḥ syāt api tu smṛti rūpā eva sā matiḥ iti

original: athāśvasya smarato gavekṣaṇakāle tad-darśanaṃ smṛtimad bhavatīti cet |
analyzed: atha āśvasya smarataḥ gavekṣaṇa kāle tat darśanam smṛtimat bhavati iti ced

original: tat kiṃ tad-avasthāyā eva smṛtter niṣedho (30b) vivakṣitaḥ | kevalā tu yadi smṛtir bhavati tadā bhavatu | naivaṃ cet | kim anena tarhi uttarabuddhīnām iti sahacāranirdeśena |
analyzed: tat kim tad avasthāyāḥ eva smṛtteḥ niṣedhaḥ vivakṣitaḥ kevalā tu yadi smṛtiḥ bhavati tadā bhavatu na evam ced kim anena tarhi uttara buddhīnām iti sahacāra nirdeśena

original: athānumānārthaṃ dharmi-nirdeśa eva iti cet | na, prakṛtābhimatasākalyasiddheḥ sarvathottarakālaṃ smṛti-niṣedhasyeṣṭatvāt pakṣaikadeśāsiddhiḥ sādhanasya |
analyzed: atha anumāna artham dharmi nirdeśaḥ eva iti ced na prakṛta abhimata sākalya siddheḥ sarvathā uttarakālam smṛti niṣedhasya iṣṭa tvāt pakṣa eka deśa asiddhiḥ sādhanasya

original: [75,1] athāśakti-darśāyāṃ kevalasmṛti-kāle niṣedho neṣṭa eva | tarhi vinātmānam uttarakālaṃ smṛti-saṃbhave buddhy-antarasahacārakālena kim aparāddhaṃ yat tatraiva niṣedhaḥ | nāpi vyāptiviṣaye kiñcid asti bādhakam |
analyzed: atha aśakti darśāyām kevala smṛti kāle niṣedhaḥ na iṣṭaḥ eva tarhi vinā ātmānam uttara kālam smṛti saṃbhave buddhi antara sahacāra kālena kim aparāddham yat tatra eva niṣedhaḥ nā api vyāpti viṣaye kiñcid asti bādhakam

original: dvitīyapakṣe tu uttarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtitvaniṣedhe kim anubhavasyaiva smṛtitvam atha pūrvabuddhīnām | sarvathā niṣedhe tu kiṃ viśeṣanirdeśeneti pūrvavat |
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe tu uttara buddhīnām smṛti tva niṣedhe kim anubhavasya eva smṛti tvam atha pūrva buddhīnām sarvathā niṣedhe tu kim viśeṣa nirdeśena iti pūrvavat

original: [75,6] tṛtīye tu vikalpe evam eva viśeṣanirdeśavaiyarthyaṃ samarthanīyam | atha viśeṣanirdeśasyopalakṣaṇatvāt sarvaivānubhavād anyā buddhir na smṛti-rūpā, nāpi smṛtim utpādayati ity abhimatam | anubhavasya na hi tathātvaṃ niṣiddham, tato 'nubhavaḥ smṛti-rūpaḥ smṛtiṃ cotpādayatīty ubhayam apy aniṣṭam āsaktam |
analyzed: tṛtīye tu vikalpe evam eva viśeṣa nirdeśa vaiyarthyam samarthanīyam atha viśeṣa nirdeśasya upalakṣaṇa tvāt sarvā eva anubhavāt anyā buddhiḥ na smṛti rūpā na api smṛtim utpādayati iti abhimatam anubhavasya na hi tathātvam niṣiddham tatas nubhavaḥ smṛti rūpaḥ smṛtim ca utpādayati iti ubhayam api aniṣṭam āsaktam

original: anyathā 'nubhavād anyatayā viśeṣaṇam anarthakam | anarthakam evāstu, sarveṣām eva jñānānāṃ tadāpy anubhavād anyatvaṃ hetuḥ pakṣaikadeśāsiddhaḥ, anubhavasyaiva tad-anyathābhāvāt |
analyzed: anyathā anubhavāt anya tayā viśeṣaṇam anarthakam anarthakam eva astu sarveṣām eva jñānānām tadā api anubhavāt anya tvam hetuḥ pakṣa eka deśa asiddhaḥ anubhavasya eva tad anyathābhāvāt

original: athottaragrahaṇaṃ vivādapadatvena na tv anyavyavacchedena, anyāsāṃ tu buddhīnāṃ bauddhenāpi smṛti-bhāvāniṣṭeḥ | tathāpi tṛtīyapakṣe nedam uttaram, anubhavasyāpi vivādapadatvāt | nairātmyapakṣe hy anubhavo 'pi sākṣāt smṛtim utpādayatīty aniṣṭam eva bhavataḥ | bauddhasya punar iṣṭam |
analyzed: atha uttara grahaṇam vivāda pada tvena na tu anya vyavacchedena anyāsām tu buddhīnām bauddhena api smṛti bhāva aniṣṭeḥ tathā api tṛtīya pakṣe na idam uttaram anubhavasya api vivāda pada tvāt nairātmya pakṣe hi sākṣāt smṛtim utpādayati iti aniṣṭam eva bhavataḥ bauddhasya punar iṣṭam

original: tad ayam anubhavasya smṛti-janakatvaṃ na svīkartuṃ śakto 'priyatvāt, na parihartum, hetoḥ pakṣaikadeśāsiddher iti |
analyzed: tat ayam anubhavasya smṛti janaka tvam na svīkartum śakto priya tvāt na parihartum hetoḥ pakṣa eka deśa asiddheḥ iti

original: [75,16] astu caivam ubhayapakṣe 'pi tu vyāptir na śakyā | tathā hi yasyā uttarabuddheḥ smṛtitvaṃ smṛti-janakatvaṃ veṣyate, tasyā yadi tad ubhayaprāptav anubhavād anyatvahānir upapādayituṃ pāryate na paryavasyatu vyāptis tad anyatvasya tad-ubhayaniṣedhena | na caivaṃ śakyam |
analyzed: astu ca evam ubhaya pakṣe tu vyāptiḥ na śakyā tathā hi yasyāḥ uttara buddheḥ smṛti tvam smṛti janaka tvam vā iṣyate tasyāḥ yadi tat anubhavāt anya tva hāniḥ upapādayitum pāryate na paryavasyatu vyāptiḥ tat anya tvasya tad ubhaya niṣedhena na ca evam śakyam

original: anubhavād anyatvahānāv anubhavatvam eva, tac ca kathaṃ smṛtitve vaktum śakyam | smṛti-janakatve ca tad ucyamānam anubhavasya smaraṇahetutvam anapīya na viśramyati | pratibandhasiddhau hi prasaṅgasaṅgatiḥ | evam uttarakālabhāvitvādayo 'pi nāśaṅkyāḥ, śakyapratīkaratvāt tad-vad eva | anekāntas tu hetu-doṣo vyāpter abhāvāt |
analyzed: anubhavāt anya tva hānau anubhava tvam eva tat ca katham smṛti tve vaktum śakyam smṛti janaka tve ca tat ucyamānam anubhavasya smaraṇa hetu tvam na viśramyati pratibandha siddhau hi prasaṅga saṅgatiḥ evam uttara kāla bhāvi tva ādayaḥ pi nā āśaṅkyāḥ śakya pratīkara tvāt tadvat eva anekāntaḥ tu hetu doṣaḥ vyāpteḥ abhāvāt

original: na tāvad vāstavaḥ, kalpitavirodhivirodhatvād bandhyā-putravirodhavat | atha virodho 'pi kālpanika eva, na tarhi paramārthato 'kṣaṇikasyārthakriyāyāṃ kramākramābhyāṃ virodha ity ato 'kṣaṇikāt sattvasya vyatirekasiddhir apy apāramārthikīty avāstavavyatirekatvāt sattāyāḥ, tad-āyattaṃ kṣaṇikatvam apy avāstavam eveti |
analyzed: na tāvat vāstavaḥ kalpita virodhi virodha tvāt bandhyā putra virodha vat atha virodhaḥ pi kālpanikaḥ eva na tarhi paramārthataḥ kṣaṇikasya arthakriyāyām kramākramābhyām virodhaḥ iti atas kṣaṇikāt sattvasya vyatireka siddhiḥ api apāramārthikī iti avāstava vyatireka tvāt sattāyāḥ tad āyattam kṣaṇika tvam api avāstavam eva iti

original: [97,6] abaddhapralapitam etat | na hi virodho nāma vastv-antaraṃ kiñcid ubhayakoṭi-dattapādaṃ sambandhābhidhānam iṣyate 'smābhiḥ, upapadyate vā, yenaikasaṃbandhino vastutvābhāve apāramārthikaḥ syāt | yathā tv iṣyate tathā pāramārthika eva | viruddhābhimatayor anyonyasvarūpaparihāramātraṃ virodhārthaḥ |
analyzed: abaddha pralapitam etat na hi virodhaḥ nāma vastu antaram kiñcid ubhaya koṭi datta pādam sambandha abhidhānam iṣyate smābhiḥ upapadyate vā yena eka saṃbandhinaḥ vastu tva abhāve apāramārthikaḥ syāt yathā tu iṣyate tathā pāramārthikaḥ eva viruddha abhimatayoḥ anyonya svarūpa parihāra mātram virodha arthaḥ

original: tac ca bhāvābhāvayoḥ (39b) pāramārthikam eva | na hi bhāvo 'bhāvarūpam āviśati, nāpy abhāvo bhāvarūpam iti yo 'yam anayor asaṅkaraniyamaḥ sa eva virodhaḥ | sa ca niyamaḥ svātmanaṃ virodham api pāramārthikapade niveśayati | evaṃ na nityaṃ kramayaugapadyarūpam āviśati, nāpi kramayaugapadyaṃ nityarūpam āviśatīti yo 'yaṃniyamaḥ sa eva virodhas tayoḥ |
analyzed: tat ca bhāva abhāvayoḥ pāramārthikam eva na hi bhāvaḥ bhāva rūpam āviśati na api abhāvaḥ bhāva rūpam iti yaḥ yam anayoḥ asaṅkara niyamaḥ saḥ eva virodhaḥ sa ca niyamaḥ sva ātmanam virodham api pāramārthika pade niveśayati evam na nityam krama yaugapadya rūpam āviśati na api krama yaugapadyam nitya rūpam āviśati iti yaḥ yam niyamaḥ saḥ eva virodhaḥ tayoḥ

original: na ca kadācid anyateti pramāṇasiddhir eva pāramārthikateti katham ucyate, virodhasyāpāramārthikatayā sattvahetor vyatireko 'py atāttvika iti?
analyzed: na ca kadācid anyatā iti pramāṇa siddhiḥ eva pāramārthika tā iti katham ucyate virodhasya apāramārthika tayā sattva hetoḥ vyatirekaḥ pi atāttvikaḥ iti

original: [97,14] nityasya punar apāramārthikatvam aṅgīkṛtyaiva sarvam avasthāpitam iti na kaścid doṣaḥ | yac ca kalpitavirodhivirodhasya vāstvatvaniṣedhāya kalpitaviroddhivirodhatvād bandhyā-sutavirodhavad ity uktam, tatraiva anena tapasvinā katham āśrayāsiddhitvādi-dūṣaṇaṃ sthavīyo 'pi nopalabdham ity āstāṃ tāvad asya maodghāṭanam |
analyzed: nityasya punar apāramārthika tvam aṅgīkṛtya eva sarvam avasthāpitam iti na kaścid doṣaḥ yat ca kalpita virodhi virodhasya vāstva tva niṣedhāya kalpita viroddhi virodha tvāt bandhyā suta virodha vat iti uktam tatra eva anena tapasvinā katham āśraya asiddhi tva ādi dūṣaṇam sthavīyaḥ na upalabdham iti āstām tāvat asya

original: [97,19] etac ca cintyate | kalpitavirodhivirodhatvam eva vāstavatvena viruddhaṃ vā? yadi tāvan na viruddhaṃ, tadā kalpitāvirodhiviruddhatvam api bhavati, vāstavatvam api syād iti kathaṃ tad upanyāsas tan nirākaraṇaikāntikaḥ syāt? nāviruddhavidheḥ kasyacit pratiṣedhasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: etat ca cintyate kalpita virodhi virodha tvam eva vāstava tvena viruddham vā yadi tāvat na viruddham tadā kalpita avirodhi viruddha tvam api bhavati vāstava tvam api syāt iti katham tat upanyāsaḥ tat nirākaraṇa aikāntikaḥ syāt na aviruddha vidheḥ kasyacid pratiṣedha siddhiḥ

original: atha viruddham, sa virodho vāstavo 'vāstavo vā? tatrāvāstavo virodhaḥ paraṃparābhave 'tiprasaṅgāt asamartha iti, vāstavapakṣe kalpitavirodhivirodho 'pisvayaṃ vāstava iṣṭaḥ, na cāsmākam eva svaviruddhaniṣedhābhidhāyīti paśya dhārṣṭyavijṛmbhitam |
analyzed: atha viruddham sa virodhaḥ vāstavaḥ vāstavaḥ vā tatra avāstavaḥ virodhaḥ paraṃparā bhave tiprasaṅgāt asamarthaḥ iti vāstava pakṣe kalpita virodhi virodhaḥ u pi svayam vāstavaḥ iṣṭaḥ na ca asmākam eva sva viruddha niṣedha abhidhāyī iti paśya dhārṣṭya vijṛmbhitam

original: yathāhi nityakramayaugapadyayor virodhaḥ kalpitavirodhivirodho nityasya kalpitatvāt tathā vāstavatvakalpitavirodhe virodhayor virodhaḥ kalpitavirodhavirodho vartate kalpitasya virodhinovirodha iti kṛtvā kalpito virodhī tasyeti vā,kalpitasaya hi virodhino virodho 'pi kalpita eva na vāstava ity eva bhavat-paurṣeṇa sādhyamānam īkṣāmahe |
analyzed: yathā hi nitya krama yaugapadyayoḥ virodhaḥ kalpita virodhi virodhaḥ nityasya kalpita tvāt tathā vāstava tva kalpita virodhe virodhayoḥ virodhaḥ kalpita virodha virodhaḥ vartate kalpitasya virodhinaḥ virodhaḥ iti kṛtvā kalpitaḥ virodhī tasya iti hi virodhinaḥ virodhaḥ kalpitaḥ eva na vāstavaḥ iti eva bhavat paurṣeṇa sādhyamānam īkṣāmahe

original: tasmāt tasya kalpitasya virodhasya virodhino vāstavatvena saha yo virodhaḥ so 'pi kalpitavirodhivirodhaḥ siddhaḥ | tasya vāstavatve svavacanavirodhaḥ | avāstavatve dūṣaṇam uktam eva |
analyzed: tasmāt tasya kalpitasya virodhasya virodhinaḥ vāstava tvena saha yaḥ virodhaḥ saḥ u pi kalpita virodhi virodhaḥ siddhaḥ tasya vāstava tve sva vacana virodhaḥ avāstava tve dūṣaṇam uktam eva

original: [98,6] api ca | virodho nāmaikatra dvayaḥ saṃvāsaniṣedhārtham arthyate | na tu dvayor vastutvasiddhir nāma virodhaphalam | yatra tu dvayor vastutvasiddhis tatra sāmarthyād ekena vastunā vastv-antaratiraskārāt kvacid deśe, yathā sahānavasthāne yathoktaṃ prāk | prakṛtas tu virodho dhamayor ekatra dharmiṇi sadbhāvaniṣedhaphalaḥ |
analyzed: api ca virodhaḥ nāma ekatra dvayaḥ saṃvāsa niṣedha artham arthyate na tu dvayoḥ vastu tva siddhiḥ nāma virodha phalam yatra tu dvayoḥ vastu tva siddhiḥ tatra sāmarthyāt ekena vastunā vastu antara tiraskārāt kvacid deśe yathā saha anavasthāne yathoktam prāk prakṛtaḥ tu virodhaḥ dhamayoḥ ekatra dharmiṇi sadbhāva niṣedha phalaḥ

original: tatra yathā dvāv api dharmau santau niṣedhyete,yatra nīlatvaṃ na tatrānīlatvam | ato na nīlānīlam ekam iti | tathā sad-asattvarūpāv api vipratiṣiddhau dharmāv ekatra dharmiṇi samāropitau pratiṣiddhāv eva | na hi jananyāḥ (40a) tanaye bandhyā-tanayatvam āropitaṃ tattvato 'saditi na niṣedhyam |
analyzed: tatra yathā dvau api dharmau santau niṣedhyete iyatra nīla tvam na tatra anīla tvam atas na nīla anīlam ekam iti tathā sat asat tva rūpau api vipratiṣiddhau dharmau ekatra dharmiṇi samāropitau pratiṣiddhau eva na hi jananyāḥ tanaye bandhyā tanaya tvam āropitam sat iti na niṣedhyam

original: bandhyā-tanaye vā vikalpaikagocare jananī-tanayatvam āropitaṃ na niṣedhyam | na hi jananī-tanayo babdhyā-tanayo vaikātmā, tāvataiva virodhakāryaparyavasanāt, kim apareṇa virodhanāmnā yo vastu-dharmāv anapekṣya nātmalābham āsādayati? evaṃ yatra nityatvaṃna tatra kramayaugapadyavattvam, yatra kramayaugapadyavattvaṃ tatra na nityatvam ato na nityaṃ
analyzed: bandhyā tanaye vā vikalpa eka gocare jananī tanaya tvam āropitam na niṣedhyam na hi jananī tanayaḥ babdhyā tanayaḥ vā eka ātmā tāvatā eva virodha kārya paryavasanāt kim apareṇa virodha nāmnā yaḥ vastu dharmau an apekṣya na ātmalābham āsādayati evam yatra nitya tvam na tatra krama yaugapadyavat tvam yatra krama yaugapadyavat tvam tatra na nitya tvam atas na nityam

original: kramayaugapadyayogi paramārthataḥ | tataś ca sattāyuktam api naiva niyamena paramārtataḥ | tataḥ kṣaṇika eva viśrāmyat tad-āyattasattākameva sattvam iti sattvāt kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddher avirodhaḥ |
analyzed: krama yaugapadya yogi paramārthataḥ tatas ca sattā yuktam api nā eva niyamena parama ārtataḥ tatas kṣaṇikaḥ eva viśrāmyat tad āyatta sattākam eva sattvam iti sattvāt kṣaṇabhaṅga siddheḥ avirodhaḥ

original: [98,19] yadi caivam api virodhavyatirekapratisandhānena mātṛ-modakakrameṇa gṛhītvā giri-kṛharakoṣaṇamāviśya ghoṣayitum icchasi ced, ghoṣaya | na punar asmad ārabdhasiddhi-pratibandhe kiñcid upayujyase | tad alam abhiniveśaparaviśī-bhūya vāstavā evaite virodhādaya ity eva sādhu |
analyzed: yadi ca evam api virodha vyatireka pratisandhānena mātṛ modaka krameṇa gṛhītvā giri kṛhara koṣaṇam āviśya ghoṣayitum icchasi ced ghoṣaya na punar asmat ārabdha siddhi pratibandhe kiñcid upayujyase tat alam abhiniveśa paraviśībhūya vāstavāḥ eva ete virodha ādayaḥ iti eva sādhu

original: nanu nityatvaṃ kramayaugapadyavattvaṃ ca viruddhau dharmau vidhūya nāparo virodho nāma, kasya vāstavavatvam iti cet | tad api yat kiñcit | na hi dharmāntarasaṃbhavena virodhasya pāramārthikatvaṃ brūmaḥ | kiṃ tu yato viruddhau dharmau dharmāntarasaṃbhave 'pi hi yadi na viruddhau na pāramārthiko 'pi virodhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu nitya tvam krama yaugapadyavat tvam ca viruddhau dharmau vidhūya na aparaḥ virodhaḥ nāma kasya vāstavavatvam iti ced tat api yat kiñcid na hi dharma antara saṃbhavena virodhasya pāramārthika tvam brūmaḥ kim tu yatas viruddhau dharmau dharma antara saṃbhave hi yadi na viruddhau na pāramārthikaḥ virodhaḥ

original: [99,1] viruddhau cet tāvataiva tāttviko virodha iti vyavahāraḥ, kim apareṇa dharmeṇa? yad api bandhyā-putravirodhavat ity uktam, tatra kim ekādhāra evāyaṃ virodho dṛṣṭāntīkṛtaḥ, atha dvitīyāpekṣaḥ? dvitīyo 'pi pratiyogi-rūpo 'nyamātraṃ vā? | prathamapakṣas tāvad ayuktaḥ, na hi kaścid ekādhāraṃ virodhaṃ pratijānīte |
analyzed: viruddhau ced tāvatā eva tāttvikaḥ virodhaḥ iti vyavahāraḥ kim apareṇa dharmeṇa yat api bandhyā putra virodha vat iti uktam tatra kim eka ādhāraḥ eva ayam virodhaḥ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtaḥ atha dvitīya apekṣaḥ pratiyogi rūpaḥ vā prathama pakṣaḥ tāvat ayuktaḥ na hi kaścid eka ādhāram virodham pratijānīte

original: tato yadi bandhyā-putravirodhasyābhinnadharmiṇo 'paramārthikatvaṃ taobhayadharmiṇo 'pi pāramārthikena virodhena na bhāvyam iti ko 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ? evam anyamātreṇāpi na virodhaḥ, kṛtakānityatvavat | pratiyoginā tu tatrāpīṣyate eva | bandhyā-putrasaya hi abandhyā-putratvena virodho 'sty eva | ekātmaniṣedhaś cābhimata eva |
analyzed: tatas yadi paramārthika tvam pāramārthikena virodhena na bhāvyam iti kaḥ yam nyāyaḥ evam anya mātreṇa api na virodhaḥ kṛtaka anitya tva vat pratiyoginā tu tatra api iṣyate eva hi abandhyā putra tvena virodhaḥ sti eva eka ātma niṣedhaḥ ca abhimataḥ eva

original: [99,9] nanu dharmayor virodhe dharmiṇor aikāttmyaniṣedha iti yuktaṃ, ban[dh] yā-putrasyābandhyā-putratvena virodho dharmi-dharmayor vartate | naiṣa doṣaḥ | dharmiṇo 'pi dharmadvāreṇaiva vyavahriyante evaṃ dharmiṇor api kadācid bhāvapradhāno vā nirdeśa iti |
analyzed: nanu dharmayoḥ virodhe dharmiṇoḥ aikāttmya niṣedhaḥ iti yuktam virodhaḥ dharmi dharmayoḥ vartate na eṣa doṣaḥ dharmiṇaḥ dharma dvāreṇa eva vyavahriyante evam dharmiṇoḥ api kadācid bhāva pradhānaḥ vā nirdeśaḥ iti

original: yaś ca vaidharmyeṇa dahanatuhinayor upanyāsaḥ, so 'py ayuktaḥ, parasparaparihārasya vivakṣitatvāt | yau ca tad-viṣayatayā sāpekṣadhruvabhāvāv uktau, tatrāpi sāpekṣatayā kādācitkatvam anityatvam uktam | dhruvabhāvo 'py avaśyam bhāva iti yadi bhāvaniyamatvam, tadā nityatvam eva |
analyzed: yaḥ ca vaidharmyeṇa dahana tuhinayoḥ upanyāsaḥ saḥ u pi ayuktaḥ paraspara parihārasya vivakṣita tvāt yau ca tad viṣaya tayā sāpekṣa dhruva bhāvau uktau tatra api sāpekṣa tayā kādācitkatvam anitya tvam uktam dhruva bhāvaḥ api avaśyam bhāvaḥ iti yadi bhāva niyama tvam tadā nitya tvam eva

original: tato nityānityayor ayaṃ virodhasthitiḥ katham anubhavapūrvakatayopadarśayantaṃ nopahāsayati | nityena kathaṃ virodhapratītir ity eva hi prakṛtam | athāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyayyā dhruvabhāvaḥ, (40b) sāpi na kasyacid anubhavaviṣaya iti nityavad eva doṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatas nitya anityayoḥ ayam virodha sthitiḥ katham anubhava pūrvakatayā upadarśayantam na upahāsayati nityena katham virodha pratītiḥ iti eva hi prakṛtam atha avaśyam dhruva bhāvaḥ sā api na kasyacid anubhava viṣayaḥ iti nitya vat eva doṣaḥ

original: [99,18] syād etat | yac ca kadācid avaśyam bhūtam upalabdhaṃ tad apekṣayedam ucyata iti | tad apekṣayā tarhi virodha eva nāsti, tad dhi sāpekṣaṃ c dhruvabhūtaṃ ca | atha tadā sāpekṣatvaṃ nāsti siddhatvāt, anyadā tadā sutarāṃ nāsti, asiddhatvād eva | asiddhadharma evāpekṣeti cet | ananubhūte tarhi na virodhavyavastheti sa eva doṣaḥ |
analyzed: syāt etat yat ca kadācid avaśyam bhūtam upalabdham tad apekṣayā idam ucyate iti tad apekṣayā tarhi virodhaḥ eva na asti tat dhi sāpekṣam dhruva bhūtam ca atha tadā sāpekṣa tvam na asti siddha tvāt anyadā tadā sutarām na asti asiddha tvāt eva asiddha dharmaḥ eva apekṣā iti ced ananubhūte tarhi na virodha vyavasthā iti saḥ eva doṣaḥ

original: asiddhasyaiva siddhi-kālāpekṣayā anubhūtenaiva virodha iti cet | siddhi-kālāpekṣā-svīkāre tarhi virodha eva nāstīty eva sādhu |
analyzed: asiddhasya eva siddhi kāla apekṣayā anubhūtena eva virodhaḥ iti ced siddhi kāla apekṣā svīkāre tarhi virodhaḥ eva na asti iti eva sādhu

original: etenānubhavābhāvād virodhavyavasthābhāve sādhye vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntābhimataḥ sādhyāvyatirekī, asatā virodhaprasañjane tu sādhanāvyatirekī | dhruvabhāvasya nityatārthapakṣe tu sādhyakoṭi-nikṣepa eveti |
analyzed: etena anubhava abhāvāt virodha vyavasthā bhāve sādhye vaidharmya dṛṣṭānta abhimataḥ sādhya avyatirekī asatā virodha prasañjane tu sādhana avyatirekī dhruva bhāvasya nitya tā artha pakṣe tu sādhya koṭi nikṣepaḥ eva iti

original: [100,1] bhedābhedādikaṃ tu bhavatu vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | naca tāvatāpi vastunor eva nākṣaṇiko virodha iti niyamaḥ, anyatāpi samarthitatvād iti | yad api
analyzed: bheda abheda ādikam tu bhavatu vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ na ca tāvatā api vastunoḥ eva na ākṣaṇikaḥ virodhaḥ iti niyamaḥ anyatā api samarthita tvāt iti yat api

original: nāsiddhe bhāvadharmo 'stīti (PV I 191a; PVin III 63a)
analyzed: na asiddhe bhāva dharmaḥ asti

original: vācyam, tad apy āśrayāsiddhi-codyasya dūrīkṛtatvān nirākṛtam | asato 'pi dharmitvasādhanāt, avasuni vikalpasya pratītivyavasthāsiddheś ca vyomādi-svarūpāpratītir api parihṛtā |
analyzed: vācyam tat api āśraya asiddhi codyasya dūrīkṛta tvāt nirākṛtam asataḥ api dharmi tva sādhanāt vikalpasya pratīti vyavasthā siddheḥ ca vyoma ādi svarūpa apratītiḥ api parihṛtā

original: [100,9] syād etat, yadi vikalparūpāṃ pratītim āśrityāśrayāsiddhi-parihāraḥ sattā-sādhane 'pi samānam, tataḥ katham ucyate nāsiddhe bhāvadharmo 'stīty-ādi | kathaṃ ātmano vibhutvā-sādhanaṃ sarvatropalabhyamānaguṇatvam āśrayāsiddhāv udāhriyata iti cet | sādhanānurodhād ubhayatrāpi hi bhāvadharma eva hetur upātta āśaṅkitaś ca |
analyzed: syāt etat yadi vikalpa rūpām pratītim āśritya āśraya asiddhi parihāraḥ sattā sādhane samānam tatas katham ucyate na asiddhe bhāva dharmaḥ sti ityādi katham ātmanaḥ vibhu tva asādhanam sarvatra upalabhyamāna guṇa tvam āśraya asiddhau udāhriyate iti ced sādhana anurodhāt ubhayatra api hi bhāva dharmaḥ eva hetuḥ upāttaḥ āśaṅkitaḥ ca

original: na ca bhāvadharmasyāvastu dharmī bhavatum arhati | na hi dhūmaśiṃśapātvādayo 'vastuni vasanti | tasnād yatra bhāvadharmaḥ sādhanaṃ tatra niyamena vastv eva dharmī | na ca vikalpamātraviṣayasya vastutāśvāsaḥ, avastuny api vikalpamātrānapāyāt | tato vastu dharmī-kurvatā pratyakṣānumānarūpe ca siddhir abhidhātavyā |
analyzed: na ca bhāva dharmasya avastu dharmī bhavatum arhati na hi dhūma śiṃśapā tu ādayaḥ vastuni vasanti yatra bhāva dharmaḥ sādhanam tatra niyamena vastu eva dharmī na ca vikalpa mātra viṣayasya vastu tā āśvāsaḥ avastuni api vikalpa mātra anapāyāt tatas vastu dharmīkurvatā pratyakṣa anumāna rūpe ca siddhiḥ abhidhātavyā

original: tad anabhidhāne tu vikalpamātragocarrito 'rthaḥ sandigdhasattāko nirastasattāko vā dharmī-kriyamāṇaḥ kathaṃ vatutayā niścitaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | tathā ca sati yāvān vastu-dharmo hetuḥ sarvo 'sau nāśrayāsiddhim atikrāmati, ekatra sandehād anyatra viparyayāt |
analyzed: tat anabhidhāne tu vikalpa mātra gocarritaḥ rthaḥ sandigdha sattākaḥ nirasta sattākaḥ vā dharmīkriyamāṇaḥ katham vatutayā niścitaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt tathā ca sati yāvān vastu dharmaḥ hetuḥ na āśraya asiddhim atikrāmati ekatra sandehāt anyatra viparyayāt

original: tataḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ vastu-viṣayābhyām asiddhe bhāvadharmo na hetur asty āśrayāsiddhatvād iti yuktam etat sattā-sādhane | asattā-sādhane tv avastu-dharmo hetur avastuni viklpamātrasiddha nāśrayāsiddhi-doṣeṇa dūṣayituṃ śakyaḥ | na hi tasya vastv-āśrayāpekṣā, avastu-dharmād eva | na ca tad-ādhārasya pratyakṣānumānāpekṣā, avastutvād eva |
analyzed: tatas pratyakṣa anumānābhyām vastu viṣayābhyām asiddhe bhāva dharmaḥ na hetuḥ asti āśraya asiddha tvāt iti yuktam etat sattā sādhane asattā sādhane tu avastu dharmaḥ hetuḥ avastuni na āśraya asiddhi doṣeṇa dūṣayitum śakyaḥ na hi tasya vastu āśraya apekṣā avastu dharmāt eva na ca tad ādhārasya pratyakṣa anumāna apekṣā avastu tvāt eva

original: bhāvadharme tu sādhane vastv evāśrayo (41a) vastu-dharmatvāt | vastunaś ca niścayaḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyām eva, tatas tayor abhāve niyamenāśrayāsiddhir iti sad-asattā-sādhanayoḥ kathaṃ samāno doṣaḥ |
analyzed: bhāva dharme tu sādhane vastu eva āśrayaḥ vastu dharma tvāt vastunaḥ ca niścayaḥ pratyakṣa anumānābhyām eva tatas tayoḥ abhāve niyamena āśraya asiddhiḥ iti sat asat tā sādhanayoḥ katham samānaḥ doṣaḥ

original: [100,24] yat tu Trilocanena pramāṇāntaraṃ nityānām asattā-siddhau kramādivirahasyābhāva dharmatā na sidhyatīty uktam, tad bālasyāpi durabhidhānam | nityā hi dharmiṇa | asattvaṃ sādhyam | kramādiviraho hetuḥ | asya cābhāvadharmatvaṃ nāma svasādhyāvinābhāvitvam ucyate, abhāvānāṃ śaśaśṛṅgādīnāṃ dharmo na bhāvānām iti kṛtvā |
analyzed: yat tu Trilocanena pramāṇa antaram nityānām asattā siddhau krama ādi virahasya abhāva dharma tā na sidhyati iti uktam tat bālasya api durabhidhānam nityāḥ hi dharmiṇaḥ asattvam sādhyam krama ādi virahaḥ hetuḥ asya ca abhāva dharma tvam nāma sva sādhya avinābhāvi tvam ucyate abhāvānām śaśa śṛṅga ādīnām dharmaḥ na bhāvānām iti kṛtvā

original: tad anena vacasā yāvat pramāṇāntareṇa pakṣe sādhyaṃ na sidhyati, na tāvad dhetor vyāptir ity uktaṃ bhavati | tac ca kutra hetāv upalabdham aneneti na vidmaḥ |
analyzed: tat anena vacasā yāvat pramāṇa antareṇa pakṣe sādhyam na sidhyati na tāvat hetoḥ vyāptiḥ iti uktam bhavati tat ca kutra hetau upalabdham anena iti na vidmaḥ

original: yathā cānyatra sādhyanāntarīyakatā anyadā pravṛttapramāṇāntarasiddhā dṛṣṭāntena smāritā pakṣīkṛte sādhyasiddhy-artham upayujyate, nānyataḥ sādhyasiddhim apekṣate, tadā kramādy-abhāve 'bhāvadharmatā vyāpti-svabhāvānyadaiva kramākrameṇa siddhatvasya [sattvasya] |
analyzed: yathā ca anyatra sādhya nāntarīyaka tā anyadā pravṛtta pramāṇa antara siddhā dṛṣṭāntena smāritā pakṣīkṛte sādhya siddhi artham upayujyate na anyatas sādhya siddhim apekṣate tadā krama ādi abhāve bhāva dharma tā vyāpti svabhāvā anyadā eva kramākrameṇa siddha tvasya sattvasya

original: vyāpti-grahaṇakāle pravṛttapramāṇasiddhākāśakamaladṛṣṭāntena smāritā sādhyasiddhāv upayujyate, nānyataḥ sādhyasiddhim apekṣate | anyathā sarvānumānavaiyarthyāt | kramayaugapadyena hi sattvasya vyāpti-siddhau sattvasya vyāpyasyābhāvena kramayaugapadyasya vyāpakasya viraho vyāptaḥ sidhyatīty abhāvadharmatvaṃ kramayaugapadyaviṣayaḥ |
analyzed: vyāpti grahaṇa kāle pravṛtta pramāṇa siddha ākāśa kamala dṛṣṭāntena smāritā sādhya siddhau upayujyate na anyatas sādhya siddhim apekṣate anyathā sarva anumāna vaiyarthyāt krama yaugapadyena hi sattvasya vyāpti siddhau sattvasya vyāpyasya abhāvena krama yaugapadyasya vyāpakasya virahaḥ vyāptaḥ sidhyati iti abhāva dharma tvam krama yaugapadya viṣayaḥ

original: yathā ca vyāpti-rūpaṃ tathā pūrvam eva niścitaṃ, sad-abhāvadharmatvaṃ na pakṣe pramāṇāntareṇa sādhyasiddhyā vyavasthāpyate, tathā kramākramābhāvābhāvenāpi sādhyaṃ prasādhya vyavasthāpyata iti naḥ pakṣaḥ, pūrvam eva vyavasthāpitatvāt | tat kuta itaretarāśrayatvam |
analyzed: yathā ca vyāpti rūpam tathā pūrvam eva niścitam sat abhāva dharma tvam na pakṣe pramāṇa antareṇa sādhya siddhyā vyavasthāpyate tathā kramākrama abhāva abhāvena api sādhyam prasādhya vyavasthāpyate iti naḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvam eva vyavasthāpita tvāt tat kutas itaretara āśraya tvam

original: [101,14] kiṃ ca, itaretarāśrayatvam apy evaṃ yujyate | kramādivirahasyābhāvadharmatvasiddhau teṣām asattvasiddhiḥ asattvasiddhau cābhāvadharmatvasiddhir iti | viṣamadṛṣṭinā punar abhāvadharmasiddher asattvāsiddhau na prayojakatvam uktaṃ, kiṃ tu pakṣadharmatāsiddheḥ | tat kīdṛśam itaretarāśrayatvam |
analyzed: kim ca itaretara āśraya tvam api evam yujyate krama ādi virahasya abhāva dharma tva siddhau teṣām asattva siddhiḥ asattva siddhau ca abhāva dharma tva siddhiḥ iti viṣama dṛṣṭinā punar abhāva dharma siddheḥ asattva asiddhau na prayojaka tvam uktam kim tu pakṣa dharmatā siddheḥ tat kīdṛśam itaretara āśraya tvam

original: na ca pakṣadharmataivābhāvadharmatā, sādhyāvinā-bhāvarūpatvād abhāvadharmatāyāḥ | atha yady abhāvadharmatvaṃ kramādy-abhāvasya syāt, tadā pakṣīkṛtānām asatāṃ nityānāṃ dharmaḥ syād ity abhiprāyāt pakṣadharmatāvyāpāradvāreṇa tad-avyāpāro darśitaḥ, tathāpi cakrakaṃ vakutum ucitam | tad api pracīnacarcayā carcitam eva |
analyzed: na ca pakṣa dharmatā eva abhāva dharmatā sādhya avinābhāva rūpa tvāt abhāva dharmatāyāḥ atha yadi abhāva dharma tvam krama ādi abhāvasya syāt tadā pakṣīkṛtānām asatām nityānām dharmaḥ syāt iti abhiprāyāt pakṣa dharmatā vyāpāra dvāreṇa tad avyāpāraḥ darśitaḥ tathā api cakrakam ucitam tat api pracīna carcayā carcitam eva

original: [101,21] kiṃ ca, abhāvadharmatve vyāpti-rūpe sati pakṣadharmatvam iti nāyaṃ hetv-antarasādhāraṇo nyāyaḥ | na cāsyāpi hetor evam, abhāvadharmatvaṃ hi vyāptir bhavatu mā vā, kramādivirahas tu kena nityāāṃ niṣidhyate |
analyzed: kim ca abhāva dharma tve vyāpti rūpe sati pakṣa dharma tvam iti na ayam hetu antara sādhāraṇaḥ nyāyaḥ na ca asya api hetoḥ evam abhāva dharma tvam hi vyāptiḥ bhavatu mā vā krama ādi virahaḥ tu kena niṣidhyate

original: na caite 'py asattā-rūpeṇa dharmiṇaḥ, kiṃ tu sad-asattvasandehavattveneti yat kiñcid etat bhāvadharmatvam ubhayadharmatvaṃ ca neṣṭam asya kramādivirahasya hetor iti na prathamavikalpe doṣaḥ | nāpi dvitīye, vyatirekasyābhāvarūpatve 'pi vikalpena pratīteḥ samarthitatvāt |
analyzed: na ca ete pi asattā rūpeṇa dharmiṇaḥ kim tu sat asat tva sandehavattvena iti yat kiñcid etat bhāva dharma tvam ubhaya dharma tvam ca na iṣṭam asya krama ādi virahasya hetoḥ iti na prathama vikalpe doṣaḥ nā api dvitīye vyatirekasya abhāva rūpa tve vikalpena pratīteḥ samarthita tvāt

original: [102,1] na hy abhāvarūpāṇāṃ vikalpād anyā pratītir apratītir vā, ubhayathāpy abhāvavyavahārahāni-prasaṅgāt | tato 'nubhavāpekṣā-virahān na taj-jananaprasaṅge doṣāvakāśaḥ | anāśvāsas tu śāsitum ucitaḥ | so 'pi kramayaugapadyavirahalakṣaṇavyāpakānupalambhasaṃbhavāl liṅgajatvena dūrīkṛtaḥ |
analyzed: na hi abhāva rūpāṇām vikalpāt anyā pratītiḥ apratītiḥ vā ubhayathā api abhāva vyavahāra hāni prasaṅgāt tatas nubhava apekṣā virahāt na tad janana prasaṅge doṣa avakāśaḥ anāśvāsaḥ tu śāsitum ucitaḥ saḥ u pi krama yaugapadya viraha lakṣaṇa vyāpaka anupalambha saṃbhavāt liṅga ja tvena dūrīkṛtaḥ

original: tathā hi tathaiva trairūpyapariśodhanam etad ārabdham, siddhaṃ ca kim iti vismaryate, yato liṅgābhāvād ity ucyate | tasmāt kramādivyāpyasattā-vyatirekavikalpe katham anāśvāsaḥ | avyatirekaśaṅkā hy anāśvāsyārthaḥ | vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaniścaye cāsthānam etad iti nityān niyamena vyatiricyamānaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvena vyāptaṃ siddham iti na doṣaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi tathā eva trairūpya pariśodhanam etat ārabdham siddham ca kim iti vismaryate yatas liṅga abhāvāt iti ucyate tasmāt krama ādi vyāpya sattā vyatireka vikalpe katham anāśvāsaḥ avyatireka śaṅkā hi anāśvāsya arthaḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva niścaye ca asthānam etat iti nityāt niyamena vyatiricyamānam sattvam kṣaṇika tvena vyāptam siddham iti na doṣaḥ

original: tṛtīye 'pi vikalpe vyatirekaniścayasya dṛṭhīkṛtatvāt, so 'yaṃ vyāpakānupalambho nitye sva-āśraye kramādy-abhāvaṃ sādhayann eva sattāyās tato niyamena vyatirekaṃ, kṣaṇikatāyāṃ ca pratibandham asyāḥ sādhayatīti trayo 'sya vyāpārāḥ ekavyāpārasaṃgṛhītāś ca, na ca doṣaleśena lipyante |
analyzed: tṛtīye pi vikalpe vyatireka niścayasya dṛṭhīkṛta tvāt saḥ yam vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ nitye sva āśraye krama ādi abhāvam sādhayan eva sattāyāḥ tatas niyamena vyatirekam kṣaṇika tāyām ca pratibandham asyāḥ sādhayati iti trayaḥ vyāpārāḥ eka vyāpāra saṃgṛhītāḥ ca na ca doṣa leśena lipyante

original: tritvaṃ cārthaśakteḥ sattā-lakṣaṇatve, hetu-mātratve tu vyatirekamātrasādhanam asattāsādhanārtha iti vyāpāradvaitam eveti sthitam ||
analyzed: tritvam ca artha śakteḥ sattā lakṣaṇa tve hetu mātra tve tu vyatireka mātra sādhanam asattā sādhana arthaḥ iti vyāpāra dvaitam eva iti sthitam

original: [102,14] nanu vyāpakābhāvasyābhāvarūpatvena vastu-dharmatayā āśrayāsiddhi-parihāre 'pi sa katham abhāvaḥ kasyacit pratipattiḥ, pratipatti-hetur vā tasyāpi vā kathaṃ pratipattir iti kiṃ na dṛśyate? tal-liṅgajanmā ca saṃpraty eva vyatirekavikalpo na visaṃvādaśaṅkām aṅke nidhatta ity uktam |
analyzed: nanu vyāpaka abhāvasya abhāva rūpa tvena vastu dharma tayā āśraya asiddhi parihāre pi sa katham abhāvaḥ kasyacid pratipattiḥ pratipatti hetuḥ vā tasya api vā katham pratipattiḥ iti kim na dṛśyate tad liṅga janmā ca saṃprati eva vyatireka vikalpaḥ na visaṃvāda śaṅkām aṅke nidhatte iti uktam

original: avaśyaṃ ca sādhyabuddhiṃ sādhayatā sādhanena bhāvavyavahāraḥ svīkartavyo nānyathā | tac cābhāvarūpatve sarvaṃ virudhyate | vyāpakānupalabdhir ity api yady apy anupalabdhi-mātraṃ sa eva doṣaḥ, na cānyopalabdhir vyāpakānupalabdhir abhidhātuṃ śkyā,anyasyāpi kasyacid anupalabdhir iti |
analyzed: avaśyam ca sādhya buddhim sādhayatā sādhanena bhāva vyavahāraḥ svīkartavyaḥ na anyathā tat ca abhāva rūpa tve sarvam virudhyate vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ iti api yadi api anupalabdhi mātram saḥ eva doṣaḥ na ca anya upalabdhiḥ vyāpakā anupalabdhiḥ abhidhātum śkyā anyasya api kasyacid anupalabdhiḥ iti

original: [102,20] tad api yat-kiñcit, dharmy-upalabdher evāanyatrāpy anupalabdhitayā vyavasthāpanāt | yathā hi nehi śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāvād ity atra vṛkṣāpekṣayā kevalapadeśasya dharmiṇa upalabdhiḥ vṛkṣānupalabdhiḥ, śiṃśapāpekṣayā ca kevalapratītir eva śiṃśapābhāvapratītir iti svabhāvahetuparyavasāyivyāpāro vyāpakānupalambhaḥ |
analyzed: tat api yat kiñcid dharmi upalabdheḥ eva a anyatra api anupalabdhi tayā vyavasthāpanāt yathā hi na ihi śiṃśapā vṛkṣa abhāvāt iti atra vṛkṣa apekṣayā kevala padeśasya dharmiṇaḥ upalabdhiḥ vṛkṣa anupalabdhiḥ śiṃśapā apekṣayā ca kevala pratītiḥ eva śiṃśapā bhāva pratītiḥ iti svabhāva hetu paryavasāyi vyāpāraḥ vyāpaka anupalambhaḥ

original: tathā nityasya dharmiṇo vikalpabuddhau parisphurataḥ kramādy-apekṣayā kevalasphuraṇam eva kramādy-anupalambhaḥ, arthakriyāpekṣayā ca kevalapratītir evārthakriyā-viyogapratītir iti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tathā nityasya dharmiṇaḥ vikalpa buddhau parisphurataḥ krama ādi apekṣayā kevala sphuraṇam eva krama ādi anupalambhaḥ arthakriyā apekṣayā ca kevala pratītiḥ eva arthakriyā viyoga pratītiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

original: [102,25] adhyavasāyāpekṣayā ca yathā neha śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāvād ity abhāvasya hetupañcamyā nirdeśaḥ, tathā bhāvaḥ sādhanam ity api vyavahāraḥ, na tv abhāvaḥ sādhanameva (42a) kvacit | sa ca vyavahāraḥ avasitārthāvisaṃvādān na parihartuṃ śakyaḥ |
analyzed: adhyavasāya apekṣayā ca yathā na iha śiṃśapā vṛkṣa abhāvāt iti abhāvasya hetu pañcamyā nirdeśaḥ tathā bhāvaḥ sādhanam iti api vyavahāraḥ na tu abhāvaḥ sādhanam eva kvacid sa ca vyavahāraḥ avasita artha avisaṃvādāt na parihartum śakyaḥ

original: yat khalu vyāpakena virahitaṃ tad avaśyaṃ vyāpyenāpīty etāvata evārthasya saṃvādinaḥ tenāpi prakāreṇa pratipādanāt | ayaṃ ca nyāyo yathā satye dharmiṇi tathāsaty 'pīti ko viśeṣaḥ?
analyzed: yat khalu vyāpakena virahitam tat avaśyam vyāpyena api iti etāvataḥ eva arthasya saṃvādinaḥ tena api prakāreṇa pratipādanāt ayam ca nyāyaḥ yathā satye dharmiṇi tathā asati pi iti kaḥ viśeṣaḥ

original: [103,6] nanu ayam eva mahān viśeṣaḥ | satye hi dharmiṇi vyāpakasyaikajñānasaṃsargī sa eva dharmīti tasyopalabdhir anupalabdhir vyāpakasyāstu, asatyas tu dharmīnaikajñānasaṃsargī kenacid iti ced,
analyzed: nanu ayam eva mahān viśeṣaḥ satye hi dharmiṇi vyāpakasya eka jñāna saṃsargī saḥ eva dharmī iti tasya upalabdhiḥ anupalabdhiḥ vyāpakasya astu asatyaḥ tu kenacid iti ced

original: [103,8] tenaiva svasaṃbandhinā dharmeṇa vyāpakasaṃmatena | tathā hy ekajñānam atra vikalpa eva | sa hi nityagrāhī vikalpaḥ tad-ākārāntaram iva kramayaugapadyadharmasaṃbandhe nityasya kramādy-ākāram apy ullikhed iti saṃbhāvanayā ekajñānasaṣargitvam ubhayor anivāryam |
analyzed: tena eva sva saṃbandhinā dharmeṇa vyāpaka saṃmatena tathā hi eka jñānam atra vikalpaḥ eva sa hi nitya grāhī vikalpaḥ tad ākāra antaram iva krama yaugapadya dharma saṃbandhe nityasya krama ādi ākāram api ullikhet iti saṃbhāvanayā eka jñāna saṣargi tvam ubhayoḥ anivāryam

original: yadi na nityam anādheyāti] sayatvādinā dharmāntareṇa saha pratīti-gocarībhāvet, yaugapadyāyaugapadyaṃ vāstavadharmi |ṇā saha na pratītiviṣayaḥ syād apy evam | na caivam, na ca niṣedhyasya saṃbhāvanāṃ vinā kvacid ekajñānasaṃsargaḥ tadaiva syāl labhyaḥ |
analyzed: yadi na nityam saya tva ādinā dharma antareṇa saha yaugapadya ayaugapadyam vāstava dharmi saha na pratīti viṣayaḥ syāt api evam na ca evam na ca niṣedhyasya saṃbhāvanām vinā kvacid eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ tadā eva syāt labhyaḥ

original: tatra yathā hariṇaśirasi tenaikajñānasaṃsargi śṛṅgam upalabdham, harivarāṅge 'pi tatsambhāvanayaiva ttsaṃsargān niṣidhyate, tathā nīlādāv apariniṣṭhitanityānityabhāve tāvat kramākramau svadharmiṇā sārdham ekajñānasaṃsargiṇau dṛṣṭau nitye 'pi yad bhavato nityagrāhiṇā jñānena svadharmiṇānityena sahaiva gṛhyeyātām iti
analyzed: tatra yathā hariṇa śirasi tena eka jñāna saṃsargi śṛṅgam upalabdham hari varāṅge tad sambhāvanayā eva niṣidhyate tathā nīla ādau apariniṣṭhita nitya anitya bhāve tāvat krama akramau svadharmiṇā sārdham eka jñāna saṃsargiṇau dṛṣṭau nitye yat bhavataḥ nitya grāhiṇā jñānena svadharmiṇā anityena saha eva gṛhyeyātām iti

original: saṃbhavanayaikajñānasaṃsargadvāraka eva pratiṣedham āviśataḥ |
analyzed: saṃbhavanayā eka jñāna saṃsarga dvārake eva pratiṣedham āviśataḥ

original: [103,18] kathaṃ punar etannityajñāne kramāder asphuraṇam iti, yāvatā kramākramakroṭīkṛtam eva nityaṃ vikalpayāma iti cetata eva bādhakāvatāraḥ, viparītarūpāvatāraṇaṃ vinā tasya vaiyarthyāt | so 'yaṃ nityātmani kramākramāropau bhavatas tadbādhakopanyāsaṃ prayojayen nāma, na tu nitye kramākramāv antarbhāvayituṃ prabhavati, virodhāt |
analyzed: katham punar etat nitya jñāne krama ādeḥ asphuraṇam iti yāvatā kramākrama kroṭīkṛtam eva nityam vikalpayāmaḥ iti cetataḥ eva bādhaka avatāraḥ viparīta rūpa avatāraṇam vinā tasya vaiyarthyāt saḥ yam nitya ātmani kramākrama āropau bhavataḥ tad bādhaka upanyāsam prayojayet nāma na tu nitye kramākramau antarbhāvayitum prabhavati virodhāt

original: na ca mudgarādāv apy abhāvaśabdāpravṛttir eva, bhāvāntaraparyudāsena tatsiddheḥ | na cātiprasaṅgo, dhvaṃsavat | yayā hi pratyāsattyā dhavaṃsākhyam eva vastu ghaṭasya nivṛttir ucyate, tasyā na karparaparighayor vighātaḥ | virodhitvam api tayor eva ramaṇīyam, aṇīyasāpy aṃśena darśanākhyena tayor utkarṣāt |
analyzed: na ca mudgara ādau api abhāva śabda apravṛttiḥ eva bhāva antara paryudāsena tad siddheḥ na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ dhvaṃsa vat yayā hi pratyāsattyā dhavaṃsa ākhyam eva vastu ghaṭasya nivṛttiḥ ucyate tasyāḥ na karpara parighayoḥ vighātaḥ virodhi tvam api tayoḥ eva ramaṇīyam aṇīyasā api aṃśena darśana ākhyena tayoḥ utkarṣāt

original: yayoḥ satoḥ kumbhābhāvavyavahāra itiy asyātiprasaṅgasaṅgamād bhṅganimittasya puṣṭatvāt | na ca bhāvo bhāvāntaravirodhī na bhavaty eva, katham anyathā gotvam agotvasya, dahanas tukinasya vā |
analyzed: yayoḥ satoḥ kumbha abhāva vyavahāraḥ asya atiprasaṅga saṅgamāt bhṅga nimittasya puṣṭa tvāt na ca bhāvaḥ bhāva antara virodhī na bhavati eva katham anyathā go tvam a go tvasya dahanaḥ tukinasya vā

original: kiṃ ca virodho 'pi dvividhaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tatra, rodhaḥ so 'pi sahāsthitir yadi tadā bhāvadvayasyaiva sā dahanatuhinavat | avikalakāraṇasya bhavato 'nyabhāvo 'bhāvād dhi sahānasthānavyavasthānam | na ceyaṃ gatir bhāvābhāvayoḥ saṃbhavatīti vyaktam |
analyzed: kim ca virodhaḥ dvividhaḥ prasiddhaḥ tatra rodhaḥ saha asthitiḥ yadi tadā bhāva dvayasya eva sā dahana tuhina vat avikala kāraṇasya bhavataḥ nyabhāvaḥ bhāvāt hi sahāna sthāna vyavasthānam na ca iyam gatiḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ saṃbhavati iti vyaktam

original: [116,1] naikenānyahatiḥ parasparaparīhārasthite lakṣaṇe ||
analyzed: na ekena anya hatiḥ paraspara parīhāra sthite lakṣaṇe

original: na khalu alākṣaṇikavirodhasya sad vastu-bādhanavyāpāraḥ, kiṃ tu sahānavasthānasyaiva, lākṣaṇikasya tu dharmayor eva vyavasthānāt | vyavasthita eva vastuni vastunā avastunā vā svarūpasaṃkaravyatikara- niṣedhaḥ | tato yathā nīlam-anīlaṃ na bhavati ubhayor anyonyasvabhāvatvāt, tathā kalasanāśayor api syāt |
analyzed: na khalu alākṣaṇika virodhasya sat vastu bādhana vyāpāraḥ kim tu saha anavasthānasya eva lākṣaṇikasya tu dharmayoḥ eva vyavasthānāt vyavasthite eva vastuni vastunā avastunā vā svarūpa saṃkara vyatikara niṣedhaḥ tatas yathā nīlam anīlam na bhavati ubhayoḥ anyonya svabhāva tvāt tathā kalasa nāśayoḥ api syāt

original: na ca tāvateṣṭasiddhiḥ mudgarasannidhi-mātra iva tasya tādavasthānapāyāt |
analyzed: na ca tāvatā iṣṭa siddhiḥ mudgara sannidhi mātre iva tasya tādavasthāna apāyāt

original: [116,7] nanu kalasakuliśādau dharmayor eva virodhāt tad-adhyāsitasya bhedamātram, kalasanāśau tu bhāvābhāvarūpatayā svayaṃ viruddāv iti kathaṃ saha syātām |
analyzed: nanu kalasa kuliśa ādau dharmayoḥ eva virodhāt tad adhyāsitasya bheda mātram kalasa nāśau tu bhāva abhāva rūpa tayā svayam viruddau iti katham saha syātām

original: na, bhāvābhāvayor hi bhavanābhavanarūpatayā dharmayor eva parasparaparihāraḥ, yato na bhāvādhyasitasyābhāvo 'bhāvādhiṣṭhitasya vā bhāvaḥ, yato vā kumbhanabho 'mbhor uhāder naikatvam | virodhamātraṃ tu na vāryate, kevalam ekena bhavatā bhavataḥ paribhave sati | tāvatā ca sahānavasthānavyāpāraḥ | tasmād dharmayor eva parasparaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: na bhāva abhāvayoḥ hi bhavana abhavana rūpa tayā dharmayoḥ eva paraspara parihāraḥ yatas na bhāva adhyasitasya abhāvaḥ bhāva adhiṣṭhitasya vā bhāvaḥ yatas vā kumbha nabhaḥ mbhoḥ uha ādeḥ na ekatvam virodha mātram tu na vāryate kevalam ekena bhavatā bhavataḥ paribhave sati tāvatā ca saha anavasthāna vyāpāraḥ tasmāt dharmayoḥ eva paraspara parihāraḥ

original: nīlānīlayoḥ katham iti cet | nīlānīlayoḥ parasparaparihāra iti naikatvam anayor ity evārthaḥ | tato dharmavirodha evānenāpi prakāreṇa prakāśyate | anyathā tuhinahutabhujor iva nīlānīlavāsasor api militayor anavasthiti-prasaṅgaḥ | tādātmyaṃ tu tadāpi nāsty eva |
analyzed: nīla anīlayoḥ katham iti ced nīla anīlayoḥ paraspara parihāraḥ iti na ekatvam anayoḥ iti eva arthaḥ tatas dharma virodhaḥ eva anena api prakāreṇa prakāśyate anyathā tuhina hutabhujoḥ iva nīla anīla vāsasoḥ api militayoḥ anavasthiti prasaṅgaḥ tādātmyam tu tadā api na asti eva

original: [116,17] deśo 'pi nīlānīlayor bhinna eveti cet | kāmaṃ bhinnaḥ, na tu vastunor virodhaḥ tāvatā deśabhedena kṛtārthaḥ | anyathā jalajvalayor api tad-vad eva militayoḥ prabandhasthitiḥ prasajyeta, sūkṣmadeśaparihāreṇa virodhasya phalavattvāt | ata eva viruddhopalabdhau kalpitaikabhāvaḥ sthūla eva deśo dharmī |
analyzed: nīla anīlayoḥ bhinnaḥ eva iti ced kāmam bhinnaḥ na tu vastunoḥ virodhaḥ tāvatā deśa bhedena kṛtārthaḥ anyathā jala jvalayoḥ api tadvat eva militayoḥ prabandha sthitiḥ prasajyeta sūkṣma deśa parihāreṇa virodhasya phalavat tvāt atas eva viruddha upalabdhau kalpita eka bhāvaḥ sthūlaḥ eva deśaḥ dharmī

original: evaṃ nīlam anīlatvena virudhyata ity api nīlam-anīlaṃ na bhavaīty evārthaḥ |
analyzed: evam nīlam anīla tvena virudhyate iti api nīlam anīlam na eva arthaḥ

original: [116,22] yadi tu dharmi-dharmayor api sākṣād virodhaḥ syāt, tadā yatra dharmiṇy-anīlatvaṃ tatra nīlatvaṃ na syāt | asti ca yathā ratnāntaraṃ tapanīyamātre, tathā nāśasyābhāvarūpadharmamātratve 'pi bhāvadharmā ghaṭo nāsann abhāvadharmā ca na sann ity evārthaḥ, tataṛ
analyzed: yadi tu dharmi dharmayoḥ api sākṣāt virodhaḥ syāt tadā yatra dharmiṇi anīla tvam tatra nīla tvam na syāt asti ca yathā ratna antaram tapanīya mātre tathā nāśasya abhāva rūpa dharma mātra tve bhāva dharmā ghaṭaḥ na asān abhāva dharmā ca na san iti eva arthaḥ tatas

original: [117,1] siddhenābhāvena dharmeṇāsann eva ghaṭo 'sann iti vyavahriyate, na tu sann eva nivartyate | sattā-nivartate tu sarvatra sahānavasthānavyāparaḥ | kathaṃ punar ghaṭasyābhāvo dharmaḥ | kasya punar asau dharmo 'stu | dharmatvena svī-kārāt dharmiṇo 'vaśyam ākṣepātkṣmātalasyaivāstu iti cet | tataḥ kiṃ bhūtalasyaivābhāvo(47a) vivakṣitaḥ |
analyzed: siddhena abhāvena dharmeṇa asan eva ghaṭaḥ san iti vyavahriyate na tu san eva nivartyate sattā nivartate tu sarvatra saha anavasthāna vyāparaḥ katham punar ghaṭasya abhāvaḥ dharmaḥ kasya punar asau dharmaḥ astu dharma tvena svīkārāt dharmiṇaḥ vaśyam ākṣepāt kṣmā talasya eva astu iti ced tatas kim bhū talasya eva abhāvaḥ vivakṣitaḥ

original: [117,5] nanu ghaṭasya nivartyanivartakabhāvasaṃbaddho 'bhāvo bhūtalasya dharmamātram ucyate, na tu bhūtalasya nivartaka iti cet |
analyzed: nanu ghaṭasya nivartya nivartaka bhāva saṃbaddhaḥ bhāvaḥ bhū talasya dharma mātram ucyate na tu bhū talasya nivartakaḥ iti ced

original: bhavatu bhūtalasyānivartakas tad-dharmo vā kevalam, yathā nīlaviruddhānīlatvayukte bhūtale nīlavastu-sthitir aviruddhā, tathā gaṭaviruddhābhimatenābhāvena yukte 'pi ghaṭasthiter avirodhaḥ syāt, tato 'bhimānamātravyavasthita evaiṣāṃ nivartyanivartakabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu bhū talasya anivartakaḥ tad dharmaḥ vā kevalam yathā nīla viruddha anīla tva yukte bhū tale nīla vastu sthitiḥ aviruddhā tathā gaṭa viruddha abhimatena abhāvena yukte ghaṭa sthiteḥ avirodhaḥ syāt tatas bhimāna mātra vyavasthitaḥ eva eṣām nivartya nivartaka bhāvaḥ

original: tasmād bhūtale kalasasyābhāva iti bhūtalādhārasya ghaṭasya saṃbandhitvenābhāsayantī vikalpabuddhir abhāvaṃ tad-dharmatvena vyavahārayatīti nyāyyam | adhyavasitāpekṣayā tu saṃvādetarau tad evaṃ parasparaparihāraviruddho dharmaḥ svaviruddhasyāsata evāsattāmātmadharmiṇi vyavahārayati | na tu nivartayatīti dharmiṇo bhedavyavahārahetur eva |
analyzed: tasmāt bhū tale kalasasya abhāvaḥ iti bhū tala ādhārasya ghaṭasya saṃbandhi tvena ābhāsayantī vikalpa buddhiḥ abhāvam tad dharma tvena vyavahārayati iti nyāyyam adhyavasita apekṣayā tu saṃvāda itarau tat evam paraspara parihāra viruddhaḥ dharmaḥ sva viruddhasya asataḥ eva asattām ātma dharmiṇi vyavahārayati na tu nivartayati iti dharmiṇaḥ bheda vyavahāra hetuḥ eva

original: tathā ca jalānalādiṣu sparśasyoṣṇetaratvaṃ dūre 'pi pratyanīkākāravattayā anyonyāpanayanam anapekṣya svarūpavimarśamātreṇa virodhavyavahāragocarībhavati | sahānavasthānaṃ punar ekenānyasya, sattā-nivartanadarśanād eva vyavasthāpyate | tad yadi sahānavasthānam abhimato virodhaḥ, tadā sidhyatu bhāvasya sattopalambhayor nivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca jala anala ādiṣu sparśasya uṣṇa itara tvam dūre pi pratyanīka ākāravat tayā anyonya apanayanam an apekṣya sva rūpa vimarśa mātreṇa virodha vyavahāra gocarībhavati saha anavasthānam punar ekena anyasya sattā nivartana darśanāt eva vyavasthāpyate tat yadi saha anavasthānam abhimataḥ virodhaḥ tadā sidhyatu bhāvasya sattā upalambhayoḥ nivṛttiḥ

original: kevalaṃ bhāvayor evāsau na bhāvābhāvayoḥ |
analyzed: kevalam bhāvayoḥ eva asau na bhāva abhāvayoḥ

original: [117,17] nanu tasmin sati tan-nivṛttir itīyatā sahānavasthānam abhimato virodhaḥ, tac cābhāvenāpi bhāvasya labhyata iti na bhāvayor eveti yukto niyama iti cet |
analyzed: nanu tasmin sati tad nivṛttiḥ iti iyatā saha anavasthānam abhimataḥ virodhaḥ tat ca abhāvena api bhāvasya labhyate iti na bhāvayoḥ eva iti yuktaḥ niyamaḥ iti ced

original: uktam atrāsmin satīty eva durlabham abhāve iti | kiṃ caivam abhāvatvasamarthanam upayogi, bhāvayor api tad-virodhasyāvirodhāt | mudgarādinaiva virodhasiddheś ca dhvaṃsasyānupayogāt | atha lākṣaṇiko virodha iṣṭaḥ, tadā svarūpāsaṃkareṇāiva tasya kṛtārthatvāt bhāvasyāvasthānam anivāryam |
analyzed: uktam atra asmin sati iti eva durlabham abhāve iti kim ca evam abhāva tva samarthanam upayogi bhāvayoḥ api tad virodhasya avirodhāt mudgara ādinā eva virodha siddheḥ ca dhvaṃsasya anupayogāt atha lākṣaṇikaḥ virodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ tadā svarūpa asaṃkareṇa iva tasya kṛtārtha tvāt bhāvasya avasthānam anivāryam

original: [117,23] kiṃ ca, sahānavasthānalakṣaṇapakṣe nānupapannena virodhinā paro viroddhvyaḥ, śītahutāśavat | prathamam utpattiḥ, tato vyāparaḥ, vyāpārapāṭavatāratamyāpekṣayā kiyatāpi kṣaṇena paroparodha itīyan taṃ kālamuparodhāt prāgabhāvena saha saṃvaset |
analyzed: kim ca saha anavasthāna lakṣaṇa pakṣe na anupapannena virodhinā paraḥ viroddhvyaḥ śīta hutāśa vat prathamam utpattiḥ tatas vyāparaḥ vyāpāra pāṭava tāratamya apekṣayā kiyatā api kṣaṇena para uparodhaḥ iti iyan tam kālam uparodhāt prāgabhāvena saha saṃvaset

original: [118,1] athotpatti-kṣaṇa eva vyāpāras thāpy utpadyamānena dhvaṃsena sahakāriṇā bhāvaḥ svopādeyaṃ bandham ādadhīta, tato nivṛttir iti durnivāraḥ sahabhāvaḥ | bandhakṣaṇādhānānapekṣāyām api svasantānakṣaṇānantaraṃ nāśanāt kṣaṇam api sahabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | etac ca kathaṃ cetanā-vataḥ soṭhuṃ śakyam ekasminn eva kṣaṇe bhāvasya bhāvābhāvāv iti |
analyzed: atha utpatti kṣaṇaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ utpadyamānena dhvaṃsena sahakāriṇā bhāvaḥ sva upādeyam bandham ādadhīta tatas nivṛttiḥ iti durnivāraḥ sahabhāvaḥ bandha kṣaṇa ādhāna anapekṣāyām api sva santāna kṣaṇa anantaram nāśanāt kṣaṇam api sahabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ etat ca katham cetanāvataḥ soṭhum śakyam ekasmin eva kṣaṇe bhāvasya bhāva abhāvau iti

original: api ca sahānavasthānasvīkārāt kṛśānunā śītam iva dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā dhvaṃsenāpi nipādi nivartanīyam iti tenāpi dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā pratiyogī pratihantavya ity anavasthānāt puruṣāyuṣaśatenāpi na kasyacid abhāvavyavahāraḥ syāt |
analyzed: api ca saha anavasthāna svīkārāt kṛśānunā śītam iva dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā dhvaṃsena api nipādi nivartanīyam iti tena api dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā pratiyogī pratihantavyaḥ iti anavasthānāt puruṣa āyuṣa śatena api na kasyacid abhāva vyavahāraḥ syāt

original: [118,8] atha dvitīyo (47b) virodhaḥ, tadā yatra bhāvas tatrābhāvasyāvakāśa eva nāsti | ayam eva hi lākṣaṇikavirodhasya svabhāvo yad viruddhayor dharmayor anyatrādhiṣṭhite dharmiṇi netarasyāvakāśa iti anutpattir eva dhvaṃsasya |
analyzed: atha dvitīyaḥ virodhaḥ tadā yatra bhāvaḥ tatra abhāvasya avakāśaḥ eva na asti ayam eva hi lākṣaṇika virodhasya svabhāvaḥ yat viruddhayoḥ dharmayoḥ anyatra adhiṣṭhite dharmiṇi na itarasya avakāśaḥ iti anutpattiḥ eva dhvaṃsasya

original: atha hetu-sāmarthyāt katham abhūtvā āsituṃ śaknotīty avaśyaṃ bhāvyaṃ dhvaṃseneti cet | na, pramāṇabādhite 'rthe hetu-sāmarthyakalpanānupapatter atiprasaṅgāt | yāvat khalu bhāvasya śvāsaḥ calati na tāvad abhāvagandhaḥ | anyathā viruddhābhimatayoḥ dharmayor ekatra dharmiṇi kṣaṇam api saṃbhave kva parasparaparihāravirodhaḥ |
analyzed: atha hetu sāmarthyāt katham a bhūtvā āsitum śaknoti iti avaśyam bhāvyam dhvaṃsena iti ced na pramāṇa bādhite rthe hetu sāmarthya kalpanā anupapatteḥ atiprasaṅgāt yāvat khalu bhāvasya śvāsaḥ calati na tāvat abhāva gandhaḥ anyathā viruddha abhimatayoḥ dharmayoḥ ekatra dharmiṇi kṣaṇam api saṃbhave kva paraspara parihāra virodhaḥ

original: tathā hi hetu-balād bhavatu nāma, sahabhāvas tu vastyny ekatra bhāvābhāvayor duṣ-pariharaḥ | sa hi bhāvaḥ pūrvavyavasthito, na bhavanaprayāsakhinno yan nivarteta | mudgarādeś ca dhvaṃsa eva vyāpāraḥ | ubhayatra vyāpāre 'pi kim aṅga dhvaṃsena | nāpi dhvaṃsenaiva nivartanīyaḥ, tasyodayāt pūrvam avyāpārāt |
analyzed: tathā hi hetu balāt bhavatu nāma sahabhāvaḥ tu vastyni ekatra bhāva abhāvayoḥ duṣpariharaḥ sa hi bhāvaḥ pūrva vyavasthitaḥ na bhavana prayāsa khinnaḥ yat nivarteta mudgara ādeḥ ca dhvaṃsaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ ubhayatra vyāpāre pi kim aṅga dhvaṃsena nā api dhvaṃsena eva nivartanīyaḥ tasya udayāt pūrvam avyāpārāt

original: tato bhāvasya sthitir abhāvasyotpattir iti siddhaḥ sahabhāvaḥ, girer iva kāśariṇotpadyamānena |
analyzed: tatas bhāvasya sthitiḥ abhāvasya utpattiḥ iti siddhaḥ sahabhāvaḥ gireḥ iva kāśariṇā utpadyamānena

original: [118,20] paścāt tarhi barhi-ṣevendhanadhvaṃsena nirākariṣyate tāvad iti cet | bhāvābhāvayoḥ bhāvābhāvayoḥ sahabhāvaprasaṅgadūṣaṇād avibhyad-abhyastadurnītir uttaraṃ kila vilapati | paścād vidhvaṃsena bhāvo nirākariṣyate na vā, bhāvābhāvayos tu sahabhāvaḥ prasakta ity eva pakṣakṣatir āyātā | kim aparagaveṣaṇena |
analyzed: paścāt tarhi barhiṣā iva indhana dhvaṃsena nirākariṣyate tāvat iti ced bhāva abhāvayoḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ sahabhāva prasaṅga dūṣaṇāt a vibhyat abhyasta durnītiḥ uttaram kila vilapati paścāt vidhvaṃsena bhāvaḥ nirākariṣyate na vā bhāva abhāvayoḥ tu sahabhāvaḥ prasaktaḥ iti eva pakṣa kṣatiḥ āyātā kim apara gaveṣaṇena

original: yadi ca vyavasthito bhāvas tena dhvaṃsena dhvaṃsanīyaḥ, tadā vyaktam ayaṃ sahānavasthānavirodhavyāpāra iti prakṛtakṣatiḥ | parasparaparihāravirodho hi vicārayitum upakrāntaḥ | tataḥ prakaraṇavismaraṇād vyutthāpayaty adyāpi parasparaparihāravirodhābhimataḥ, tadā na vyavasthitāpanayanavyāpāraḥ spraṣṭavya iti drāghīyānasahabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca vyavasthitaḥ bhāvaḥ tena dhvaṃsena dhvaṃsanīyaḥ tadā vyaktam ayam saha anavasthāna virodha vyāpāraḥ iti prakṛta kṣatiḥ paraspara parihāra virodhaḥ hi vicārayitum upakrāntaḥ tatas prakaraṇa vismaraṇāt vyutthāpayati adya api paraspara parihāra virodha abhimataḥ tadā na vyavasthita apanayana vyāpāraḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ iti drāghīyān asahabhāvaḥ

original: [119,2] saṃprati svahetu-balāvalambinoḥ kalasanāśayor upanatau bhāvābhāvau caikatra dharmiṇi dhīyete ciram iti paryavasitaṃ virodhakathayā |
analyzed: saṃprati sva hetu bala avalambinoḥ kalasa nāśayoḥ upanatau bhāva abhāvau ca ekatra dharmiṇi dhīyete ciram iti paryavasitam virodha kathayā

original: ata evābhāvotpattividhānena ca bhāvasya tādavasthyaprasaṅga iti pramattabhāṣitam ity abhidadhānaḥ sphuṭam ayaṃ tapasvī prativātakṣiptabhāsmānātmanam eva cchurayatīti mahā-mohamagnatayā kṛpāpātraṃ mahātām avagantavyaḥ | yadi evaṃ bhavatām apy abhāvo vyavahriyate sa kiṃ svabhāvo yadi na vastu bhāvena vā satyaṃ na virudhyata evāyam |
analyzed: atas eva abhāva utpatti vidhānena ca bhāvasya tādavasthya prasaṅgaḥ iti pramatta bhāṣitam iti abhidadhānaḥ sphuṭam ayam tapasvī prativāta kṣipta bhāsmān ātmanam eva churayati iti mahā moha magna tayā kṛpā pātram mahātām avagantavyaḥ yadi evam bhavatām api abhāvaḥ vyavahriyate sa kim svabhāvaḥ yadi na vastu bhāvena vā satyam na virudhyate eva ayam

original: kathaṃ vā virodhadvayavyavasthā | ko vāsya hetuḥ | kādācitkatve akādācitkatve ca bhāvasya saṃkālaṃ kathaṃ na vyavahriyate | kathaṃ vā prāg iva paścād api na kṣaṇapramparāprasavaḥ | prasave ca na shaḥ sahānavasthānavirodhaḥ |

original: [120,16] bhāvapracyuti-mātraṃ prasajyapratiṣedhasaṃjñākam iti svarūpanirdeśaḥ | tatra 1pratiṣedhe pratiṣedham eva vastv-icchantīti pracyuti-mātram uktam | pracyutir nāma kiṃsvit tṛtīyo bhāvaniṣedha iti śaṅkāyāṃ prasajyāhvayam ity uktam, tac ca tathā vyavahāramātraviṣayo na punar anubhavaviṣayaḥ anyathā vastv eva syāt |

original: [120,20] na ca yat kiñcid vyavahriyate vikalpabuddhyā tāvad vastu, kharaśṛṅgāder api vastuprasaṅgāt, nirvastukavikalpavyavasthānupapatteś ca | tac cābhāvasya bhūtyā dharmeṇa virudhyata eveti dvitīyapraśnavisarjanam | bhūtiś ca sattārthasāmarthyaṃ, svarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ vā |
analyzed: na ca yat kiñcid vyavahriyate vikalpa buddhyā tāvat vastu khara śṛṅga ādeḥ api vastu prasaṅgāt nirvastuka vikalpa vyavasthā anupapatteḥ ca tat ca abhāvasya bhūtyā dharmeṇa virudhyate eva iti dvitīya praśna visarjanam bhūtiḥ ca sattā artha sāmarthyam sva rūpeṇa avasthānam vā

original: ubhayathāpy anyonyapratyanīkarūpatayā pracyuti-mātreṇa virudhyata iti parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇavirodhavyavasthoktā |
analyzed: ubhayathā api anyonya pratyanīka rūpatayā pracyuti mātreṇa virudhyate iti paraspara parihāra sthiti lakṣaṇa virodha vyavasthā uktā

original: [121,1] nanu pracyuti-mātraṃ na kiñcit, tac ca kathaṃ (48b) kenacid virudhyate |

original: yata eva pracyuti-mātraṃ na kiñcit, bhāvas tu nañ-arthapratyanīkas tata eva virudhyate | virodho 'py eṣa nānyonyapratighātaḥ, sattānavasthānavat, kim tv anyonyarūpānanupraveśamātram | tac ca vikalpitānubhūtayor apy astīti na doṣaḥ | pracyuti-mātrasya ca kadācid bhāvatvābhāvāt kiṃ hetuneti caturthe visarjanam |
