original: kenacid rūpeṇonmajjato hi janakaḥ kalpyeta, akādācitkaṃ ca sarvadāsti vā nāsti vā | tatrāsti-pakṣakṣepāt sarvadā nāsty eva tat | vyavahāras tu kādācitkaḥ, bhāvakāle tad apravṛtteḥ | kathaṃ virodhād eva | bhāvavirodho hy abhāvaḥ pracyuti-svabhāvaḥ kalpanā-viparivartī kathaṃ bhāvakāle vyavahriyate |
analyzed: kenacid rūpeṇa unmajjataḥ hi janakaḥ kalpyeta akādācitkam ca sarvadā asti vā na asti vā tatra asti pakṣa kṣepāt sarvadā na asti eva tat vyavahāraḥ tu kādācitkaḥ bhāva kāle tat apravṛtteḥ katham virodhāt eva bhāva virodhaḥ hi abhāvaḥ pracyuti svabhāvaḥ kalpanā viparivartī katham bhāva kāle vyavahriyate

original: bhāvadharmā hi nirhetuko vā, bhavanahetu-janito vā, hetv-antarakṛto vā bhāvakāle 'pi bhaven nāma, bhāvānvayaṃ ca vyavahāram asyāsādayet | yadā tu nāsya bhāvo na tadā bhāvānuyāyī vyavahāraḥ | vāsanānugas tu virodho niścayavato vastu-darśane vāsanā-prabodhavaidhuryāt kathaṃ pravarteta |
analyzed: bhāva dharmāḥ hi nirhetukaḥ vā bhavana hetu janitaḥ vā hetu antara kṛtaḥ vā bhāva kāle bhavet nāma bhāva anvayam ca vyavahāram asya āsādayet yadā tu na asya bhāvaḥ na tadā bhāva anuyāyī vyavahāraḥ vāsanā anugaḥ tu virodhaḥ niścayavataḥ vastu darśane vāsanā prabodha vaidhuryāt katham pravarteta

original: [121,13] ata eva yāvat sa eva vastv-ātmāstīti vyavasāya, tāvad anavakāśa evābhāvavyavahāraḥ, kṣaṇabhaṅgabhāve 'pi tattvataḥ | yadā tu pramāṇabalād ekakṣaṇasthitadharmaiva bhāvasvabhāva ity avadhārayati tadā dvitīye kṣaṇe tad-vastūpādeyakṣaṇasamakālaṃ tad-abhāvaṃ vyavaharati |
analyzed: atas eva yāvat saḥ eva vastu ātmā asti iti vyavasāya tāvat anavakāśaḥ eva abhāva vyavahāraḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhāve tattvataḥ yadā tu pramāṇa balāt eka kṣaṇa sthita dharmā eva bhāva svabhāvaḥ iti avadhārayati tadā dvitīye kṣaṇe tad vastu upādeya kṣaṇa sama kālam tad abhāvam vyavaharati

original: tat-pramāṇālābhe tu karparādivikāradarśanam apekṣyaivābhāvavyavahārā iti pañcame visarjanam | ṣaṣṭhe 'pi hetu-kṣayān nodayaḥ sajātīyakṣaṇadhārayā iti |
analyzed: tad pramāṇa alābhe tu karpara ādi vikāra darśanam apekṣya eva abhāva vyavahārāḥ iti pañcame visarjanam ṣaṣṭhe pi hetu kṣayāt na udayaḥ sajātīya kṣaṇa dhārayā iti

original: [121,18] etad uktaṃ svarasanirdheṣu pūrvapūrvakṣaṇeṣu mudgarasahakāriṇā kṣaṇe sāmāgrī-vaisadṛśyād bandhyakṣaṇasyotpādanād upādānaṃ kṣīṇam iti nāparasyotpattiḥ | yat kṛte ca kasyacid bandhyakṣaṇādhāne sajātīyakṣaṇāntarāpratisandhānam, so 'pi bhāvas tasya bhāvasya virodhī siddha iti sahānavasthānavirodhavyavasthā |
analyzed: etat uktam pūrva pūrva kṣaṇeṣu mudgara sahakāriṇā kṣaṇe sāmāgrī vaisadṛśyāt bandhya kṣaṇasya utpādanāt upādānam kṣīṇam iti na aparasya utpattiḥ yat kṛte ca kasyacid bandhya kṣaṇa ādhāne sajātīya kṣaṇa antara apratisandhānam saḥ u pi bhāvaḥ tasya bhāvasya virodhī siddhaḥ iti saha anavasthāna virodha vyavasthā

original: tenaiva saptame 'pi caturthapādena yadi nāma vastv-avastunoḥ parasparaparihāro virodhaḥ tathāpi na tāttvikatvahāniḥ | na hi tayoḥ kadācit svabhāvasāṅkaryam asti | etāvān eva dharmavirodhasyārthaḥ | ata eva sthiti-grahaṇaṃ niyamasūcanaparam | etena tṛtīyo 'pi vikalpo nirastaḥ |
analyzed: tena eva saptame caturtha pādena yadi nāma vastu avastunoḥ paraspara parihāraḥ virodhaḥ tathā api na tāttvika tva hāniḥ na hi tayoḥ kadācid svabhāva sāṅkaryam asti etāvān eva dharma virodhasya arthaḥ atas eva sthiti grahaṇam niyama sūcana param etena vikalpaḥ nirastaḥ

original: tasmān nāśo nāma na prasajyātmā kartavyarūpo yato hetu-sāpekṣaḥ syāt, nāpy etāvanti dūṣaṇānīti sthitam ||
analyzed: tasmāt nāśaḥ nāma na prasajya ātmā kartavya rūpaḥ yatas hetu sāpekṣaḥ syāt nā api etāvanti dūṣaṇāni iti sthitam

original: [122,1] kiṃ cārthasya vinaśvaretaratayoḥ kiṃ nāśane kāraṇaiḥ svayaṃ vinaśvarasvabhāvasyotpattau vaiyarthyam anarthahetūnām, avinaśvarasvabhāvatve tv asāmarthyam |
analyzed: kim ca arthasya vinaśvara itara tayoḥ kim nāśane kāraṇaiḥ svayam vinaśvara svabhāvasya utpattau vaiyarthyam anartha hetūnām a vinaśvara svabhāva tve tu asāmarthyam

original: evaṃ tarhi bhaviṣṇutetaratayoḥ kiṃ kāraṇair janmani |
analyzed: evam tarhi bhaviṣṇu tā itara tayoḥ kim kāraṇaiḥ janmani

original: śakyaṃ hi vaktum arthasya bhaviṣṇutāyāṃ vyarthā janmahetavaḥ, abhaviṣṇutāyām asamarthā iti |
analyzed: śakyam hi vaktum arthasya bhaviṣṇu tāyām vyarthāḥ janma hetavaḥ abhaviṣṇu tāyām asamarthāḥ iti

original: [122,7] tathā ca nyāyabhūṣaṇakāraḥ | tan na, hetu-vādocchedaprasaṅgāt, vikalpasya sarvatra saṃbhavāt | tathā hi hetutaḥ kiṃ bhavanasvabhāvo bhavatvāhosvid (49a) abhāvasvabhāva iti | yady ādyaḥ pakṣas tadā svayam eva bhavati, tatsvabhāvatvād iti vyartho hetuḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca nyāyabhūṣaṇa kāraḥ tat na hetuvāda uccheda prasaṅgāt vikalpasya sarvatra saṃbhavāt tathā hi hetutaḥ kim bhavana svabhāvaḥ bhavatu āhosvit abhāva svabhāvaḥ iti yadi ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tadā svayam eva bhavati tad svabhāva tvāt iti vyarthaḥ hetuḥ

original: dvitīyapakṣe tv asamartho na hy abhāvasvabhāvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇādi kenacid utpādayituṃ śakyam | tathā cchedadāhādi-hetavo 'pi tatsvabhāvatva-'tatsvabhāvatvapakṣayoḥ vaiyarthyāsāmarthyābhyām anupapannā draṣṭavyāḥ | tathā caivaṃ sarvahetupratikṣepasaṃbhavān mokṣādau prayāsaḥ śāstraśravaṇādau vyartha iti,
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe tu asamarthaḥ na hi abhāva svabhāvam śaśaviṣāṇa ādi kenacid utpādayitum śakyam tathā cheda dāha ādi hetavaḥ api tad svabhāva tva tad svabhāva tva pakṣayoḥ vaiyarthya asāmarthyābhyām anupapannāḥ draṣṭavyāḥ tathā ca evam sarva hetu pratikṣepa saṃbhavāt mokṣa ādau prayāsaḥ śāstra śravaṇa ādau vyarthaḥ iti

original: [122,13] atrāyaṃ paryanuyujyate | kim anena mūle paraśu-nipātaprakāreṇa | sarvathā kvacid api hetutayopanīte 'sāmarthyavaiyarthyalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣaṇam eva na vācyam ity ucyate | tat-tāvad ayuktam, dṛśyate hi nakhacchedye kuṭhāravaiyarthyam, kutṭhāracchedye ca nakhasyāsāmarthyam |
analyzed: atra ayam paryanuyujyate kim anena mūle paraśu nipāta prakāreṇa sarvathā kvacid api hetu tayā upanīte sāmarthya vaiyarthya lakṣaṇam dūṣaṇam eva na vācyam iti ucyate tat tāvat ayuktam dṛśyate hi nakha chedye kuṭhāra vaiyarthyam kutṭhāra chedye ca nakhasya asāmarthyam

original: tathā devadattenaiva yat sādhyaṃ tatra devadattasahāyasya yajñadattasya vyāpāravaiyarthyam | tad-vinā-kṛtasya punar asāmarthyam | dahanendhanasāmāgryāṃ satyāṃ rāsabhasya dhūme vaiarthyam asatyām asāmarthyam | yatra vā sidhasādhanapoṣaṇaṃ tatra vaiyarthyam | asiddhaviruddhānaikāntikeṣv anyatamasattve asāmarthyam iti |
analyzed: tathā devadattena eva yat sādhyam tatra devadatta sahāyasya yajñadattasya vyāpāra vaiyarthyam tad vinākṛtasya punar asāmarthyam dahana indhana sāmāgryām satyām rāsabhasya dhūme vaiarthyam asatyām asāmarthyam yatra vā tatra vaiyarthyam asiddha viruddha anaikāntikeṣu anyatama sattve asāmarthyam iti

analyzed: iti nyāyasya svayam pratijñānāt sa ca abhāvaḥ bhavan paścāt evā iti sphuṭataram asya kādācitkatvāt sa hetutvam vastu tvam ca iti tathā ca sahaḥ evā āha yasya bhāvasya paścāt abhāvaḥ saḥ eva nāśaḥ iti ucyate katham bhāvasya vināśaḥ nyaḥ vā kaścid na upalabhyate atha bhāvasya vināśaḥ ucyate kim tu sa bhavati iti nā ucyate bhavati iti abhidhāne kaḥ doṣaḥ

original: bhāva eva syād iti cet | tat-kim idānīm abhidhānād evārthasya rūpaparivarto bhavati | yadi ca bhavet tato jāyata ity ucyatām | janmāpy abhāvasya kuta iti cet | kādācitkatvāt | akādācitkatve tu pratyutpannāvasthāyām apy abhāvaḥ syād iti |
analyzed: bhāvaḥ eva syāt iti ced tat kim idānīm abhidhānāt evā arthasya rūpa parivartaḥ bhavati yadi ca bhavet tatas jāyate iti ucyatām janma api abhāvasya kutas iti ced kādācitka tvāt a kādācitka tve tu pratyutpanna avasthāyām api abhāvaḥ syāt iti

original: [137,15] atrocyate, vyavahāraśabdena tāvad asmākaṃ niścayavacasī abhimate, vacanaṃ ca vikalpena 8sahaikaviṣayam eva | vikalpasya ca grāhyādhyavasāyabhedena dvividho viṣayaḥ | tatra yat pratibhāsaṃ vikalpajñānam ājāyate tad grāhyam ucyate |
analyzed: atra ucyate vyavahāra śabdena tāvat asmākam niścaya vacasī abhimate vacanam ca vikalpena saha eka viṣayam eva vikalpasya ca grāhya adhyavasāya bhedena dvividhaḥ viṣayaḥ tatra yat pratibhāsam vikalpa jñānam ājāyate tat grāhyam ucyate

original: yad āśraye tu pravṛtti-nivṛttī tad adhyavaseyam, yathā paścād abhāvo bhāvasyaiva jāta9 ity asyaiva vikalpasyārthāntarotpattiḥ ( || )
analyzed: yat āśraye tu pravṛtti nivṛttī tat adhyavaseyam yathā paścāt abhāvaḥ bhāvasya eva jātaḥ iti asya eva vikalpasya artha antara utpattiḥ

original: sākṣān nirbhāsamānā grāhyā tadbhāvārthakriyārthino nivṛtter āśrayabhūtā ca tad-viviktatat-kāladeśasvabhāvavastv-avasthādhyavaseyā, yatas tad-vikalpodaye vināśākhyavastūtpatti-parāmarśavimukhaḥ pratiṣedhyabhāvārthkriyārthī tad-deśakālātmani vastuni na pravartate, api tu nivartate | tatas tad-deśakālavastv-avasthādhyavaseya ucyate |
analyzed: sākṣāt nirbhāsamānā grāhyā tad bhāva artha kriyā arthinaḥ nivṛtteḥ āśraya bhūtā ca tad vivikta tad kāla deśa svabhāva vastu avasthā adhyavaseyā yatas tad vikalpa udaye vināśa ākhya vastu utpatti parāmarśa vimukhaḥ pratiṣedhya bhāva arth kriyā arthī tad deśa kāla ātmani vastuni na pravartate api tu nivartate tatas tad deśa kāla vastu avasthā adhyavaseyaḥ ucyate

original: tatra pratibhāsamānavastv-antarāpekṣayā vyavahāramātram ucyate, yatnena nirūpatayā nayanasahasreṇāpy udīyamānapadārthāntarasyānupalabdheḥ | tatas tad-visaṃvāde 'pi yatra pravṛtti-nivṛttibhyāṃ pariniṣṭhitavyāpāro vikalpaḥ saṃpadyate, tam adhyavaseyaṃ viṣayam apekṣya na visaṃvādasaṃvādaḥ |
analyzed: tatra pratibhāsamāna vastu antara apekṣayā vyavahāra mātram ucyate yatnena nirūpatayā nayana sahasreṇa api udīyamāna padārtha antarasya anupalabdheḥ tatas tad visaṃvāde pi yatra pravṛtti nivṛttibhyām pariniṣṭhita vyāpāraḥ vikalpaḥ saṃpadyate tam adhyavaseyam viṣayam apekṣya na visaṃvāda saṃvādaḥ

original: adhyavaseye casaṃvādetaracintā, na pratibhāsini |

original: tad ayam vyāpako 'pi yadi nyāyaḥ prakṛte tāvad avaseyasaṃvādenaiva saṃvādam anuśiṣmaḥ | pratibhāsinī tu visaṃvādaḥ sādhya eva yadi sidhyati prasannāḥ devatāḥ, kim atra bhava[ta] ḥ (55a) kopena |
analyzed: tat ayam yadi nyāyaḥ prakṛte tāvat avaseya saṃvādena eva saṃvādam anuśiṣmaḥ pratibhāsinī tu visaṃvādaḥ sādhyaḥ eva yadi sidhyati prasannāḥ devatāḥ kim atra bhavataḥ kopena

original: tasmād abhāvavikalpapratibhāsinaḥ kāryarūpasya mithyātve 'pi nābhāvavyavahārasya visaṃvāditā, adhyavasitārthayathātmyasya sattvāt | tasya ca kalpitarūpasya mithyātve 'pi bhāvavirodhinaḥ pracyuti-mātrasya vyavahartavyaikarūpasya mithyātvam iti na vastu-niṣedhe bhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca sā tena rūpeṇa pracyuti-mātrātmanā pratiṣidhyate |
analyzed: tasmāt abhāva vikalpa pratibhāsinaḥ kārya rūpasya mithyātve pi na abhāva vyavahārasya visaṃvādi tā adhyavasita artha yathātmyasya sattvāt tasya ca kalpita rūpasya mithyātve pi bhāva virodhinaḥ pracyuti mātrasya vyavahartavya eka rūpasya mithyātvam iti na vastu niṣedhe bhāva prasaṅgaḥ na ca sā tena rūpeṇa pracyuti mātra ātmanā pratiṣidhyate

original: kiṃ tu vastu-rūpatayā kalpitayā |
analyzed: kim tu vastu rūpatayā kalpitayā

original: [138,9] nanu vastu na bhavatīty ayam eva pratiṣedhaḥ tathā ca sā pracyutir asti naveti praśne yady asti kathaṃ na vastu, nāsti cet? katham apratiṣedhaḥ, ucyate, vastu-virahamātrasya7 vastutvāropa eva niṣedhaḥ | na vastutvaniṣedhas tan-niṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu vastu na bhavati iti ayam eva pratiṣedhaḥ tathā ca sā pracyutiḥ asti na vā iti praśne yadi asti katham na vastu na asti ced katham apratiṣedhaḥ ucyate vastu viraha mātrasya vastu tva āropaḥ eva niṣedhaḥ na vastu tva niṣedhaḥ tad niṣedhaḥ

original: [138,11] tataḥ pracyutir astīti na pracyuti-rūpāt pracyavata ity ayam evārthaḥ | na tv asti prayogamātreṇa kalpitasyāpi trai-guṇyamayatvāder vidhiḥ | yathā ca pratiṣiddhaghaṭarūpād atiriktarūpāpekṣaiva nāsti ghṭo nityatayā kṣaṇikatayā veti sādhu, tathā nāsti pracyutir ity api vastutvenety apekṣaiva sādhu |
analyzed: tatas pracyutiḥ asti iti na pracyuti rūpāt pracyavate iti ayam eva arthaḥ na tu asti prayoga mātreṇa kalpitasya api traiguṇya maya tva ādeḥ vidhiḥ yathā ca pratiṣiddha ghaṭa rūpāt atirikta rūpa apekṣā eva na asti ghṭaḥ nitya tayā kṣaṇika tayā vā iti sādhu tathā na asti pracyutiḥ iti api vastu tvena iti apekṣā eva sādhu

original: nirupādhis tv asti pracyutir iti tat svarūpāpracyutau na duṣyati | yāvac ca na pratiṣedhyabhāvas tāvat pracyutiḥ, svarūpāpracyutiḥ, parasparābhāvarūpatvād anayoḥ |
analyzed: nirupādhiḥ tu asti pracyutiḥ iti tat svarūpa apracyutau na duṣyati yāvat ca na pratiṣedhya bhāvaḥ tāvat pracyutiḥ svarūpa apracyutiḥ paraspara abhāva rūpa tvāt anayoḥ

original: [138,17] ata eva,
analyzed: atas eva

analyzed: nivṛttiḥ yadi tasmin na hetoḥ vṛttiḥ kim iṣyate

original: [139,1] ity ucyate yadi tadā na doṣaḥ | yasya hi yadāstīty asya pratyanīkaṃ nāstīti virahamātram avastu-rūpaṃ kalpanā-viparivati pratiṣidhyate, tasya tadā niyamenāstīty evaṃ rūpam antar-mātrāyām upasthānam āsādayati |

original: yadā tu paścād virahamātram apratikṣipya paścād bhavati jāyate ceti vikalpavivartavaśād vāsanāgād vastu-rūpasya kalpitasya niṣedhaḥ, tadā kathaṃ virahamātrapratikṣepaprabhavo bhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, yato

original: ity ucyate | na hi ghaṭaḥ kalpitarūpaniṣedhe svarūpāt pracyavamāsādayati, udakadhāraṇādy arthakriyā virahaprasaṅgāt | na ca pracyuteḥ svarūpollekho vastutvapratyāśāyāḥ pūrakaḥ, asatsvabhāvo bandhyā-suta ity-ādivat, svabhāvāvasthānaniveśane 'pi tad ayogāt | asiddho hetur ity-ādivad vā |

original: tasmāt nāśaḥ paścād bhavati jāyate mudgarādibhya iti bālavyavahāramātram apalapyate | tat pratibhāṣitaṃ tu kādācitkatvādi vastu-rūpaṃ nāstīti brūmaḥ |

original: [139,13] na ca vastu yāvad vyavahāropasthāpitaṃ tatsarvaṃ vastu-tattvam iti śakyam, śāstrapraṇayanārthakyaprasaṅgāt | vyavahāraṃ tu vitatham upadarśayan nāpi mūlabalābalābhyāṃ kaścid upādeyo heyaś ca kaścid iti vibhāgaḥ subhagaḥ | mūlaṃ cādhyavaseyam iti (55b) darśitam | tasmāt tattvacintāyām,

original: na hy evam abhidhīyamānaṃ vadanaṃ vakrayati | adarśanād anyapauruṣābhāvasya | na ca dṛṣtāntamātrāt sādhyasiddhiḥ, hetus tadbhāvasādhanāyābhāve upādīyamānaḥ ko 'sāv asti yo nāśrayāsiddha iti |

original: yat tu tad-viviktabhūtalāder viṣayatvam āśaṅkyoktam, na bhūtalāder vastv-antaratvāt, na ca vastv-antare pratipādite pratīte vādyaghaṭādivastv-antaram abhūtam iti pratipāditaṃ pratītaṃ vā bhavati |

original: evaṃ yadi karparādivat kevalasya nāśasyāpy upalambhaḥ syāt, bhavatu ghaṭo niṣedhapratītiḥ ghaṭaniṣedhas tu kena kṛtaḥ | pūrvaṃ sann eva hi ghaṭābhāvaḥ tad-dvāreṇa pratipattavyaḥ, na hi pradeśena ghaṭābhāvo janyante, kiṃ tu sann eva ghaṭābhāvaḥ tad-dvāreṇa niścetavyaḥ, yadi hi ghaṭo 'pi na syān na pradeśaikarūpaniyatā pratītir iti |

original: [150,1] evaṃ yathā yadi ghaṭo 'dyāpi syān na karparaikarūpaniyatā pratipattis tathā na nāśaikarūpaniyatā pratipattir iti balād ghaṭābhāvaniścayo bhavatu, yadi pūrvaṃ ghaṭābhāvaḥ syāt, sa ca nāsti | tadbhāve 'pi kiṃ nāśena, kapālenaiva pratiyoginā gatārthatvāt |

original: [150,6] yat tu āha, na ca tad vivekāpratītau tad viviktagahaṇaṃ bhavati | tad-vivekaś ca na bhūtalādi-svarūpam eva, viśeṣaṇatvād iti, tat nyāyabahiṣ-kṛtam | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo 'pi saṅkalpārūṭhe rūpe | sa ca,

original: skhalad-gatir ayaṃ rāhoḥ śira ity-ādi-nirdeśa iti cet | yadi satyam etat tadā bhinnasya sākṣād anupalambhād eva | iyaṃ ca gatir ghaṭavivekākhyapadārthāntarāpekṣayāpy asti, tathāpi neti koṣapānaṃ pramāṇam | tasmāt sa ghaṭābhāvapradeśa eva ayam anyo ghaṭavivikto na tu ghaṭavivekena bhinnena viśeṣita iti |

original: tasmād yady api kiñcid viśeṣaṇaṃ bhinnam eva dṛṣṭaṃ vāhādi, tathāpi nāyaṃ niyamaḥ, viparyayasyāpi darśanāt, saṃbhāvanāc ca bādhakādarśanāt | vivakṣā-paratantratā tu dṛṣṭāntasaṃbhāvanā-bījam | tad evaṃ na vācyaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāad arthāntaratvād vāhādivad iti | kiṃ ca,
analyzed: tasmāt yadi api kiñcid viśeṣaṇam bhinnam eva dṛṣṭam vāha ādi tathā api na ayam niyamaḥ viparyayasya api darśanāt saṃbhāvanāt ca bādhaka adarśanāt vivakṣā paratantra tā tu dṛṣṭānta saṃbhāvanā bījam tat evam na vācyam artha antara tvāt vāha ādi vat iti kim ca

original: yac cedam yadi ca ghaṭo nāstīty asya saṃjñānasyābhidhānasya ca bhūtalam eva viṣayo na ca tato 'nyo ghaṭābhāvaḥ, tadātra ghaṭo 'stīty asyāpi bhūtalam eva viṣayaḥ syāt | ghaṭo 'pi na tato 'nyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, tathotpādena viśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalam evobhayatrāpy astu |

original: na caitad yuktam | yasmād gaṭasadbhāvavad ghaṭāsadbhāve 'pi bhūtarato 'nyaḥ pratibhāti, evaṃ hi vidhi-pratiṣedhayoḥ prayogo 'py arthavān eva bhaved iti tad varaṃ januṣāndho, na punar ayaṃ durnīti-dagdhabuddhiḥ | abhāvavat kila kalaso 'pi kalpanā-mātraviṣayo na locanagocara iti kim atra brūmaḥ |

original: sakumbham udbhūtaṃ bhūtalam (59b) ity api sahitotpattir āpadyate, na rūpasaṅkaraḥ, bhedopalambhasya bhinnārthakriyā-niyogasya ca durapahnavatvāt | tad-van nābhāvo 'pi bhūtalakapālādibhyo bhinnaḥ pratibhātīti cintitam eva | kiṃ ca,

original: tad api na kiñcit | niścāyakaṃ hi cakṣur vijñānam abhāvasya na grāhakam avastutvāt, ālokāntarānapekṣam iti tu siddham eva |
analyzed: tat api na kiñcid niścāyakam hi cakṣuḥ vijñānam abhāvasya na grāhakam avastu tvāt āloka antara anapekṣam iti tu siddham eva

original: na caitat vācyam | yo hi bhāvo yāvatyā sāmagryā gṛhyate tad abhāvo 'pi tāvatyaivety ālokagrahaṇasāmagryā gṛhyamāṇaṃ tamas tad abhāva eveti, tamo grahaṇasāmagryā gṛhyamāṇasyālokasyaiva tad abhāvatvaprasaṅgenānaikāntakatvāt | ghaṭapaṭayor vā samānagrahaṇasāmagrīkatayā pramparābhāvatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: na ca etat vācyam yaḥ hi bhāvaḥ yāvatyā sāmagryā gṛhyate tat abhāvaḥ pi tāvatyā eva iti āloka grahaṇa sāmagryā gṛhyamāṇam tamaḥ tat abhāvaḥ eva iti tamaḥ grahaṇa sāmagryā gṛhyamāṇasya ālokasya eva tat abhāva tva prasaṅgena anaikāntaka tvāt ghaṭa paṭayoḥ vā samāna grahaṇa sāmagrīkatayā pramparā bhāva tva prasaṅgaḥ

original: tasmāt padārthāntare rūpavivekena pratibhāsamānam adhyakṣe andhakāram ālokavirodhi vastv eva | virodhitve tarhi kadācid ālokam apy andhakāraḥ paribhaved iti na codyam, adyāpi prakṛtivādasyopasthāpanāt, tūlānalādivat |

original: etena tamasa eva pratiyogivastuna upalabdhir abhāvaṃ sahasā vyavahārayituṃ prabhavati | tamasyālokanivṛttāv apīti siddhe yathehālokasyābhāvopalabdhis tathā sarvatreti śaṅkarādīnāṃ pratyāśā-pratyādeśo veditavyaḥ |
analyzed: etena tamasaḥ eva pratiyogi vastunaḥ upalabdhiḥ abhāvam sahasā vyavahārayitum prabhavati tamasi āloka nivṛttau api iti siddhe yathā iha ālokasya abhāva upalabdhiḥ tathā sarvatra iti śaṅkara ādīnām pratyāśā pratyādeśaḥ veditavyaḥ

original: anupalabdhi-niṣṭhāyāṃ tu jñānākāre 'pi pratiyoginy abhāvasiddhir darśitā | na ca kaścid doṣa ity āstāṃ tāvat | tasmān nābhāvo nāma kiñcid yatra kāraṇavyāpāra iti sthitam |
analyzed: anupalabdhi niṣṭhāyām tu jñāna ākāre pi pratiyogini abhāva siddhiḥ darśitā na ca kaścid doṣaḥ iti āstām tāvat tasmāt na abhāvaḥ nāma kiñcid yatra kāraṇa vyāpāraḥ iti sthitam

original: etena Trilocano 'pi nirastaḥ,
analyzed: etena Trilocanaḥ pi nirastaḥ

original: yad āha | bhāvasya vyatiriktāṃ nivṛttim anicchadbhir aśakyā svarūpanivṛttir avasthāpayitum, yā hi tasya prāktanī kācid avasthā bhavadbhir arthakriyā-nirvartanayogyā dṛṣṭā saiva yady uttarakālam apy anuvarteta tarhi svarūpeṇaiva nivṛttau bhāvaḥ katham avasthāpyeta |
analyzed: yat āha bhāvasya vyatiriktām nivṛttim an icchadbhiḥ aśakyā svarūpa nivṛttiḥ avasthāpayitum yā hi tasya prāktanī kācid avasthā bhavadbhiḥ arthakriyā nirvartana yogyā dṛṣṭā sā eva yadi uttara kālam api anuvarteta tarhi svarūpeṇa eva nivṛttau bhāvaḥ katham avasthāpyeta

original: tadānīm ayaṃ naṣṭo bhāvo, na sapadi svahetupratilabdhasvarūpātirekiṇī tasya kācid avasthotpadyeta ||
analyzed: tadānīm ayam naṣṭaḥ bhāvaḥ na sapadi sva hetu pratilabdha sva rūpa atirekiṇī tasya kācid avasthā utpadyeta

original: [154,1] utpattau saiva tasyātmāntaraṃ jātām ity atādavasthyas | atādavasthyam evāsya vināśaṃ brūmaḥ | tādavasthye tādātmyam eva svarūpeṇa nivṛtto bhāva ity asya śabdasya satyam arthaṃ na vidmaḥ | svarūpanivṛttiḥ khalv iyaṃ bhavantī bhāva eva syāt, bhāvād anyā vā |
analyzed: utpattau sā eva tasya ātma antaram jātām iti atādavasthyaḥ atādavasthyam eva asya vināśam brūmaḥ tādavasthye tādātmyam eva sva rūpeṇa nivṛttaḥ bhāvaḥ iti asya śabdasya satyam artham na vidmaḥ sva rūpa nivṛttiḥ khalu iyam bhavantī bhāvaḥ eva syāt bhāvāt anyā vā

original: tattve svakāraṇebhyo niṣpannasyānyathānutpattāv utpatter ārabhya sattvān nityatvaṃ prasajyate, anyathātve ca tad eva nivṛtter anyatvam iti priyam anuṣṭhitaṃ priyeṇa | tasmād utsṛjya vibhramaṃ nāśotpattir eva naṣṭatvam abhyupagantavyam | tat kim ucyate naṣṭasyādarśanam, na ca tasya kiñcid bhavatīti | adarśanaṃ naṣṭasya punar abhāvadarśanam eva |
analyzed: tattve sva kāraṇebhyaḥ niṣpannasya anyathā anutpattau utpatteḥ ārabhya sattvāt nitya tvam prasajyate anyathātve ca tat eva nivṛtteḥ anya tvam iti priyam anuṣṭhitam priyeṇa tasmāt utsṛjya vibhramam nāśa utpattiḥ eva naṣṭa tvam abhyupagantavyam tat kim ucyate naṣṭasya adarśanam na ca tasya kiñcid bhavati iti adarśanam naṣṭasya punar abhāva darśanam eva

original: ātmahānam abhāvotpattim eva vayam aṅgī-kurma iti sarvam anavadyam | akṣaṇikāḥ santaḥ, kāraṇavattvāt | yat kāraṇavat tad akṣaṇikam, yathā bhāvavināśaḥ | kāraṇavantaś ceme santaḥ | tasmād akṣaṇikā iti |
analyzed: ātma hānam abhāva utpattim eva vayam aṅgīkurmaḥ iti sarvam anavadyam akṣaṇikāḥ santaḥ kāraṇavat tvāt yat kāraṇavat tat akṣaṇikam yathā bhāva vināśaḥ kāraṇavantaḥ ca ime santaḥ tasmāt akṣaṇikāḥ iti

original: [154,10] kāraṇavat tv asya (60b) sādhyaviparyaye vṛtti-śaṅkā vināśahetu-mattvam eva nivartayatīti prasiddhavyāptikā-kāraṇavattvād akṣaṇikatvasiddhir iti, vyatiriktanivṛttim antareṇāpi svarūpanivṛtter upapāditattvāt | tataś ca kṣaṇād ūrdhvaṃ kutaḥ prāktanaśaktāvasthā-sthitiḥ | vyatiriktotpāde 'pi kathaṃ naṣṭo nāma |
analyzed: kāraṇa vat tu asya sādhya viparyaye vṛtti śaṅkā vināśa hetumat tvam eva nivartayati iti prasiddha vyāptika akāraṇavat tvāt akṣaṇika tva siddhiḥ iti vyatirikta nivṛttim antareṇa api svarūpa nivṛtteḥ upapādi tattvāt tatas ca kṣaṇāt ūrdhvam kutas prāktana śaktā avasthā sthitiḥ vyatirikta utpāde pi katham naṣṭaḥ nāma

original: atādavasthyam atādātmyaṃ ca jātam ity asyātyakṣarasya svahetor evāvasthā-svabhāvāntaravirahito 'yaṃ jāta ity evārtha uktaḥ | tan-mūlakaḥ ātādavasthyādivyavahāra eva paścād bhāvī na tad-vikalpapratibhāsi bhāvāntaram iti na tattvānyatvavikalpāvakāśaḥ | tasmād utsṛjya vibhramaṃ naṣṭavyavahāro 'stu, na tu tasyānyat kiñcit jāyata iti |
analyzed: atādavasthyam atādātmyam ca jātam iti asya atyakṣarasya sva hetoḥ eva avasthā svabhāva antara virahitaḥ yam jātaḥ iti eva arthaḥ uktaḥ tad mūlakaḥ ātādavasthya ādi vyavahāraḥ eva paścāt bhāvī na tad vikalpa pratibhāsi bhāva antaram iti na tattva anyatva vikalpa avakāśaḥ tasmāt utsṛjya vibhramam naṣṭavyavahāraḥ astu na tu tasya anyat kiñcid jāyate iti

original: adarśanaṃ cābhāvadarśanam eveti saṃpraty eva pratyākhyātam iti sarvam anavadyam |
analyzed: adarśanam ca abhāva darśanam eva iti saṃprati eva pratyākhyātam iti sarvam anavadyam

original: tasmāt prasajyātmano 'bhāvasya nāśākhyasya hetur eva na kaścit | vinaśvarasvabhāve tu hetv-antaraśaktim-apākṛtya svahetor eva sāmarthyasamarthanād jātamātram eva vinaśyantīti na kṣaṇāntaram anvetīti siddheḥ | kāraṇavattvasyākṣaṇikatvena vyāpty asiddher anekāntaḥ | kṛtakānām avaśyam ante 'pi nāśābhyupagame ca virodhaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt prasajya ātmanaḥ bhāvasya nāśa ākhyasya hetuḥ eva na kaścid vinaśvara svabhāve tu hetu antara śaktim apākṛtya sva hetoḥ eva sāmarthya samarthanāt jāta mātram eva vinaśyanti iti na kṣaṇa antaram anveti iti siddheḥ kāraṇavat tvasya akṣaṇika tvena vyāptī asiddheḥ anekāntaḥ kṛtakānām avaśyam ante nāśa abhyupagame ca virodhaḥ

original: pramāṇagocarasya pakṣīkaraṇe pratijñāyā anumānabādhā | agocare c`aśrayasvarūpayor asiddhir iti sthitam |
analyzed: pramāṇa gocarasya pakṣīkaraṇe pratijñāyāḥ anumāna bādhā agocare caśraya svarūpayoḥ asiddhiḥ iti sthitam

original: [154,24] pratyakṣasiddham kṣaṇikatvam yat punar ayaṃ bhagavato bhāṣyakārasya pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddham anavagāhamānaḥ anurūpavikalpābhāvodbhāvanamātrasāreṇa vistareṇa dūṣaṇam abhilaṣann-apabhāṣaṇapramādam ācarati,
analyzed: pratyakṣa siddham kṣaṇika tvam yat punar ayam bhagavataḥ bhāṣyakārasya pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅga siddham an avagāhamānaḥ anurūpa vikalpa abhāva udbhāvana mātra sāreṇa vistareṇa dūṣaṇam abhilaṣan apabhāṣaṇa pramādam ācarati

original: [155,1] tad asya caṭulavaṭubhāvasulabham-anātmajñātāviṣkaraṇamātram iti mantavyam | tathā hi pratyakṣasiddhaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti na pratyakṣavyavahṛtam, anurūpavikalpānudayāt | kiṃ tu pratyakṣagṛhītam, vyavahāratvānumānāt |
analyzed: tat asya caṭula vaṭu bhāva sulabham anātma jñāta āviṣkaraṇa mātram iti mantavyam tathā hi pratyakṣa siddham kṣaṇika tvam iti na pratyakṣa vyavahṛtam anurūpa vikalpa anudayāt kim tu pratyakṣa gṛhītam vyavahāra tva anumānāt

original: tac cānumānaṃ yadi svayaṃ kutaścil liṅgāt prasādhya pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgagrahaṇavyavahāram ādadhīta sāmarthyāt, tadā na viśeṣaḥ sattvādy-anumānavat | arthato hi tadā pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhṅgagrahaṇam avasthāpyamānaṃ svapauruṣasparśābhāvāt na pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhi-prasiddhiṃ puṣṇāti |
analyzed: tat ca anumānam yadi svayam kutaścid liṅgāt prasādhya pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇa bhaṅga grahaṇa vyavahāram ādadhīta sāmarthyāt tadā na viśeṣaḥ sattva ādi anumāna vat arthataḥ hi tadā pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇa bhṅga grahaṇam avasthāpyamānam sva pauruṣa sparśa abhāvāt na pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga siddhi prasiddhim puṣṇāti

original: yadā tu pramāṇāntarasiddham adhyakṣasya kṣaṇamātrasthiti-grahaṇam āśritya vyavahāramātrasādhanam anumānaṃ pṛṣṭhajavikalpanirviśeṣaṃ tat-pauruṣam eva dīpayad utpadyate, tadā pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir iti mukhyam ākhyāyate | tad ayam arthaḥ,
analyzed: yadā tu pramāṇa antara siddham adhyakṣasya kṣaṇa mātra sthiti grahaṇam āśritya vyavahāra mātra sādhanam anumānam pṛṣṭha ja vikalpa nirviśeṣam tat pauruṣam eva dīpayat utpadyate tadā pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga siddhiḥ iti mukhyam ākhyāyate tat ayam arthaḥ

original: kṣaṇikatvam adhyakṣadhiyādhipātaṃ pātaṃ punar na vyavahāram etat |
analyzed: kṣaṇika tvam adhyakṣa dhiyā adhipātam pātam punar na vyavahāram etat

original: ataḥ samakṣagrahasādhanena prasādhyate tad-vyavahāra eva ||
analyzed: atas samakṣa graha sādhanena prasādhyate tad vyavahāraḥ eva

original: kṣaṇabhaṅge 'nyadāsiddhe pratyakṣena grahasthitiḥ |
analyzed: kṣaṇabhaṅge pratyakṣena graha sthitiḥ

original: pratyakṣena grahād asya kṣaṇabhaṅgavyavasthitiḥ ||
tathā hi,
analyzed: tathā hi

original: yan nirbhāti yathā tathā tad akhilaṃ gaṅgāmbu gauraṃ yathā
analyzed: yat nirbhāti yathā tathā tat akhilam gaṅgā ambu gauram yathā

original: no cen na prativastu śakti-niyamaḥ saṅkīrṇabhāve bhavet |
analyzed: no ced na prativastu śakti niyamaḥ saṅkīrṇa bhāve bhavet

analyzed: saṃskārāḥ pratibhānti ca indriya matiṣu eka kṣaṇa sthāyinaḥ

original: syād ekakṣaṇavīkṣaṇād itarathā (61a) dṛṣṭas tri-kālī kalaḥ ||
analyzed: syāt eka kṣaṇa vīkṣaṇāt itarathā dṛṣṭaḥ trikālī kalaḥ

original: liṅgarūpopapattivyavakīrṇo 'yaṃ svabhāvahetuprayogaḥ | atra ca sapakṣe sadbhāvān na virodhadoṣaḥ | dvitīyapādena cānekāntaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: liṅga rūpa upapatti vyavakīrṇaḥ yam svabhāva hetu prayogaḥ atra ca sapakṣe sadbhāvāt na virodha doṣaḥ dvitīya pādena ca anekānta parihāraḥ

original: tathā hi, nirbhānaṃ pratyakṣe pratibhānam uktam, tato yāvatā viśeṣeṇa padārthaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsam āsādayati tan-niyamaparihāreṇa yadi svarūpasthititam ābhajeta tadā sarvasaṅkīrṇam asya rūpam iti sarvatra sarvopayogādi-prasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi nirbhānam pratyakṣe pratibhānam uktam tatas yāvatā viśeṣeṇa padārthaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsam āsādayati tad niyama parihāreṇa yadi ābhajeta tadā sarva saṅkīrṇam asya rūpam iti sarvatra sarva upayoga ādi prasaṅgaḥ

original: ataḥ svarūpaniyame pramāṇāpekṣāyāṃ pravṛtti-nivṛttikām asya yad yathā pratyakṣe pratibhātaṃ tat-tathaiva san, nānyatheti |
analyzed: atas sva rūpa niyame pramāṇa apekṣāyām pravṛtti nivṛttikām asya yat yathā pratyakṣe pratibhātam tat tathā eva sat na anyathā iti

original: [156,1] tad anena avaitathyavyāpto hi pratyakṣapratibhāso 'rthasyānyathāvasthāne vipakṣe vyāpakābhāvād abhavaṃs tathāvasthānena vyāpyata iti darśitam |
analyzed: tat anena avaitathya vyāptaḥ hi pratyakṣa pratibhāsaḥ rthasya anyathā avasthāne vipakṣe vyāpaka abhāvāt abhavan tathā avasthānena vyāpyate iti darśitam

original: tṛtīyapādena pakṣadharmopasaṃhāraḥ tad-asiddhiparihāraś caturthena pūrvāparakālayor ekatve hi padārthasya dṛṣṭād rūpād rūpāntaravirahāt sakalakālakalā-kalitasya deśāntarayuṣo 'pi rūpasyāvaśyaṃ pratibhāsa iti na deśakālāntarāvasthā-pratipattaye pramāṇāntaraparyeṣaṇāvakāśaḥ |
analyzed: tṛtīya pādena pakṣa dharma upasaṃhāraḥ tad asiddhi parihāraḥ caturthena pūrva apara kālayoḥ ekatve hi padārthasya dṛṣṭāt rūpāt rūpa antara virahāt sakala kāla kalā kalitasya deśa antara yuṣaḥ pi rūpasya avaśyam pratibhāsaḥ iti na deśa kāla antara avasthā pratipattaye pramāṇa antara paryeṣaṇa avakāśaḥ

original: asti ca paryeṣaṇā idānīm anyadeśe kāle vā tad-vastu kathaṃ asti kiṃ-svin-nopanipātinā rāgarasena siktam iti tad upanipātasaṃbhaviny-avasre vimarśadarśanāt | na ca darśanaviṣayīkṛte tathā saṃbhavaḥ | na ca dṛṣṭe 'py anavāayaḥ śakyo 'bhidhātum, tādṛśi jijñāsite raktādau rūpe kṣaṇikatāvad-anabhyāsābhāvāt |
analyzed: asti ca paryeṣaṇā idānīm anya deśe kāle vā tat vastu katham asti kiṃsvinna upanipātinā rāga rasena siktam iti tat upanipāta saṃbhavini avasre vimarśa darśanāt na ca darśana viṣayīkṛte tathā saṃbhavaḥ na ca dṛṣṭe pi anavāayaḥ śakyaḥ abhidhātum tādṛśi jijñāsite rakta ādau rūpe kṣaṇika tā vat anabhyāsa abhāvāt

original: anyathā paścād darśane 'pi nāvasāyodayaḥ syāt | tasmāt tad-anavasāyas tu tad-apratibhāsād eva |
analyzed: anyathā paścāt darśane na avasāya udayaḥ syāt tasmāt tad anavasāyaḥ tu tad apratibhāsāt eva

original: [156,11] nanu vastunas traikālyavyāptipratibhāse 'pi svasaṃbandhiviśeṣāṇāṃ kāladeśadaśāntarāṇām apratibhāso na bādhakaḥ, kṣaṇikagrahaṇe 'pi tatsaṃbandhihetuphalasaṃyogyādivastvantarāṇām apratibhāsasya samānatvāt, ataḥ saṃbandhyantarāpekṣayā pramāṇāntaraparyeṣaṇam api yuktam eveti cet?
analyzed: nanu vastunaḥ traikālya vyāpti pratibhāse pi sva saṃbandhi viśeṣāṇām kāla deśa daśā antarāṇām apratibhāsaḥ na bādhakaḥ kṣaṇika grahaṇe pi tad saṃbandhi hetu phala saṃyogi ādi vastu antarāṇām apratibhāsasya samāna tvāt atas saṃbandhi antara apekṣayā pramāṇa antara paryeṣaṇam api yuktam eva iti ced

original: uktam atra pratiyogyupalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ pratiyogī ca dvividha eva | tatra yadā viruddaḥ (5a5) pratiyogī tadā viruddhaśabdaprayoga upalabdhiśabdam eva prayojyam upapādayati | śeṣe tu pratiyogini

original: [189] gamyamāne svabhāvaśabdo dṛśyaśabdo vā prayujyamānaḥ pratiṣedhyāpekṣayā 'nupalabdhiśabdena vyapadeśayati | tad ekatropalabdhitvaṃ gamyam anyatrānupalabdhitvaṃ | tattvaṃ tv ekam eveti na doṣaḥ |

original: na hy anumīyamāne pradeśe ghaṭo yadi bhaved upalabhyetaiveti sāmarthyaṃ pratyakṣāyogād (5a7) anumānasya cārambhaniyamābhāvād iti kathaṃ niṣedhaḥ |

original: kāryānupalabdhyā samarthasyaiva (5b2) niṣedha iti cet |
analyzed: kārya anupalabdhyā samarthasya eva niṣedhaḥ iti ced

original: gandhādis tarhi sann api nīrādāv indriyavaiguṇyān nopalambhya iti mahad eva śāstrapariśramaphalaṃ | sa hi vaiguṇyasya kāraṇānupalambhe 'pi yogyādibhir abhibhavaṃ sambhāvayan saṃśete | bhūtale tu tatkṛtābhūtadarśanam indriyapāṭave 'pi sambhāvayan kiṃ na saṃśete | tasmād abhyāsadaśāyāṃ tādavasthyasthityaiva vyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: gandha ādiḥ tarhi san api nīra ādau indriya vaiguṇyāt na upalambhyaḥ iti mahat eva śāstra pariśrama phalam sa hi vaiguṇyasya kāraṇa anupalambhe yogi ādibhiḥ abhibhavam sambhāvayan saṃśete bhū tale tu tad kṛta abhūta darśanam indriya pāṭave pi sambhāvayan kim na saṃśete tasmāt abhyāsa daśāyām tādavasthya sthityā eva vyavahāraḥ

original: nyāyanāthasya tu na vyavahāram anuvṛttya (5b3) paryanuyogo visargo vā kiṃ tv etāvatyām api gatau nāsmallakṣaṇakṣatir iti darśayituṃ prauṭhivaśāt | yathā sarvacittāsarvabodhaniścaye 'pi sa eva sarvajña iti |
analyzed: nyāyanāthasya tu na vyavahāram anuvṛttya paryanuyogaḥ visargaḥ vā kim tu etāvatyām api gatau na asmad lakṣaṇa kṣatiḥ iti darśayitum prauṭhi vaśāt yathā sarva citta asarva bodha niścaye saḥ eva sarvajñaḥ iti

original: vyavahāre ca yathaikajñānasaṃsargiṇaṃ paśyatas tathā 'nyam api pratiyoginam abhāvaniścayo dṛṣṭaḥ sādhāraṇo 'visamvadī ceti naikajñānasaṃsargigrahaḥ | vikalpaśaraṇāvasthāyāṃ ca (5b4) tadākārasamvedanam evānyaniṣedhasādhanaṃ yuktaṃ | tathaivābhyāsena
analyzed: vyavahāre ca yathā eka jñāna saṃsargiṇam paśyataḥ tathā api pratiyoginam abhāva niścayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ visamvadī ca iti na eka jñāna saṃsargi grahaḥ vikalpa śaraṇa avasthāyām ca tad ākāra samvedanam eva anya niṣedha sādhanam yuktam tathā eva abhyāsena

original: [190] pratyakṣasāmarthyadarśanāt | tad evam viruddhasya parokṣasyāpy upalabdhir anumānātmikā 'bhāvam itarasya sādhayati | yathā neha śītaṃ dhūmād ity evaṃ vyāpakaviruddhakāryopalabdhir draṣṭavyā | yathā neha tuṣāraṃ dhumāt | etac ca saṅkalayya prayogakāle vyākhyānaṃ | vastutas tu (5b5) na śītam agner ity ekaḥ prayogaḥ | tadasiddhiparihārāya tu |
analyzed: pratyakṣa sāmarthya darśanāt tat evam viruddhasya parokṣasya api upalabdhiḥ anumāna ātmikā bhāvam itarasya sādhayati yathā na iha śītam dhūmāt iti evam vyāpaka viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ draṣṭavyā yathā na iha tuṣāram dhumāt etat ca saṅkalayya prayoga kāle vyākhyānam vastutas tu na śītam agneḥ iti ekaḥ prayogaḥ tad asiddhi parihārāya tu

original: asti cāgnir atra dhūmād ity aparaḥ | tathā na tuṣāram agneḥ | vyāpakasya hi viruddho viruddha eva | agniś ca dhūmād iti | śeṣam apy evam ūhyaṃ |
analyzed: asti ca agniḥ atra dhūmāt iti aparaḥ tathā na tuṣāram agneḥ vyāpakasya hi viruddhaḥ viruddhaḥ eva agniḥ ca dhūmāt iti śeṣam api evam ūhyam

original: yadi kāraṇādeḥ svabhāvānupalabdhir anyasya kāraṇādyanupalabdhiḥ paryudāsarūpā | kathaṃ tarhi nirupākhyeṣu | yathā na vaktā bandhyāsutaś (5b6) caitanyābhāvād iti |

original: tatrāpi buddhipratibhāsasyaiva caitanyaviyuktatvena samvedanaṃ vyāpakānupalabdhiparyudāsaḥ | vaktṛtvavyavacchedena ca samvedanaṃ | vyāpyābhāvaḥ |

original: svabhāvahetuparyavasitāś ca sarvānupalabdhayo niṣedhasādhanādhyavasāyāc ca bhedena nirdeśa iti na doṣaḥ |

original: tathā 'py uktena krameṇa sākṣād eva svabhāvānupalabdhir niṣedha iti katham ācāryapādaiḥ (5b7) paramparayā 'bhidhānād aupacārikaḥ kṛta iti cet |
analyzed: tathā pi uktena krameṇa sākṣāt eva svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ niṣedhaḥ iti katham ācārya pādaiḥ paramparayā abhidhānāt aupacārikaḥ kṛtaḥ iti ced

original: niṣedhyasyaiva yadi dṛśyānupalabdhir niṣeddhrā vivakṣitā tadaupacārikaḥ | yadi tu parasyāpi tadā mukhya iti ko virodha iti

original: kevalam aupacārikakathane kiṃ prayojanam iti syāt |
analyzed: kevalam aupacārika kathane kim prayojanam iti syāt

original: tatrāpi dṛśyasyaiva niṣedho yathā śakyaḥ syān nānyasya sarvajñavītarāgādeḥ pradhānapuruṣasyeti kāryatas tatrāntarbhāvaḥ | tattvatas tu tasya (6a1) tadanyasya vā yathoktasyānupalabdhiḥ sādhiketi ||

original: || anupalabdhirahasyaṃ samāptam||

original: [191,3] iha sarvaśabdābhāvasādhane jñānakāryānupalabdhim eke pramāṇayanti | ekajñānasaṃsargivirahāt kila neha svabhāvānupalabdher avasaraḥ |

original: [191,4] tathā hi trayam avaśyam asyām abhidheyaṃ ghaṭādimatpratikṣepeṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ svabhāvaḥ phalañ ceti | tatra dṛśyaviṣayaviśeṣaṇavaśāt piśācāder (6a2) apratiṣedhaḥ | ekajñānasaṃsargivedanasvabhāvatvena rūpajñānād rasasya | nāpy abhāvapakṣadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ | vyavahāraphalatayā ca pratyakṣasiddhir upasaṃhitā |
analyzed: tathā hi trayam avaśyam asyām abhidheyam ghaṭa ādimat pratikṣepeṇa viśeṣaṇam svabhāvaḥ phalam ca iti tatra dṛśya viṣaya viśeṣaṇa vaśāt piśāca ādeḥ apratiṣedhaḥ eka jñāna saṃsargi vedana svabhāva tvena rūpa jñānāt rasasya na api abhāva pakṣa doṣa anuṣaṅgaḥ vyavahāra phalatayā ca pratyakṣa siddhiḥ upasaṃhitā

original: [191,7] sā ca pratiyogijñānāśraye saty upapadyate | tad eva pratiyogyantarābhāvanāntarīyakatayā tadabhāvavikalpajananasāmarthyāt sādhanaṃ bhavet | tato mūṭhaṃ prati tadātmikānupalabdhir abhāvavyavahārasādhanīti (6'a1) yuktam |
analyzed: sā ca pratiyogi jñāna āśraye satī upapadyate tat eva pratiyogi antara abhāva nāntarīyaka tayā tad abhāva vikalpa janana sāmarthyāt sādhanam bhavet tatas mūṭham prati tad ātmikā anupalabdhiḥ abhāva vyavahāra sādhanī iti yuktam

original: na ca sarvaśabdābhāve sādhye kaścid ekajñānasaṃsargī labhyata iti nātrāvakāśas tasyāḥ | sa tu śabdarāśir abhimatapradeśe vidyamānas tadā jñānakāryam anārabhyāsituṃ na samartha iti kāryapratiṣedhe 'pi nirviśeṣeṇaiva sattā pratiṣiddhā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca sarva śabda abhāve sādhye kaścid eka jñāna saṃsargī labhyate iti na atra avakāśaḥ tasyāḥ sa tu śabdarāśiḥ abhimata pradeśe vidyamānaḥ tadā jñāna kāryam an ārabhya āsitum na samarthaḥ iti kārya pratiṣedhe niḥ viśeṣeṇa eva sattā pratiṣiddhā bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: [191,13] atra cintyate | na tāvat dhvanir ity eva śravaṇam vadhirasyāpi prasaṅgāt | tasmād indriyapāṭavasahakṛtasyaiva śabdasya (6'a2) śravaṇajñānajanakatvam | tac ca śravaṇapāṭavam ekajñānasaṃsargivirahe duravadhāram | ata eva pradeśapratyakṣāpekṣayā ghaṭaniṣedhaḥ | tato hīndriyaguṇaṃ gaṇayan ghaṭāparādham evānupalabdher avadhārayati |
analyzed: atra cintyate na tāvat dhvaniḥ iti eva śravaṇam vadhirasya api prasaṅgāt tasmāt indriya pāṭava sahakṛtasya eva śabdasya śravaṇa jñāna janaka tvam tat ca śravaṇa pāṭavam eka jñāna saṃsargi virahe duravadhāram atas eva pradeśa pratyakṣa apekṣayā ghaṭa niṣedhaḥ tatas hi indriya guṇam gaṇayan ghaṭa aparādham eva anupalabdheḥ avadhārayati

original: [191,16] na ca manaskāravat svasaṃvedanasiddhir indriyasya jaṭatvāt | nāpīndriyāntaragamyatvam | atīndriyatvāt | kāryaṃ punar upalabdhir evāsya | tatsiddhau ca kāryānupalabdher (6'a3) evāsiddhiḥ | asiddhau siddham anaikāntikatvam | na hi viṣaye saty apīndriyadoṣāt saṃbhāvyamāno 'nupalambhas tadabhāvaniyato nāma |
analyzed: na ca manaskāra vat sva saṃvedana siddhiḥ indriyasya jaṭa tvāt na api indriya antara gamya tvam atīndriya tvāt kāryam punar upalabdhiḥ eva asya tad siddhau ca kārya anupalabdheḥ eva asiddhiḥ asiddhau siddham anaikāntika tvam na hi viṣaye sati api indriya doṣāt saṃbhāvyamānaḥ nupalambhaḥ tad abhāva niyataḥ nāma

original: [191,21] nābhāva eva śabdasya tajjñānajananayogyas tu nāstīti brūma iti cet |
analyzed: na abhāvaḥ eva śabdasya tad jñāna janana yogyaḥ tu na asti iti brūmaḥ iti ced

original: seyaṃ kuvaidyavṛttir āyātā | prathamaṃ prāgalbhyagarbham abhimatapratikaraṇam abhyupagamyopāyabuddhyopanyastasyānupāyasya pareṇa (6'a4] tattvapratipādane kṛte paścād asādhyatvaghoṣaṇāt | sarvathā 'bhāva eva hi jijñāsite kāryānupalabdhir iyaṃ sādhanam uktā | na tu jñānajananayogyatāvirahajijñāsāyām | tad yadi pramāṇabhraṃśa eva kathañcij jñātaḥ |
analyzed: sā iyam kuvaidya vṛttiḥ āyātā prathamam prāgalbhya garbham abhimata pratikaraṇam abhyupagamya upāya buddhyā upanyastasya anupāyasya pareṇa tattva pratipādane kṛte paścāt asādhya tva ghoṣaṇāt sarvathā bhāve eva hi jijñāsite kārya anupalabdhiḥ iyam sādhanam uktā na tu jñāna janana yogya tā viraha jijñāsāyām tat yadi pramāṇa bhraṃśaḥ eva kathañcid jñātaḥ

original: prameyabhraṃśas tu kimaṅgāṅgīkriyate |
analyzed: prameya bhraṃśaḥ tu kimaṅga aṅgīkriyate

original: [192,1] varaṃ ca pramāṇāntaram eva mṛgyatām asādhyataiva tu kasmād avaghuṣyate | na hi śakyam avadhirasyāśṛṇvataḥ (6'a5) sannihitabherīravādyabhāvaḥ pratikṣeptum | vadhirāvadhirayor aviśeṣaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: varam ca pramāṇa antaram eva mṛgyatām asādhya tā eva tu kasmāt avaghuṣyate na hi śakyam avadhirasya aśṛṇvataḥ sannihita bherī rava ādi abhāvaḥ pratikṣeptum vadhira avadhirayoḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt

analyzed: sati śruti kṛtaḥ sti viśeṣaḥ prāk paścāt iti ced na evam yadi hi prāc avasthātaḥ śravaṇa śaktyā nirviśeṣaḥ eṣaḥ katham aśrutiḥ sati śabde anyathā prāk api na syāt atha saṃbhāvyate śrutau api na śraddhātavyam asya viplavasya saṃbhāvyamāna tvāt tatra aśravaṇam abhūta śravaṇam vā iti na viśeṣaḥ

analyzed: nanu katham etat duravadhāraṇam dṛṣṭa śravaṇa pāṭava smaraṇa balavataḥ śrotum pravṛttasya kṣaṇika tve hi visadṛśa sahakāri pratyaya antara virahe visadṛśa daśā saṃbhava abhāvāt indriya vikāra kāriṇaḥ hi pratyayāḥ dhātu kṣobha prahāra ādayaḥ nirṇīta śaktayaḥ sva santāne santāna vyākulībhāva hetavaḥ su upalakṣāḥ eva

original: anupalakṣItās tu svaprabhavabhedaśaṅkā katham iva kṣamante | sūkṣmaṃ tu prabhāvavato 'dhiṣṭhānādivikārakāraṇaṃ (6'b1) śaṅkamānasya śravaṇe 'pi ka āśvāsaḥ |

original: tasmād anupalakṣyakāraṇārabdhadiṇmohalakṣaṇendriyabhrāntidarśane 'pi prasiddhakāraṇānupalakṣaṇān nendriyāṇām atādavasthyavyavasthā yathā anyathā tatpratyayānāṃ bhramatvaprasaṅgāt tathādyāpi kiṃ na gaṇyate mābhūt sarvasaṃvṛttivilopaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt anupalakṣya kāraṇa ārabdha diṣ moha lakṣaṇa indriya bhrānti darśane pi prasiddha kāraṇa anupalakṣaṇāt na indriyāṇām atādavasthya vyavasthā yathā anyathā tad pratyayānām bhrama tva prasaṅgāt tathā adya api kim na gaṇyate mā abhūt sarva saṃvṛtti vilopaḥ

original: [192,19] abhyāsadaśāsattisamāśrayas tu samānaḥ | na hi vadhiravarasyābhiropārūṭhaśravaṇabalasyāpy aśravaṇe (6'b2) 'bhāvaniścayaṃ brūmaḥ balaniścayasyaivābhāvāt | tadvad anyasyāpy akalitabalasya |

original: atyantābhyāse hi sakalarajanīsuptaprabuddhānām adarśane 'pi tadavasthāsaṃvedinām aviparītavyavahāravṛttidarśanāt kaḥ prastāvo jāgrataḥ svātmany anyathātvaśaṅkāyāḥ |

original: tasmād atādavasthasya tadvyavasthāyā vā niṣedhaḥ prasiddhakāraṇābhāvāt tadupalakṣaṇābhāvād vā |

original: yadi (6'b3) darśanaśravaṇādāv abhyāsadaśāpekṣayādhyakṣatvanibandhanaṃ tādavasthyam icchatā saṃvṛtivyavasthite nendriyatādavasthyaṃ sāmagrīpratibuddhabuddhitādavasthyaṃ vā sādhāraṇaśaktyapekṣayā svasaṃvedanam eva vā śaraṇam āsthīyate | tad evāśravaṇadaśāyām apīti katham anekāntaḥ śabdābhāve |
analyzed: yadi darśana śravaṇa ādau abhyāsa daśā apekṣayā adhyakṣa tva nibandhanam tādavasthyam icchatā saṃvṛti vyavasthite na indriya tādavasthyam sāmagrī pratibuddha buddhi tādavasthyam vā sādhāraṇa śakti apekṣayā sva saṃvedanam eva vā śaraṇam āsthīyate tat eva a śravaṇa daśāyām api iti katham anekāntaḥ śabda abhāve

original: nanu jñānātmany eva svasaṃvedanam (6'b4) iti cet | na |

original: pañcaskandheṣv apy aham ity eko 'dhimokṣaḥ | bhāṣaṇādāv ekasminn arthe parasparopādeye copayogaḥ | ghaṭādisaṃjñake tu rūparasādau prasiddho 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ | anyathā vyavahārāyogāt |
analyzed: pañca skandheṣu api aham iti ekaḥ dhi mokṣaḥ bhāṣaṇa ādau ekasmin arthe paraspara upādeye ca upayogaḥ ghaṭa ādi saṃjñake tu rūpa rasa ādau prasiddhaḥ yam nyāyaḥ anyathā vyavahāra ayogāt

original: [193,5] nanu na (6'b5) śarīrapratyakṣaṃ buddhim anveti | evam etat prātisvikarūpāpekṣayā rūparasādivad eva | sāmānyena tu gṛhītvaikadhīviṣayatvam ucyate yāvan na nirbandho vivecane | vivecane tu pṛthakpramāṇam uktam | tena pratyakṣaś caitro na ca buddhir adhyakṣeti dvitayam aviruddham |
analyzed: nanu na śarīra pratyakṣam buddhim anveti evam etat prātisvika rūpa apekṣayā rūpa rasa ādi vat eva sāmānyena tu gṛhītvā eka dhī viṣaya tvam ucyate yāvat na nirbandhaḥ vivecane vivecane tu pṛthak pramāṇam uktam tena pratyakṣaḥ caitraḥ na ca buddhiḥ adhyakṣā iti dvitayam aviruddham

original: ata eva tadavastho 'ham iti vikalpo 'pi (6'b6) saṃvedanānusārī sarvaviṣaya eva |
analyzed: atas eva tad avasthaḥ ham iti saṃvedanā anusārī sarva viṣayaḥ eva

original: [193,9] bhrāntir iyam iti cet | na | bādhakābhāvād bhrāntyasiddheḥ | tasmāt pūrvapratītaśrotraśaktes tadavasthāniścayasaṃbhavād aśrutiḥ śabdasyaivāparādhād iti jñānābhāvenāpi tadabhāvasiddhir aikāntikīti na prakṛtavyāghātaḥ | iyaty eva tarhi svabhāvānupalabdher (6'b7) lakṣaṇasāmagrīti kāryānupalabdhisaṃjñākaraṇe ko 'rthaḥ |
analyzed: bhrāntiḥ iyam iti ced na bādhaka abhāvāt bhrānti asiddheḥ tasmāt pūrva pratīta śrotra śakteḥ tad avasthā niścaya saṃbhavāt aśrutiḥ śabdasya eva aparādhāt iti jñāna abhāvena api tad abhāva siddhiḥ aikāntikī iti na prakṛta vyāghātaḥ iyatī eva tarhi svabhāva anupalabdheḥ lakṣaṇa sāmagrī iti kārya anupalabdhi saṃjñā karaṇe kaḥ rthaḥ

original: pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cāpannasyaiva śabdasyānupalabdhyā niṣedhāt | tathāpy anyasaṃjñāyāṃ ghaṭaniṣedhe 'pi ko niṣeddhā kevalaṃ ghaṭavat śabdasyāpi dṛśyānupalabdhyāpi niṣedhaḥ sādhyo jāta ity ucyate | tatraikajñānasaṃsargisaṃbhavād yuktaḥ tayā niṣedha iti cet |
analyzed: pratyaya antara sākalyam svabhāva viśeṣam ca āpannasya eva śabdasya anupalabdhyāḥ niṣedhāt tathā api anya saṃjñāyām ghaṭa niṣedhe pi kaḥ niṣeddhā kevalam ghaṭa vat śabdasya api dṛśya anupalabdhyā api niṣedhaḥ sādhyaḥ jātaḥ iti ucyate tatra eka jñāna saṃsargi saṃbhavāt yuktaḥ tayā niṣedhaḥ iti ced

original: tatraiva (6a3) tāvad ekajñānasaṃsargiṇaḥ kim apekṣayā | rūpadarśane hi rasasya viprakṛṣṭadeśatayā 'nupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvād evāpratiṣedhaḥ prāpyakāritvād ghrāṇarasanasparśanānām | uktena ca krameṇendriyatādavasthyaṃ siddham iti kim ekajñānasaṃsargyapekṣayā | naivam indriyātiriktasyālokasya tatrāpekṣyatvāt |
analyzed: tatra eva tāvat eka jñāna saṃsargiṇaḥ kim apekṣayā rūpa darśane hi rasasya viprakṛṣṭa deśa tayā nupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvāt eva apratiṣedhaḥ prāpya kāri tvāt ghrāṇa rasana sparśanānām uktena ca krameṇa indriya tādavasthyam siddham iti kim eka jñāna saṃsargi apekṣayā na evam indriya atiriktasya ālokasya tatra apekṣya tvāt

original: sa hi bahiṛsulabhakāraṇādhīnopajanāpajanadharmako na svātmatādavasthyasādhya (6a4) iti tadartham ekajñānasaṃsargo 'pekṣyamāṇa indriyasādguṇyajñāne 'pi sahāyībhaviṣyati |
analyzed: sa hi bahiṛ sulabha kāraṇa adhīna upajana apajana dharmakaḥ na svātma tādavasthya sādhyaḥ iti tad artham eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ upekṣyamāṇaḥ indriya sādguṇya jñāne sahāyībhaviṣyati

original: evaṃ yatrālokanirapekṣaiva grahaṇaśaktis tatra na kiñcid ekajñānasaṃsargyapekṣayeti siddham | tac ca nāma kvacit sādhane 'pekṣyate yadantareṇa virodhāsiddhisandeheṣv anyatamadoṣāsattiḥ | na ca dvividhopalabdhiyogyatāpannasya kvacid (6a5) anupalabdhyā niṣedhe sā 'sti yena saṃsargī niyatam apekṣyeta | yatrāpy ayam apekṣyate |
analyzed: evam yatra āloka nirapekṣā eva grahaṇa śaktiḥ tatra na kiñcid eka jñāna saṃsargi apekṣayā iti siddham tat ca nāma kvacid sādhane pekṣyate yat antareṇa virodha asiddhi sandeheṣu anyatama doṣa āsattiḥ na ca dvividha upalabdhi yogyatā āpannasya kvacid anupalabdhyā niṣedhe sā sti yena saṃsargī niyatam apekṣyeta yatra api ayam apekṣyate

original: tatrāpi ālokāpekṣapratipattino vastunaḥ pratiṣedhe viśeṣaṇāsiddhiparihārārtham eva | na caitāvatā sarvatra tadapekṣā | na hi vināśaṃ praty anapekṣā vyāptisādhanī sarvatra kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhane 'pi svabhāvahetāv apekṣyate |
analyzed: tatra api āloka apekṣa pratipattinaḥ vastunaḥ pratiṣedhe viśeṣaṇa asiddhi parihāra artham eva na ca etāvatā sarvatra tad apekṣā na hi vināśam prati anapekṣā vyāpti sādhanī sarvatra kṣaṇa bhaṅga sādhane svabhāva hetau apekṣyate

original: [194,3] yadi cāyam apekṣya eva kimaṅga dṛśyaviśeṣaṇena (6a6) kenacid ekajñānasaṃsargino dṛśyatvāvyabhicārāt | na hi piśācasya kenacid ekajñānasaṃsargaḥ
analyzed: yadi ca ayam apekṣyaḥ eva kim aṅga dṛśya viśeṣaṇena kenacid eka jñāna saṃsarginaḥ dṛśya tva avyabhicārāt na hi piśācasya kenacid eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ

original: eka evārtha ubhayathāpīti naikaprayoge 'nyaprayojanacarceti cet |
analyzed: ekaḥ eva arthaḥ ubhayathā api iti na eka prayoge nyaprayojana carcā iti ced

original: na sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhedasyāvyaktatvāt | saṃsargo hi na viśeṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati | viśeṣaṇamātraṃ tu taṃ vyabhicaraty eva | ata eva viśeṣaṇasiddhaye saṃsarga upanīyate na tu viśeṣaṇaṃ saṃsargākṛṣṭaye (6a7) prabhavati śabde 'pi prasaṅgāt | tathā ca pakṣakṣaya iti kaḥ śramasyārthaḥ |
analyzed: na sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvena bhedasya avyakta tvāt saṃsargaḥ hi na viśeṣaṇam vyabhicarati viśeṣaṇa mātram tu tam vyabhicarati eva atas eva viśeṣaṇa siddhaye saṃsargaḥ upanīyate na tu viśeṣaṇam saṃsarga ākṛṣṭaye prabhavati śabde pi prasaṅgāt tathā ca pakṣa kṣayaḥ iti kaḥ śramasya arthaḥ

original: tasmād ekajñānasaṃsargo nāma prakṛtodāharaṇāpekṣayaivodghuṣyate | na svabhāvānupalabdhau sarvatrāpekṣyatvena ||
analyzed: tasmāt eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ nāma prakṛta udāharaṇa apekṣayā evā udghuṣyate na svabhāva anupalabdhau sarvatra apekṣya tvena

original: [194,10] prastute hi kalasapratiṣedhe sā dig astu saviśeṣaṇasiddhyai | nopalabdham upalabhyam itīyallakṣaṇaṃ khalu nijānupalabdheḥ | tathā ca lakṣaṇe prayoge copalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhimātropanyāsaḥ | śāstre viparyayabādhopadarśane ca pratyayāntarasannidhau svabhāvaviśeṣavataḥ sattve 'nupalabdher asaṃbhavaḥ khyāpyate |
analyzed: prastute hi kalasa pratiṣedhe sā diś astu sa viśeṣaṇa siddhyai na upalabdham upalabhyam iti iyat lakṣaṇam khalu nija anupalabdheḥ tathā ca lakṣaṇe prayoge ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalabdhi mātra upanyāsaḥ śāstre viparyaya bādha upadarśane ca pratyaya antara sannidhau svabhāva viśeṣavataḥ sattve asaṃbhavaḥ khyāpyate

original: anyathā prayojakam aṃśaṃ saṃsargam eva sarvatra darśayet viśeṣaṇavat | tādātmyaṃ tu dṛśyatvam abhyupagamyaiva niṣidhyata iti viśeṣaṇasyānuktimātram na punar aprayojakatvaṃ vyāpter iva viduṣi | anvayoktiviśeṣe vā vyatirekasya | tasmāt nyāyanāthasyāpi nāvaśyam ekajñānasaṃsargivyapekṣābhiprāyaḥ svabhāvānupalabdhau |
analyzed: anyathā prayojakam aṃśam saṃsargam eva sarvatra darśayet viśeṣaṇa vat tādātmyam tu dṛśya tvam abhyupagamya eva niṣidhyate iti viśeṣaṇasya anukti mātram na punar aprayojaka tvam vyāpteḥ iva viduṣi anvaya ukti viśeṣe vā vyatirekasya tasmāt nyāyanāthasya api nā avaśyam eka jñāna saṃsargi vyapekṣā abhiprāyaḥ svabhāva anupalabdhau

original: [194,17] api caivaṃ kāryānupalabdhāv eva sarvasaṅgraham ācakṣīta svabhāvānupalabdher api tadekadeśatvāt | sarvapramāṇasaṅgrahavyavasthāṃ ca kāryānumāne kuryāt svasaṃvedanād anyatra |
analyzed: api ca evam kārya anupalabdhau eva sarva saṅgraham ācakṣīta svabhāva anupalabdheḥ api tad eka deśa tvāt sarva pramāṇa saṅgraha vyavasthām ca kārya anumāne kuryāt sva saṃvedanāt anyatra

original: [194,19] tasmād indriyajñānaviṣaye na kāryānumānavyavasthā yathā tathā tadagṛhīta ity eva kutaḥ kāryānupalabdhivyavasthāpi śāstrakārasya | yathā hi pratyakṣavyavasthāvilopabhayam ekatra tathānyatra svabhāvānupalambhasya | yathā vā 'pratyakṣe kāryaṃ liṅgam tathā 'pratyakṣayogya eva tadanupalabdhir iti samānam |
analyzed: tasmāt indriya jñāna viṣaye na kārya anumāna vyavasthā yathā tathā tad agṛhītaḥ iti eva kutas kārya anupalabdhi vyavasthā api śāstra kārasya yathā hi pratyakṣa vyavasthā vilopa bhayam ekatra tathā anyatra svabhāva anupalambhasya yathā vā pratyakṣe kāryam liṅgam tathā pratyakṣa yogye eva tad anupalabdhiḥ iti samānam

original: yathā vāyam eva bhagavān jñāne jñānāntarābhāvam api dṛśyānupalabdhyā vyavahārayati | yad āha;
analyzed: yathā vā ayam eva bhagavān jñāne jñāna antara abhāvam api dṛśya anupalabdhyā vyavahārayati yat āha

original: dṛśyātmano vā vikalpasya darśane 'dṛṣṭir
analyzed: dṛśya ātmanaḥ vā vikalpasya darśane dṛṣṭiḥ

original: vikalpakalpanām indriyajñāne pratihantīti
analyzed: vikalpa kalpanām indriya jñāne pratihanti iti

original: tadā ka ekajñānasaṃsargī | kiṃ caivamabhyupagame kāryānupalabdher apy asiddhir iti prakṛtamatahānir eva | na hi jñānakāryasyābhāvaḥ kāryānupalabdher eva boddhavyo 'navasthāprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: tadā kaḥ eka jñāna saṃsargī kim ca evam abhyupagame kārya anupalabdheḥ api asiddhiḥ iti prakṛta mata hāniḥ eva na hi jñāna kāryasya abhāvaḥ kārya anupalabdheḥ eva boddhavyaḥ navasthā prasaṅgāt

original: svasaṃvedanaṃ caikākāraniyatam anyābhāvaniścayam ākṣipty eva kevalaṃ vimataṃ prati yadi syāj jñānāntaram anubhūyeteti dṛśyānupalabdhir eva śaraṇaṃ vyavahāre bāhyavat | viśeṣaṇānuccāraṇaṃ tu syāt | na tv anyā gatiḥ | saṃsargāpekṣāyāṃ ca sāpi nāstīti sandigdhāsiddho hetuḥ |

original: śabdagandharasasparśatamisrālokās tu manaskārātiriktam indriyaṃ ghaṭādisanniveśinas tu rūpaviśeṣāḥ prakāśam api prāyaśaḥ | tathaiṣāṃ vidhāv upalabdhir iva svabhāvasyānupalabdhir api niṣedhe kiṃ na bhinnām eva sāmagrīm apekṣeta |

original: [195,10] tatrādye yathā nendriyatādavasthyenopayogaḥ tathā madhyamīyeṣv api naikajñānasaṃsargiṇā | anyātiriktāpekṣiṇas tadapekṣā yujyate 'pi | tato yathā yadi buddhiḥ syād upalabhyetaiva kim indriyatādavasthyāpekṣayeti sāmarthyam tathā yadi syād rasādis tadavasthendriyeṇa mayopalabhyetaiva kim ekajñānasaṃsargiṇeti śakyam eva |
analyzed: tatra ādye yathā na indriya tādavasthyena upayogaḥ tathā madhyamīyeṣu api na eka jñāna saṃsargiṇā anya atirikta apekṣiṇaḥ tad apekṣā yujyate tatas yathā yadi buddhiḥ syāt upalabhyeta eva kim indriya tādavasthya apekṣayā iti sāmarthyam tathā yadi syāt rasa ādiḥ tad avasthā indriyeṇa mayā upalabhyeta eva kim eka jñāna saṃsargiṇā iti śakyam eva

original: tasmād bahir api niyamasaṃbhāvanā 'tidūraivābhyupagame vā jñāne 'py apekṣeta |

original: [195,15] tatrāpi saṃvedanaikapratyakṣāpekṣaikajñānasaṃsargo 'stīti cet | 	nanu na saṃvedanaṃ nāmaikaṃ pratyakṣam asti dharmamātrasya tasya pratisvaṃ bhedāt | sāmānyam āśrityaikajñānasaṃjñayā tu parituṣṭau bhinnendriyagrāhyayor api svasaṃvedanendriyajñānaviṣayayor api vā prasaṅgaḥ | yayoḥ sator anyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāras tatreyaṃ vyavastheti cet |
analyzed: tatra api saṃvedana eka pratyakṣa apekṣā eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ sti iti ced nanu na saṃvedanam nāma ekam pratyakṣam asti dharma mātrasya tasya pratisvam bhedāt sāmānyam āśritya eka jñāna saṃjñayā tu parituṣṭau bhinna indriya grāhyayoḥ api sva saṃvedana indriya jñāna viṣayayoḥ api vā prasaṅgaḥ yayoḥ satoḥ anyonya pratyakṣa avyabhicāraḥ tatra iyam vyavasthā iti ced

original: rūpayor api nāyaṃ niyamaḥ | pradeśapiśācayor adarśanāt | viśiṣṭayor asty eva | na ca sāmānyāparādho viśeṣam āskandatīti cet | evam api śabdākāśayoḥ śabdamanaskārayor vā prasaṅgaḥ | na hy ākāśapratyakṣaṃ manaskārasaṃvedanapratyakṣaṃ vā sattve śabdasya pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicarati | vyabhicāre punaḥ kāryānupalabdher anekāntaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: rūpayoḥ api nā ayam niyamaḥ pradeśa piśācayoḥ adarśanāt viśiṣṭayoḥ asti eva na ca sāmānya aparādhaḥ viśeṣam āskandati iti ced evam api śabda ākāśayoḥ śabda manaskārayoḥ vā prasaṅgaḥ na hi ākāśa pratyakṣam manaskāra saṃvedana pratyakṣam vā sattve śabdasya pratyakṣam vyabhicarati vyabhicāre punar kārya anupalabdheḥ anekānta prasaṅgaḥ

original: tasmād avyāpakam ekajñānāpekṣaṇam anyasyāpi ca sulabham ity alaṃ vimatyā |
analyzed: tasmāt avyāpakam eka jñāna apekṣaṇam anyasya api ca sulabham iti alam vimatyā

original: [195,24] api cāyaṃ cittayor ekajñānasaṃsargo 'pūrva eva mukhyasyābhāvād gauṇasya caikāyatanasaṅgrahābhāvāt | upalakṣaṇam ekāyatanasaṅgraha iti cet | ekajñānasaṃsarga eva kiṃ nopalakṣaṇam ākhyāyate | prakṛtaghaṭodāharaṇāpekṣayā tu dvayam apy etad uktam ity anabhiniveśaḥ |
analyzed: api ca ayam cittayoḥ eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ pūrvaḥ eva mukhyasya abhāvāt gauṇasya ca eka āyatana saṅgraha abhāvāt upalakṣaṇam eka āyatana saṅgrahaḥ iti ced eka jñāna saṃsargaḥ eva kim na upalakṣaṇam ākhyāyate prakṛta ghaṭa udāharaṇa apekṣayā tu dvayam api etat uktam iti anabhiniveśaḥ

original: [196] yathā hy ekāyatanasaṅgraheṇānyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāra upalakṣyate tathaikajñānasaṃsargeṇāpi pratiyogimātrāpekṣaiveti yujyate |
analyzed: yathā hi eka āyatana saṅgraheṇa anyonya pratyakṣa avyabhicāraḥ upalakṣyate tathā eka jñāna saṃsargeṇa api pratiyogi mātra apekṣā eva iti yujyate

original: kaś ca kasya pratiyogī | yayor ekākāraniyataṃ pratyakṣam itarābhāvaniścayam upapādayituṃ śaknotīti | kayoś caivam anupalabdhiḥ | yayor ekapratyakṣam aparapratyakṣāvyabhicāri | tayor hi sator naikarūpaniyatā pratipattir asaṃbhavāt | tatas tāvat yo viśiṣṭakāladeśadaśāsantānāpekṣayānyo 'nyasya pratiyoginau vyavasthāpyete |
analyzed: kaḥ ca kasya pratiyogī yayoḥ eka ākāra niyatam pratyakṣam itara abhāva niścayam upapādayitum śaknoti iti kayoḥ ca evam anupalabdhiḥ yayoḥ eka pratyakṣam apara pratyakṣa avyabhicāri tayoḥ hi satoḥ nā eka rūpa niyatā pratipattiḥ asaṃbhavāt tatas tāvat yaḥ viśiṣṭa kāla deśa daśā santāna apekṣayā anyaḥ nyasya pratiyoginau vyavasthāpyete

original: sa dṛśyaḥ saṃvittilābhalakṣaṇe 'yogas tayor iti kṛtvā | ata eva tayor ekākāraniyataṃ vedanam anyasya pratiṣedhavikalpam upapādayituṃ śaknotīti tādṛśām abhāvaḥ pratyakṣasiddho 'bhidhīyate |
analyzed: sa dṛśyaḥ saṃvitti lābha lakṣaṇe yogaḥ tayoḥ iti kṛtvā atas eva tayoḥ eka ākāra niyatam vedanam anyasya pratiṣedha vikalpam upapādayitum śaknoti iti tādṛśām abhāvaḥ pratyakṣa siddhaḥ abhidhīyate

original: tam eva niścayaṃ mūṭhaṃ prati pratiyogyupalambhasvabhāvānupalabdhir upalabdhiyogyatā yugayoginaḥ saṃbhavantī vyāhāravyāhārāv api sādhayatīti tāvataivetaramatapratikṣepeṇa svabhāvaphalayor api pariniṣṭhāsiddhau kim ekendriyagrāhyatāpekṣopagraheṇa |
analyzed: tam eva niścayam mūṭham prati pratiyogi upalambha svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ upalabdhi yogyatā yuga yoginaḥ saṃbhavantī vyāhāra vyāhārau api sādhayati iti tāvatā evā itara mata pratikṣepeṇa svabhāva phalayoḥ api pariniṣṭhā siddhau kim eka indriya grāhya tā apekṣā upagraheṇa

original: [196,12] ayaṃ hi pratiyoga ekenānekena vendriyeṇa grāhyayor arthayor jñānayor jñānārthayor vā sādhāraṇo 'bhāvasādhane ca nirapavāda iti kas tadanurodhaḥ |
analyzed: ayam hi pratiyogaḥ ekena anekena vā indriyeṇa grāhyayoḥ arthayoḥ jñānayoḥ jñāna arthayoḥ vā sādhāraṇaḥ bhāva sādhane ca nirapavādaḥ iti kaḥ tad anurodhaḥ

original: yathā hi bhūtalakalasayoḥ jñānayor vaikarūpavedanam anyapratyakṣāvyabhicāritayā tadabhāvaniścayotpādane paryāptam tathā pānakapānakarmaṇi dvayam upalabdhavatas tādavasthyasaṃvedinaḥ pradīpakavalane sparśamātropalabdhī rasābhāvaniścayajanane |
analyzed: yathā hi bhū tala kalasayoḥ jñānayoḥ vā eka rūpa vedanam anya pratyakṣa avyabhicāri tayā tad abhāva niścaya utpādane paryāptam tathā pānaka pāna karmaṇi dvayam upalabdhavataḥ tādavasthya saṃvedinaḥ pradīpa kavalane sparśa mātra upalabdhī rasa abhāva niścaya janane

original: svavikalpākāramātrasaṃvedanaṃ vā sannihitasparśābhāvāvasāyasādhane śaknoty eva | na hi tadvikalpavedanaṃ tadā sataḥ sparśasya pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicarati | na cānyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicārād anyad anyatrāpi dvitīyābhāvaniścayotpādanasāmarthyaṃ nāma | nāpy abhāvaniścayotpādanasāmarthyād arthāntaram abhāvapratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ nāma |
analyzed: sva vikalpa ākāra mātra saṃvedanam vā sannihita sparśa abhāva avasāya sādhane śaknoti eva na hi tad vikalpa vedanam tadā sataḥ sparśasya pratyakṣam vyabhicarati na ca anyonya pratyakṣa avyabhicārāt anyat anyatra api dvitīya abhāva niścaya utpādana sāmarthyam nāma nā api abhāva niścaya utpādana sāmarthyāt artha antaram abhāva pratyakṣīkaraṇam nāma

original: na hy asau vigrahavān yataḥ sākṣātkartavyaḥ |
analyzed: na hi asau vigrahavān yatas sākṣātkartavyaḥ

original: yadā ca paryudāsena pratiyogy evābhāvas tadā tv asya mukhyaiva pratyakṣasiddhir iti yuktaṃ sarvatra vyavahāraphalatvam | na cāyaṃ pratiyogaḥ svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇāṃ kenacid asti yena kasyacit pratyakṣaṃ tadabhāvavibhāvanāya prabhavet | na caivaṃ nivṛttimātram anupalabdhir ukta bhavati |
analyzed: yadā ca paryudāsena pratiyogī eva abhāvaḥ tadā tu asya mukhyā eva pratyakṣa siddhiḥ iti yuktam sarvatra vyavahāra phala tvam na ca ayam pratiyogaḥ svabhāva ādi viprakarṣiṇām kenacid asti yena kasyacid pratyakṣam tad abhāva vibhāvanāya prabhavet na ca evam nivṛtti mātram anupalabdhiḥ bhavati

original: bhaṭṭas tu paryudāsapakṣe 'pi yathoktaṃ pratiyoginam anapekṣyānyamātrasyopalabdhim anupalabdhiṃ pramāṇayatīti tanmate yuktaḥ piśācādipratikṣepaḥ | rūpadarśinas tu rasas taddeśaviprakṛṣṭa eva | na tena pratiyogaṃ yathoktam āvahati | rasanāgrasaṅgī tu nābhāvam anupalabdhau vyabhicarati
analyzed: bhaṭṭaḥ tu paryudāsa pakṣe yathā uktam pratiyoginam an apekṣya anya mātrasya upalabdhim anupalabdhim pramāṇayati iti tad mate yuktaḥ piśāca ādi pratikṣepaḥ rūpa darśinaḥ tu rasaḥ tad deśa viprakṛṣṭaḥ eva na tena pratiyogam yathoktam āvahati rasanā agrasaṅgī tu na abhāvam anupalabdhau vyabhicarati

original: [197] iti na dośaḥ kaścit | ata eva kāryānupalabdhyādīnām sākṣād akṣamaḥ svabhāvānupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ paramparyeṇocyate | tādṛśasya pratiyogasyābhāvat |
analyzed: iti na dośaḥ kaścid atas eva kārya anupalabdhi ādīnām sākṣāt akṣamaḥ svabhāva anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ paramparyeṇa ucyate tādṛśasya pratiyogasya abhāvat

original: tasmād upalambhayogyatāprāptasyānupalambha ity eva dṛśyānupalabdher lakṣaṇam | sā ca yathoktapratiyogyupalambharūpatayā siddhasyābhāvasya vyavahārikasyaivāvatiṣṭhata iti na nyāyaśāstrayor uparodhaḥ | ekendriyagrāhyopanyāsas tu ghaṭādyudāharaṇāpekṣa eva mantavya iti sthitam |
analyzed: tasmāt upalambha yogya tā prāptasya anupalambhaḥ iti eva dṛśya anupalabdheḥ lakṣaṇam sā ca yathā ukta pratiyogi upalambha rūpa tayā siddhasya abhāvasya vyavahārikasya eva avatiṣṭhate iti na nyāya śāstrayoḥ uparodhaḥ eka indriya grāhya upanyāsaḥ tu ghaṭa ādi udāharaṇa apekṣaḥ eva mantavyaḥ iti sthitam

original: tatra yadā tāvat timirālokasaṃjñite ākāśapradeśe dṛśyamāne devakulādau vā bheryāder evābhāvaṃ pratipadyate tadā tad eva tadekākāroparaktajñānaviṣayībhavatjñānaṃ vā tādṛśaṃ niyataprāptikapratyakṣodayasya niṣedhyasya tajjñānasya vā paryudāso 'nupalabdhiḥ | avyāpṛtacakṣus tu rasādis tajjñānaṃ vāntato manaskārākāro jñeyaparyudāsaḥ |
analyzed: tatra yadā tāvat timira āloka saṃjñite ākāśa pradeśe dṛśyamāne devakula ādau vā bherī ādeḥ eva abhāvam pratipadyate tadā tat eva tad eka ākāra uparakta jñāna viṣayībhavat jñānam vā tādṛśam niyata prāptika pratyakṣa udayasya niṣedhyasya tad jñānasya vā paryudāsaḥ nupalabdhiḥ avyāpṛta cakṣuḥ tu rasa ādiḥ tat jñānam vā antatas manaskāra ākāraḥ jñeya paryudāsaḥ

analyzed: niyata viṣaya tvam tathā api na khalu sakṛt eva vyabhicāravatām bādha bodhaḥ kim tu krameṇa tadā ca vyabhicāriṇām api vyabhicāra darśanam āhatya nā asti iti dhūmasya tatas viśeṣaṇa abhāvāt punar ahetu tvam hetu tvam vā anyasya api

original: na ca sarvasyānyasya vyabhicāradarśanair dhūme vyaptiviśvāsa iti vācyam | evaṃ hi purastād dhūme vyāptigrahaṇānantaram eva parvatanitambe dhūmād dahanānumānaṃ na śārdūlād iti na syāt, vyabhicāradarśanavilambāpekṣaṇāt | aśakyaṃ caitad anyatra vyabhicāradarśanair abhimate
analyzed: na ca sarvasya anyasya vyabhicāra darśanaiḥ dhūme vyapti viśvāsaḥ iti vācyam evam hi purastāt dhūme vyāpti grahaṇa anantaram eva parvata nitambe dhūmāt dahana anumānam na śārdūlāt iti na syāt vyabhicāra darśana vilamba apekṣaṇāt aśakyam ca etat anyatra vyabhicāra darśanaiḥ abhimate

original: [248] vyāptiviśrāma iti | vyabhicāraviṣayāṇām apy anantatvād deśādiviprakarṣavatāṃ gocarīkaraṇakālāpekṣayā puruṣāyuṣasya kanīyastvāt | tasmād vyabhicāradarśanavan niyataviṣaya eva vyāptigraho nirapavādaḥ, śuddhekādhyavasāyasya vibhāgena pravṛtteḥ | ata eva ca svābhāvikavikalpasyaiva kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇe 'dhikāro naupādhikasya |
analyzed: vyāpti viśrāmaḥ iti vyabhicāra viṣayāṇām api ananta tvāt deśa ādi viprakarṣavatām gocarīkaraṇa kāla apekṣayā puruṣa āyuṣasya kanīyaḥ tvāt tasmāt vyabhicāra darśana vat niyata viṣayaḥ eva vyāpti grahaḥ nirapavādaḥ śuddha eka adhyavasāyasya vibhāgena pravṛtteḥ atas eva ca svābhāvika vikalpasya eva kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaṇe dhikāraḥ na aupādhikasya

original: asti hi śuddhaviṣayajanitālocanājñānamātrāpekṣo bālatiryaksādhāraṇo vikalpaḥ | sa śuddhaḥ svābhāvika iti cocyate, yadvaśāt paśavo 'pi kṣutpipāsāpraśamādisādhanāni tatraiva samarthānyavadhārayantaḥ punas tadanvitayā tathaiva tatas tatra pravartante, nivartante vānanvitayā |
analyzed: asti hi śuddha viṣaya janita ālocanā jñāna mātra apekṣaḥ bāla tiryak sādhāraṇaḥ vikalpaḥ sa śuddhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ iti ca ucyate yad vaśāt kṣudh pipāsā praśama ādi sādhanāni tatra eva samarthāni avadhārayantaḥ punar tad anvitayā tathā eva tatas tatra pravartante nivartante vā ananvitayā

original: asti ca saṅketasmaraṇasacivālocanājñānajanito vikalpaḥ, yathā dīpāt kajjalamālokayato nīlam idaṃ rañjanādyupayogīty eva vikalpaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭārthakriyāsmaraṇasahāyānubhavabhāvitas tādṛgaupādhika ucyate | na ca tadā nīlavikalpa ity eva pradīpād akhilaṃ nīlam utpadyata iti prekṣaḥ kaścin niścinoti |
analyzed: asti ca saṅketa smaraṇa saciva ālocanā jñāna janitaḥ vikalpaḥ yathā dīpāt kajjalam ālokayataḥ nīlam idam rañjana ādi upayogi iti eva vikalpaḥ pūrva dṛṣṭa artha kriyā smaraṇa sahāya anubhava bhāvitaḥ tādṛś aupādhikaḥ ucyate na ca tadā nīla vikalpaḥ iti eva pradīpāt akhilam nīlam utpadyate iti prekṣaḥ kaścid niścinoti

original: kiṃ tu yad eva kajjalāvalokanamātrānurūpavikalpapuraskṛtaṃ vastu kajjalaśabdasaṅketayogyaṃ jātiyogāt svarūpaviśeṣād vā tad eva pradīpakāryaṃ vyabhicārālambane coktam |
analyzed: kim tu yat eva kajjala avalokana mātra anurūpa vikalpa puraskṛtam vastu kajjala śabda saṅketa yogyam jāti yogāt svarūpa viśeṣāt vā tat eva pradīpa kāryam vyabhicāra ālambane ca uktam

original: evaṃ dhūme 'pi dhavalam idaṃ vastu vahner jāyata iti saṅketānusārī vikalpa aupādhika evākṣipati kāryatvena tuhinādikam | śuddhe tu vikalpe dhūmajātir eva parisphuratīti tata eva tuhināder vyāptau nirāso na vyabhicārālambanaṃ sādhviti boddhavyam | tadvat kāryavikalpo 'pi sarvatra aupādhika eva | apekṣitaparavyāpāro hi svotpattāvandhaḥ |
analyzed: evam dhūme dhavalam idam vastu vahneḥ jāyate iti saṅketa anusārī vikalpaḥ aupādhikaḥ evā ākṣipati kārya tvena tuhina ādikam śuddhe tu vikalpe dhūma jātiḥ eva parisphurati iti tatas eva tuhina ādeḥ vyāptau nirāsaḥ na vyabhicāra ālambanam sādhu iti boddhavyam tadvat kārya vikalpaḥ sarvatra aupādhikaḥ eva apekṣita para vyāpāraḥ hi sva utpattau andhaḥ

original: kāryam iti saṅketasmaraṇasahāyād indriyajñānād utpattir iti na hetuphalabhāvavyavahārasyāṅgam | tato yady api puruṣāt ghaṭodayadarśane ghaṭo 'yam asmād iti vikalpavat kāryam idam asmād ity api sulabho vikalpaḥ, tathāpi svābhāvikatvābhāvān na tatpuraskṛtasvarūpasya tatkāryatvavyavasthā | naisargikavikalpaviṣayīkṛtasya tu bhavatu |
analyzed: kāryam iti saṅketa smaraṇa sahāyāt indriya jñānāt utpattiḥ iti na hetu phala bhāva vyavahārasya aṅgam tatas yadi api puruṣāt ghaṭa udaya darśane ghaṭaḥ yam asmāt iti vikalpa vat kāryam idam asmāt iti api sulabhaḥ vikalpaḥ tathā api svābhāvika tva abhāvāt na tad puraskṛta svarūpasya tad kāryatva vyavasthā naisargika vikalpa viṣayīkṛtasya tu bhavatu

original: nanu śuddhāvasāyagocare 'pi vikalpaḥ saṅketasmṛtijanito dṛśyate 'yaṃ ghaṭaḥ pauruṣeya iti nāmollekhāt | tataḥ so 'py aupādhikaḥ prāptaḥ | na, tanmātravikalpane smaraṇasya aprayojakatvāt, vācakāṃśollekha eva tasya sāmarthyāt |
analyzed: nanu śuddhāvasāya gocare pi vikalpaḥ saṅketa smṛti janitaḥ dṛśyate yam ghaṭaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ iti nāma ullekhāt tatas saḥ pi aupādhikaḥ prāptaḥ na tanmātra vikalpane smaraṇasya aprayojaka tvāt vācaka aṃśa ullekhaḥ eva tasya sāmarthyāt

original: yady api ca vācyavācakākārotkalitākhaṇṭavikalpodayaḥ smaraṇasāhāyakena, tathāpy apoṭdhāradvāreṇa tanmātre tadvyāpāra ucyate, mṛnmayatvamātre kulālasyeva | jātyantarasamavāyikāryatvadhavalatādidharmakalpanaṃ tu saṅketasambandhagrahaṇādiprācīnavyāpārasmaraṇam antareṇa śuddhādhyavasāyasya
analyzed: yadi api ca vācya vācaka ākāra utkalita akhaṇṭa vikalpa udayaḥ smaraṇa sāhāyakena tathā api apoṭdhāra dvāreṇa tad mātre tad vyāpāraḥ ucyate mṛd maya tva mātre kulālasya iva jāti antara samavāyi kārya tva dhavala tā ādi dharma kalpanam tu saṅketa sambandha grahaṇa ādi prācīna vyāpāra smaraṇam antareṇa śuddha adhyavasāyasya

original: [249] tanmātrajāty ullekhenaiva kṛtārthatvād bālakādivat, atas tanmātraviṣayaiva pratyakṣakṛtā vyāptir ity anavadyam | tasmād vyāptigrahaḥ pratyakṣakṛto vyabhicārapratyayo vā bhinnaviṣaya eveti siddham |
analyzed: tanmātra jāti ullekhena eva kṛtārtha tvāt bālaka ādi vat atas tanmātra viṣayā eva pratyakṣa kṛtā vyāptiḥ iti anavadyam tasmāt vyāpti grahaḥ pratyakṣa kṛtaḥ vyabhicāra pratyayaḥ vā bhinna viṣayaḥ eva iti siddham

original: evaṃ tarhi vyabhicāradarśanena sādhāraṇānekāntavyavasthā duṛstheti cet? evam etad yadi buddhipāṭavaniyamaḥ sarveṣām | mandabuddhis tu sādṛśyādinā jātiviśeṣapravṛtte 'pi pratyakṣe jātyantareṇaikīkṛtya vyāptigrahaṇābhimānād anumānam ātiṣṭhamānaḥ paṭunā pareṇa vyabhicāram ādrśya vyāptidurgraham āpādyate | ataḥ sādhāraṇānekāntavyavasthā |
analyzed: evam tarhi vyabhicāra darśanena sādhāraṇa anekānta vyavasthā duṛsthā iti ced evam etat yadi buddhi pāṭava niyamaḥ sarveṣām manda buddhiḥ tu sādṛśya ādinā jāti viśeṣa pravṛtte pi pratyakṣe jāti antareṇa ekīkṛtya vyāpti grahaṇa abhimānāt anumānam ātiṣṭhamānaḥ paṭunā pareṇa vyabhicāram ādrśya vyāpti durgraham āpādyate atas sādhāraṇa anekānta vyavasthā

original: yathā dhūme pravṛtte 'pi pratyakṣe vyāptigrāhiṇy ucchaladbahalarūpam analavyāptim anusmaran mārutoddhūtadhūlipaṭalād analam anumāpayan vāṣpodayena prasiddhoṣarbudhavaidhuryeṇa vyabhicāram ādṛśya vāryate, tato 'pi kāraṇāt jātiviśeṣaviṣayaiva vyāptiḥ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyata iti siddham |
analyzed: yathā dhūme pravṛtte pi pratyakṣe vyāpti grāhiṇi ucchalat bahala rūpam anala vyāptim anusmaran māruta uddhūta dhūli paṭalāt analam anumāpayan vāṣpa udayena vyabhicāram ādṛśya vāryate kāraṇāt jāti viśeṣa viṣayā eva vyāptiḥ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate iti siddham

original: yadi hi dhūmaikajātipratibaddhapratibandhabodham adhyakṣam, tadā sādṛśyāpekṣo 'nyatra tadrūpāropaḥ, sadṛśāntaravyabhicāreṇa ca vāraṇaṃ yuktam |
analyzed: yadi hi dhūma eka jāti pratibaddha pratibandha bodham adhyakṣam tadā sādṛśya apekṣaḥ nyatra tad rūpa āropaḥ sadṛśa antara vyabhicāreṇa ca vāraṇam yuktam

original: yadā tu kāryajātau sarvatra vyāptigrahaḥ, tadā kiṃ sādṛśyāpekṣayeti? yadi tarhi jātiviśeṣapratibaddha evādhyakṣeṇa pratibandhabodhaḥ katham atyantavijātīyo 'pi (atyantavijātiyā 'pi) ghaṭakuṭakuṇṭyādayaḥ sādhāraṇarāgayogino haridrādidravyasaṃskāram anumāpayanti? kathaṃ vā kuṭṛārādi cchedakriyāyāṃ dṛṣṭavyāpāraṃ karaṇam atyantavijātīyāpi buddhiḥ
analyzed: yadā tu kārya jātau sarvatra vyāpti grahaḥ tadā kim sādṛśya apekṣayā iti yadi tarhi jāti viśeṣa pratibaddhaḥ eva adhyakṣeṇa pratibandha bodhaḥ katham ghaṭa kuṭa kuṇṭya ādayaḥ sādhāraṇa rāga yoginaḥ haridrā ādi dravya saṃskāram anumāpayanti katham vā kuṭṛāra ādi cheda kriyāyām dṛṣṭa vyāpāram karaṇam atyanta vijātīyā api buddhiḥ

original: kriyātvenānumāpayati?
analyzed: kriyā tvena anumāpayati

original: evam atyantavijātīyā api kailāsakuliśādayaḥ sādhāraṇakāryatvādidharmakāḥ puruṣam anumāpayiṣyantīti cet? naivam, vyāpyasya gamakatvāt, tad apekṣayaiva sajātīyavijātīyatāyāś cintyatvāt | vyāpyaṃ ca nirvartyavikāryakam āpekṣayā dvividhaṃ dharmirūpaṃ dharmarūpaṃ ca | tatra sarvathāpūṛvotpattau dharmiṇo vyāptir ucyate, dhūmādivat |
analyzed: evam atyanta vijātīyāḥ api kailāsa kuliśa ādayaḥ sādhāraṇa kārya tva ādi dharmakāḥ puruṣam anumāpayiṣyanti iti ced nā evam vyāpyasya gamaka tvāt tat apekṣayā eva sajātīya vijātīya tāyāḥ cintya tvāt vyāpyam ca āpekṣayā dvividham dharmi rūpam dharma rūpam ca tatra dharmiṇaḥ vyāptiḥ ucyate dhūma ādi vat

original: tadā ca dhūmāntaram eva sajātīyam, vijātīyam anyad vastu | yadā tu pūṛvasthitasyaiva dharmāntarotpattivyavasāyaḥ, tadā dharmavyāptir ucyate, payasi auṣṇyādivat, tadā ca auṣṇyāntaram eva sajātīyo dharmaḥ, nādhunā dharmijāter apekṣā |
analyzed: tadā ca dhūma antaram eva sajātīyam vijātīyam anyat vastu yadā tu pūṛva sthitasya eva dharma antara utpatti vyavasāyaḥ tadā dharma vyāptiḥ ucyate payasi auṣṇya ādi vat tadā ca auṣṇya antaram eva sajātīyaḥ dharmaḥ na adhunā dharmi jāteḥ apekṣā

original: evaṃ rāgo 'pi ghaṭakuṭādidravyavaijātyam avamatya svayaṃ svajātīyakāryāpekṣayaiva rāgadravyasaṃskārasya gamakaḥ | ata eva tadviśeṣe kvacit kuṅkumasya samparkaḥ kvacit haridrāder anumīyate | na caivaṃ pūṛvasthite bhūdharāmbhodharādau kāryatvādimātranirvartakaḥ puruṣa iṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tu kumbhādivad apūṛvakotpādaka eva |
analyzed: evam rāgaḥ pi ghaṭa kuṭa ādi dravya vaijātyam avamatya svayam sva jātīya kārya apekṣayā eva rāga dravya saṃskārasya gamakaḥ atas eva tad viśeṣe kvacid kuṅkumasya samparkaḥ kvacid haridrā ādeḥ anumīyate na ca evam bhūdhara ambhodhara ādau kāryatva ādi mātra nirvartakaḥ puruṣaḥ iṣṭaḥ kim tu kumbha ādi vat eva

original: tadā ca dhūme dhavalatādivat kāryatādayaḥ
analyzed: tadā ca dhūme dhavala tā ādi vat kārya tā ādayaḥ

original: [250] santo 'pi jātyantarasamavāyino dharmā vyāpter bahir bhāvād kiñcitkarā eva | tasmād dharmivastuvyāptigraho na dharmamātrapratyāsattim anurudhyate | nāpi dharmavyāpter dharmiṇaḥ sajātīyatām | śuddhaikavimarśāpekṣayā cā sajātīyetaravyavasthānam uktam | nāto rāgavad dharmivaijātye 'pi kāryatvādīnāṃ gamakatvam |
analyzed: santaḥ pi jāti antara samavāyinaḥ dharmāḥ vyāpteḥ bahis bhāvāt kiñcitkarāḥ eva tasmāt dharmi vastu vyāpti grahaḥ na dharma mātra pratyāsattim anurudhyate na api dharma vyāpteḥ dharmiṇaḥ sajātīya tām śuddha eka vimarśa apekṣayā sajātīya itara vyavasthānam uktam na atas rāga vat dharmi vaijātye pi kārya tva ādīnām gamaka tvam

original: anyathā pāṇṭudravyād api havyāśanānumānaprasaṅgo duṣpariharaḥ, vyabhicārottarasya duṣitatvāt |
analyzed: anyathā pāṇṭu dravyāt api havya aśana anumāna prasaṅgaḥ duṣpariharaḥ vyabhicāra uttarasya duṣita tvāt

original: indriye tv evam anumānam | yad anyakāraṇasannidhau kādācitkam, tat kāraṇāntarāpekṣam, yathā pāthaṛpṛthvīsannidhāvaṅkuraḥ, viṣayamanaskārālokasannidhau ca kādācitkī buddhir iti svabhāvahetuḥ | anapekṣatve vipakṣe kādācitka (kādācitkaṃ? ) virodhād anavasthāyīti bādhakāt vyāptisiddhiḥ |
analyzed: indriye tu evam anumānam yat anya kāraṇa sannidhau kādācitkam tat kāraṇa antara apekṣam yathā pāthaḥ pṛthvī sannidhau aṅkuraḥ viṣaya manaskāra āloka sannidhau ca kādācitkī buddhiḥ iti svabhāva hetuḥ anapekṣa tve vipakṣe kādācitka kādācitkam virodhāt anavasthāyi iti bādhakāt vyāpti siddhiḥ

original: yat tadanyad apekṣyaṃ tad indriyam iti vyavasthā, tato na kriyātvena kāraṇānumānaṃ, nāpi pratyakṣaṃ vyāptigrāhi | avaśyaṃ ca svābhāvikavikalpāmukhīkṛtajātibhedapuraskāreṇaiva sāmānyagrahaṇam eṣitavyam adhyakṣasya, anyathā yadā pratyakṣeṇa vyāptim ekām uparadśāyaṃ ghaṭa iti saṅketaḥ kriyate, tadā kim asau kāryatvādidharmayogi viśvam āviśati?
analyzed: yat tad anyat apekṣyam tat indriyam iti vyavasthā tatas na kriyā tvena kāraṇa anumānam na api pratyakṣam vyāpti grāhi avaśyam ca svābhāvika vikalpa āmukhīkṛta jāti bheda puraskāreṇa eva sāmānya grahaṇam eṣitavyam adhyakṣasya anyathā yadā pratyakṣeṇa vyāptim ekām ghaṭaḥ iti saṅketaḥ kriyate tadā kim asau kārya tva ādi dharma yogi viśvam āviśati

original: vyabhicāradarśanena ca niyataviṣayatām upanīyate? upadeṣṭaiva vā sarvānyajātiṣu niṣedhan viṣayaniyame niṣṭṛāpayati? atha sāmānyaviṣaya eva nāsau samayaḥ?
analyzed: vyabhicāra darśanena ca niyata viṣaya tām upanīyate upadeṣṭā eva vā sarva anya jātiṣu niṣedhan viṣaya niyame atha sāmānya viṣayaḥ eva na asau samayaḥ

original: evaṃ vācakajātibhede 'pi draṣṭavyam | kāryaśabdas tu pratyakṣam anapekṣya vikalpamātragocarite parāpekṣodayamātre niveśita iti na viśeṣavṛttiḥ | yadi tu so 'pi pratyakṣavartinyayaṃ kārya iti niveśyeta, so 'pi tatparyāyāntaravān niyatavṛttir eva syāt | tasmāt kāyajātiviśeṣaviṣayīkaraṇam eva nisargaḥ pratyakṣasya |
