original: anityatve kṛtakatvamātrasya viparyayabādhakapramāṇād anumānasvabhāvāt prabidandhasiddhir iti na tatra jātiviśeṣānurodhaḥ | jātiviśeṣānavacchinne tu kṛtakamātre vyāptisādhanasamartham asamarthaṃ vā tat pramāṇam iti cintanīyam | śaktau na doṣasparśaḥ |
analyzed: anitya tve kṛtaka tva mātrasya viparyaya bādhaka pramāṇāt anumāna svabhāvāt prabidandha siddhiḥ iti na tatra jāti viśeṣa anurodhaḥ jāti viśeṣa anavacchinne tu kṛtaka mātre vyāpti sādhana samartham asamartham vā tat pramāṇam iti cintanīyam śaktau na doṣa sparśaḥ

original: ata eva tatra ghaṭaśabdabhedena bhedodbhāvanaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikavaidharmyābhidhānam iti na yuktam | yato dharmirūpādākṛṣṭadharmadvayasya vyāptivyavasthāpanād dharmavastv eva dharmīti tadbhedābhidhānasya dharmimātrabheda evārthaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva tatra ghaṭa śabda bhedena bheda udbhāvanam dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika vaidharmya abhidhānam iti na yuktam yatas dharmi rūpāt ākṛṣṭa dharma dvayasya vyāpti vyavasthāpanāt dharma vastu eva dharmī iti tad bheda abhidhānasya dharmi mātra bhedaḥ eva arthaḥ

original: [254] ihāpi tarhi kāryeṣu dharmiṣu pauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhyaṃ kāryatvamātraṃ hetur iti na viśeṣaḥ kaścid iti cet? ucyate, kāryatvamātraṃ hetur iti ko 'sya bhāṣitasyārthaḥ? kiṃ tāvan mukhyatayā dharmamātre kāraṇasya kuṅkumāder eva rāge vyāpārād evam ucyate? utasvit kātsnaryena kārye vyāptisiddheḥ, dhūmatvamātraṃ hetur itivat? yathā kṛtsno dhūmaḥ
analyzed: iha api tarhi kāryeṣu dharmiṣu pauruṣeya tvam sādhyam kārya tva mātram hetuḥ iti na viśeṣaḥ kaścid iti ced ucyate kārya tva mātram hetuḥ iti kaḥ sya bhāṣitasya arthaḥ kim tāvat mukhya tayā dharma mātre kāraṇasya kuṅkuma ādeḥ eva rāge vyāpārāt evam ucyate uta svid kātsnaryena kārye vyāpti siddheḥ dhūma tva mātram hetuḥ itivat yathā kṛtsnaḥ dhūmaḥ

original: sādhyavyāptaḥ, tathā yāvat kāryaṃ tat kṛtsnaṃ puruṣavyāpārajanmakam iti niścayāt | tad etad ubhayam api nirastam | kṛtakatvamātram anityatvavyāptam iti tu kārtsnyapara eva bhāvanirdeśaḥ, yāvat kṛtakaṃ tat sarvam anityam ity ayam evārthaḥ |
analyzed: sādhya vyāptaḥ tathā yāvat kāryam tat kṛtsnam puruṣa vyāpāra janmakam iti niścayāt tat etat ubhayam api nirastam kṛtaka tva mātram anitya tva vyāptam iti tu kārtsnya paraḥ eva bhāva nirdeśaḥ yāvat kṛtakam tat sarvam anityam iti ayam eva arthaḥ

original: atrārthe pramāṇabale milite siddhe ca dhvaneḥ kṛtakatve ghaṭa eva kṛtako 'nityo dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ śabdaḥ syād iti niravakāśam evety ayam evārtho dharmimātrabhedo 'yam ity anayā rītyā prakāśyate |
analyzed: atra arthe pramāṇa bale milite siddhe ca dhvaneḥ kṛtaka tve ghaṭaḥ eva kṛtakaḥ nityaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ katham śabdaḥ syāt iti niravakāśam eva iti ayam eva arthaḥ dharmi mātra bhedaḥ yam iti anayā rītyā prakāśyate

original: yathā hi svabhāvahetvadhikāraprastāvāt sādhyasādhanadharmau vikalpārūṭharūpāpekṣayā bhinnau vyavsthāpitau tathā dharmy api śabdādiḥ, anyasya taddharmaṇo 'bhāvāt | na cānyatra dharmiṇi kṛtakavastunā anityavastusādhane dhvaner anityatāsiddhiḥ | tasya ca dharmiṇo ghaṭaśabdabhāvena bhedamāpādayan dūṣaṇam abhidhāya nigṛhyate dharmimātrabhedadvāreṇa |
analyzed: yathā hi svabhāva hetu adhikāra prastāvāt sādhya sādhana dharmau vikalpa ārūṭha rūpa apekṣayā bhinnau vyavsthāpitau tathā dharmī api śabda ādiḥ anyasya tad dharmaṇaḥ bhāvāt na ca anyatra dharmiṇi kṛtaka vastunā anitya vastu sādhane dhvaneḥ anitya tā siddhiḥ tasya ca dharmiṇaḥ ghaṭa śabda bhāvena bhedam āpādayan dūṣaṇam abhidhāya nigṛhyate dharmi mātra bheda dvāreṇa

original: prastute tu kāryahetvabhimānād dhūmasthānīyaḥ kāryarāśiḥ sādhyaś ca bhinno 'gnivat puruṣaḥ | kevalaṃ nāgnivat taddeśakāla eva |
analyzed: prastute tu kārya hetu abhimānāt dhūma sthānīyaḥ kārya rāśiḥ sādhyaḥ ca bhinnaḥ agni vat puruṣaḥ kevalam na agni vat tad deśa kāle eva

original: kiṃ tu janmadeśakāle sannihito niśceyaḥ, bhasmakumbhābhyām deśasannihitavyāpāraḥ kulālo niścīyate, ghaṛaś ca hetur vastutaḥ, tathā puruṣe 'pi sādhye vastv eva hetur na kāryatvadharmaḥ, tathā sati puruṣavyāptāt kāryād vilakṣaṇaṃ kṣoṇīdharādikāryāmati vadatā sādhanavaisadṛśyam udbhāvitam, na dharmivaisadṛśyam |
analyzed: kim tu janma deśa kāle sannihitaḥ niśceyaḥ bhasma kumbhābhyām deśa sannihita vyāpāraḥ kulālaḥ niścīyate ghaṛaḥ ca hetuḥ vastutas tathā puruṣe sādhye vastu eva hetuḥ na kāryatva dharmaḥ tathā sati puruṣa vyāptāt kāryāt vilakṣaṇam kṣoṇīdhara ādi kāryāmati vadatā sādhana vaisadṛśyam udbhāvitam na dharmi vaisadṛśyam

original: tadā hi tadudayadeśakālam eva dharmi, na ca kalasādikāladeśāt kailāsādikāladeśavaisadṛśyaṃ kaścid vaktum upakrānto yena dharmivaisadṛśyodbhāvanaṃ bhavet |
analyzed: tadā hi tad udaya deśa kālam eva dharmi na ca kalasa ādi kāla deśāt kailāsa ādi kāla deśa vaisadṛśyam kaścid vaktum upakrāntaḥ yena dharmi vaisadṛśya udbhāvanam bhavet

original: tasmād dahanarūpamātrād dahanānumānavat sādhanavaisadṛśyodbhāvanam etad asiddhim avyāptiṃ vā darśayituṃ dharmiṇa iti tu viplavaḥ pareṣām | ayam evārtho yādṛk kāryatvaṃ devakulādau puruṣavyāptaṃ pratītam, na tādṛg yugandharādāv ity anayā diśopadiśyate | yajjātīyaṃ devakulādi puruṣavyāptaṃ na tajjātīyaṃ yugandharādīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt dahana rūpa mātrāt dahana anumāna vat sādhana vaisadṛśya udbhāvanam etat asiddhim avyāptim vā darśayitum dharmiṇaḥ iti tu viplavaḥ pareṣām ayam eva arthaḥ yādṛś kāryatvam devakula ādau puruṣa vyāptam pratītam na tādṛś yugandhara ādau iti anayā diśā upadiśyate yad jātīyam devakula ādi puruṣa vyāptam na tad jātīyam yugandhara ādi iti arthaḥ

original: atyantavaijātyāc ca kāryaśabdamātrasāmyam ucyate na punar kāryavyāvṛtteḥ kvacit nyūnabhāvaḥ | vyāptau tu kāryatvāder anantarbhāvaṃ brūmaḥ | ata eva tanmātreṇa sāmyaṃ nopayogi, mūrtatvādineva dahanānumāne |
analyzed: atyanta vaijātyāt ca kārya śabda mātra sāmyam ucyate na punar kārya vyāvṛtteḥ kvacid nyūnabhāvaḥ vyāptau tu kārya tva ādeḥ anantarbhāvam brūmaḥ atas eva tanmātreṇa sāmyam na upayogi mūrta tva ādinā iva dahana anumāne

original: [255] mañjariyas tu paryanuyogo 'sthānapatitaḥ | ghaṭādijāniter eva puruṣavyāptā siddheti vadatāny atra saṃśayamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt | kulālādimanuṣyakṛtabuddhiś ca kṛtabuddhir uktā | tadabhāvaś ca jātibhede uttarīkṛtaḥ | sa cobhayasiddhatayā na visarjanāny avakāśayati | na cātyantikajātibhedam antareṇopapadyata iti niveditam |
analyzed: tu sthāna pateḥ ghaṭa ādi jāniteḥ eva puruṣa vyāptā siddhā iti atra saṃśaya mātrasya vivakṣita tvāt kulāla ādi manuṣya kṛtabuddhiḥ ca kṛtabuddhiḥ uktā tad abhāvaḥ ca jāti bhede uttarīkṛtaḥ sa ca ubhaya siddha tayā na visarjanāni avakāśayati na ca ātyantika jāti bhedam antareṇa upapadyate iti niveditam

original: evaṃ Vācaspater api viśeṣagaveṣaṇaṃ kṛtabuddhivaidhuryasyābhidheyaprayojanayor aparijñānaprayuktam iti veditavyam | yadi hi kṛtabuddhir nāstīti prakṛtasādhyabuddhir nāstīti vivakṣitam, tadā pratītikalahe 'muṣmin kuto viśeṣād anyatra sā bhavati parvatādau tadabhāvān neti cintyate |
analyzed: evam Vācaspateḥ api viśeṣa gaveṣaṇam kṛta buddhi vaidhuryasya abhidheya prayojanayoḥ aparijñāna prayuktam iti veditavyam yadi hi kṛta buddhiḥ na asti iti prakṛta sādhya buddhiḥ na asti iti vivakṣitam tadā pratīti kalahe muṣmin kutas viśeṣāt anyatra sā bhavati parvata ādau tad abhāvāt na iti cintyate

original: yadā tu kṛtabuddhir nāstīti sāmānaśilpikṛtabuddhir nāstīty abhidheyam, tatra ca na vivādaḥ | prayojanaṃ ca kumbhādibhyo 'mbhodharāder atyantavaijātyakhyāpanam | tad apy aśakyaparihāram | tato gṛhītavyāptikebhyo 'tyantavilakṣaṇāt kathaṃ prakṛtasādhyabuddhir ity abhipretam? tadā plavata eva sakalam evaṃvidham |
analyzed: yadā tu kṛtabuddhiḥ na asti iti sāmānaśilpi kṛtabuddhiḥ na asti iti abhidheyam tatra ca na vivādaḥ prayojanam ca kumbha ādibhyaḥ mbhodhara ādeḥ atyanta vaijātya khyāpanam tat api aśakya parihāram tatas gṛhīta vyāptikebhyaḥ tyanta vilakṣaṇāt katham prakṛta sādhya buddhiḥ iti abhipretam tadā plavate eva sakalam evaṃvidham

original: utpattimanmātre ca vyāptinirasanāt hantotpattimad ityādy uttaraṃ kāladaṇṭakhaṇṭitam eva | tena ghaṭe dṛṣṭavyāptikasya ghaṭasajātīyam eva buddhimatpūṛvakam | yadā tu prāsādādāv api vyāptigrahas tadā tajjāter api tatpūrvakatvasiddhir ity apy uktam |
analyzed: utpattimat mātre ca vyāpti nirasanāt hanta utpattimat ityādi uttaram kāla daṇṭa khaṇṭitam eva tena ghaṭe dṛṣṭa vyāptikasya ghaṭa sajātīyam eva yadā tu prāsāda ādau api vyāpti grahaḥ tadā tad jāteḥ api tad pūrvakatva siddhiḥ iti api uktam

original: yaccā (yaccātha) yajjātīyam ity āśaṅkya kiṃ kāryajātīyam? tathā na dṛṣṭam ity uttaram, tad api svābhāvikavikalpāvabhāsinaḥ sāmānyasya pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaṇayogyatāsamarthanāt kadarthitam | tasmād yad api aupādhikavikalpapratibhāsināpi rūpeṇa tajjātīyavyavahāro duṣparihāraḥ, vyāptigrahaṇe tu pratikṣiptatvān mahān viśeṣa iti |
analyzed: yat ca atha yad jātīyam iti āśaṅkya kim kārya jātīyam tathā na dṛṣṭam iti uttaram tat api svābhāvika vikalpa avabhāsinaḥ sāmānyasya pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti grahaṇa yogyatā samarthanāt kadarthitam tasmāt yat api aupādhika vikalpa pratibhāsinā api rūpeṇa tad jātīya vyavahāraḥ duṣparihāraḥ vyāpti grahaṇe tu pratikṣipta tvāt mahān viśeṣaḥ iti

original: ata eva vittokavikalpā api na kiñcit | tathā hi, yady asmadabhiprāyapraśnaḥ, tadā viśiṣṭaiva kāryajātir devakulakalasādilakṣaṇā buddhimadvyāptā yaddṛṣṭer hi parokṣakriyasyāpy anubhūtasajātīyaśilpyanumānam, sā na siddhā sindhubhūdharādau | kāryatvamātraṃ tu na vyāptam ity uccais tarāṃ tanvanta evāsmahe | tatra kim ebhir vikalpair iti cintaya |
analyzed: atas eva vittoka vikalpāḥ api na kiñcid tathā hi yadi asmad abhiprāya praśnaḥ tadā viśiṣṭā eva kārya jātiḥ devakula kalasa ādi lakṣaṇā buddhimat vyāptā yad dṛṣṭeḥ hi parokṣa kriyasya api anubhūta sajātīya śilpi anumānam sā na siddhā sindhu bhūdhara ādau kāryatva mātram tu na vyāptam iti uccais tarām tanvantaḥ eva āsmahe tatra kim ebhiḥ vikalpaiḥ iti cintaya

original: yadviśeṣād viśiṣṭā kāryajātiḥ sa viśeṣaḥ kim anirūpitarūpa evety api pāpīyaḥ, pratyakṣasiddhānāṃ kāryajātīnāṃ parasparavaisadṛśyasyāpahnotum aśakyatvāt | vyāptis tu viśiṣṭāyāṃ jātau bhavatu kāryamātre vety atra paramāpātato vimantum arhati |
analyzed: yad viśeṣāt viśiṣṭā kārya jātiḥ sa viśeṣaḥ kim anirūpita rūpaḥ eva iti api pāpīyaḥ pratyakṣa siddhānām kārya jātīnām paraspara vaisadṛśyasya apahnotum aśakya tvāt vyāptiḥ tu viśiṣṭāyām jātau bhavatu kārya mātre vā iti atra parama āpātataḥ vimantum arhati

original: katham anyathā svayam api vastutvasyāgnikāryatvāsaṃjananaṃ vyabhicāram ālambya parihṛtam? vyabhicārabuddhīnāṃ niyatajātiviṣayatve vivādābhāvād ity āvirbhāvitam eva | tasmād ākārārthakriyāsāmarthādivedanāt
analyzed: katham anyathā svayam api vastu tvasya agni kārya tva asaṃjananam vyabhicāram ālambya parihṛtam vyabhicāra buddhīnām niyata jāti viṣaya tve vivāda abhāvāt iti āvirbhāvitam eva tasmāt ākāra artha kriyā sāmartha ādi vedanāt

original: [256] citrākāre jagati niyatam īśvaraprasādād evālaukikam ekākāram ālokitam asyetyupekṣaiva jyāyasī |
analyzed: citra ākāre jagati niyatam īśvara prasādāt eva alaukikam eka ākāram ālokitam asya iti upekṣā eva jyāyasī

original: yad api prācīnam upādānodāharaṇam asya kāryamātre vyāptisamīhayā, tad api naupayikam, tatrāpi pratyakṣavyāpārasyāśakyasādhanatvāt, naisargikavikalpaviṣayatvāt, upādānasya dṛśyādṛśyasvabhāvatvāc ca |
analyzed: yat api prācīnam upādāna udāharaṇam asya kārya mātre vyāpti samīhayā tat api na aupayikam tatra api pratyakṣa vyāpārasya aśakya sādhana tvāt naisargika vikalpa viṣaya tvāt upādānasya dṛśya adṛśya svabhāva tvāt ca

original: tat kim idānīm upādānena kāryarāśer vyāptir eva nāsti? āhosvit pramāṇāntaragamyā bhavatv iti cet? ubhayatra saṃśayaḥ, sato 'pi vyabhicārasya viparyayabādhakānumānasya hānullekhasaṃbhavād idānīm ekāntahetor abhāvāt |
analyzed: tat kim idānīm upādānena kārya rāśeḥ vyāptiḥ eva nā asti āhosvit pramāṇa antara gamyā bhavatu iti ced ubhayatra saṃśayaḥ vyabhicārasya viparyaya bādhaka anumānasya ha an ullekha saṃbhavāt idānīm ekānta hetoḥ abhāvāt

original: tad ayaṃ sopādānaṃ sarvotpattir iti sarvatantrasiddhānto 'virodhād anuvṛttaḥ, yāvac ca kāryam ālokayāmas tāvad upādānavadevety avigānena vyavahāro 'pi | na ca kāryaparyantabodhaḥ pṛthagjanasyeti tanīyasāpi viparītāṃśena saṃśayo durvāraḥ |
analyzed: tat ayam sa upādānam sarva utpattiḥ iti sarva tantra siddhāntaḥ virodhāt anuvṛttaḥ yāvat ca kāryam ālokayāmaḥ tāvat upādāna vat eva iti avigānena na ca kārya paryanta bodhaḥ pṛthagjanasya iti tanīyasā api viparīta aṃśena saṃśayaḥ durvāraḥ

original: buddheś ca buddhir upādānaṃ niścitā iti vijñānasya vijñānānupādānāc (vijñānānyānupādānāc) ca sidhyatīti na virudhyate, tato yadi siddhāntād api tadvyāptivyavasāyo na kācit kṣatiḥ | pratyakṣāt tu mā bhūt, kevalam atra pakṣe 'cetanopādānatvahetur ekadeśasiddhaḥ śaṅkyeteti vyavasthā |
analyzed: buddheḥ ca buddhiḥ upādānam niścitā iti vijñānasya vijñāna anupādānāt vijñāna anya anupādānāt ca sidhyati iti na virudhyate tatas yadi siddhāntāt api tad vyāpti vyavasāyaḥ na kācid kṣatiḥ pratyakṣāt tu mā bhūt kevalam atra pakṣe cetanā upādāna tva hetuḥ eka deśa siddhaḥ śaṅkyeta iti vyavasthā

original: sā cāyātaiva, kiṃ kriyatām? viparyayabādhakapramāṇalābhe tu sāpi na syāt | kevalaṃ pratyakṣeṇa kṛtsnakāryavyāptivāde 'nudāharaṇam evedam | ataḥ pratyakṣasya jātiviśeṣe vyāpāraniyamaprasādhanād viśeṣahetvabhāvād ity ādy api dhvastam?
analyzed: sā ca āyātā eva kim kriyatām viparyaya bādhaka pramāṇa lābhe tu sā api na syāt kevalam pratyakṣeṇa kṛtsna kārya vyāpti vāde eva idam atas pratyakṣasya jāti viśeṣe vyāpāra niyama prasādhanāt viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt iti ādi api dhvastam

original: yat punar aparasya viparyayabādhakapramāṇopanyāsapauruṣam, tatrāpi prathamadvitayaṃ tāvad bādhakaṃ dhūmasyeva siddhāyām eva tadutpattau tatsādhakapratyakṣānupalambhasya viśiṣṭajātyadhikāreṇa pravṛttisādhanād viśiṣṭam eva ghaṭādikāryaṃ prati śakyam |
analyzed: yat punar aparasya viparyaya bādhaka pramāṇa upanyāsa pauruṣam tatra api prathama dvitayam tāvat bādhakam dhūmasya iva siddhāyām eva tad utpattau tad sādhaka pratyakṣa anupalambhasya viśiṣṭa jāti adhikāreṇa pravṛtti sādhanāt viśiṣṭam eva ghaṭa ādi kāryam prati śakyam

original: evaṃ ca yadi buddhimantam antareṇa jāyeta sakṛd api tato na bhavet, aniyatahetutve vāhetutvam iti na kāryamātraṃ prati, tasya puruṣād utpattiprasādhanābhāvāt | tataś ca tat kāryaṃ yat puruṣapūrvam ity api niravakāśam ||
analyzed: evam ca yadi buddhimantam antareṇa jāyeta sakṛt api tatas na bhavet aniyata hetu tve vā ahetu tvam iti na kārya mātram prati tasya puruṣāt utpatti prasādhana abhāvāt tatas ca tat kāryam yat puruṣa pūrvam iti api niravakāśam

original: nāpi kāryāvirāmaprasaṅgasaṅgatiḥ, svakāraṇāyattasannidher adṛṣṭapariṇāmasahakāriṇaḥ kāraṇāvasthāviśeṣasya satatam abhāve 'pi kāryāṇāṃ kādācitkatopapatteḥ, yad apekṣayā nityaśakter api īśvarasya śaśvan na karaṇam (karaṇatvam) | ekāvasthāniyame hi kāraṇāntarāṇāṃ pravṛttinivṛttisādhanīcchā prārthyeta |
analyzed: nā api kārya avirāma prasaṅga saṅgatiḥ sva kāraṇa āyatta sannidheḥ adṛṣṭa pariṇāma sahakāriṇaḥ kāraṇa avasthā viśeṣasya satatam abhāve pi kāryāṇām kādācitkatā upapatteḥ yat apekṣayā nitya śakteḥ api īśvarasya śaśvat na karaṇam karaṇa tvam eka avasthā niyame hi kāraṇa antarāṇām pravṛtti nivṛtti sādhanī icchā prārthyeta

original: sa ca nāsti, bījasyocchūnataratamādibhāvavat pariṇāmaparamparāparicayasya
analyzed: sa ca nā asti bījasya ucchūnataratama ādi bhāva vat pariṇāma paramparā paricayasya

original: [257] teṣām apahnotum aśakyatvāt | astu vā ekāvasthāniyama īśvarasya icchāyā api nityatvāt tadavasthaḥ kāryāvirāmaḥ, anitye tu yadapekṣo 'syāḥ kadācit bhāvaḥ, tad apekṣayā kāryagrāmasya yadi syāt kīdṛśo doṣaḥ? kumbhādikāryakrame 'pi tarhi kiṃ puruṣecchayā, yadapekṣo 'syāḥ kramaḥ, tadapekṣa eva kumbhāder apy astīti vaktuṃ śakteḥ? tad ayuktam,
analyzed: teṣām apahnotum aśakya tvāt astu vā eka avasthā niyamaḥ īśvarasya icchāyāḥ api nitya tvāt tad avasthaḥ kārya avirāmaḥ anitye tu syāḥ kadācid bhāvaḥ tat apekṣayā kārya grāmasya yadi syāt kīdṛśaḥ doṣaḥ kumbha ādi kārya krame tarhi kim puruṣa icchayā syāḥ kramaḥ tad apekṣaḥ eva kumbha ādeḥ api asti iti vaktum śakteḥ tat ayuktam

original: pramāṇena dṛṣṭasāmarthyasya hetor apohitum aśakyatvāt | prastute tu pramāṇābhāvāt kāryakādācitkatāmātram āśritaṃ tadanyathāpy upapatsyata iti kutaḥ puruṣāpattiniyamaḥ kāryasya?
analyzed: pramāṇena dṛṣṭa sāmarthyasya hetoḥ apohitum aśakya tvāt prastute tu pramāṇa abhāvāt kārya kādācitkatā mātram āśritam tad anyathā api upapatsyate iti kutas puruṣa āpatti niyamaḥ kāryasya

original: atha kumbhādeḥ kadācidbhāvaḥ puruṣādhīno dṛṣṭa iti kāryāntarasyāpi tatheti cet? evaṃ tarhi tad eva darśanādarśanamātraṃ vyāptisādhanam āyātam, kim atra viparyayabādhakopanyāsaśauṭīryeṇeti tṛtīyam api nirastam ||
analyzed: atha kumbha ādeḥ kadācid bhāvaḥ puruṣa adhīnaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti kārya antarasya api tathā iti ced evam tarhi tat eva darśana adarśana mātram vyāpti sādhanam āyātam kim atra viparyaya bādhaka upanyāsa śauṭīryeṇa iti tṛtīyam api nirastam

original: yac cocyate, kāraṇasannidher dhīdhanādhīno niścita iti, tatrāpi tathā darśanamātrāśraye etad eva vācyam | viparyayabādhakaṃ ca na kiñcid uktam | pratyakṣānupalambhaśaraṇīkaraṇe ca vātopadhātādimilajjambālabījādisāmagryā anaikāntikatvād sarvam āpekṣaparihārasametaṃ kāryavad avagantavyaṃ sāmagrīviśeṣa eva vyāptiyogya ity etat paryantam |
analyzed: yat ca ucyate kāraṇa sannidheḥ dhī dhana adhīnaḥ niścitaḥ iti tatra api tathā darśana mātra āśraye etat eva vācyam viparyaya bādhakam ca na kiñcid uktam pratyakṣa anupalambha śaraṇīkaraṇe ca vāta upadhāta ādi milat jambāla bīja ādi sāmagryāḥ anaikāntika tvāt sarvam āpekṣa parihāra sametam kārya vat avagantavyam sāmagrī viśeṣaḥ eva vyāpti yogyaḥ iti etat paryantam

original: tan na kāraṇasāmagryāḥ puruṣeṇa vyāptisiddhaḥ, yato vipakṣe vyāpakānupalambhād asambhava iti caturtham api kadarthitam ||
analyzed: tat na kāraṇa sāmagryāḥ puruṣeṇa vyāpti siddhaḥ yatas vipakṣe vyāpaka anupalambhāt asambhavaḥ iti caturtham api kadarthitam

original: tāvataiva Vācaspater api hṛdayaśūnyaḥ pralāpo 'pahastitaḥ | yathā hi vitatānāṃ tāvad ajananabījamuktam avasthāviśeṣābhāvo nāma |
analyzed: tāvatā eva Vācaspateḥ api hṛdaya śūnyaḥ pralāpaḥ upahastitaḥ yathā hi vitatānām tāvat ajanana bījam uktam avasthā viśeṣa abhāvaḥ nāma

original: yady api daṇṭacakrādīnāṃ puruṣād eva milanam upalabdhaṃ tatprayatnasacivānāṃ ca kāryārambhaḥ, tathāpi sarvatra sarvadā vā tathaiveti niyamayituḥ pramāṇasyābhāvāt kāryotpādavyāpakasyāpi kāraṇasamavadhānasya buddhimad adhīnatvena vyāptyasiddhes tadavastho doṣaḥ |
analyzed: yadi api daṇṭa cakra ādīnām puruṣāt eva milanam upalabdham tad prayatna sacivānām ca kārya ārambhaḥ tathā api sarvatra sarvadā vā tathā eva iti niyamayituḥ pramāṇasya abhāvāt kārya utpāda vyāpakasya api kāraṇa samavadhānasya buddhimat adhīna tvena vyāpti asiddheḥ tad avasthaḥ doṣaḥ

original: yathā ca kāraṇāntaradaśāviśeṣāśrayeṇaiva kāryāṇāṃ kadācid bhāvas tathā prakṛtiviśeṣo 'pīti pañcamaṃ ca pañcatām añcitam ||
analyzed: yathā ca kāraṇa antara daśā viśeṣa āśrayeṇa eva kāryāṇām kadācid bhāvaḥ tathā prakṛti viśeṣaḥ u pi iti pañcamam ca pañcatām añcitam

original: kāraṇamātrāpattisādhanaṃ punar etad iti darśitaṃ śāstre ||
analyzed: kāraṇa mātra āpatti sādhanam punar etat iti darśitam śāstre

original: etenaiva śaṅkaroktam api nāpi kaścid viśeṣa ity ādi kāvyaracanāmātramāpāditam, pratibandhasādhakapramāṇaparyādānāt | yady api ca nirabhiprāyavyāpāratvena prāsādādihetubhyo bhūbhūdharādihetūnāṃ na viśeṣas tathāpi prayatnavad apekṣānapekṣābhyāṃ yadi syāt ko doṣaḥ? yathā pārthivatvāviśeṣe 'pi lohalekhyatvālohalekhyatve |
analyzed: etena eva śaṅkara uktam api nā api kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti ādi kāvya racanā mātram āpāditam pratibandha sādhaka pramāṇa paryādānāt yadi api ca nirabhiprāya vyāpāra tvena prāsāda ādi hetubhyaḥ bhūbhūdhara ādi hetūnām na viśeṣaḥ tathā api prayatna vat apekṣā anapekṣābhyām yadi syāt kaḥ doṣaḥ yathā pārthiva tva aviśeṣe pi loha lekhya tva a loha lekhya tve

original: avaśyaṃ ca nirabhiprāyatvāviśeṣe
analyzed: avaśyam ca nirabhiprāya tva aviśeṣe

original: [258] 'pi viśeṣa evāmeṣitavyaḥ śakteḥ, katham anyathā kāryavaijātyam ātyantikam? tad asau śaktiḥ prayatnavad apekṣāvaimukhyam api yadi kṣameta kā kṣatiḥ? kiṃ ca kartur api karādivyāpāram antareṇa samīhāmātrāt na mūrtakāryasiddhir upalabdhā, tam ativartamānānāṃ bhūdharādīnāṃ kā gaṇanā samīhāmātre?
analyzed: api viśeṣaḥ śakteḥ katham anyathā kārya vaijātyam ātyantikam tat asau śaktiḥ prayatna vat apekṣā vaimukhyam api yadi kṣameta kā kṣatiḥ kim ca kartuḥ api kara ādi vyāpāram antareṇa samīhā mātrāt na mūrta kārya siddhiḥ upalabdhā tam ativartamānānām bhūdhara ādīnām kā gaṇanā samīhā mātre

original: kārādayo 'pi samīhayā pravartyanta iti cet? samīhāpi sanniveśini śayādivyāpāravirahe na kiñcitkarīty uktam | tato yayā śaktayā karādivyāpārapāravaśyamapāsya mahīdharādihetavo nirabhiprāyatve saty api na kāryakarmaṇi pratihanyante, tayā samīhām api nātikrameyur iti ka evaṃ śraddadhīta? na hi dhūmodayakāle ucchaladbahalarūpaṃ vastu
analyzed: kāra ādayaḥ pi samīhayā pravartyante iti ced samīhā api sanniveśini śaya ādi vyāpāra virahe na kiñcitkarī iti uktam tatas yayā śaktayā kara ādi vyāpāra pāravaśyam apāsya mahīdhara ādi hetavaḥ nirabhiprāya tve sati api na kārya karmaṇi pratihanyante tayā samīhām api na atikrameyuḥ iti kaḥ evam śraddadhīta na hi dhūma udaya kāle ucchalat bahala rūpam vastu

original: vahnīndhanajanyatayā sambhāvitam ekābhāvaniścaye niścīyamānam anyābhāve 'pi na bhāvaśaṅkāyāṃ niveśyati, tādṛg etad api ||
analyzed: vahni indhana janya tayā sambhāvitam eka abhāva niścaye niścīyamānam anya abhāve pi na bhāva śaṅkāyām tādṛś etat api

original: śarīrasvīkāre tu prādeśikakāryānityānekāsarvajñatvāt sādhu sādhitaḥ sudhībhirīśvaraḥ | etenaiva vā vyabhicāraḥ kāryatvādeḥ | na hy anadhiṣṭhitānām ity ādicanād (ādivacanād) darśanādarśanamātrād anyam upāyam asya vyāptisādhanāya spṛśati, tac ca kṛtottaram |
analyzed: śarīra svīkāre tu prādeśika kārya anitya aneka asarvajña tvāt sādhu sādhitaḥ sudhībhiḥ īśvaraḥ etena eva vā vyabhicāraḥ kārya tva ādeḥ na hi anadhiṣṭhitānām iti ādi canāt ādi vacanāt darśana adarśana mātrāt anyam upāyam asya vyāpti sādhanāya spṛśati tat ca kṛta uttaram

original: yadi ca darśanādarśanam eva śaraṇam, tadā yathā samīhāvataḥ kāryakriyā dṛṣṭeti kārye sati samīhāvato 'numānam iṣṭam, tathā karādimata eva mūrtakriyā dṛṣṭeti karādivyāpāranupapattau puruṣasyākriyaiva kasmāt na niścīyate? na khalu kāryahetuvyāpakānupalambhayoḥ prāmāṇye kaścid viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca darśana adarśanam eva śaraṇam tadā yathā samīhāvataḥ kārya kriyā dṛṣṭā iti kārye sati samīhāvataḥ numānam iṣṭam tathā kara ādimataḥ eva mūrta kriyā dṛṣṭā iti kara ādi vyāpāra anupapattau puruṣasya akriyā eva kasmāt na niścīyate na khalu kārya hetu vyāpaka anupalambhayoḥ prāmāṇye kaścid viśeṣaḥ

original: yadi tu darśanādarśanamātramanāsthāya pramāṇāntaram ekaniyataṃ syāt, syād ekasādhyabuddhiḥ, tadabhāve tu pratibandha eva tayoḥ parasparam, na bādhā tulyakakṣatvād iti prakaraṇasamaḥ parābhiprāyāt |
analyzed: yadi tu darśana adarśana mātram an āsthāya pramāṇa antaram eka niyatam syāt syāt eka sādhya buddhiḥ tad abhāve tu pratibandhaḥ eva tayoḥ parasparam na bādhā tulya kakṣa tvāt iti prakaraṇasamaḥ para abhiprāyāt

original: prayogaḥ, yo na svāṅgavyāpāravān nāsau mūrtanirvartanasamartho dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā kulāla eva saṃhṛtakarādivyāpāradaśāyām | nāsti ca svāṅgavyāpāraḥ prakṛte puṃsīti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: prayogaḥ yaḥ na sva aṅga vyāpāravān na asau mūrta nirvartana samarthaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā kulālaḥ eva saṃhṛta kara ādi vyāpāra daśāyām na asti ca sva aṅga vyāpāraḥ prakṛte puṃsi iti vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ

original: nāśrayāsiddhiḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgādhyāyanyāyeneti vastutas tarhi dūṣaṇāntaram eva yuktaṃ, kaḥ pratihetor avakāśa iti cet, na, bhūyodarśanasya vyāptisiddhāv anaṅgatvapratipādanārtham asyopanyāsāt | yadi bhūyodarśanam upāyaḥ tadaivam api syād ity ukter iti vyāptigrahaprakārāṇām ayogād anekānta iti sthitam |
analyzed: na āśraya asiddhiḥ kṣaṇabhaṅga adhyāya nyāyena iti vastutas tarhi dūṣaṇa antaram eva yuktam kaḥ pratihetoḥ avakāśaḥ iti ced na bhūyodarśanasya vyāpti siddhau anaṅga tva pratipādana artham asya upanyāsāt yadi bhūyodarśanam upāyaḥ tadā evam api syāt iti ukteḥ iti vyāpti graha prakārāṇām ayogāt anekāntaḥ iti sthitam

original: astu vā vyāptigrahaḥ kathañcit, tathāpi neśvarasiddhipratyāśā phalavatī, buddhimataḥ sādhyasyaikatvaniyamaniścayābhāvāt | ekatve hi tasya siddhe nityavibhusarvajñatvasiddhir
analyzed: astu vā vyāpti grahaḥ kathañcid tathā api nā īśvara siddhi pratyāśā phalavatī buddhimataḥ sādhyasya eka tva niyama niścaya abhāvāt ekatve hi tasya siddhe nitya vibhu sarvajña tva siddhiḥ

original: [259] īśvaravyavahāram āropayet | yadā tu bhinnadeśakālakalitaṃ kāryajātam anekena saṃkhyātikrāntena kartrā kṛtaṃ sambhāvyeta, na tadā vibhutvanityatve, svasvaviṣayopādānādimātravedanasiddhau ca kva sarvajñatvam?
analyzed: īśvara vyavahāram āropayet yadā tu bhinna deśa kāla kalitam kārya jātam anekena saṃkhyā atikrāntena kartrā kṛtam sambhāvyeta na tadā vibhu tva nitya tve sva sva viṣaya upādāna ādi mātra vedana siddhau ca kva sarvajñatvam

original: atha bahūnāṃ vyāhatamanasāṃ vyāpāre kāryasyānutpattir upanyasya vilopādiprasaṅgaś ca syād iti cet? pratyekaṃ vaibhavādiguṇayogād īśvarāṇāṃ vyāpāre syād apīyam āśaṅkā, adya punar eko 'pi tādṛṇ na sidhyatīty ucyate | arvācīnaśaktayaś ca bhūyāṃsa ekam anekaṃ ca kāryam ārabhya niṣpādayanto dṛśyanta eva |
analyzed: atha bahūnām vyāhata manasām vyāpāre kāryasya anutpattiḥ upanyasya vilopa ādi prasaṅgaḥ ca syāt iti ced pratyekam vaibhava ādi guṇa yogāt īśvarāṇām vyāpāre syāt api iyam āśaṅkā adya punar tādṛś na sidhyati iti ucyate arvācīna śaktayaḥ ca bhūyāṃsaḥ ekam anekam ca kāryam ārabhya niṣpādayantaḥ dṛśyante eva

original: nanv anekatrāpi pradhānabhūtenaikena bhāvyam, balīyasā vā, sūtradhāravat, senānīvad vā | atas tasyaiva kartṛtvam itareṣāṃ tadanuvṛttitvād iti cet, na, tatrāpi niyamābhāvāt, svasvaprayojanānurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣāñcid ekasattvādighaṭanādarśanāt |
analyzed: nanu anekatra api pradhāna bhūtena ekena bhāvyam balīyasā vā sūtradhāra vat senānī vat vā atas tasya eva kartṛ tvam itareṣām tad anuvṛtti tvāt iti ced na tatra api niyama abhāvāt sva sva prayojana anurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣāñcid eka sattva ādi ghaṭana adarśanāt

original: tatrāpi kaścid eva prathamaḥ prayojaka ity api nāsti, anekasya tathā hṛdayotkalikāyā anivāraṇāt, nīcasyāpi prayojakatvasambhavāt |
analyzed: tatra api kaścid eva prathamaḥ prayojakaḥ iti api nā asti anekasya tathā hṛdaya utkalikāyāḥ anivāraṇāt nīcasya api prayojaka tva sambhavāt

original: tasmād bhramaramadhumakṣikāvalmīkajantuvat kṣudraprāṇibhir apy ekaikam ainākādikaraṇasambhāvanāyāṃ kā vārtā viśvasyaikena kriyāyāḥ? tatrādṛṣṭajanmānas tāvat tāvataiva kṛtārthīkṛtacetanānumitayaḥ kṣitir adharādayaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt bhramara madhumakṣikā valmīka jantu vat kṣudra prāṇibhiḥ api ekaikam aināka ādi karaṇa sambhāvanāyām kā vārtā viśvasya ekena kriyāyāḥ tatra adṛṣṭa janmānaḥ tāvat tāvatā eva kṛtārthīkṛta cetanā anumitayaḥ kṣitiḥ adhara ādayaḥ

original: te ca kṣudrajantava upādānam atikṣudraṃ pṛthvyādidravyam upakaraṇaṃ sukhādisampradānam ātmanaṃ sthitisukhādi ca prayojanaṃ jānanta eva valmīkajantuvat pravarteran | siddhe ca nāvaśyam adhiṣṭhāyakā dṛśyeran, vicitraśaktikarmāpekṣāt svabhāvaviprakarṣād vā | ye 'pi dṛṣṭajanyamāno vṛkṣādayaḥ pauruṣeyāḥ, tatra cintaiva nāsti |
analyzed: te ca kṣudra jantavaḥ upādānam ati kṣudram pṛthvī ādi dravyam upakaraṇam sukha ādi sampradānam ātmanam sthiti sukha ādi ca prayojanam jānantaḥ eva valmīka jantu vat pravarteran siddhe ca na avaśyam adhiṣṭhāyakāḥ dṛśyeran vicitra śakti karma apekṣāt svabhāva viprakarṣāt vā ye dṛṣṭa janyamānaḥ vṛkṣa ādayaḥ pauruṣeyāḥ tatra cintā eva na asti

original: adṛṣṭapuruṣavyāpārās tu ye bindhyayugandharādiparisaradbhāvās te 'pi piśācādiprakārair adhitṛbhir (adhiṣṭhātṛbhir) asaṃkhyaiḥ kartṛmanta iti kaḥ sarvavedī bhavatu? deśakālayoś ca bhinnā evepri kva vibhutvanityatve? na caivaṃ śaṅkāyā bādhakaṃ kiñcid asti vastubalapravṛttam anumānam |

original: na ca vyavasthite kumbhādau kāryatvādidharmamātrotpattir īkṣyate, kṣitidharādau vābhyupeyate, yenākāram anādṛtya rāgavattanmātram eva hetum anumāpayet | sanniveśas tarhi sthita eva tadātmani kumbhakārād iti cet, na, drāg api saṃsthānavinākṛtāyā mṛdo 'nupalabdheḥ |

original: sa hi saṅkalpaniveśiny udayārtham apekṣitaparavyāpāramātre arthe akārādikam udāsya kṛtasamaya iti na tasya vyāghātaḥ | upapattyantareṇa vyāpakatayā yaḥ pratīto dharmaḥ tatraiva nāśavat pratyakṣavyāpāra eva tu svodayasamayaparisphurad ākārādisādṛśyam apekṣate, deśādikṛtabhede tu vaisadṛśyāvasāya iti na virodhaḥ |
analyzed: sa hi saṅkalpa niveśini udaya artham apekṣita para vyāpāra mātre arthe akāra ādikam udāsya kṛta samayaḥ iti na tasya vyāghātaḥ upapatti antareṇa vyāpaka tayā yaḥ pratītaḥ dharmaḥ tatra eva nāśa vat pratyakṣa vyāpāraḥ eva tu sva udaya samaya parisphurat ākāra ādi sādṛśyam apekṣate deśa ādi kṛta bhede tu vaisadṛśya avasāyaḥ iti na virodhaḥ

original: tasmād ekakāravirahāt (ekakāraṇavirahāt) pratyekaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhāpekṣāyām etāni vastūni etat kāraṇānugāmīnīty anenaivākāreṇa vyāptiniścayaḥ kāryaḥ | kevalam adyāpi na vyaktikārtsnyenopayoga iti sarvakāryaprakāreṣv ekaikaviṣayo 'vatiṣṭhate | sa cāśakyaḥ kramayaugapadyābhyām ayogāt |
analyzed: tasmāt eka kāra virahāt eka kāraṇa virahāt pratyekam pratyakṣa anupalambha apekṣāyām etāni vastūni etat kāraṇa anugāmīni iti anena eva ākāreṇa vyāpti niścayaḥ kāryaḥ kevalam adya api na vyakti kārtsnyena upayogaḥ iti sarva kārya prakāreṣu ekaika viṣayaḥ vatiṣṭhate sa ca aśakyaḥ krama yaugapadyābhyām ayogāt

original: tathā hi na tāvat sakṛd eva teṣām anvayaḥ, sarvaprakāropanipāte darśanasya draṣṭur evāntardhānaprāpteḥ | vyatireko vā śakyaniścayaḥ, aśakyaparihāratvāt keṣāñcid ādhārālokaśarīrādīnām |
analyzed: tathā hi na tāvat sakṛt eva teṣām anvayaḥ sarva prakāra upanipāte darśanasya draṣṭuḥ eva antardhāna prāpteḥ vyatirekaḥ vā śakya niścayaḥ aśakya parihāra tvāt keṣāñcid ādhāra āloka śarīra ādīnām

original: nāpy ekena narāyuṣā kṣamam idaṃ sarvaprakārekṣaṇaṃ kāryasyāntaviyogataḥ katipayāpekṣāsu kārtsnyaṃ kutaḥ ?
analyzed: nā api ekena nara āyuṣā kṣamam idam sarva prakāra īkṣaṇam kāryasya anta viyogataḥ katipaya apekṣāsu kārtsnyam kutas

original: na khalu bhūyaso 'pi bhāg asyābhividhibodhe nivṛttiḥ, na hi tad api yad yat kāryaṃ tat tad evam iti śakyam abhidhātum, etāvad iti tu syāt |
analyzed: na khalu bhāj asya abhividhi bodhe nivṛttiḥ na hi tat api yat yat kāryam tat tat evam iti śakyam abhidhātum etāvat iti tu syāt

original: yat punar ekatra pravṛtto vicāraḥ sarvabhāvāṃs tathābhāve vyavasthāpayatīty ucyate, tat sādhāraṇākārapravṛttim adhikṛtyākṛtyādivyudāsena pramāṇāntarāvalambanāt | pratyakṣavyāpāra eva hy ekajātigrahaniyama uktaḥ | nanu tatrāpy avāntarānekabhedasaṃbhavād ayam evam ity abhidhātum aśakter anāśvāsaḥ |
analyzed: yat punar ekatra pravṛttaḥ vicāraḥ sarva bhāvān tathā abhāve vyavasthāpayati iti ucyate tat sādhāraṇa ākāra pravṛttim adhikṛtya ākṛti ādi vyudāsena pramāṇa antara avalambanāt pratyakṣa vyāpāraḥ eva hi eka jāti graha niyamaḥ uktaḥ nanu tatra api avāntara aneka bheda saṃbhavāt ayam evam iti abhidhātum aśakteḥ anāśvāsaḥ

original: atra vā bhedatiraskāreṇa dhūmādijātyantaram avalambya saṃvyavahāre kāryatām āśritya jātyantareṣv api kīdṛśo doṣa iti cet? na vayaṃ svecchayā kañcid bhedaṃ tiraskurmaḥ, puraskurmo vā kām api jātim | adhyakṣapūṛvakas tu saṃkalpo yathā arthān upasthāpayati bhedenābhedena vā, tathā hetuphalabhāvavyavahāram avatarāmaḥ |
analyzed: atra vā bheda tiraskāreṇa dhūma ādi jāti antaram avalambya saṃvyavahāre kārya tām āśritya jāti antareṣu api kīdṛśaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced na vayam sva icchayā kañcid bhedam tiraskurmaḥ puraskurmaḥ vā kām api jātim tu saṃkalpaḥ yathā arthān upasthāpayati bhedena abhedena vā tathā hetu phala bhāva vyavahāram avatarāmaḥ

original: sa tu 	[296] prakṛtiviśeṣam āsādya yadi sūkṣmasthūlabhāvena bhedeṣv abhibhūtisāmarthyāsāmarthyābhyāṃ bhinatti vṛttim, kim atra kaiścit kartavyaṃ (kecid iti mātṛkāyām) tadvivartas tu cintyaḥ | tatra,
analyzed: sa tu prakṛti viśeṣam āsādya yadi sūkṣma sthūla bhāvena bhedeṣu abhibhūti sāmarthya asāmarthyābhyām bhinatti vṛttim kim atra kaiścid kartavyam kecid iti mātṛkāyām tad vivartaḥ tu cintyaḥ tatra

original: dhūmo 'vāntarabhedavaty api yathā jātyantarāpohitaṃ
analyzed: dhūmaḥ vā antarabhedavati api yathā jāti antara apohitam

original: sārūpyaṃ viṣayīkaroti hṛdayaṃ kiṃ kāryamātre tathā ||
analyzed: sārūpyam viṣayīkaroti hṛdayam kim kārya mātre tathā

original: ekasaṃsthānādyanugamānanugamayoḥ, pratyātmavedyatvāt nāparam atra prārthyate nirṇayanibandhanam, anyathā ca vyapadeśārthakriyāviniyogādisaṃkaraprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: eka saṃsthāna ādi anugama ananugamayoḥ pratyātma vedya tvāt na aparam atra prārthyate nirṇaya nibandhanam anyathā ca vyapadeśa artha kriyā viniyoga ādi saṃkara prasaṅgaḥ

original: tasmān na kvacit kāraṇe sarvakāryaprakāraṇāṃ krameṇa yaogapadyena vā adhyakṣānupalambhasaṃbhavā vyāptir upapādayituṃ śakyeti kim ābhyām? ata evaṃ mukhena sarvakāryavyāptivādinaḥ svabhiprāyanivedanamātram etad, vartmani sthāṇūpadeśaghoṣaṇavat | tathā ca sati icchāmātraṃ sādhanam astv iti sphuṭam anayor apārthakatvam |
analyzed: tasmāt na kvacid kāraṇe sarva kārya prakāraṇām krameṇa yaogapadyena vā adhyakṣa anupalambha saṃbhavā vyāptiḥ upapādayitum śakyā iti kim ābhyām atas evam mukhena sarva kārya vyāpti vādinaḥ su abhiprāya nivedana mātram etat vartmani sthāṇu upadeśa ghoṣaṇa vat tathā ca sati icchā mātram sādhanam astu iti sphuṭam anayoḥ apārthaka tvam

original: tasmād ābhyām ata idam iti matiḥ kāryāntaravyavacchedenaiva bhavantī na kāryamātragocarīkaraṇasaṃvādam āsādayati | tato niścayam upādānādivido 'panudan nāha
analyzed: tasmāt ābhyām atas idam iti matiḥ kārya antara vyavacchedena eva bhavantī na kārya mātra gocarīkaraṇa saṃvādam āsādayati tatas niścayam upādāna ādi vidaḥ upanudan na āha

original: saṃśayo 'thaveti ||
analyzed: saṃśayaḥ thavā iti

original: pareṣṭasiddhir na parasya bādhane prasādhane vedanatnamātrayoḥ (vedanayatnamātrayoṛ) |
analyzed: para iṣṭa siddhiḥ na parasya bādhane prasādhane veda na tna mātrayoḥ vedana yatna mātrayoḥ

original: ananvayo 'bhīṣṭaviśeṣasādhane vipakṣasandehasahaṃ tu sādhanam ||
analyzed: ananvayaḥ bhīṣṭa viśeṣa sādhane vipakṣa sandeha saham tu sādhanam

original: sādhye ca dṛśye vyabhicāra eva dṛśyaṃ na cen na vyatirekasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: sādhye ca dṛśye vyabhicāraḥ eva dṛśyam na ced na vyatireka siddhiḥ

original: na cānvaye 'pi vyatirekavad vā vyāptir viśeṣeṇa na cetarasya ||
analyzed: na ca anvaye vyatireka vat vā vyāptiḥ viśeṣeṇa na ca itarasya

original: || dvitīyaḥ khaṇṭaḥ ||
analyzed: dvitīyaḥ khaṇṭaḥ

original: [297] evaṃ sati saty api vyāptir aśakyaniścayā saṃbhāvyata iti kim atra sāmpratam iti cet? paśya,
analyzed: evam sati sati api vyāptiḥ aśakya niścayā saṃbhāvyate iti kim atra sāmpratam iti ced paśya

original: kāryaṃ tāvad anekajāti, janakaścaiko jaṭo vīkṣyate nānābhedavato na caikaniyamajñāne 'nyabhede 'pi tat |
analyzed: kāryam tāvat aneka jāti janakaḥ ca ekaḥ jaṭaḥ vīkṣyate nānā bhedavataḥ na ca eka niyama jñāne tat

original: yadyajjātikam ekahetuviditaṃ tattattadaṅgaṃ tato naivaṃ ced atisañjanaṃ na ca mataḥ sādhyopame 'yannayaḥ || na hi nānāprakārakāryajananaṃ nāma prayatnavaty eva niyatam, vahnyāder api vividhasāmagrīmadhyamadhyāsīnasya dhūmabhasmāṅgārāṅgatāpapākapāratsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtivicitrakāryakriyādarśanāt
analyzed: yat yad jātikam eka hetu viditam tat tat tad aṅgam tatas na evam ced ati sañjanam na ca mataḥ sādhyopame yat nayaḥ na hi nānā prakāra kārya jananam nāma prayatnavati eva niyatam vahni ādeḥ api vividha sāmagrī madhyam adhyāsīnasya dhūma bhasma aṅgāra aṅga tāpa pāka pāra tsāraṇa vīkṣaṇa kṣati prabhṛti vicitra kārya kriyā darśanāt

original: (dhūmabhasmāṅgārāṅgatāpapākapāradotsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtivicitrakāryakriyādarśanāt) | yadi paraṃ prayatnavato 'dhiṣṭhānenety atra vivādaḥ, na caikasya tatra niyame jñāte kāryāntare 'pi niyamajñānam upapadyate, yathoktaṃ prāk | tato yāvantaḥ prakārā ekahetavo niścitāḥ, tāvantas tasya hetoścetanasyetarasya vā sādhanaṃ yujyante |
analyzed: dhūma bhasma aṅgāra aṅga tāpa pāka pārada utsāraṇa vīkṣaṇa kṣati prabhṛti vicitra kārya kriyā darśanāt yadi param prayatnavataḥ dhiṣṭhānena iti atra vivādaḥ na ca ekasya tatra niyame jñāte kārya antare niyama jñānam upapadyate yathoktam prāk tatas yāvantaḥ prakārāḥ eka hetavaḥ niścitāḥ tāvantaḥ tasya hetoḥ cetanasya itarasya vā sādhanam yujyante

original: anyathā stimitendhanasakhena śikhinā gṛhītadhūmavyāptir aparicitatatkāryabhāvair bhasmādibhir api dahanam anuminuyāt | na caivaṃ, tasmāt tajjātibhedo vyakti vyāptigrahaś ca pṛthak pṛthagapekṣyamāṇo yatra kvacit tadgrahaṇena yena kenacid anumānam unmūlayati |
analyzed: anyathā stimita indhana sakhena śikhinā gṛhīta dhūma vyāptiḥ aparicita tad kārya bhāvaiḥ bhasma ādibhiḥ api dahanam anuminuyāt na ca evam tasmāt tad jāti bhedaḥ vyakti vyāpti grahaḥ ca pṛthak pṛthak apekṣyamāṇaḥ yatra kvacid tad grahaṇena yena kenacid anumānam unmūlayati

original: kaḥ punar evam āha, yatra kvacid gṛhītavyāptir yena kenacid anumimītām iti, ekadharmānuvṛttivirahe hetor evābhāvāt? na hi tadā bhasmasādhanam avyāpteḥ | nāpi dhūmo 'siddheḥ | kuṭakūṭādau kāryatvam evānyadharmānanuvṛttāv apy anumāne vartamānaṃ hetuḥ syād iti cet, na, kāryatvasyāpi prāgavyāpter vistareṇa sādhanāt |
analyzed: kaḥ punar evam āha yatra kvacid gṛhīta vyāptiḥ yena kenacid anumimītām iti eka dharma anuvṛtti virahe hetoḥ eva abhāvāt na hi tadā bhasma sādhanam avyāpteḥ na api siddheḥ kuṭa kūṭa ādau kāryatvam eva anya dharma ananuvṛttau api anumāne vartamānam hetuḥ syāt iti ced na kāryatvasya api prāk avyāpteḥ vistareṇa sādhanāt

original: tatra yathā kulagiriḥ kulālavyāpārakāle svabhāvavaikalyādikalitaniyamah, tathā sad api kāryatvaṃ prāmāṇyapravṛttyā dhūmajanmanīva rāsabha iti pramāṇena vyāptigrahavirahe na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | tad ayaṃ ghaṭādau kāryaviśeṣe gṛhītavyāptiḥ sarvato na kāryatāmātreṇa vā vyāpakam anumātu |
analyzed: tatra yathā kula giriḥ kulāla vyāpāra kāle svabhāva vaikalya ādi kalita niyamaḥ tathā sat api kāryatvam prāmāṇya pravṛttyā dhūma janmani iva rāsabhaḥ iti pramāṇena vyāpti graha virahe na kaścid viśeṣaḥ tat ayam ghaṭa ādau kārya viśeṣe gṛhīta vyāptiḥ sarvatas na kāryatā mātreṇa vā vyāpakam anumātu

original: na tu vyāptigrahaṇasādhanavyavasthayor bhinnādhikaraṇatām atikrāmatīti katham atiprasaṅgopālambhaparihāraḥ?
analyzed: na tu vyāpti grahaṇa sādhana vyavasthayoḥ bhinna adhikaraṇa tām atikrāmati iti katham atiprasaṅga upālambha parihāraḥ

original: tasmān naikadharmānuvṛttimātreṇopayogaḥ | kena vā dhūmasaṃbhavinaḥ kāryatvavastutvādayo bhasmani bhasmasād eva kṛtāḥ? santo 'pi vyabhicāriṇa iti cet? nanu savyabhicāro vyāptiviyogād eva, vyāptau tadgandhasyābhāvāt | sa ca vyāpty abhāvaḥ kāryatvenāpi arjita (avarjita) iti tatrāpi vyabhicāro durnivāraḥ | āhaty ādarśanaṃ tu viprakarṣād api syāt |
analyzed: tasmāt na eka dharma anuvṛtti mātreṇa upayogaḥ kena vā dhūma saṃbhavinaḥ kāryatva vastu tva ādayaḥ bhasmani bhasmasāt eva kṛtāḥ vyabhicāriṇaḥ iti ced nanu savyabhicāraḥ vyāpti viyogāt eva vyāptau tad gandhasya abhāvāt sa ca vyāptī abhāvaḥ kāryatvena api arjitaḥ avarjitaḥ iti tatra api vyabhicāraḥ durnivāraḥ āhati ādarśanam tu viprakarṣāt api syāt

original: [298] na tāvatā tadabhāva eva, tanmūlabhūtāyā avyāptes tādavasthyāt | yadi tu vyāptāv eva savyabhicāraḥ, tadā nitarāmavyāptāv ity alaṃ mithyābhiniveśena | tad yady api sādhāraṇadharmā tanmātraṃ vyāptim anādṛtya sādhanam iṣyate, kiṃ na bhinna evaṃ bhūdharādisādhāraṇaṃ dharmam, anādṛtyety atiprasaṅgas tadavasthaḥ?
analyzed: na tāvatā tad abhāvaḥ eva tad mūla bhūtāyāḥ avyāpteḥ tādavasthyāt yadi tu vyāptau eva savyabhicāraḥ tadā nitarām avyāptau iti alam mithyā abhiniveśena tat yadi api sādhāraṇa dharmā tad mātram vyāptim an ādṛtya sādhanam iṣyate kim na bhinnaḥ evam bhūdhara ādi sādhāraṇam dharmam an ādṛtya iti atiprasaṅgaḥ tad avasthaḥ

original: nāpy ayaṃ nayaḥ sādhyasamānīkṛte kalasādāv apy asti, tatrāpi yathāyathā pratisaraśarābodañcanādiṣu kumbhakārakṛtim upalabhāmahe, tathātathaivam apīdam apy anena sujyata iti pratiyantaḥ paricitakriyebhya eva prakārebhyas tadvyāpāram avadhārayāmaḥ, anyathā taddoṣānativṛttiḥ |
analyzed: nā api ayam nayaḥ sādhya samānīkṛte kalasa ādau api asti tatra api yathā yathā pratisara śarāba udañcana ādiṣu kumbhakāra kṛtim upalabhāmahe tathā tathā evam api idam api anena sujyate iti pratiyantaḥ paricita kriyebhyaḥ eva prakārebhyaḥ tad vyāpāram avadhārayāmaḥ anyathā tad doṣa anativṛttiḥ

original: tasmād yadi paramārthataḥ prayatnavannāntarīyaka evāyaṃ sakalaprakāraḥ kāryagrāmaḥ, tathāpi svayam akiñcitkara iti pramāṇavṛttyapekṣayā,
analyzed: tasmāt yadi paramārthataḥ prayatna vat nāntarīyakaḥ eva ayam sakala prakāraḥ kārya grāmaḥ tathā api svayam akiñcitkaraḥ iti pramāṇa vṛtti apekṣayā

original: siddhaṃ yādṛg adhiṣṭhātḥ bhāvābhāvānuvṛttimat |
analyzed: siddham yādṛś adhiṣṭhātḥ bhāva abhāva anuvṛttimat

original: sanniveśādi tadyuktaṃ tasmād yad anumīyate || (PV II 13)
analyzed: sanniveśa ādi tat yuktam tasmāt yat anumīyate

original: iti || yaddṛṣṭer akriyādarśino 'pi kṛtabuddhir bhavati, śūnyanagaraparidṛṣṭadevakulādivat sanniveśādi,
analyzed: iti yat dṛṣṭeḥ akriyā darśinaḥ u pi kṛtabuddhiḥ bhavati śūnya nagara paridṛṣṭa devakula ādi vat sanniveśa ādi

original: tādṛg eva yadīkṣyeta tannagādiṣu dharmiṣu |
analyzed: tādṛś eva yadi īkṣyeta tat naga ādiṣu dharmiṣu

original: yuktaṃ tatsādhanād asmād yathābhīṣṭasya sādhanam ||
analyzed: yuktam tad sādhanāt asmāt yathā abhīṣṭasya sādhanam

original: tac cāsiddhim ity ākūtam |
analyzed: tat ca asiddhim iti ākūtam

original: nanu bhavaty evāsmākaṃ sarvatra pauruṣeyabuddhiḥ, kṛtabuddhiḥ sā, sādhyabuddhir evānumānam iti niyamaḥ, kathañcit kasyacit tatrāpy abhāvāt | kiṃ ca kṛtabuddhir iti kāryamātrabuddhir vā, puruṣamātrabuddhir vā? yadi kṛtamātrabuddhiḥ, sā bauddasyāpi siddhā sindhubhūdharādiṣu | sāvayavatvāc ca tadārambhasaṃbhavitvam eva kṛtatvam |
analyzed: nanu bhavati eva asmākam sarvatra pauruṣeya buddhiḥ kṛta buddhiḥ sā sādhya buddhiḥ eva anumānam iti niyamaḥ kathañcid kasyacid tatra api abhāvāt kim ca kṛta buddhiḥ iti kārya mātra buddhiḥ vā puruṣa mātra buddhiḥ vā yadi kṛta mātra buddhiḥ sā bauddasya api siddhā sindhu bhūdhara ādiṣu sāvayava tvāt ca tad ārambha saṃbhavi tvam eva kṛta tvam

original: atha pauruṣeyabuddhiḥ kṛtabuddhiḥ? sā sādhyabuddhir evānumānam iti cocyate, tatas tadabhāvān nānumānam iti katham ucyamānaṃ nopaplavate ?
analyzed: atha pauruṣeya buddhiḥ kṛta buddhiḥ sā sādhya buddhiḥ evā anumānam iti ca ucyate tatas tad abhāvāt na anumānam iti katham ucyamānam na upaplavate

original: yadāha, na ca vyāmohāt kasyacit sādhyabuddhyabhāve hetor asiddhatādoṣaḥ, sarvānumāneṣu tadbhāvaprasaṅgād iti | yad apīdam ucyate, tādṛkkāryatvādi niṣiddham acalādiṣv iti,
analyzed: yat āha na ca vyāmohāt kasyacid sādhya buddhi abhāve hetoḥ asiddha tā doṣaḥ sarva anumāneṣu tad bhāva prasaṅgāt iti yat api idam ucyate tādṛś kārya tva ādi niṣiddham acala ādiṣu iti

original: vyāptigrahaṇasmaraṇayor aparādhe tu neyam iṣṭasiddhiḥ | tadarthaṃ yathāvad grahaṇam | tatra smaraṇāparādhe devakulāntarād api nānumimīta, grahaṇāparādho 'pi pratyakṣāpekṣayā 'saṃbhāvī, ekapratyavamarśayogyatāyā evābhāvād ity ukteḥ | anyathā jaladharādyarthino 'pi kumbhakārasūtradhārādīnapekṣeran |

original: apekṣata eva tatrāpi sūtradhārasthānīyo 'nyo yathā kumbhakārasthānīyaḥ kvacit sūtradhāra iti cet, na, kāryajātivaisadṛśyābhāve kāraṇasāmarthyavaisadṛśyāpekṣānupapatteḥ | anyathā kumbhāntare 'pi na kulālamātreṇa toṣam aśnuvīta |

original: tadvad vā kṛṣīvalaḥ kulālapauruṣāpaneyānāvṛṣṭikaṣṭaḥ syād iti siddha eva tādṛśo jātibhedaḥ, tasmād ekākārapratyavamarśāśnupapatter adhyakṣasādhyā vyāptir viśiṣṭaviṣayatayā na durgrahadoṣam āvahati, yato 'numānābhāve 'pi jātibhedātiśayasyāsiddheḥ siddhasādhanadoṣaḥ syāt |

original: kumbhakārādyavasthāniyatena tena nāyaṃ prasaṅga iti cet? tadavasthāniyatenaiva vyāptigrahe kīdṛśo doṣa iti kim atra vaktavyam? na ca samayāpakṣālakalāṅkitadhiyaṃ bhavantaṃ prati kācic cintā, api tu lokaṃ prati | so 'pi vyabhicārān na tena pratipadyate iti cet? evaṃ tarhi kalasāntarād api nānumānam ayaṃ kuryāt |

original: niyatajātikam iti kalasāntaram apy āskandet | tathā ca sati sa eva doṣaḥ | vyāptigrāhiṇaiva

original: ubhayor niyataviṣayatve tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ | kevalam idānīm adhyakṣeṇa viśiṣṭaviṣayasvīkārān na vyabhicāropanyāsaḥ saphalaḥ | vyāptigrāhiṇas tu pramāṇasya viśiṣṭaviṣayapravṛttismaraṇādhānārtham upayujyante mūṭhaṃ prati | na tu parito visāriṇī vyāptigṛhītarasya niyataviṣayā kriyate vyabhicāreṇa | nāpy anumānakhaṇṭanamātram uktanyāyād eva |

original: tasmād viśiṣṭaviṣayaiva vyāptiḥ kumbhakārādinā gṛhyate vyabhicāradarśanādarśanāpekṣyapratyakṣasyaikajātyapekṣayaiva pravṛtter iti siddham |
analyzed: tasmāt viśiṣṭa viṣayā eva vyāptiḥ kumbhakāra ādinā gṛhyate vyabhicāra darśana adarśana apekṣya pratyakṣasya eka jāti apekṣayā eva pravṛtteḥ iti siddham

original: evaṃ cetanamātreṇāpi vyāptijighṛkṣāyāṃ vyabhicāro darśanābhāvāt yajjātini vastuni pratyakṣapravṛttis tad eva tena vyāptam sidhyatīty api siddham | tat kathaṃ sāmānyena vyāptim abhidadhānaḥ samayānuvādamātreṇa nopālambham arhati? yadi tu puruṣamātreṇa vyāptiṃ jighṛkṣor adhyakṣapratikṣepeṇa pramāṇāntaraṃ śaraṇam, tadā naiṣa doṣaḥ |

original: tat tu vicāritam | yadi veśvaraprasādād asya vādino jagataś citrākāraparihāreṇa sarvatraikākāraṃ pratyakṣam udayam āsādayati, taccāsādhāraṇam iti na vyavahārāṅgam |

original: saśarīrāśarīrayoḥ prayatnavator na kaścid viśeṣaḥ karmadharmāpekṣayā pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaṇe, yato jaladharārthinā kumbhakārānanusaraṇena tatkṛtānumānavirahānumāne prakārāntareṇāpi saṃbhāvanāyāṃ jātibhedaikanibandhanāpratibandhāt siddhasādhanaṃ punar apy āsajyeta |

original: tato jātibhedakṛtas tatrānumānābhāvaḥ saṃsidhyan pratiniyatajātipratibaddham anumānam upapādayati |

original: viśiṣṭajātipratibaddhapauruṣeyānumānāsiddhau vā anubhavasiddham api jātibhedaṃ śāṭhyād apahnuvānaḥ paralokasya jātibhedānantarīyakeṇa tathā pravṛttyabhāvasiddhena kulālādikṛtatvānumānābhāvena | anyathānumānodayaṃ prasajya jātibhedam āpādyate, yathā sthāṇukākābhyāṃ bhinnaḥ saṃyogo nāma yadi syād dṛśyo loko 'py enaṃ tṛtīyam īkṣeteti ucyate |

original: tathā ca yadi yādṛśaḥ sanniveśo buddhimatpūrvako dṛṣṭas tādṛg eva jaladharādāv api syāt, lokasyāpi puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ syāt, ghaṭāntaravat |

analyzed: dharmottare pi hi mate sva lakṣaṇam adhyavaseyam iti sthitiḥ

original: [332,21] nanu vahniḥ pratīto mayety adhyavasāyākāraḥ | tatra ca svalakṣaṇasphuraṇam iti sāhasam, vikalpādhyavasāyayor ekārthatvāt | satyam, na tu tatra sphuratīti tāvatā svalakṣaṇam adhyavasitam ucyate | aphuraṇe tarhy abodhāt katham avsāyaḥ? sphraṇe 'pi pratibhāsa evāsau, katham adhyavasāyaḥ? na ca pratibhāsādhyavasāyāv apy ekārthau |
analyzed: nanu vahniḥ pratītaḥ mayā iti adhyavasāya ākāraḥ tatra ca sva lakṣaṇa sphuraṇam iti sāhasam vikalpa adhyavasāyayoḥ ekārtha tvāt satyam na tu tatra sphurati iti tāvatā sva lakṣaṇam adhyavasitam ucyate tarhi abodhāt katham sphraṇe pratibhāsaḥ eva asau katham adhyavasāyaḥ na ca pratibhāsa adhyavasāyau api ekārthau

original: pratibhāso hi sākṣātsphuraṇam asphuraṇe 'pi pravṛttiviṣayīkaraṇam ekavyāvṛtyullekhasāmarthyād adhyavasāyo bhāṣyamataḥ | ato yad anurūpam anuṣṭhānaṃ tad adhyavaseyam, pratibhāsamānarūpān anuprativiṣṭam eva | tac ca kvacid āropitamātram | kvacid vasturūpam |
analyzed: pratibhāsaḥ hi sākṣāt sphuraṇam asphuraṇe pi pravṛtti viṣayīkaraṇam eka vyāvṛti ullekha sāmarthyāt adhyavasāyaḥ bhāṣyam atas atas yat anurūpam anuṣṭhānam tat adhyavaseyam pratibhāsamāna rūpān anuprativiṣṭam eva tat ca kvacid āropita mātram kvacid vastu rūpam

original: prakṛtaṃ tu pramāṇavyāpārasvīkārād vasturūpam eveti katham ucyate nivṛttimātram avastu vādhyavaseyam ity āstāṃ tāvad anārabdhanirbandhaḥ | pratibhāso 'pi vikalpe vyāvṛttākārasya, na vyāvṛttimātrasya, yady anubhavānusāraḥ | sarvadā yad vā tad vā rākṣasādi pratibhāseta |
analyzed: prakṛtam tu pramāṇa vyāpāra svīkārāt vastu rūpam eva iti katham ucyate nivṛtti mātram avastu vā adhyavaseyam iti āstām tāvat anārabdha nirbandhaḥ vikalpe vyāvṛtta ākārasya na vyāvṛtti mātrasya yadi anubhava anusāraḥ sarvadā yat vā tat vā rākṣasa ādi pratibhāseta

original: bhāvanayā punar adhyavasitākāreṇa pariṇitiḥ abādhyā tatrāropitamātre 'dhyavaseye nirālambanatvam | sati tu tad evālambanaṃ yathānantaram uktam ||
analyzed: bhāvanayā punar adhyavasita ākāreṇa pariṇitiḥ abādhyā tatra āropita mātre dhyavaseye nirālambana tvam sati tu tat eva ālambanam yathā anantaram uktam

original: [333,5] yat tv āha, arthasyālambanapratyayatvaṃ vijñānaṃ pratīndriyāpekṣatvena vyāptam | tac cāsmāt svaviruddhopalabdhyā nivartamānam ālambanapratyayatvam apy arthasya nivartayatīti, tatrālambanapratyayatvendriyāpekṣatvayor vyāpyakabhāvam aprasādhya pramāṇena vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiṃ sphuṭayatīti mahadvaidagdhyam |
analyzed: yat tu āha arthasya ālambana pratyaya tvam vijñānam prati indriya apekṣa tvena vyāptam tat ca asmāt sva viruddha upalabdhyā nivartamānam ālambana pratyaya tvam api arthasya nivartayati iti tatra ālambana pratyaya tva indriya apekṣa tvayoḥ vyāpyaka bhāvam a prasādhya pramāṇena vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhim sphuṭayati iti mahat vaidagdhyam

original: tathā darsanād iti cet? darśanādarśnam eva tarhi pramaṇīkṛtya sthīyatām, kim evaṃvidhapramāṇopanyāsavyasanena? tasmād indriyam anapekṣyāpi yady ālambanabhāvaṃ bhāvaḥ svīkuryāt na bādhakam utpaśyāmaḥ | athātroktam eva na khalv indhanaviśeṣo dhūmahetur iti vināpi dahanaṃ sahasrteṇāpi saṃskārair dhūmam ādhatte |
analyzed: tathā darsanāt iti ced darśana adarśnam eva tarhi pramaṇīkṛtya sthīyatām kim evaṃvidha pramāṇa upanyāsa vyasanena tasmāt indriyam an apekṣya api yadi ālambana bhāvam bhāvaḥ svīkuryāt na bādhakam utpaśyāmaḥ atha atra uktam eva na khalu indhana viśeṣaḥ dhūma hetuḥ iti vinā api dahanam sahasrteṇa api saṃskāraiḥ dhūmam ādhatte

original: tadādhāne vā samastakāryahetvanumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāj jñānam apīndriyasāpekṣād arthād utpattidharmakam |
analyzed: tad ādhāne vā samasta kārya hetu anumāna uccheda prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt jñānam api indriya sāpekṣāt arthāt utpatti dharmakam

original: [333,14] indriyavyāpāravirahe ca samastāparakāraṇasannidhāvasannidhīyamānasattākaṃ tatpratibaddhaṃ siddham iti katham indriyānapekṣyasyārthasya svavijñānaṃ pratyālambanabhāva iti cet? etad api paracittajñānasaṃbhavena prativyūṭham | iṣtāś ca paricittavedinaś cārvākamīmāṃsakavyatiriktaiḥ | cārvākāder api sandehān nāparā gatiḥ |
analyzed: indriya vyāpāra virahe ca samasta apara kāraṇa sannidhau asannidhīyamāna sattākam tat pratibaddham siddham iti katham indriya an apekṣyasya arthasya sva vijñānam pratyālambana bhāvaḥ iti ced etat api para citta jñāna saṃbhavena prativyūṭham iṣtāḥ ca cārvāka mīmāṃsaka vyatiriktaiḥ cārvāka ādeḥ api sandehāt na aparā gatiḥ

original: sandehe ca vipakṣād ekāntavyāvṛtter ayogaḥ | nanu jñānakāryasyendriyāpekṣāniyamād eva nānyatra sandeho dahanāpekṣadhūmavat |
analyzed: sandehe ca vipakṣāt ekānta vyāvṛtteḥ ayogaḥ nanu jñāna kāryasya indriya apekṣā niyamāt eva na anyatra sandehaḥ dahana apekṣa dhūma vat

original: yady evaṃ rūpajñānasya vīkṣaṇāpekṣaṇe yādṛśī sāmagrī sā na saṃcaraṇaviśeṣasya caraṇāpekṣaṇe kalayāpi hīyate, tat kathaṃ na dhūmadṛṣṭāntaś caraṇavarihiṇām uragādīnāṃ gamananiṣedhāya prabhur abhūt? kathaṃ vā karādivyāpārasaṅgi sāvegamantrodgāraparamparāsādhyam ekeṣāṃ viṣaśamanādikāryaṃ samādhimātrād anyasya? na caivaṃ dhūmo 'pi kvacid indhane
analyzed: yadi evam rūpa jñānasya vīkṣaṇa apekṣaṇe yādṛśī sāmagrī sā na saṃcaraṇa viśeṣasya caraṇa apekṣaṇe kalayā api hīyate tat katham na dhūma dṛṣṭāntaḥ caraṇa varihiṇām uraga ādīnām gamana niṣedhāya prabhuḥ abhūt katham vā kara ādi vyāpāra saṅgi sa āvega mantra udgāra paramparā sādhyam ekeṣām viṣa śamana ādi kāryam samādhi mātrāt anyasya na ca evam kvacid indhane kvacid indhane kvacid indhane kvacid indhane kvacid indhane kvacid indha

original: dahanānapekṣodayo dṛṣṭo yato 'trāpi tathā śaṅkyeta |
analyzed: dahana anapekṣā udayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā

original: [333,25] tasmād bahirbhuvo bhāvā yathā hetuphalabhāvenopalambhabhājaḥ te tathaiva niyatavṛttayaḥ | cittasantānasya tu vicitrakarmābhisaṃskārasāmarthyād vicitra eva vivartaḥ | atas tadāśrayakāryam ekatra yāvad apekṣaṃ tāvad apekṣam anyatrāpīti na niyantuṃ śakyam |
analyzed: tasmāt bahis bhuvaḥ bhāvāḥ yathā hetu phala bhāvena upalambha bhājaḥ te tathā eva niyata vṛttayaḥ citta santānasya tu vicitra karma abhisaṃskāra sāmarthyāt vicitraḥ eva vivartaḥ atas tad āśraya kāryam ekatra yāvat apekṣam tāvat apekṣam anyatra api iti na niyantum śakyam

original: tat kathaṃ paracittavedanāder abhāva eva? yadi ca dhūmavad analam anapekṣya nendriyaṃ buddhiḥ, tadā svaviṣaye 'py utkarṣaghoṣaṇāvīkṣaṇādīnāṃ dīnaiva syāt | tathā hi yāvad deśaṃ dahanendhanādidhūmādisādhanam upalabdhaṃ na tāvad deśātikrame samartham |
analyzed: tat katham para citta vedanā ādeḥ abhāvaḥ eva yadi ca dhūma vat analam an apekṣya na indriyam buddhiḥ tadā sva viṣaye pi utkarṣa ghoṣaṇa avīkṣaṇa ādīnām dīnā eva syāt tathā hi yāvat deśam dahana indhana ādi dhūma ādi sādhanam upalabdham na tāvat deśa atikrame samartham

original: evaṃ yāvaddeśe 'smākaṃ viṣayendriyādivedanam utpāditavat kathaṃ tadatikrame gṛdhrādīnām utpādayet? utpādane vā nendhanadahanādikakṣāṃ kṣamate cittasantānāśrayā sāmagrī |nāpi dhūmakakṣāṃ buddhiḥ |
analyzed: evam yāvat deśe smākam viṣaya indriya ādi vedanam utpādita vat katham tad atikrame gṛdhra ādīnām utpādayet utpādane vā na indhana dahana ādi kakṣām kṣamate citta santāna āśrayā sāmagrī nā api dhūma kakṣām buddhiḥ

original: [334,4] ataḥ sahakāriṇo 'tivyavadhānavadvaikalye 'pi kiṃ na kutaścit viśeṣāt saṃbhāvyate? jātikṛto 'sau vibhāgaḥ, na cittasantānāśrayād iti cet, na, jātir api hi vicitrakarmādhipatyād eva vicitrasvarūpopasaṃhārasvabhāvā, karma ca na cittād anyad iti na cittāśrayatvaparihāraḥ |
analyzed: atas kim na kutaścid viśeṣāt saṃbhāvyate jāti kṛtaḥ sau vibhāgaḥ na citta santāna āśrayāt iti ced na jātiḥ api hi vicitra karma ādhipatyāt eva vicitra svarūpa upasaṃhāra svabhāvā karma ca na cittāt anyat iti na citta āśraya tva parihāraḥ

original: athendriyasya prāpyakāritayā sarvaiva vijñānajananasāmagrī sādhāraṇadeśety ucyate | tathāpi kasmāt punas tāvad dūradeśasthitim iti kvacillocanaruṭhāṃśaśleṣaḥ kvacid arvāgeva viśrāma iti kim atra vaktavyaṃ karmādhipatyād anyatra? tasmāt tadāśrayasya cittasantānasya citraiva śaktiḥ |
analyzed: atha indriyasya prāpya kāri tayā sarvā eva vijñāna janana sāmagrī sādhāraṇa deśā iti ucyate tathā api kasmāt punar tāvat dūra deśa sthitim iti kvacid locana ruṭha aṃśa śleṣaḥ kvacid arvāk eva viśrāmaḥ iti kim atra vaktavyam karma ādhipatyāt anyatra tasmāt tad āśrayasya citta santānasya citrā eva śaktiḥ

original: [334,11] na hi bahir api śakyam evam | anyathā sadṛśapradeśasthāyinoḥ pradīpayor alpakasya kasyacid dūrasāriṇī kiraṇasaṃhatir itarasya punar arvācīnacāriṇī syāt | atha mantraprabhāvād evam api syāt, sarīsṛpadṛśā ca māndyamādadhātīti cet? sa tarhi cittasantater eva prabhāvaḥ | mantre 'pi puruṣamāhātmyakṛta eva |
analyzed: na hi bahis api śakyam evam anyathā sadṛśa pradeśa sthāyinoḥ pradīpayoḥ alpakasya kasyacid dūra sāriṇī kiraṇa saṃhatiḥ itarasya punar arvācīna cāriṇī syāt atha mantra prabhāvāt evam api syāt sarīsṛpa dṛśā ca māndyam ādadhāti iti ced sa tarhi citta santateḥ eva prabhāvaḥ mantre pi puruṣa māhātmya kṛtaḥ eva

original: yathā vārtike nirṇītam, apauruṣeyatve 'pi mantrāṇāṃ na puruṣanirapekṣāṇāṃ śaktiḥ | tataś ca puruṣa eva mantrādyupāyena bāhyavastuśaktivyavasthāṃ dusthayatīti āyātām iti prastute kim asaṃbhāvanam? yathā ca locanāpekṣaḥ padārthasyālambanabhāvo dṛṣṭa iti tanniyata iṣṭaḥ, tathālokāpekṣo 'pi dṛṣṭa iti na saṃtamase paśyeyur ulūkādayaḥ |
analyzed: yathā vārtike nirṇītam apauruṣeya tve pi mantrāṇām na puruṣa nirapekṣāṇām śaktiḥ tatas ca puruṣaḥ eva mantra ādi upāyena bāhya vastu śakti vyavasthām dusthayati iti āyātām iti prastute kim asaṃbhāvanam yathā ca locana apekṣaḥ padārthasya ālambana bhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti tad niyataḥ iṣṭaḥ tathā āloka apekṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti na saṃtamase paśyeyuḥ ulūka ādayaḥ

original: tathā dṛṣṭatvān na doṣa iti cet? tathā dṛṣṭatvād eva hato 'si | tathā hi netrālokayoḥ samāne 'py apekṣāsādhananyāye cittasyācintyaśaktitayā anyatarollaṅghanadarśanam anyad api śaṅkayā kalaṅkayati | na tv adarśane śakyam evam | atha tādṛśi jñānatvasāmānyavanty api kāryāṇītarajātibhedabhāñjīti nānapekṣya sādhanasāmagrībhedam udiyur ity ucyate |
analyzed: tathā dṛṣṭa tvāt na doṣaḥ iti ced tathā dṛṣṭa tvāt eva tathā hi netra ālokayoḥ samāne pi apekṣā sādhana nyāye cittasya acintya śakti tayā anyatara ullaṅghana darśanam anyat api śaṅkayā kalaṅkayati na tu adarśane śakyam evam atha tādṛśi jñāna tva sāmānyavanti api kāryāṇi itara jāti bheda bhāñji iti na an apekṣya sādhana sāmagrī bhedam udiyuḥ iti ucyate

original: [334,24] kena punaḥ prakṛtajñānasyāpy alaukikasya pṛthagjanajñānena sahaikajātitāyāṃ pratārito 'si? asattvād eva tarhi tasya na jātibheda iti cetasattvam iti jātibhedābhāvād evendriyāpekṣayā niyamasaṃbhavād itītaretarāśrayaḥ |
analyzed: kena punar prakṛta jñānasya api alaukikasya pṛthagjana jñānena saha eka jāti tāyām asattvāt eva tarhi tasya na jāti bhedaḥ iti asattvam eva tarhi tasya na jāti bhedaḥ iti iti jāti bheda abhāvāt eva indriya apekṣayā niyama saṃbhavāt iti itaretarāśrayaḥ

original: tasmāt sādhāraṇakarmanirjātānām asmadādīnām anubhavabhedaṃ pratīndriyāpekṣatvam ālambanatvasya vyāpakam api na svanivṛttyā anubhavamātraṃ prati nirvartakaṃ bhavitum arhati, viśeṣoddeśenaiva vyāptisiddheḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt sādhāraṇa karma nirjātānām asmat ādīnām anubhava bhedam prati indriya apekṣa tvam ālambana tvasya vyāpakam api na sva nivṛttyā anubhava mātram prati nirvartakam bhavitum arhati viśeṣa uddeśena eva vyāpti siddheḥ

original: athānubhavamātram ekīkṛtya vyāptir iṣyate? tadā virpayayādhakābhāvāt vyāptir eva na sidhyati hetuphalaniyamāśrayas tu dhvasto dhūmādisādhāraṇyānupapatter vicitrakarmābhisaṃskārād acintyaśaktisvāntasantānasaṃbhāvino 'nubhavamātrasya | viśeṣāśraye ca na sarvopasaṃhāravatī vyāptir iti sa eva doṣo viśeṣavattvaṃ nāma |
analyzed: atha anubhava mātram ekīkṛtya vyāptiḥ iṣyate tadā vyāptiḥ eva na sidhyati hetu phala niyama āśrayaḥ tu dhvastaḥ dhūma ādi sādhāraṇya anupapatteḥ vicitra karma abhisaṃskārāt acintya śakti svānta santāna saṃbhāvinaḥ nubhava mātrasya viśeṣa āśraye ca na sarva upasaṃhāravatī vyāptiḥ iti saḥ eva doṣaḥ viśeṣavat tvam nāma

original: [335,4] yad apy ayam āha, bhāvanāyās cābhūtārthāyā arthānapekṣāyā eva viśadajñānajananasāmarthyam upalabdhaṃ kāmāturādivartinyā iti bhūtārthāpi tannirapekṣaiva samartheti nārthasya ālambanapratyayatvaṃ śakyāvagaman iti |
analyzed: yat api ayam āha bhāvanāyāḥ ca abhūta arthāyāḥ artha anapekṣāyāḥ eva viśada jñāna janana sāmarthyam upalabdham kāma ātura ādi vartinyāḥ iti bhūtārthā api tad nirapekṣā eva samarthā iti na arthasya ālambana pratyaya tvam śakya avagamān iti

original: tatrāpi keyam arhtanirapekṣatā? kim arthāviṣayatvaṃ sākṣādarthāpratibhāso vā, yad vā arthāhetutvam athārthavyabhicāra iti pakṣāḥ | prathamapakṣe bhūtārthatvam aviṣayatvaṃ ceti vyāhatam, tatprabhavānumānasyeva tasyāpy adhyavasāyāpekṣayā tadviṣayatvāt |
analyzed: tatra api kā iyam arhta nirapekṣa tā kim artha aviṣaya tvam sākṣāt artha apratibhāsaḥ vā yat vā artha ahetutvam atha artha vyabhicāraḥ iti pakṣāḥ prathama pakṣe bhūta artha tvam aviṣaya tvam ca iti vyāhatam tad prabhava anumānasya iva tasya api adhyavasāya apekṣayā tad viṣaya tvāt

original: pratibhāsāpekṣayā tu mā bhūt tadviṣayatvaṃ tasyās tajjanitajñānasyaiva tadiṣṭer iti na dvitīyo 'pi pakṣaḥ | tṛtīyo 'saṃbhavī, svaprabhavānumānadvāreṇa tasyāpi bhūtārthakāryatvāt | ata eva vyabhicāro 'pi siddha iti na carurthaḥ |
analyzed: pratibhāsa apekṣayā tu mā bhūt tad viṣaya tvam tasyāḥ tad janita jñānasya eva tad iṣṭeḥ iti na dvitīyaḥ pi pakṣaḥ tṛtīyaḥ saṃbhavī sva prabhava anumāna dvāreṇa tasya api bhūtārtha kāryatvāt atas eva vyabhicāraḥ pi siddhaḥ iti na carurthaḥ

original: atas tajjaviśadajñānasya saṃvādaniyamād arthasya katham ālambanatvam aśakyāvagamam? tasmāt prācīnarītyaiva codyaṃ cāru, parihāraś cokta eva |
analyzed: atas tad ja viśada jñānasya saṃvāda niyamāt arthasya katham ālambana tvam aśakya avagamam tasmāt prācīna rītyā eva codyam cāru parihāraḥ ca uktaḥ eva

original: [335,14] yac cānena punas tāttanā evāsya viṣayakṣaṇā grāhyā yujyante na pūrvatarā itādinā bhūtānāgatabodhiniṣedhāya prayattaṃ, tat prāg eva pratyādiṣṭam | prakṛtasarvajñapakṣe tu yāvanto jñānam upajanayantaḥ svajñānagocaratām anubhavanti tāvantaḥ kṣaṇikaduṛkhānātmākāreṇaivety etāvataiva sādhyasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: yat ca anena punar tāttanāḥ eva asya viṣaya kṣaṇāḥ grāhyāḥ yujyante na pūrvatarāḥ iti ādinā bhūta anāgata bodhi niṣedhāya prayattam tat prāk eva pratyādiṣṭam prakṛta sarvajña pakṣe tu yāvantaḥ jñānam upajanayantaḥ sva jñāna gocara tām anubhavanti tāvantaḥ kṣaṇika duḥkha anātma ākāreṇa eva iti etāvatā eva sādhya siddhiḥ

original: pratītātīteṣu smaraṇaṃ bhāvini saṃbhāvaneveti | yady atīte smaraṇam eva, tat kathaṃ samudayākārāṇāṃ sphuṭībhāva iti cet? pañcaskandhā evottarāpekṣayā samudayaḥ | tatrāyam eva samudayākārasphuṭībhāvo yadabhimukhībhūteṣu parāpekṣayā jhagati tadanurūpavikalpānuṣṭhānādiprasavahetuḥ sphuraṇarītiḥ kācit, yayā pṛthagjanād vibhāgabhāgī bhavati pūrvavat |

original: tasmād abhūtaviṣayād abhyāsān nirvikalpakam api saṃvādān na pramāṇam iti, tad api dhvastam, samāropitabhāvanāyā evābhāvāt |

original: [339,6] yathā hi tanayas tanaya iti vikalpābhyāsas tathā yadi samāropitaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ samāropitaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti vikalpaḥ, tadā samāropitakṣaṇikabhāvanā bhavet, na caivam | kiṃ tu kṣaṇikāḥ saṃskārā iti | tataḥ satyatanayavad vāstavam eva kṣaṇikatvaṃ bhāvyate | satyatanayabhāvanāyā vā anya ākāro vaktavyaḥ |
analyzed: yathā hi tanayaḥ tanayaḥ iti vikalpa abhyāsaḥ tathā yadi samāropitam kṣaṇika tvam samāropitam kṣaṇika tvam iti vikalpaḥ tadā samāropita kṣaṇika bhāvanā bhavet na ca evam kim tu kṣaṇikāḥ saṃskārāḥ iti tatas satya tanaya vat vāstavam eva kṣaṇika tvam bhāvyate satya tanaya bhāvanāyāḥ vā anyaḥ ākāraḥ vaktavyaḥ

original: kṣaṇikavikalpena kṣaṇikasvalakṣaṇāsparśāt kathaṃ tadvikalpo bhāvanā veti tanayavikalpe 'pi samānam | adhyavaseyāpekṣayā tadvikalpatvavyavasthā ca samānaiva | na hi tanayavikalpe 'py āropitād anyasya pratibhāsaḥ |
analyzed: kṣaṇika vikalpena kṣaṇika sva lakṣaṇa asparśāt katham tad vikalpaḥ bhāvanā vā iti tanaya vikalpe pi samānam adhyavaseya apekṣayā tad vikalpa tva vyavasthā ca samānā eva na hi tanaya vikalpe pi āropitāt anyasya pratibhāsaḥ

original: tad ayaṃ tanayabhāvanāyām āropitaśabdasaṃsṛṣṭapratibhāse 'pi satyatanayasphuṭībhāvam icchan prastutaṃ pratikṣipatīti kim anyamohamahāgrahagrāsībhāvāt |
analyzed: tat ayam tanaya bhāvanāyām āropita śabda saṃsṛṣṭa pratibhāse satya tanaya sphuṭībhāvam icchan prastutam pratikṣipati iti kim anya moha mahā graha grāsībhāvāt

original: [339,14] etac ca vikalpasphuradāropitāpekṣayā bāhyatvamātreṇa satyabhāvanāsāmyam uktam | bāhyāpekṣayā tu śokātur asya tanayabhāvanam abhūtabhāvanaiva | ata eva tadabhūtaṃ punaḥ sphurattanayakāraṃ tadā tādṛktanayābhāvād apramāṇam | kṣaṇikabhāvanā tu sadā tatprakṛtitvād dharmāṇāṃ bhūtaviṣayaiveti, tajjanitavaiśadyam avisaṃvādāt pramāṇam |
analyzed: etat ca vikalpa sphurat āropita apekṣayā bāhya tva mātreṇa satya bhāvanā sāmyam uktam bāhya apekṣayā tu śoka ātur asya tanaya bhāvanam abhūta bhāvanā eva atas eva tat abhūtam punar sphurat tanaya kāram tadā tādṛś tanaya abhāvāt apramāṇam kṣaṇika bhāvanā tu sadā tad prakṛti tvāt dharmāṇām bhūta viṣayā eva iti tad janita vaiśadyam avisaṃvādāt pramāṇam

original: atha vikalpasyāvastuviṣayatayā tanaye tanayabhāvane 'pi bhinnam eva vaiśadyam āpadyate nāsmanmata iti hṛdistham | tad api hṛdaya eva jīryatu | yoginirṇayo hi prārabdha eṣaḥ, tasya cobhayathāpi na kṣatiḥ |
analyzed: atha vikalpasya avastu viṣaya tayā tanaye tanaya bhāvane bhinnam eva vaiśadyam āpadyate na asmad mate iti hṛdistham tat api hṛdaye eva jīryatu yogi nirṇayaḥ hi prārabdhaḥ eṣaḥ tasya ca ubhayathā api na kṣatiḥ

original: apohasyāpi pramāṇena pariśuddhāv adhyavaseyasyaiva vaiśadyaṃ dṛṣṭam iti kim atra kriyatām? anumāne vastunirbhāsābhāvāt kathaṃ tadapekṣayā pramāṇapariśuddhir iti cet? prastāvāntaram etat |
analyzed: apohasya api pramāṇena pariśuddhau adhyavaseyasya eva vaiśadyam dṛṣṭam iti kim atra kriyatām anumāne vastu nirbhāsa abhāvāt katham tad apekṣayā pramāṇa pariśuddhiḥ iti ced prastāva antaram etat

original: [339,23] tac cedam, api ca bhāvyasya vastunaḥ punaḥ punaś cetasi niveśanam abhyāsaḥ | sa ca brahmacaryeṇa tapasā sādaradīrghakālanirantaram āsevito dṣṭhabhūmir asphuṭākārasya vikalpasya sphuṭābhatvajanana iṣṭaḥ | sa ca kṣaṇikanairātmyavādinā draṭhayitum aśakyaḥ | tathā hi, bhāvyagrāhī yādṛśo vikalpa utpannas tādṛśa eva niranvayaṃ nirudhyate |
analyzed: tat ca idam api ca bhāvyasya vastunaḥ punar punar cetasi niveśanam abhyāsaḥ sa ca brahmacaryeṇa tapasā sādara dīrgha kāla nirantaram āsevitaḥ dṣṭha bhūmiḥ asphuṭa ākārasya vikalpasya sphuṭa ābha tva jananaḥ iṣṭaḥ sa ca kṣaṇika nairātmya vādinā draṭhayitum aśakyaḥ tathā hi bhāvya grāhī yādṛśaḥ vikalpaḥ utpannaḥ tādṛśaḥ eva niranvayam nirudhyate

original: tasmiṃś ca niruddhe punar utpadyamānaḥ pratyayas tādṛśa evāpūrva utpadyate | tad anena paryāyeṇa kalpasahasre apy apūrvotpatter aviśeṣān na tajjanyaḥ saṃskāro 'bhyāsa utpadyate | etena viśiṣṭavijñānotpādo 'bhyāso vyākhyātaḥ |
analyzed: tasmin ca niruddhe punar utpadyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ tādṛśaḥ eva apūrvaḥ utpadyate tat anena paryāyeṇa kalpa sahasre api apūrva utpatteḥ aviśeṣāt na tad janyaḥ saṃskāraḥ bhyāse utpadyate etena viśiṣṭa vijñāna utpādaḥ bhyāsaḥ vyākhyātaḥ

original: niranvayaniruddhaṃ hi pūrvavijñānaṃ kathaṃ uttarottarāvasthāntaraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ janayet? sarvathā kramabhāvibhiḥ pratyayair avasthitam eva rūpaṃ śakyaṃ saṃskurtum iti |
analyzed: niranvaya niruddham hi pūrva vijñānam katham uttara uttara avasthā antaram viśiṣṭam janayet sarvathā krama bhāvibhiḥ pratyayaiḥ avasthitam eva rūpam śakyam saṃskurtum iti

original: [340,4] tad etad saṃgatam | na hi yādṛśa [eva] bhāvyagrāhī pratyayaḥ prathamo niranvayaniruddhaḥ, tādṛśa evāpara utpadyata iti niyamaniścayakāraṇaṃ kiñcid asti caṇṭadevatāsparśād anyat | kṣaṇikatvād iti cet? nanu kṣaṇikatvaṃ sthāyitayā virudhyate, na visadṛśotpādena |
analyzed: tat etat saṃgatam na hi yādṛśaḥ eva bhāvya grāhī pratyayaḥ prathamaḥ niranvaya niruddhaḥ tādṛśaḥ eva aparaḥ utpadyate iti niyama niścaya kāraṇam kiñcid asti caṇṭa devatā sparśāt anyat kṣaṇika tvāt iti ced nanu kṣaṇika tvam sthāyi tayā virudhyate na visadṛśa utpādena

original: tad dhi prācīnaṃ niranvayanirodhi yathā sadṛśaṃ kṣaṇānta[ra] m ārabhte, tathā yadi sāmagrībhedaleśato viśeṣaleśaniveśikṣaṇāntaram utpādayati tadā kā kṣatiḥ? na hi bhavata iva bhāvasyāpi kṣaṇikatāyāṃ pradveṣaḥ | asti cehāpi leśena sāmagrībhedaḥ |
analyzed: tat hi prācīnam niranvaya nirodhi yathā sadṛśam kṣaṇa antaram ārabhte tathā yadi sāmagrī bheda leśataḥ viśeṣa leśa niveśi kṣaṇa antaram utpādayati tadā kā kṣatiḥ na hi bhavataḥ iva bhāvasya api kṣaṇika tāyām pradveṣaḥ asti ca iha api leśena sāmagrī bhedaḥ

original: tathā hi kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārā ity anuvādamātrāpekṣayā saṃsāraduṛkhakṣayārthitayā bhāvanāyām abhiprayujyamānasya viśiṣṭa eva saṃkalpaḥ, so 'pi viśiṣṭam aṇumātrayātiriktaṃ janayati yāvat taratamādikrameṇāntimāt phalalābhaḥ, bījādivat | yadi tu vyāsaṅgādyo madhyamadhyāsīran mandatāditāratamyam eva syāt | yad bhāṣyam,
analyzed: tathā hi kṣaṇikāḥ sarva saṃskārāḥ iti anuvāda mātra apekṣayā saṃsāra duḥkha kṣaya arthi tayā bhāvanāyām abhiprayujyamānasya viśiṣṭaḥ eva saṃkalpaḥ viśiṣṭam aṇu mātrayā atiriktam janayati yāvat taratama ādi krameṇa antimāt phala lābhaḥ bīja ādi vat yadi tu vyāsaṅgāt yaḥ madhyam adhyāsīran manda tā ādi tāratamyam eva syāt yat bhāṣyam

original: [340,18] tathā hi prathamo viśeṣas tādṛgviśeṣavinākṛtād utpannaḥ | ayaṃ tu tādṛśaviśeṣasacivād iti kathaṃ samānaḥ syāt? anvayas tu vicārāsaha eva | yo hi hetutaḥ saṃkrānto bhāgas tatra nāparasya hetor vyāpāraḥ, ya eva vyāpāraḥ sa pūrvam asann eva | evaṃ yad aṅgasya nirodho na tasya sthitiḥ, sthitam ataś ca na nirodhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi prathamaḥ viśeṣaḥ tādṛś viśeṣa vinākṛtāt utpannaḥ ayam tu tādṛśa viśeṣa sacivāt iti katham samānaḥ syāt anvayaḥ tu vicāra asahaḥ eva yaḥ hi hetutaḥ saṃkrāntaḥ bhāgaḥ tatra na aparasya hetoḥ vyāpāraḥ yaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ sa pūrvam asān eva evam yat aṅgasya nirodhaḥ na tasya sthitiḥ sthitam atas ca na nirodhaḥ

original: tat kathaṃ sānvaye nirodhajanmanī? tena sahavṛtter iti cet? ākāśenāpi sānvayatvakalpanāprasaṅgāt | ubhayakālānuvṛttimātrajanyasya sahārthasyābhāvāt | tac ca kalasakapālayor nidhanasaṃbhavakāle 'ntarālasya na vāryate |

original: [341,3] yac cāha, kiṃ ca cittam ekāgram avasthāpayituṃ vikṣepatyāgārtham abhyāso 'nuṣṭhīyate, na ca kṣaṇikavādināṃ vikṣiptaṃ cittam asti, pratyarthaṃ niyatatayā sarvasyaikāgratvād iti | tad apy asaṃbaddham | anubhavasiddhaṃ hi cetasaḥ kasyacit tattvasaṃmukhīkaraṇam, kasyacid viparyayaḥ, kāryādimātraparāmarśo 'parasyeti |

original: tatra nairātmyāditattvaparāṇmukhaṃ sarvam eva cittaṃ vikṣiptam ucyate | uktakrameṇa tu tattvaikaniṣṭhaṃ samāhitam ity etāvatā kiṃ na paryāptam? yad avaśyam ekasyaiva vicitragocaracāritvam anveṣitavyam |

original: atha ca tattvasākṣātkriyākālāt prāgaham ity ekākārāvagrahasaṃbhavād vyāvahārikaṃ tad apy asati, yato mamaiva doṣakṣayo bhāvīti mārgābhyāsapravṛttir avyāhṛtā bhavati | prāpyasaṃkalpo hi sarvatra pravartakaḥ |

original: sa cedasti vastutathābhāvavyatireke 'pi kaḥ pravṛttiṃ nivartayati? yena hi tarhi tathānumānena niścitaṃ kṣaṇikatādi tasya pravṛttir iti cet? niścayasya sātmībhāvābhāvād anādyavidyāv āsanāvaśīkṛtena cetasā niścayānucitasaiva vyavahārasya pravartanāt | ata eva darśanamārge 'pi labdhe bhāvanāmārgāpekṣaṇam uktaṃ vārtike 'nveṣaṇīyam |

original: so 'pi sthūlagrāhī nāṇuśaḥ pratiniyamena deśam avasātuṃ śaktaḥ | tasmād atra tāvad vartate kiyantam api deśam (92b) abhivyāpyeti samānam | evaṃ grahaṇakāle 'pīndriyadeśaparimityasya pratiniyamaniścaya eva | sukhāder api vā sa eva nyāyo darśanaśravaṇajanitasyāpi | apriyāvalokanataptaṃ hi locanam eva priyadarśane śītalībhavad anubhūyate |
analyzed: saḥ pi sthūlagrāhī na aṇuśas pratiniyamena deśam avasātum śaktaḥ tasmāt atra tāvat vartate kiyantam api deśam abhivyāpya iti samānam evam grahaṇa kāle pi indriya deśa parimityasya pratiniyama niścayaḥ eva sukha ādeḥ api vā saḥ eva nyāyaḥ darśana śravaṇa janitasya api apriya avalokana taptam hi locanam eva priya darśane śītalībhavat anubhūyate

analyzed: kim ca parimāṇa niyama anavadhāraṇe yadi deśavat tā niṣedhaḥ kvacid kālavat tā tu sarvasya mā bhūt kṣaṇasya parimāṇena avadhārayitum aśakya tvāt kevalam pūrvam nā āsīt paścāt ca na bhavati iti pratiniyata kāla tām upasthāpayati sthavīyasī buddhiḥ iha api na bahis dehāt iha eva tu saumanasya ādi iti niścayaḥ sthitaḥ eva

original: kiṃ ca, kālayogas tāvad iṣṭa eva saumanasyādeḥ, anyathā kadāpy abhavataḥ sādhvī bādhakayuktiḥ, sa eva ca deśavattām upanayati, kvacid abhavataḥ kadācid bhāvayogāt | yatraiva cāsti sa eva deśaḥ, sa tu sthūlaḥ sūkṣmo veti kim anena | kāle tu prayojanāntarāpekṣayā niyamasthāpanam iti ||
